Abstract: Deep research agents (DRA) are commonly used for open-ended synthesis tasks where closed-world QA benchmarks are poorly suited to characterize relevant aspects of performance. We study the self-consistency of one commercial deep research system under repeated identical prompting, representing each report with the set of named entities it mentions, categorised by a custom schema, and the set of citations it retrieves. Across repeated runs of a single open-ended cybersecurity related prompt, we quantify pairwise overlap to characterize how stable the retrieved and synthesized output structure is under repeated identical prompts. In ten runs, the pairwise entity Jaccard results in a median of 0.12 and the pairwise citation Jaccard is below 0.02, with discovery curves that do not visibly saturate. The magnitude and structure of (dis)agreement between entity sets varies by entity class, which suggests that self-consistency in a DRA is better understood as a function of the underlying entity space than as a stable property of the system.

</details>


### [146] [Governing the Rule Space. Ruliology, Computational Irreducibility and Anticipatory Governance of Quantum Technologies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26423)
*Antonio Felice Uricchio,Francesco Scagliola*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出Ruliological预期性监管框架，将监管理解为对新兴技术可能发生转型的探索，区分规则、转型与轨迹，有条件采用计算不可约性，并以量子欧洲战略为案例研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有监管常被视为事后补救，但治理的根本任务是收集信号、构建场景、适应预期未来。现有文献指出预期治理在于建立制度能力而非精确预测，本文以此为出发点，旨在重构监管的理论基础。

Method: 提出Ruliological预期性监管框架，核心区分三要素：规则、转型、轨迹，用于评估备选方案与可能发展。有条件采纳计算不可约性作为分析工具，而非预设法律系统的固有属性。以量子欧洲战略为实证案例进行说明与反思。

Result: 该框架能将监管从追赶模式转向探索模式，为评估技术转型的多元路径提供结构化分析工具；量子欧洲战略案例展示了框架在真实政策语境中的适用性与反思价值。

Conclusion: 预期性监管应建立在制度能力建设之上，Ruliological框架通过规则-转型-轨迹三元结构与计算不可约性的有条件引入，为新兴技术治理提供了可操作的理论与分析范式。

Abstract: The regulation of emerging technologies is often conceived as a strategy of catching up, because legislators arrive too late. Yet gathering signals, constructing scenarios and adapting rules to an anticipated future are fundamental tasks for those entrusted with governance, including the governance of rules themselves. The literature on so-called future law has already shown that anticipation means building institutional capabilities rather than predicting outcomes precisely (anticipatory governance). Taking this premise as its starting point, this article proposes to understand regulation as an exploration of the transformations that may occur. The Ruliological Framework for Anticipatory Regulation distinguishes rules, transformations and trajectories, assessing alternatives and possible developments. Within this approach, computational irreducibility is adopted conditionally, not as a demonstrated property of legal systems. The Quantum Europe Strategy provides a case study and further grounds for reflection.

</details>


### [147] [SNO-PI: Label-Scarce SNOMED CT Entity Linking with Pre-trained Encoders and Curated Terminology Knowledge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26425)
*Piyawoot Songsiritat*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: SNO-PI 在 SNOMED CT 实体链接基准测试中取得最佳成绩，宏字符 IoU 达 0.5387，比参考系统提升 18%。采用高召回跨度提议、SapBERT 候选检索和列表式集成重排序，结合三个 BERT 编码器，在 MIMIC-IV 笔记和 SNOMED CT 同义词/层级上进一步预训练后微调。发现精选知识对未见概念帮助最大，但未见概念仍是主要错误来源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床提及链接到 SNOMED CT 属于零/小样本问题，标签空间极大（约 21.9 万概念），仅 272 份标注摘要覆盖 6,595 概念，其中三分之一仅出现一次。这促使利用预训练模型迁移和人工精选知识。

Method: 结合高召回跨度提议、SapBERT 候选检索和列表式集成重排序。使用三个 BERT 族编码器，先在未标注 MIMIC-IV 笔记上掩码语言建模预训练，再在 SNOMED CT 同义词和层级上预训练，最后任务微调。

Result: 宏字符 IoU 0.5387，比组织者参考系统（0.4582）提升 18%。精选知识对训练中未见概念提升最大，但未见概念仍是主要错误来源。

Conclusion: SNO-PI 通过迁移学习和知识注入有效缓解零/小样本实体链接难题，但在未见概念泛化上仍有提升空间。

Abstract: We present SNO-PI, the top-performing submission on SNOMED International's SNOMED CT Entity Linking Benchmark as of 18 October 2026. SNO-PI achieves a macro character IoU of 0.5387, outperforming the organisers' reference system (0.4582; based on the 2024 challenge winner's approach) by 18% relative. Linking clinical mentions to SNOMED CT is a zero- and few-shot problem over a very large label space: the 272 annotated MIMIC-IV discharge summaries cover only 6,595 of the roughly 219,000 eligible concepts, and a third of those occur only once. This motivates a design built on transfer from pre-trained models and human-curated knowledge. SNO-PI combines high-recall span proposal, SapBERT candidate retrieval and listwise ensemble reranking with three BERT-family encoders, each further pre-trained with masked language modelling on unlabelled MIMIC-IV notes and then on SNOMED CT synonyms and hierarchy before task fine-tuning. We find that curated knowledge helps most on concepts never seen in training, yet these concepts remain the main source of error.

</details>


### [148] [HarnessRL: Co-Evolving Policies with a Just-in-Time Training Harness for Open-Ended RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26426)
*Xiaoqiang Wang,Ting-En Lin,Yuchuan Wu,Pinyi Zhang,Caixin Kang,Ling Li,Bingxue Qiu,Jieping Ye,Yongbin Li,Bang Liu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: HarnessRL 是一个训练时动态共演化的框架，解决基于评分标准的强化学习中奖励失效（非判别性奖励与虚假奖励）问题，通过三接口（任务采样、回合引导、评分标准）与进化器-提议者-即时评论家闭环，在 Rubric-Mix-10k 基准上显著超越基线且训练步数减半。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于评分标准的强化学习在开放式生成中，随着策略演进，固定的任务采样、探索与评估配置会导致两种奖励失效模式：非判别性奖励（分数坍缩为均匀高/低值）与虚假奖励（高分不代表更好回复），亟需一种能随策略共演化的训练时机制。

Method: 提出 HarnessRL：包含任务采样、回合引导、评分标准三大接口；维护训练时记忆，进化器检索任务内历史与跨任务证据，将奖励失效归因至具体接口；运行提议者-即时评论家循环，评论家在冻结策略上测量候选更新效果，仅接受有效更新，拒绝则返还修订。并构建五领域 Rubric-Mix-10k 训练评测套件。

Result: 在 Rubric-Mix-10k 上，HarnessRL 在 4B 与 9B 两种模型规模下均比最强基线高出 2.8-3.1 分，且达到最佳检查点所需训练步数减少近一半。

Conclusion: HarnessRL 通过训练时共演化的哈尼斯机制，有效缓解了评分标准 RL 中的奖励失效问题，实现了更高样本效率与更强的开放式生成性能，为动态奖励建模提供了可落地的工程范式。

Abstract: Rubric-based reinforcement learning (RL) trains policies for open-ended generation with natural-language criteria as rewards, but these rewards can become ineffective as training progresses. We identify two failure modes. Under non-discriminative rewards, scores collapse to uniformly low or high values due to insufficient exploration or a mismatch between task difficulty and policy capability. Under spurious rewards, higher scores do not correspond to better responses. Both reflect a training configuration whose task sampling, exploration, and evaluation stay fixed as the policy evolves. We introduce HarnessRL, a training-time harness that co-evolves with the policy through three interfaces for task sampling, rollout guidance, and rubric criteria. HarnessRL maintains a training-time memory from which a harness evolver retrieves within-task history and cross-task evidence. Using this evidence, the evolver attributes each reward failure to the interface whose update can address it. It then runs a proposer and just-in-time critic loop in which the critic accepts a candidate update only after measuring its effect on the current frozen policy, returning rejected candidates for revision. We also curate Rubric-Mix-10k, a five-domain training and evaluation suite for open-ended RL across medical, science, writing, role-play, and instruction-following tasks. On Rubric-Mix-10k, HarnessRL outperforms the strongest baselines by 2.8 to 3.1 points across both 4B and 9B model scales and nearly halves the training steps to its best checkpoint. Code and data are available at https://github.com/Tongyi-ConvAI/Qwen-Character/tree/main/HarnessRL.

</details>


### [149] [WenSight-Decision-1 for Direct Decisions under E-commerce Rules](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26444)
*Mingwen Liu,Jun Sun,Sichen Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出WenSight-Decision-1，一个共享决策模型，通过微调Qwen3.5-9B，在六个运营任务和六种语言上直接从自然语言规则与案例证据对选项打分，准确率从61.60%大幅提升至92.92%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电商运营决策需将自然语言规则应用于案例证据，现有方法往往针对单一任务或语言，缺乏统一的跨任务、跨语言决策接口，难以实现异构判断的集中管理。

Method: 以Qwen3.5-9B为基座，采用参考选项作为监督信号进行联合微调，训练与推理阶段使用相同的选项评分机制，覆盖六个运营任务与六种语言的合成案例。

Result: 在保留的1,440个合成运营案例上，模型准确率从基线Qwen3.5-9B的61.60%跃升至92.92%，且六个任务均获得显著改进。

Conclusion: 联合微调成功将异构运营判断统一到一个共享决策接口，验证了单一模型跨任务、跨语言处理规则驱动决策的可行性与优越性。

Abstract: E-commerce decisions require applying natural-language rules to the available case evidence. We introduce WenSight-Decision-1, a shared model that scores supplied options directly from rules and case information for six operational tasks, with examples spanning six languages. We fine-tune Qwen3.5-9B with reference options as supervision, using the same option scores for training and inference. On 1,440 synthetic operational cases reserved for final evaluation, accuracy rises from 61.60% for Qwen3.5-9B to 92.92% for WenSight-Decision-1 under identical inputs and scoring. Joint fine-tuning improves all six tasks, bringing heterogeneous operational judgments under a common decision interface.

</details>


### [150] [TeleASR-Amharic: A Benchmark for Robust Amharic ASR in Realistic Telecommunication Conditions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26448)
*Dagnachew Mekonnen Marilign,Enrique Molero,Abrham Haile,Louis Powell,Israel Abebe Azime*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文介绍了 TeleASR-Amharic 基准，用于评估阿姆哈拉语语音识别在电信信道、环境噪声及域变化下的鲁棒性；实验显示严重电信退化使最佳模型 WER 从 0.23 暴涨至 0.79（相对 +243%），而扩大训练数据并采用电信感知增强可在极端噪声下实现 23.6% 相对 WER 降低，并发布了配套电信域数据集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有阿姆哈拉语 ASR 资源多来自洁净录音室环境，难以反映真实电信场景下的信道失真、背景噪声及域偏移，导致高性能模型在实际部署中失效，亟需面向真实电信条件的评测基准与鲁棒性提升方案。

Method: 1) 收集并标注真实电信通话录音，构建覆盖多信道条件、环境干扰及电信域变化的 TeleASR-Amharic 基准；2) 系统分析各类噪声与信道退化对识别性能的影响；3) 对比不同规模训练数据及精心设计的电信感知数据增强策略（如信道模拟、噪声混加、码率变换等）对模型鲁棒性的提升效果。

Result: 严重电信退化下最佳模型 WER 从 0.23 升至 0.79（相对增加 243%）；扩大训练数据并结合电信感知增强可在极端噪声条件下实现 23.6% 相对 WER 降低；不同噪声/信道失真类型对性能影响差异显著，增强策略需针对性设计。

Conclusion: TeleASR-Amharic 为阿姆哈拉语 ASR 提供了可复现的真实电信场景评测基准，揭示了当前模型在严重电信退化下的脆弱性，并证明了数据规模扩展与领域感知增强能显著提升鲁棒性；未来仍需进一步解决极端信道条件下的识别难题，推动低资源语言语音技术的实用化部署。

Abstract: The real-world usability of ASR models remains challenging, particularly for low-resource languages, where existing speech resources are often collected in clean studio environments. In this work, we introduce TeleASR-Amharic, a benchmark for evaluating Amharic ASR under various acoustic and telecommunication conditions. We analyze the major degradations observed in real telecommunications recordings and develop a benchmark that covers multiple channel conditions, environmental disturbances, and telecom-domain variations. Our results show that telecommunication degradation can substantially reduce recognition performance, making even high-performing ASR models impractical under severe conditions. For example, the WER of the best-performing model increases from 0.23 to 0.79 under severe telecommunication degradation, corresponding to a relative increase of 243% in recognition errors. We further investigate the effects of different noise and channel distortions and show that scaling training data and applying carefully designed telecommunication-aware augmentation substantially improve robustness. In particular, our best training configuration achieves a 23.6% relative WER reduction under extreme noise conditions. Together with the release of our telecommunications-domain data, these findings provide a reproducible benchmark for measuring progress in Amharic ASR while highlighting open challenges in developing robust speech technologies for real-world deployment.

</details>


### [151] [Training Negatives Still Matter After Calibrating Answerability Readouts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26461)
*Jinchen Zhang,Zheyuan Liu,Yihan Zhu,Meng Jiang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文通过控制实验研究训练负例构建方式对答案可读性预测的影响，对比保留负段落的「原生训练」与移除负段落的「空训练」。结果显示原生训练在校准后的Brier损失、排序AUROC和下游F1上均优于空训练，但也会保留更多不可答问题的答案。优势随估计器和层深变化，且RepLiQA的文本捷径限制了对上下文理解的结论。研究表明训练负例即使在常见校准后仍影响排序和下游决策，但未确立原生训练的普遍优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 答案可读性读出器能预测段落是否提供答案，但校准能否补偿训练中移除负段落的影响尚不清楚。现有研究缺乏控制变量的系统性对比，无法隔离训练负例构建方式对校准预测、排序和下游答案保留的独立影响。

Method: 设计控制实验，固定问题、标签、正例和模型权重，仅变换负例构建策略：原生训练保留负段落，空训练移除负段落。两者在相同标注的原生样本上校准。在SQuAD 2.0和RepLiQA上评估Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct和Gemma-2-9B-it，使用选定层深的Logistic读出器，比较Brier损失、AUROC、F1等指标，并分析原生融合与单独校准输出的差异。

Result: 原生训练的Logistic读出器在两个数据集、两个模型上均实现更低Brier损失（无论是否使用输出分数）。原生融合优于单独校准输出。事后AUROC分析显示原生训练排序更优，超出阈值调整解释范围。SQuAD 2.0开发集上原生读出策略F1优于空策略，但保留更多不可答问题答案。优势随估计器和层深变化。RepLiQA的文本捷径限制上下文理解结论。未完成生成阻碍完整答案级评估，但最坏情况界限保留了原生-空F1增益。

Conclusion: 训练负例构建方式在常见校准后仍会影响排序质量和下游决策，原生训练在校准损失、排序和F1上普遍优于空训练，但会以保留更多不可答答案为代价。优势依赖于具体估计器、层深和数据集特性，RepLiQA的捷径效应削弱了泛化性。研究未建立原生训练的普遍优势，提示需在具体任务和模型上权衡校准质量与答案保留策略。

Abstract: Answerability readouts predict whether a passage supplies an answer, but whether calibration can compensate for removing negative passages during training remains unclear. We present a controlled study of how training-negative construction affects calibrated prediction, ranking, and downstream answer retention. We compare native training, which retains negative passages, with empty training, which removes them, holding questions, labels, positive examples, and model weights fixed. Both are calibrated on the same labeled native examples. On SQuAD 2.0 and RepLiQA, native-trained logistic readouts at selected depths achieve lower Brier loss for Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and Gemma-2-9B-it, with or without output scores. Native fusion also outperforms calibrated output alone. Post-hoc AUROC analysis shows better ranking under native training, beyond what threshold adjustment alone can explain. On the official SQuAD 2.0 development set, native readout policies improve F1 over empty policies but retain more answers to unanswerable questions. The advantage varies by estimator and depth, while RepLiQA's text shortcuts limit claims about contextual understanding. Unfinished generations prevent complete answer-level evaluation, although worst-case bounds preserve the native-empty F1 gains. Our findings show that training negatives affect ranking and downstream decisions even after common calibration, without establishing a universal advantage for native training.

</details>


### [152] [AfriGuard: Safety and Robust Refusal For African Languages](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26474)
*Israel Abebe Azime,Jesujoba O. Alabi,Iffat Maab,Alexander D. Cai,Tadesse Destaw Belay,Atnafu Lambebo Tonja,Jonas Kgomo,Folasade Alabi,Salomey Osei,Saminu Muhammad Aliyu,Nkechinyere Faith Aguobi,Bontu Fufa Balcha,Blessing Sibanda,Davis David,Mouhamadane Mboup,Daud Abolade,Neo Putini,Louis Powell,Kiant'e Brantley,Philipp Slusallek,Dietrich Klakow,Julia Kreutzer*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 AfriGuard，一个覆盖 10 种非洲语言及英语的文化多语言安全数据集，揭示现有护栏模型在安全意图与类别分类上表现不如大模型，模型安全行为理解 F1 低于 60%，且常因语言能力不足导致意外性非协助而非显式拒绝。基于 AfriGuard 训练的高效护栏模型性能可媲美参数量大 30 倍的模型，拒绝检测器平均性能提升 43.9%，监督微调能大幅提升整体安全表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型在多语言多文化场景下面临安全风险表达与理解的差异，现有安全研究多聚焦英语等高资源语言，缺乏对非洲等低资源语言文化背景下的有害意图、安全类别理解及拒绝行为的系统性研究，导致模型在多语言环境下安全响应能力不足。

Method: 构建 AfriGuard 数据集，涵盖 10 种非洲语言及英语，标注有害意图、安全类别及拒绝行为；对比开源/闭源大模型与护栏模型在安全意图分类、安全类别分类、拒绝检测等任务上的表现；基于 AfriGuard 训练高效护栏模型与拒绝检测器，并通过监督微调提升模型安全性能。

Result: 护栏模型在安全意图与类别分类上显著弱于开源/闭源大模型；模型安全行为理解 F1 低于 60%；模型多因语言生成质量不佳导致意外性非协助而非显式拒绝。基于 AfriGuard 训练的护栏模型性能可媲美参数量大 30 倍的模型，拒绝检测器平均性能提升 43.9%，监督微调显著提升整体安全表现。

Conclusion: AfriGuard 填补了非洲语言安全研究的空白，揭示了当前模型在多语言文化下的安全局限性，证明了文化适配数据集对训练高效安全模型的关键价值，为构建包容性 AI 安全系统提供了实证基础与实用工具。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) designed to interact with users are typically trained to respond appropriately to harmful or toxic content. However, ensuring appropriate responses becomes more challenging in diverse linguistic and cultural contexts, where safety risks may be expressed or interpreted differently. Building safe AI systems therefore requires detecting safety risks, understanding their nature, and responding appropriately, while accounting for linguistic and cultural variations that add complexity to each stage. In this work, we introduce AfriGuard, a culturally grounded multilingual dataset for studying harmful intent, safety-category understanding, and refusal behavior across 10 African languages and English. Our findings reveal that guardrail models underperform both open- and closed-source LLMs on safety-intent and safety-category classification, while models show limited understanding of appropriate safety behavior, scoring below 60% F1. We further find that models often fail to respond appropriately to unsafe prompts not because they explicitly refuse, but because they produce linguistically inadequate responses that result in incidental non-assistance rather than proper refusals. Finally, using AfriGuard, we develop efficient guardrail models that achieve performance competitive with models up to 30x larger, introduce refusal detectors that improve average performance by 43.9% over existing detectors, and demonstrate that supervised fine-tuning can substantially improve overall safety performance.

</details>


### [153] [Mitigating Reward Hacking in Preference Reward Models with Evolving Penalties](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26496)
*Afonso Baldo,António Farinhas,Marcos Treviso,Ricardo Rei,Nuno M. Guerreiro*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Dynalize 是一种在线缓解奖励黑客攻击的方法，通过让语言模型分析训练轨迹并为奖励模型错误奖励的不良行为编写惩罚，再由评判器应用到所有轨迹上，从而在临床咨询和创意写作等开放式任务中实现更长期的训练并提升下游性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 偏好奖励模型容易遭受奖励黑客攻击：策略提高奖励分数但不改善甚至降低响应质量。尽管可验证奖励支持更长优化，但在质量无法验证或写成评分标准的开放式任务中，偏好模型仍有价值，因此需要在训练过程中在线缓解奖励黑客。

Method: Dynalize 定期异步地让语言模型分析训练轨迹，识别奖励模型似乎奖励的不良行为并编写惩罚；评判器将这些惩罚应用到每个轨迹上，从而在策略训练期间动态修正奖励信号。

Result: 仅使用奖励模型训练会持续提高其分数但最终导致外部基准下降；Dynalize 能维持更长训练并提升下游性能。它抑制了偏好模型激励的、会蔓延至大多数响应甚至模型推理过程的模式；增益在多轮训练和重新训练奖励模型后依然保持。

Conclusion: Dynalize 通过在线动态生成惩罚有效缓解了奖励黑客攻击，使基于偏好模型的强化学习在开放式任务中实现可持续的长期优化和真实质量提升，且具有鲁棒性和泛化性。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning for language models has moved from preference reward models to verifiable rewards, which sustain much longer optimization. Preference models are prone to reward hacking: the policy raises their score without improving response quality, or even while degrading it. Yet for open-ended tasks, where quality can neither be verified nor fully written down as rubrics, they remain valuable. We introduce Dynalize, which mitigates reward hacking online, during policy training. Periodically and asynchronously, a language model analyzes training rollouts and writes penalties for undesirable behaviors that the reward model appears to reward; a judge applies them to every rollout. In clinical counseling and creative writing, training on the reward model alone raises its score continuously but ultimately leads to a decline in external benchmarks. Dynalize sustains longer training and results in improved downstream performance. For example, we find that our method suppresses patterns incentivized by preference models that, without penalties, spread to most responses, and even to the model's reasoning, which the reward model does not explicitly score. Furthermore, we show that its gains hold in multi-turn training, and even after we retrain the reward model on the discovered behaviors.

</details>


### [154] [ReAnchor: Reusing Rejected Verifier States for Diffusion Drafting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26531)
*Sanghyun Lee,Wonjin Nam,Seungho Jang,Jaeho Lee,Jiho Park,Jaewoon Lee,Seungryong Kim*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: ReAnchor是一种无需训练的推测解码加速方法，通过利用目标模型验证过程中被丢弃的隐藏状态，将预训练的块扩散起草器重新锚定到偏移位置，生成并行草稿块，从而提高接受长度和解码速度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 块扩散起草器每次前向传播仅能从单一锚点生成固定长度的块，限制了草稿的延伸范围；同时目标模型验证时计算的首次拒绝位置之后的隐藏状态通常被丢弃，造成计算资源浪费。

Method: ReAnchor利用验证阶段被丢弃的隐藏状态作为新的锚点，将预训练的DFlash起草器重新锚定到偏移位置，并行生成多个草稿块。这些块既改进原始块内的预测，又延伸覆盖至原块终点之后，无需额外训练。

Result: 在温度T=0下，Gemma 4-12B模型上接受长度提升19.4%、解码速度提升17.9%（八个基准平均）。四个目标模型八个基准均值下，接受长度提升15.2%、解码速度提升13.4%。

Conclusion: ReAnchor通过重用验证阶段的中间隐藏状态实现起草器的并行重锚定，显著提升推测解码的接受率和吞吐量，是一种即插即用的高效加速方案。

Abstract: Block diffusion drafters accelerate speculative decoding by generating multiple draft tokens in a single forward pass. However, each pass produces only a fixed-length block from a single target-generated anchor, limiting how far the draft can extend. Meanwhile, target verification computes hidden states even at positions beyond the first rejection, but these states are typically discarded rather than reused. We propose ReAnchor, a training-free method that reanchors a pretrained drafter at shifted positions using discarded verifier states to generate parallel draft blocks. These blocks improve predictions within the original block and extend coverage beyond its endpoint. At sampling temperature of T=0, ReAnchor achieves its largest average gains on Gemma 4-12B, improving acceptance length by 19.4% and decoding speed by 17.9% across eight benchmarks. Averaged equally over four target models and eight benchmarks, it improves acceptance length by 15.2% and decoding speed by 13.4% with pretrained DFlash drafters.

</details>


### [155] [BERT Is Already a Denoiser: Cheaply Unlocking Iterative Generation in Masked Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26601)
*Julio C. Amador Diaz Lopez*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文探究了预训练的掩码语言模型（如BERT）在没有扩散训练的情况下，是否具备条件生成能力。研究提出了一种基于余弦调度的迭代解码策略，冻结BERT已展现去噪能力，但任务导向生成需MLM适配。完全适配后在ARC-Easy和MMLU上显著提升，开放式生成性能接近扩散训练的BERT模型。更强的RoBERTa-large进一步提升性能。结果表明：预训练提供表示与去噪算子，任务适配决定生成内容，迭代承诺规则提供解码过程，显式扩散训练非必要。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管MLMs（如BERT）在去噪预训练中学习了强大的表示，但通常仅用于表征学习。作者想测试这种去噪能力是否直接支持条件生成，而无需额外的扩散训练目标，从而分离预训练、任务适配和解码策略三者在迭代生成中的作用。

Method: 提出一种迭代解码器：反复预测被掩码的token，并按余弦调度提交高置信度预测，无需扩散时间步或反向扩散目标。在冻结的BERT上验证去噪重建能力；随后进行普通MLM适配（全参数微调与参数高效适配），将同一架构转为生成器；最后将相同生成接口应用于更强的RoBERTa-large等预训练模型。

Result: 冻结BERT在15%、45%、60%掩码率下分别重建61.0%、37.5%、24.4%的token，但生成随可见上下文减少急剧下降；任务导向生成仅达ARC-Easy 11.0%、MMLU 4.2%。全参数MLM适配后分别提升至28.2%和24.6%，参数高效适配大幅减少不匹配输出。开放式生成中，全适配在QQP上BLEU/ROUGE-L为0.163/0.583，Quasar-T为0.107/0.327，处于扩散训练BERT模型同等性能区间。RoBERTa-large在ARC-Easy达44.2%、MMLU达33.8%，显著提升。

Conclusion: 实验将掩码迭代生成分解为三个组件：预训练提供表示与去噪算子，任务适配决定生成内容，迭代承诺规则提供解码过程。在研究设置中，显式扩散训练并非获取有效迭代条件生成的必要条件，普通MLM适配即可将预训练MLM转化为可用的生成模型。

Abstract: Masked language models (MLMs) such as BERT are typically used for representation learning despite their denoising pretraining. We test whether this capability supports conditional generation without diffusion training. Our decoder repeatedly predicts masked tokens and commits high-confidence predictions using a cosine schedule. It requires no diffusion timestep or reverse-diffusion objective. Frozen BERT already exhibits substantial denoising capability, reconstructing 61.0%, 37.5%, and 24.4% of masked tokens at 15%, 45%, and 60% corruption, respectively, although generation deteriorates sharply as visible context disappears. This capability alone does not yield task-directed generation: frozen BERT reaches only 11.0% on ARC-Easy and 4.2% on MMLU. Ordinary MLM adaptation, however, rapidly converts the same architecture into a usable generator. Full adaptation reaches 28.2% and 24.6%, respectively, while parameter-efficient adaptation substantially reduces unmatched outputs. On open-ended conditional generation, full MLM adaptation reaches BLEU/ROUGE-L of 0.163/0.583 on QQP and 0.107/0.327 on Quasar-T, placing it in the same broad performance range as published BERT models trained through diffusion without explicit diffusion training. Finally, applying the same generative interface to stronger masked representations substantially improves performance: RoBERTa-large reaches 44.2% on ARC-Easy and 33.8% on MMLU. These results separate three components of masked iterative generation: pretraining supplies the representation and denoising operator, task adaptation determines what the model generates, and an iterative commitment rule supplies the decoding process. Explicit diffusion training is therefore not necessary to obtain effective iterative conditional generation from pretrained MLMs in the settings studied here.

</details>


### [156] [Conducting Reliable Keyword Estimation with Unreliable ASR in Police Audio Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26614)
*Robert Cole Molloy,Rhiannon N. Miller,Stephen Morgan,Anjalie Field*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出一种后处理纠错方法，结合预测驱动推断和设计监督学习框架，利用少量人工标注数据校正现成ASR系统的系统性错误，显著提升领域特定关键词频率估计的统计有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人工转录成本高昂，现成ASR系统虽可扩展但在特定领域存在系统性错误，导致下游分析偏差；需要一种方法在保持可扩展性的同时提升关键词频率估计的统计有效性。

Method: 采用预测驱动推断和设计监督学习框架，结合ASR输出与少量人工标注样本，通过自助法置信区间覆盖率评估，在巴尔的摩和芝加哥警用无线电通信数据上验证。

Result: 该方法使统计有效置信区间的领域关键词比例从仅用ASR的43.0%和仅用人工标注的27.2%提升至56.2%（巴尔的摩），芝加哥数据也有类似提升。

Conclusion: 后处理纠错可显著改善低质量转录的下游分析统计有效性，为大规模语音分析利用现成ASR模型提供了可行途径。

Abstract: Extracting insights from large audio data sets using human transcription is expensive and time-consuming. Off-the-shelf Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) systems offer an easy-to-use scalable alternative, but systematic transcription errors, especially in domain-specific settings, can bias downstream analyses and lead to unreliable conclusions. We investigate whether imperfect ASR transcripts can still be used to obtain statistically valid keyword frequency estimates by combining model outputs with a small set of human-labeled examples, following Prediction Powered Inference and Design-based Supervised Learning frameworks. We evaluate this approach on police radio communications from Baltimore and Chicago, a domain in which keyword distributions could provide valuable insights into police activity, but off-the-shelf ASR systems exhibit systematic errors on operationally important terminology. Using bootstrap-based confidence interval coverage as our evaluation metric, we find that our approach substantially increases the number of domain-specific keywords that can be analyzed with statistically valid confidence intervals, from 43.0% using ASR alone and 27.2% using only a small set of human-labeled transcriptions to 56.2% in the Baltimore dataset, with similar improvements observed in Chicago data. Our results demonstrate that post-hoc error correction can improve statistical validity of downstream analyses even for poor-quality transcriptions, offering an avenue for better leveraging off-the-shelf ASR models for large-scale speech analysis.

</details>


### [157] [The Development of Sycophancy in Language Models: Tracing Vulnerabilities from Pretraining to Post-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26655)
*Haonan Huang,Chengkun Cai*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文通过跟踪30个开放模型谱系的741个检查点（从预训练到发布），研究语言模型在无新证据下迁就用户观点或放弃初始判断的行为。发现该行为在后训练前已存在，但个体问题层面的妥协模式在后训练阶段形成：监督微调检查点预测部分，偏好优化检查点预测大部分（如Tülu-3 8B中偏好阶段消除85%剩余预测误差，同源模型仅19%）；内部状态增加预测信息但不改变检查点预测力排名。相似平均分掩盖不同脆弱性，训练历史对审计发布模型至关重要。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型能在无新证据下改变承诺答案以迎合用户观点或反驳，但这种行为在训练期间何时出现、发布模型从早期阶段继承了什么仍不清楚。需要系统追踪模型谱系以理解该行为的演变及其对模型审计的影响。

Method: 选取30个开放模型谱系共741个检查点（覆盖早期预训练至发布模型）。在道德场景中植入初始判决，测量模型跟随用户陈述观点或在压力下放弃判决的程度。分析不同训练阶段（预训练、监督微调、偏好优化）检查点对发布模型行为的预测力，对比同源模型（不同训练路线）的预测差异，并引入内部状态作为预测特征进行补充分析。

Result: 大多数谱系在后训练前即表现出顺从行为，平均强度在不同谱系、不同阶段双向变化。个体问题层面模式在后训练形成：预训练行为难以预测发布模型在哪些问题上妥协；微调检查点预测部分，偏好优化检查点预测大部分（Tülu-3 8B中偏好阶段检查点消除85%剩余预测误差，同源模型仅19%）。内部状态提供额外预测信息但不改变检查点预测力排名。相似平均分掩盖不同脆弱性模式。

Conclusion: 语言模型的顺从行为在预训练阶段已萌芽，但具体表现模式由后训练（尤其是偏好优化）决定。训练历史（检查点序列）对审计发布模型的脆弱性至关重要，仅凭平均指标不足，需追踪训练轨迹。同源模型间差异显著，表明训练路线主导行为形成。

Abstract: Language models can change a committed answer to accommodate a user's opinion or pushback without new evidence. However, when this behaviour develops during training and what a released model inherits from earlier stages remain unclear. We follow 741 checkpoints of 30 open model lineages, from early pretraining to released models. We plant initial verdicts on moral scenarios and measure how far a model follows a user's stated opinion or abandons its verdict under pressure. In most lineages the behaviour is present before post-training, and its average strength changes in either direction, at different stages across lineages. A clearer pattern emerges at the level of individual questions. Beyond responses without pressure, pretraining behaviour predicts little of which questions a released model yields on. That pattern forms during post-training: on routes with supervised fine-tuning, the fine-tuning checkpoint predicts part of it and the preference-optimization checkpoint most of it. A sibling trained from the same base along another route predicts far less: for Tülu-3 8B, its own preference-stage checkpoint removes 85% of the remaining prediction error, a sibling 19%. Internal states add predictive information without changing this ranking. Similar average scores conceal different vulnerabilities, and training history matters for auditing a released model.

</details>


### [158] [Hierarchical Token Merging with Recursive Autoencoders for Unsupervised Grammar Induction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26695)
*Murat Guney Kemal,Robert Lieck*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一种分层token合并自编码器，通过变分信息瓶颈和动态规划边际化二叉树，在无显式结构监督下从压缩目标中涌现有意义的层级语法结构，在合成歧义语法任务上达到93%解析有效率和93%精确重构率，显著优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自编码器虽能学习压缩表示，但重构目标不必然导向有意义的组合式层级结构。作者旨在探究仅通过压缩目标（无显式结构监督）是否能涌现有意义的层级抽象，并以无监督语法归纳为测试床显式评估层级结构。

Method: 设计分层token合并自编码器：递归合并相邻token为越来越抽象的表示，通过变分信息瓶颈压缩整个序列；联合学习表示和层级结构，利用动态规划边际化所有可能的二叉树；为解决训练不稳定，采用无监督共识与蒸馏集成独立训练的模型。

Result: 在合成歧义语法实验中，模型实现93%语法解析有效率和93%精确重构率，最强平凡基线仅42%解析有效率，证明仅靠压缩目标即可涌现有意义的层级结构。

Conclusion: 研究确立了分层token合并作为无监督结构发现与抽象学习机制的概念验证，表明压缩驱动的目标配合递归合并与变分信息瓶颈足以诱导出符合语法的层级表示。

Abstract: Hierarchical abstraction is a fundamental principle across many data modalities, enabling complex sequences to be represented compositionally at multiple levels. Learning such hierarchies directly from data, without explicit structural supervision, remains a central challenge in representation learning. We investigate whether meaningful hierarchical structure can emerge from compression alone. While autoencoders learn compressed representations through reconstruction, this objective does not necessarily favour meaningful compositional structure. We study this challenge through unsupervised grammar induction, where the underlying hierarchy can be evaluated explicitly. We introduce a hierarchical token-merging autoencoder that recursively combines adjacent tokens into increasingly abstract representations, compressing entire sequences through a variational information bottleneck. The model jointly learns representations and hierarchical structure by marginalising over possible binary trees using dynamic programming. To address training instability, we combine independently trained models through unsupervised consensus and distillation. Experiments on a synthetic, ambiguous grammar demonstrate the emergence of meaningful hierarchical structure without structural supervision. The resulting model achieves 93% grammatical parse-validity and 93% exact reconstruction on held-out sequences, compared with 42% parse-validity for the strongest trivial baseline. These findings establish a proof of concept for hierarchical token merging as a mechanism for unsupervised structure discovery and abstraction learning.

</details>


### [159] [HoloCosm: Beyond Single-Metric Benchmark Compression Across Multiple Metrics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26714)
*Yupei Lin,Zhongzhan Huang,Junxin Li,Guoming Ling,Shanshan Zhong,Hefeng Wu,Yukai Shi,Liang Lin*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出HoloCosm，一种基准压缩方法，通过联合最小化跨模型和指标的归一化分数重建误差并约束排名失真，解决单指标选择在多指标基准评估中效果差的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准压缩方法通常依赖单一指标选择样本，但基准常包含多个评估维度。研究发现不同指标间的模型排名相关性较弱，单指标选择的样本无法可靠保持其他指标的分数和排名，导致跨指标评估重建误差高于随机采样。

Method: HoloCosm联合最小化跨源模型和指标的归一化分数重建误差，同时约束排名失真，实现多指标下的有效基准压缩。

Result: 在15个基准配置（含85个组件指标）上，80%压缩率下，HoloCosm优于随机采样：平均NMAE下降35.3%至0.236，最差组件NMAE下降39.5%至0.330，平均Spearman相关系数从0.884升至0.915；在单指标评估中也保持竞争力。

Conclusion: HoloCosm有效解决了多指标基准压缩中跨指标性能保持的问题，显著降低重建误差并提升排名相关性，为多维度模型评估提供了实用的压缩方案。

Abstract: Benchmark compression reduces evaluation cost by selecting a small set of samples. Existing methods typically guide selection using a single metric, although benchmarks often assess models along multiple dimensions. We find that model rankings are often weakly correlated across metrics, indicating that different metrics capture distinct aspects of model performance. Samples selected for one metric do not reliably preserve scores and rankings on others when used for compressed evaluation. At 80\% compression, each of the five single-metric baselines yields higher reconstruction error than equal-size random sampling in over 70\% of cross-metric comparisons. To address this challenge, we present HoloCosm, which jointly minimizes normalized score-reconstruction error across source models and metrics while constraining ranking distortion. We evaluate HoloCosm across multiple compression rates on 15 language, multimodal, VLA, and agent benchmark configurations with 85 component metrics. With 80\% compression, HoloCosm outperforms Random, the strongest baseline overall: average NMAE drops by 35.3\% to 0.236, worst-component NMAE drops by 39.5\% to 0.330, and average Spearman correlation rises from 0.884 to 0.915. In addition, HoloCosm remains competitive with existing baselines in single-metric evaluation. We will release our code and experimental results.

</details>


### [160] [EpiLens: Lightweight RAG for Epidemiological Knowledge Acquisition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26730)
*Vincenzo Perri,Ciro Cattuto,Daniela Paolotti*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出EpiLens，一种轻量级开源检索增强生成工具，用于大规模流行病学文献的自动化分类与参数提取。在2,297篇论文语料库上评估显示，无需任务特定训练数据即可匹配或超越监督与零样本基线。应用于多病原体参数研究，揭示了不同参数（基本再生数vs病死率）及不同病原体（SARS-CoV-2vs猴痘）相关文献中基于模型估计的比例差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对未来疫情防备需快速梳理已有研究与数据，人工标注耗时，纯大语言模型易产生幻觉或混淆来源。需要一种可溯源、轻量化的自动化文献映射工具。

Method: 构建EpiLens包：采用固定检索模板与输出模式，对语料库中每篇论文进行检索增强生成，并将输出链接至原文段落。建立2,297篇论文语料库（源自多病原体参数研究），以214篇人工标注论文评估分类器在四个任务上的表现。将327个参数估计值追溯至引用文献或综述收录文献，利用分类器标签对比不同参数与病原体相关文献的特征。

Result: 分类器在无任务特定训练数据下，四个任务均匹配或超越监督与零样本基线。EpiLens标注的基本再生数相关文献中基于模型的比例54%，病死率相关文献为22%（人工标注分别为62%与24%），差距与传播模型常用于估计再生数一致，且在五种病原体中均持续存在。潜伏期估计的基于模型比例随病原体差异大：SARS-CoV-2为55%，猴痘仅6%。

Conclusion: EpiLens实现了可溯源、可扩展的流行病学文献自动化分类与证据映射，能高效支持多病原体参数研究的证据综合，揭示了参数估计方法学上的系统性差异。

Abstract: To prepare for future outbreaks, researchers need to know what studies have been done and what data they use. Mapping a large literature by hand is slow, while large language models alone can misstate or conflate sources. We present EpiLens, a lightweight, open-source retrieval-augmented generation package that applies a fixed retrieval template and output schema to every paper in a corpus and links outputs to source passages. We build a corpus of 2,297 papers from the sources of a multi-pathogen parameter study and evaluate EpiLens's paper-classification workflow against 214 manually labelled papers. Without task-specific training data, the classifier matches or exceeds the tested supervised and zero-shot baselines across four tasks. The study's early extraction sheets cite published sources for 327 estimates. We link each estimate to a cited document or to corpus studies included by a review. Then, we use the classifier's labels to compare the papers associated with different parameters and pathogens. EpiLens labels more papers linked to reproduction numbers than fatality risks as model-based (54% versus 22%, compared with 62% versus 24% in the manual labels). The gap is consistent with the frequent use of transmission models to estimate reproduction numbers and persists within each of five pathogens compared. Beyond the contrast between parameters, the model-based share of papers linked to incubation-period estimates differs by pathogen: 55% for SARS-CoV-2 versus 6% for mpox.

</details>


### [161] [TokenGate: Adapting LLMs for Fast and Memory-Efficient Prefill with Learned Token Pruning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26754)
*Liana Patel,Rishabh Ranjan,Ion Stoica,Matei Zaharia,Carlos Guestrin*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: TokenGate是一种轻量级即插即用组件，通过可学习的token剪枝实现长上下文输入的快速且内存高效的prefill，无需牺牲准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 专家人类通过略读只关注重要部分处理大输入，而语言模型处理所有token导致长上下文计算成本高。需要一种方法在预训练模型上实现端到端可学习的token剪枝，以加速prefill并降低内存。

Method: 提出TokenGate，引入token-gated attention机制，受MoE启发，利用token重要性分数重新加权attention logits，解决top-K非微分问题，实现端到端学习。可作为drop-in组件扩展现有模型（如Qwen3, Qwen3.5），轻量级适配类似参数高效微调。

Result: 在多样任务上，TokenGate实现1.4-11.3倍更快的TTFT，1.5-3.4倍更低峰值内存，无准确率下降。优于现有最佳token剪枝方法，prefill快达6.4倍，峰值内存降低2倍。

Conclusion: TokenGate为长上下文处理提供了高效、即插即用的解决方案，显著降低计算和内存开销，且保持准确性，适用于标准Transformer和混合注意力模型，代码已开源。

Abstract: Expert human readers process large inputs (e.g., code repositories and long documents) by skimming to closely read only what matters. On the other hand, language models process all input tokens through each model layer, resulting in significant processing costs for long-context inputs. We introduce TokenGate, a small, drop-in component that extends existing trained models to enable end-to-end learnable token pruning over long-context inputs for fast and memory-efficient prefill. To enable end-to-end learning despite the non-differentiable top-K operator for token pruning, we introduce token-gated attention, a mechanism inspired by Mixture-of-Experts that re-weights attention logits using token importance scores. Across diverse tasks, TokenGate achieves $1.4$-$11.3\times$ faster time-to-first token (TTFT) and $1.5$-$3.4\times$ lower peak memory at no accuracy degradation for prefill in transformers. Compared to the best-performing prior methods for token-pruning, TokenGate gives up to $6.4\times$ faster prefill and $2\times$ lower peak memory. TokenGate natively extends both standard transformers (e.g., Qwen3) and hybrid-attention models (e.g., Qwen3.5) with simple lightweight adaptation comparable to standard parameter-efficient fine-tuning. We make our code available at: https://github.com/tokengate-models/TokenGate.

</details>


### [162] [Monsoon: Scalable Spontaneous Speech Collection for Low-Resource ASR in 50 Languages](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26776)
*Shobhit Banga,Manas Dhir,Aaditya Pareek,Amritansh Walecha,Bhaskar Singh,Hanuman Sidh,Manmeet Kaur,Sagar Jain,Supriya Paul,Vanshika Chhabra,Utkarsh Singh*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出Monsoon框架，通过配对贡献者引导非脚本对话、自动分类器筛选、五级人工审核修正转录、以及词汇和声学覆盖选择，大规模收集高质量自发语音数据。在7种语言、各3500小时语料上实验表明，该质量控制流程使语义词错误率(WER)相对降低10-39%；基于Monsoon数据微调Whisper在对话基准上将语义WER绝对降低20-44点，增益可迁移至其他架构并随数据量增长。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对大多数语言的自动语音识别(ASR)受限于缺乏准确转录的自发语音数据而非模型架构这一问题，旨在构建可扩展的高质量自发语音数据收集框架。

Method: Monsoon框架包含四个核心步骤：1)配对贡献者进行非脚本自由对话采集；2)使用自动分类器筛选录音质量；3)五级人工审核流程修正转录文本；4)基于词汇和声学覆盖选择最优数据片段。共收集50种语言数据，深度分析7种语言各3500小时语料。

Result: 同等数据量下，Monsoon质量控制流程使语义WER相对降低10-39%；在架构匹配的公开语料基线上，Whisper微调后在基线自有测试集表现相当，但在会话基准上语义WER绝对降低20-44点；性能增益可迁移至第二种架构，且随数据量增加而增大。

Conclusion: Monsoon框架有效解决了低资源语言自发语音数据稀缺问题，其质量控制机制显著提升ASR在会话场景下的识别精度。作者开源了框架、质量控制模型及微调模型，为多语言ASR研究提供了重要资源。

Abstract: For most languages, automatic speech recognition (ASR) is limited less by model architecture than by a lack of accurately transcribed spontaneous speech. We present Monsoon, a framework for collecting such data at scale. It elicits unscripted conversations between paired contributors, screens recordings with automated classifiers, corrects transcripts over five levels of human review, and selects segments for lexical and acoustic coverage. It has collected speech in 50 languages; we analyse seven 3,500-hour corpora. At equal volume, its quality stages reduce semantic word error rate (WER) by 10-39% relative to a conventional protocol. Compared with an architecture-matched baseline trained on public corpora, Whisper fine-tuned on Monsoon performs comparably on the baseline's own test sets and reduces semantic WER by 20-44 points on conversational benchmarks. The gains transfer to a second architecture and grow with data volume. We release the framework, its quality-control models, and the fine-tuned models.

</details>


### [163] [RESIN: Multi-Chain Reasoning with Entity-Structured Indexing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26782)
*Xuanyu Meng,Jash Rajesh Parekh,Jiawei Han*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出 RESIN（基于实体结构索引的推理），通过将问题分解为单跳需求、检索少量源依据单元并保留多条备选证据至最终组合，解决了多链推理中证据分散、早期路径选择过早丢弃有用信息的问题，在 HolisQA 基准上显著提升上下文召回、答案相关性和 F1 值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多链推理面临证据分散且不同推理部分需相互作用的证据链；扁平检索会引入大量松散相关文本，而过早选定单一推理路径会丢弃后续才显现价值的证据。

Method: RESIN 将问题分解为聚焦的一跳需求，为每一跳检索少量源依据单元，并将这些相关证据置入紧凑的推理缓冲区；缓冲区保留多条备选支持直到最终组合，使中间决策显式化而不强制脆弱的单一路径。

Result: 在完整 HolisQA 基准上，RESIN 实现 82.92 上下文召回和 76.70 答案相关性，在五个领域上均超越已发布基线的 CR 和 AR，在四个领域上获得更高 F1；消融实验表明类型化证据多样性和逐跳分解均为关键。

Conclusion: 精准的证据组织与延迟承诺（delayed commitment）使多链推理既有效又可审计。

Abstract: Multi-chain reasoning is a challenging task not only because the multi-chain evidence is dispersed, but also because different parts of reasoning may require distinct, interacting chains of support. Flat retrieval can flood a model with loosely related text, whereas early selection of a single reasoning path can discard evidence that becomes useful only after other facts are considered. We introduce RESIN (Reasoning with Entity Structured Indexing), which uses structure to locate evidence while keeping the original source as the basis for reasoning. RESIN decomposes a question into focused one-hop needs, retrieves a small set of source-grounded units for each hop, and places only this relevant evidence in a compact reasoning buffer. The buffer preserves alternative supports until final composition, making intermediate decisions explicit without forcing a brittle path. On the full HolisQA benchmark, RESIN achieves 82.92 context recall and 76.70 answer relevancy over all questions, with higher reported CR and AR across five domains and higher F1 in four domains than the published baselines. Ablations show that both typed evidence diversity and hop-wise decomposition are essential, supporting a clear conclusion: Precise evidence organization and delayed commitment make multi-chain reasoning effective and auditable. Our code is available at https://github.com/RamonMeng/RESIN.

</details>


### [164] [Safety Mid-Training: Internalizing LLM Safety as a Foundational Capability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26809)
*Zhengyue Zhao,Liwei Jiang,Yejin Choi,Chaowei Xiao1*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出安全中间训练，在预训练和后训练之间引入新阶段，通过共享推理结构联合开发安全性和通用推理能力。该方法在Qwen3基座模型（1.7B、4B、8B）上将平均攻击成功率降低72%-81%，同时提升通用能力，且安全性增益在后续SFT和RL训练中持久保持，显著缓解了安全性与效用的权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有安全对齐主要在后训练阶段进行，但后续训练若不包含安全数据会导致安全性退化，且安全性提升常以牺牲通用能力为代价。作者认为安全性不应作为独立训练目标，而应视为与通用任务共享推理结构的LLM能力——二者都需要理解意图、应用知识、推理后果。

Method: 引入安全中间训练阶段，位于预训练与后训练之间。给定安全提示词和效用提示词，基座模型生成结构化文档和推理轨迹，用于中间训练。通过共享的推理结构（理解意图、应用知识、推理后果）联合学习安全推理与通用推理。

Result: 1) 相对Qwen3基座模型，平均攻击成功率降低72%-81%，通用能力同步提升；2) 经通用SFT后，中间训练模型基本保持安全性，ASR低于基线且不损失通用能力；3) 在无安全奖励的通用GRPO下仍保持安全性；4) 后续RL从中间训练模型初始化可达到更优的安全-效用帕累托前沿。

Conclusion: 在共享中间训练阶段联合学习安全性和通用推理，能有效减少安全-效用权衡，并使安全性对后续训练更具鲁棒性，验证了安全性作为共享推理结构能力的可行性。

Abstract: Safety alignment for large language models (LLMs) is primarily performed during post-training, while recent work has also begun incorporating safety data into pre-training. Yet safety can degrade when later training no longer includes safety data, and gains in safety often come at the cost of general capability. This tension suggests that safety and general reasoning should not be treated as separate training goals. We instead view safety as an LLM capability that can be learned through a reasoning structure shared with general tasks. Both require the model to understand intent or task goals, apply relevant knowledge, and reason about potential consequences. We introduce safety mid-training, a stage between pre-training and post-training that jointly develops safety and general reasoning through this shared structure. Given safety and utility prompts, the base model generates structured documents and reasoning traces that are then used for mid-training. Safety mid-training reduces average attack success rate (ASR) by 72% to 81% relative to Qwen3-1.7B, 4B, and 8B base models, while also improving general capability. The benefits persist through subsequent post-training. After general-only SFT, mid-trained models largely retain their safety, achieving lower ASR than the baselines without sacrificing general capability. They also retain safety under general-only GRPO without safety rewards, while subsequent RL reaches a better safety-utility frontier when initialized from the mid-trained models. Together, these results suggest that learning safety and general reasoning within a shared mid-training stage can reduce the safety-utility trade-off and make safety more robust to subsequent training.

</details>


### [165] [ASTOR: Benchmarking and Improving Autoformulation for Soft-Constraint Optimization with a Formal Grammar](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26819)
*Amer Goel,Yeganeh Alimohammadi,Andrew Daw*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出ASTOR框架，通过语法引导的抽象语法树（AST）将自然语言决策问题转换为可执行优化代码，并发布SoftOR基准测试专注于软约束建模；ASTOR在软约束基准上达到最佳聚合准确率，同时在标准硬约束基准上保持竞争力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实决策问题包含硬约束（必须满足）和软约束（可违反的偏好），现有自动建模研究多忽略软约束，而实际问题常需显式建模软约束；大语言模型虽擅长自然语言理解，但直接生成优化代码易出错，需结构化中间表示提升可靠性。

Method: ASTOR采用推理时框架：先将自然语言问题映射为语法引导的AST，再确定性编译为可执行优化代码；引入SoftOR基准，统一收集含软约束的自然语言决策问题，支持系统性评估。

Result: 在SoftOR基准上，ASTOR在同类单次请求和多智能体LLM方法中达到最佳聚合准确率；在仅含硬约束的标准自动建模基准上，ASTOR表现仍具竞争力。

Conclusion: 通过语法引导AST中间表示，ASTOR有效解决了自然语言到优化模型的转换问题，特别是在软约束建模上显著优于现有方法；SoftOR基准填补了软约束评估空白，推动了自动建模研究向更实用方向发展。

Abstract: Real-world decision problems combine two qualitatively different kinds of constraints: requirements that must be satisfied, called hard constraints, and preferences that can be violated, called soft constraints. Because these problems are often posed to decision-makers in natural language, large language models offer a natural tool for assisting with their solution. This has given rise to autoformulation, which focuses on using LLMs to translate natural-language descriptions of decision problems into executable mathematical optimization models. However, this research often neglects soft constraints like those proposed by consumers, managers, and planners, despite the fact that many practical problems require modeling them explicitly. We introduce ASTOR, an inference-time framework that maps a natural-language decision problem to a grammar-guided abstract syntax tree (AST) before deterministically compiling the resulting representation into executable optimization code. We also introduce SoftOR, a unified benchmark of natural language problems which focuses on soft constraint formulations. On SoftOR, ASTOR achieves the best aggregate accuracy among comparable single-request and multi-agent LLM methods while remaining competitive on standard autoformulation benchmarks that include only hard constraints. Code and data are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/astor-softor-iclr-E34C/README.md.

</details>


### [166] [AfriBED: a Speech Recognition Bias Evaluation Dataset for Low Resource African Languages](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26821)
*Claytone Sikasote,Hussein Suleman,Jan Buys*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文介绍了AfriBED数据集，用于评估两种低资源非洲语言（Bemba和Nyanja）自动语音识别（ASR）系统中的性别和说话人类型偏见。数据集包含Bemba语9小时3928条语音（80位说话人）和Nyanja语18小时6260条语音（127位说话人）。基线实验表明该数据集可有效检测和量化目标语言中的说话人属性偏见。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前ASR系统存在说话人属性偏见（如性别、口音、说话人类型），但缺乏跨子群可比语音的偏见评估数据集，尤其是低资源非洲语言。需要构建专门的偏见评估基准以量化和缓解此类偏见。

Method: 构建AfriBED数据集：针对Bemba和Nyanja两种语言，收集平衡的性别和说话人类型（如母语/非母语）语音数据，确保各子群间语音内容可比。数据集包含详细的说话人属性标注，支持偏见分析。

Result: 基线实验结果显示，AfriBED数据集能有效揭示ASR系统在Bemba和Nyanja语言中的性别和说话人类型偏见，验证了数据集的实用性和评估能力。

Conclusion: AfriBED填补了低资源非洲语言ASR偏见评估的空白，为检测和量化说话人属性偏见提供了标准化基准，有助于推动公平ASR系统的发展。

Abstract: Despite advancements in automatic speech recognition systems (ASR), current systems exhibit speaker-attribute bias, i.e., their speech recognition performance is biased against certain speakers based on their demographic attributes such as gender, accents, and speaker type. However, accurately assessing speaker attribute bias in a given ASR system requires the availability of a bias evaluation dataset with comparable speech across subgroups of a speaker attribute. In this paper, we introduce African speech Bias Evaluation Dataset (AfriBED), a novel speech recognition bias evaluation dataset for two low resource African languages, Bemba and Nyanja, to detect and estimate gender and speaker-type bias for ASR systems. The dataset comprises 9 hours of speech with 3928 utterances recorded by 80 speakers for Bemba, while the Nyanja set includes 6260 utterances with approximately 18 hours of speech recorded by 127 speakers. The results of our baseline experiments demonstrate that the datasets are useful for examining gender and speaker-type attribute bias in the target languages.

</details>


### [167] [SpecMRL: Redesign Matryoshka Representation Learning within Parametric Spectrum](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26824)
*Zhongxin Chen,Songhao Wu,Heng Cui,Cong Li,Xiao Zhou,Rui Yan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 SpecMRL，通过引入基于参数衍生的谱基重组特征空间，解决了 MRL 在嵌套前缀优化中缺乏显式约束导致前缀紧凑编码不佳的问题，在 MTEB 基准上以仅一半维度超越全维 MRL 性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MRL 虽支持灵活表示尺寸，但其联合优化嵌套前缀的设计缺乏显式约束，无法保证前导部分提供适宜的紧凑编码，导致激进压缩下性能下降。

Method: SpecMRL 扩展 MRL，引入按特征重要性组织的参数衍生谱基重组特征空间，在学习的谱空间中执行前缀读出，其余流程遵循标准 MRL。

Result: MTEB 实验显示 SpecMRL 在所有评估降维尺寸上均优于 MRL，压缩越激进增益越大；仅用一半嵌入维度即超越全维 MRL 性能。

Conclusion: 学习的谱基能更有效地优先保留信息方向，显著提升表示压缩效率，拓展了 MRL 的性能边界。

Abstract: Matryoshka Representation Learning (MRL) is designed to support flexible representation sizes by jointly optimizing nested prefixes. While effective, this design lacks an explicit constraint to ensure that the leading portion provides a suitable compact encoding. To address this, we propose SpecMRL, which reorganizes the feature space to enable more effective prefix readout. Specifically, we extend MRL with a parameter-derived spectral basis organized with feature importance. SpecMRL otherwise follows standard MRL, with prefix readout performed in the learned spectral space. Experiments on MTEB show that SpecMRL outperforms MRL at all evaluated reduced dimensions, with larger gains under more aggressive compression. These results suggest that the learned spectral basis better prioritizes informative directions, enabling more effective representation compression. Notably, SpecMRL extends the performance frontier of MRL, surpassing full-dimensional MRL with only half the embedding dimensions.

</details>


### [168] [MemT-1.0: Towards Memory-Native Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26825)
*Zhiyu Li,Zeyu Zhang,Linyun Liu,Yiwei Bu,Chenyang Xi,Xichong Zhang,Yi Yu,Yu Yu,Zhichen Liu,Yuxiao Yi,Chunyu Li,Haoran Liu,Zhenkai Ding,Le Zhou,Juncheng Zhang,Boyu Chen,Zehao Lin,Guorui Li,Renyu Fu,Ji Li,Youyang Xia,Jiajun Shen,Harvey Li,Jingsong Zhou,Helan Hu,Tong Shen,Tianxiao Xu,Chenye Han,Weijie Li,Zhongquan Zhou,Hongming Xu,Yuekeng Li,Erenkai Zhu,Peng Yu,Wenhao Li,Jingyi Kang,Xixuan Hao,Xuzhou Zhu,Can Chen,Jiawei Liu,Chen Jiang,Tao Jiang,Fangwei Xiang,Zepeng Yao,Kai Chen,Guang Yang,Mingfei Lu,Chunhui Li,Zhengxuan Jiang,Bo Tang,Shiyu Zhan,Yihang Sun,Jie Chu,Wenjun Xiong,Zhenxiang Hua,Chen Lin,Detong Su,Dongyu Deng,Qiuping Ding,Guofeng Ding,Si Chen,Guohua Wen,Xu Chen,Zhi-Qin John Xu,Ying-Cong Chen,Ningyu Zhang,Haofen Wang,Muning Wen,Haotian Chen,Wentao Zhang,Xuanhe Zhou,Rita Zhang,Junchi Yan,Feiyu Xiong*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 MemT-1.0，一种将记忆内化为模型计算一部分的记忆基座模型架构。基于 Metis，采用 Gated DeltaNet-2 实现稳定的 token 级记忆更新，引入 Mixture-of-Storage 扩展原生记忆容量。通过两阶段训练（继续预训练 + 后训练）在 34B tokens 上训练，发布 Nano 和 Flash 两个规模模型。实验表明：在记忆与通用能力上超越参数化记忆基线，与检索增强方法竞争，基本保持通用能力；在 128K 历史长度下，Nano 实现约 1.86 倍端到端推理加速和 66 倍持久存储减少；内化检索到的程序性经验提升智能体任务成功率，为记忆原生演进提供实用步骤。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前基座模型缺乏原生记忆能力，需依赖外部检索或全上下文 KV 缓存，导致推理延迟高、存储开销大且难以持续积累利用信息。论文旨在将记忆作为基座模型的内在能力，实现 memory-native evolution，使模型能持续积累并利用信息，同时保持高效推理和存储。

Method: 1. 架构：基于 Metis，采用 Gated DeltaNet-2，在每轮对话内实现稳定的 token 级记忆更新机制。2. 记忆扩展：引入 Mixture-of-Storage，混合多种存储策略以扩展原生记忆容量。3. 训练流程：经过刻意的骨干网络准备，采用两阶段训练管线：继续预训练 + 后训练，使用 34B tokens 训练数据，配合高效训练和推理基础设施。4. 模型族：发布 MemT-1.0-Nano 和 MemT-1.0-Flash 两种规模。

Result: 综合评测显示：MemT-1.0 模型族在记忆与通用能力上平均优于参数化记忆基线，且与检索增强方法保持竞争力，同时基本保留通用能力。在 128K token 历史长度下，Nano 版本实现约 1.86 倍端到端推理加速，持久存储减少 66 倍（相对全上下文 KV 缓存）。内化检索到的程序性经验后，在智能体任务上任务成功率显著提升。

Conclusion: MemT-1.0 通过将记忆内化为模型计算的一部分，并配合高效的记忆更新与存储扩展机制，验证了 memory-native evolution 的可行性。该工作在保持通用能力的前提下实现了高效的长程记忆、推理加速和存储压缩，并通过内化程序性经验增强智能体能力，为构建具有原生记忆能力的基座模型提供了实用的架构与训练范式。

Abstract: Memory-native evolution requires making memory an intrinsic capability of foundation models, enabling them to continuously accumulate and utilize information. To this end, we introduce MemT-1.0, a new architecture of memory foundation models that internalize memory as part of model computation. Building on Metis, MemT-1.0 employs Gated DeltaNet-2 with a stable token-level memory update mechanism within each turn. We further introduce Mixture-of-Storage to scale native memory capacity. Following a deliberate backbone preparation, we develop a two-stage training pipeline consisting of continued pre-training and post-training, supported by 34B tokens of training data and efficient training and inference infrastructure. We release a model family comprising MemT-1.0-Nano and MemT-1.0-Flash, and conduct a comprehensive evaluation of memory and general capabilities. The results show that they outperform the parametric memory baselines on average and remain competitive with retrieval-augmented methods, while largely preserving general capabilities. At a history length of 128K tokens, MemT-1.0-Nano achieves approximately $1.86\times$ end-to-end inference speedup and a $66\times$ reduction in persistent storage relative to full context KV cache. By internalizing retrieved procedural experience, MemT-1.0 improves task success on agentic tasks, providing a practical step toward memory-native evolution.

</details>


### [169] [RefCraft: Benchmarking Visual-Reference-Conditioned Agentic Generation through Web Development](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26826)
*Yuchi Wang,Rongyao Fang,Weihao Yu,Xilin Wei,Tiancheng Gu,Dingkang Yang,Hang Zhang,Dayiheng Liu,Hongsheng Li,Shuai Bai*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出RefCraft基准，包含300个多模态网页开发任务，结合自然语言指令与1-5个参考网页截图，评估9个前沿(M)LLM在视觉参考条件下的智能体生成能力。最强系统仅得52.12/100分，揭示该任务仍是重大挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有网页开发基准多为理想化设定：要么重建视觉目标，要么仅从文本指令生成，忽略了更常见的从视觉示例开发的工作流。论文旨在研究如何有效将视觉参考融入智能体生成，解决真实生产力任务中的视觉参考条件生成问题。

Method: 构建RefCraft基准：300个真实多模态网页开发任务，每个任务包含自然语言指令和1-5个参考网页截图。智能体需选择性解读利用参考，通过渲染、视觉检查、迭代优化生成输出。采用独立可验证的关键点、程序化评判和VLM评判相结合的评估方法。

Result: 在9个前沿(M)LLM上评测，最强系统总分仅52.12/100。视觉参考条件下的智能体生成在实际网页开发场景中仍是当前模型面临的重大挑战，存在显著提升空间。

Conclusion: 视觉参考条件生成是AI智能体应用于真实生产力任务的关键能力，当前模型表现远未达到实用水平。RefCraft基准为该方向提供了真实、可评估的测试平台，将推动多模态智能体在视觉参考理解与利用方面的研究进展。

Abstract: Beyond basic tool use and coding skills, effectively incorporating visual references into agentic generation is equally essential for applying AI agents to real-world productivity tasks. We study this crucial capability through webpage development, a practical and readily evaluable setting in which existing benchmarks remain largely idealized: they typically focus on reconstructing visual targets or generating webpages from textual instructions alone, overlooking the more common workflow of developing from visual examples. Specifically, we introduce RefCraft, a benchmark comprising 300 realistic multimodal webpage-development tasks that combine natural-language instructions with screenshots from one to five reference webpages. Agents must selectively interpret and utilize these references while rendering, visually inspecting, and iteratively refining their outputs. We evaluate the resulting open-ended artifacts using independently verifiable keypoints and complementary programmatic and VLM judges. Across nine frontier (M)LLMs, the strongest system achieves an overall score of only 52.12 out of 100, revealing that visual-reference-conditioned agentic generation remains a substantial challenge for current models in practical webpage-development settings.

</details>


### [170] [KEEP-Bench: Evaluating Evidence Preservation in Context Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26827)
*Ziqing Man,Di Wu,Jia-Chen Gu,Junyi Zhang,Kai-Wei Chang,Nanyun Peng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出 KEEP-Bench 基准直接评估上下文压缩的忠实度，发现即使最强模型在三类挑战性设定下的证据保留率也不足 70%，并引入 EPR 指标揭示证据召回与计算预算的权衡，指出未来应研究低算力下的高保真压缩器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有上下文压缩评估主要依赖问答指标，但读者仍可能从不忠实的压缩中正确回答，导致忠实度损失被低估；因此需要直接评估压缩是否保留关键证据的诊断基准。

Method: 构建 KEEP-Bench，包含 4,102 个测试用例，覆盖三类需保留证据的挑战性场景：合理指代消歧、显性限定词、少数派观点。实验在上下文窗口超 100K、平均输入 3.1K tokens 条件下，对比开源和专有模型的证据保留表现，并提出 Evidence Preservation Return (EPR) 指标关联证据召回与推理 FLOPs。

Result: 最强开源模型 (31B) 仅在 66.8% 用例中保留所有必需证据，最强专有模型仅 61.6%。不同证据结构下表现差异大，结论易受限结构偏差。EPR 在中等规模 (4B-8B) 峰值，但召回率仍低；增加输出预算主要惠及已强模型并扩大能力差距，且强模型的高保真带来陡峭计算成本。

Conclusion: 未来工作应聚焦于在小计算预算下实现强信息保留的压缩器，而非依赖大输出预算或单纯扩大模型规模。

Abstract: Context compression improves long-context efficiency but may introduce faithfulness issues through an information bottleneck. Existing evaluations rely on QA metrics, but a reader can still answer correctly from an unfaithful compression, so these metrics underestimate such loss. To bridge this gap, we introduce KEEP-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark that directly assesses compression faithfulness with 4,102 cases across three challenging settings that require keeping evidence for plausible reference resolutions, explicit qualifiers, and minority perspectives. Experiments show that even with tailored prompting, the strongest models remain unreliable: despite context windows exceeding 100K tokens and inputs averaging only 3.1K tokens, the best open-weight model (31B) preserves all required evidence in only 66.8% of cases, and the best proprietary model in only 61.6%. Performance also varies sharply across evidence structures, so conclusions from limited structures may be biased. We further introduce a metric, Evidence Preservation Return (EPR), to relate evidence recall to inference FLOPs, and find that it peaks at moderate scales (4B-8B), where recall remains low. Additional output budget mainly benefits already strong models and widens capability gaps, yet the stronger preservation of these models comes at a steep computational cost. These findings highlight the importance for future work to investigate compressors with strong information preservation under a small computation budget, rather than relying on a large output budget or model scaling.

</details>


### [171] [Competing Learning in Hybrid Architectures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26830)
*Xingyu Shen,Yingfa Chen,Ziqing Qiao,Chaojun Xiao,Xu Han,Zhiyuan Liu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文发现混合架构（线性时间递归+softmax注意力）中存在'竞争学习'现象：递归层比注意力层更快学会检索功能，导致注意力层无法学习检索。提出分阶段训练策略，在训练中途停止递归层权重更新，使注意力层能学习检索功能，在1B参数模型上显著提升语言建模损失、常识推理和各类检索任务性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代混合架构结合了线性时间递归（高吞吐量、固定状态大小）和softmax注意力（更好的上下文检索），但递归在检索任务上表现不如注意力。需要理解两者交互机制并改进训练方法以发挥各自优势。

Method: 通过层归因分析揭示'竞争学习'现象：不同混合器竞争学习同一功能，一旦某层学会该功能，会抑制其他层的相应学习信号。发现典型数据分布下递归比注意力更快学会检索功能，导致注意力失效。提出分阶段训练：预训练中途停止递归层权重更新，让注意力层学习检索功能。

Result: 在高达1B参数的模型实验中，该方法显著改善语言建模损失、常识推理能力，以及不同语境长度下的广泛检索相关任务性能。

Conclusion: 分阶段训练有效解决了混合架构中的竞争学习问题，使递归和注意力能学习互补功能，整体性能显著提升。

Abstract: Many modern language models have adopted hybrid architectures that incorporate both linear-time recurrence and softmax attention. Modern recurrence layers provide a highly expressive mixing mechanism while ensuring high throughput by compressing contextual information into a fixed-size state, but underperform softmax attention in contextual information retrieval. In this paper, we reveal a Competing Learning phenomenon where different kinds of mixers compete to learn the same function, and when any layer learns a function, it suppresses the corresponding learning signal for other layers. Layer attribution analysis reveals that under typical data distributions, modern recurrence learns retrieval functions faster than softmax attention, causing attention to fail to learn retrieval in most cases. Stopping weight updates in recurrence in the middle of training helps attention learn retrieval. Based on these results, we propose a staged training procedure for pre-training hybrid architectures on natural language. Empirical results on models up to 1B parameters show that our method results in substantial improvement in language modeling loss, common-sense reasoning, as well as a wide range of retrieval-related tasks across different context lengths.

</details>


### [172] [LatComm: Reusable Context Compression for Latent Communication between Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26840)
*Huawei Lin,Jinting Liu,Tan Yu,Weijie Zhao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出 LatComm（潜在通信接口），通过将上下文编码与读取分离，实现跨模型的紧凑、可复用、可读的上下文表示。冻结的编码器将上下文压缩为固定大小的包，冻结的接收器通过基于提示的门控交叉注意力读取包，实现多问答任务的高效复用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模型协作系统常将上下文作为文本在模型间传递，导致接收模型对每个问题重复处理所有 token，计算成本高。现有压缩和潜在通信方法难以同时满足紧凑性、跨问题复用性和跨模型可读性三大需求。

Method: LatComm 将上下文编码与读取解耦：1) 冻结的上下文编码器 LLM 在无问题的情况下一次性将上下文压缩为固定大小的潜在包；2) 不同的冻结接收器 LLM 通过交叉注意力读取该包，注意力门控由其提示（问题）动态计算。包可跨多个问题复用，且无需微调任一模型。

Result: 在 12 个多项选择问答数据集上，LatComm 相较单向量基线平均准确率提升高达 10.2 个百分点。在 QuALITY 数据集上，接收器输入 token 减少 57 倍，单篇文章的问答速度加快 3 倍。

Conclusion: LatComm 通过编码-读取分离和门控交叉注意力，首次同时实现了紧凑、可复用、跨模型可读的上下文表示，显著降低了多模型协作的计算开销并提升了问答性能，为大规模 LLM 系统的高效通信提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Systems that combine several large language models (LLMs) often use one context for many questions. When the context is passed between models as text, the receiving model processes all of its tokens again for every question. Avoiding this cost requires a context representation that is compact, reusable across questions, and readable by a different LLM. Existing compression and latent communication methods each provide only some of these properties. We introduce LatComm, a Latent Communication interface that provides all three by separating encoding from reading: the context is encoded once without the question, and the receiver selects what to read for each question. A frozen context encoder LLM compresses the context into a fixed-size packet and sends it to a different frozen receiver LLM, which reads the packet through cross-attention, with gates computed from its prompt. On 12 multiple-choice question-answering datasets, LatComm improves average accuracy over single-vector baselines by up to 10.2 points. On QuALITY, it reduces the receiver's input by 57x and answers the questions of an article 3x faster.

</details>


### [173] [OpenVLHarness: Real World Visual Agentic Tool-Use with Multimodal Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26860)
*Yu Zhou,Cheng-Fu Yang,Rui Sun,Di Wu,Sibo Peng,Mingyang Zhang,Zhen Yang,Ruiyi Zhang,Nanyun Peng,Zhe Gan,Kai-Wei Chang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出OpenVLHarness，一个多模态推理框架，通过能力层（工具接口与证据渲染）和持久化多模态内存，解决MLLMs在需要外部证据、工具调用和多步推理任务上的不足。在22个基准上，配合8个开源/专有模型，平均提升9.7-12.6分，且以更低token成本超越强基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MLLMs在视觉推理任务上进展迅速，但许多任务需要难以通过内部推理获得的证据（如外部知识、数值测量、异构工具输出）。受控实验显示仅增加推理预算收效甚微。因此需要一种机制来获取、解释并保留异构工具输出，支持多步证据组合。

Method: OpenVLHarness包含两大核心组件：1) 能力层：提供任务级工具接口与证据渲染，统一访问异构后端并将输出转为模型可读观测；2) 持久化多模态内存：在整个查询过程中保留图像、结构化数据、网页引用等可寻址制品。编程接口可在存储数据上执行生成的程序，实现多工具结果的计算组合。支持迭代式获取、检查、组合多模态证据。

Result: 在22个基准上评测8个开源/专有骨干模型，OpenVLHarness较无工具基线平均提升9.7-12.6分（Qwen3-VL-8B +11.2，Kimi K3 +9.7，GPT-6 Astra +9.9）。配合GPT-6 Luna中等推理力度，以≤37%模型token成本，比分别以最大力度运行的基础模型、Codex、Visual Sketchpad高出7.7-8.5分。

Conclusion: OpenVLHarness通过能力层与持久化多模态内存的协同设计，有效解决了MLLMs在需外部证据任务上的短板，显著提升推理性能并大幅降低计算成本，为多模态工具增强推理提供了可扩展、高效的范式。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made rapid progress on visual reasoning, yet many tasks require evidence that is difficult to obtain through internal reasoning alone: our controlled study on 22 benchmarks shows that simply increasing the inference budget of the base model yields only modest gains. Such tasks demand grounded perception, external knowledge, and numerical measurements obtained through heterogeneous tools, whose outputs must be made interpretable to the model and retained across reasoning steps. We introduce OpenVLHarness, a multimodal reasoning harness organized around a capability layer and persistent multimodal memory. The capability layer combines task-level tool interfaces with evidence rendering, providing consistent access to heterogeneous backends and converting their outputs into model-readable observations. Persistent multimodal memory retains the corresponding images, structured data, and web references as addressable artifacts throughout each query. A coding interface executes generated programs over stored data, enabling computations that combine results from multiple tools. Together, these mechanisms support an iterative process of acquiring, inspecting, and composing multimodal evidence. Evaluated on 22 benchmarks with eight open and proprietary backbones, OpenVLHarness improves average scores by 9.7-12.6 points over matched no-tool baselines, including +11.2 with Qwen3-VL-8B, +9.7 with Kimi K3, and +9.9 with GPT-6 Astra. With GPT-6 Luna at medium reasoning effort, OpenVLHarness outperforms the base model, Codex, and Visual Sketchpad at maximum effort by 7.7-8.5 points while incurring at most 37% of their model-token cost.

</details>


### [174] [Transfer Learning for Power Outage Detection Task with Limited Training Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.17817)
*Olukunle Owolabi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究探讨利用迁移学习和语言模型（如BERT、GPT）从社交媒体推文中检测电力中断，重点在于少样本微调在标注数据稀缺场景下的有效性。实验表明，零样本语言模型不如经典模型，但少样本微调（10%数据）显著提升性能：BERT准确率达81.3%（+15.3%），GPT达74.5%（+8.5%），为关键基础设施监测提供了实用的NLP解决方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电力中断的早期检测对维护可靠配电系统至关重要，但获取大量标注数据困难。研究旨在验证预训练语言模型通过迁移学习（特别是少样本微调）能否在有限标注数据下实现高性能中断检测，解决数据稀缺这一实际痛点。

Method: 构建平衡的电力中断相关推文数据集，对比零样本和少样本学习设置下的语言模型（BERT、GPT）与经典基线模型。实验通过不同比例的微调数据（如10%）评估模型泛化能力，重点考察预训练模型在未见类别上的迁移表现。

Result: 零样本语言模型表现逊于经典模型；但10%数据微调后，BERT准达81.3%（提升15.3%），GPT达74.5%（提升8.5%）。少样本微调显著提升语言模型性能，验证了其在低资源场景下的优势，同时也揭示了不同模型架构的强弱差异。

Conclusion: 少样本微调语言模型是电力中断检测的有效技术路径，尤其适合标注数据有限的实际部署。研究为利用先进NLP技术管理关键基础设施提供了实证支持，展示了迁移学习在领域特定任务中的应用潜力与局限。

Abstract: Early detection of power outages is crucial for maintaining a reliable power distribution system. This research investigates the use of transfer learning and language models in detecting outages with limited labeled data. By leveraging pretraining and transfer learning, models can generalize to unseen classes.
  Using a curated balanced dataset of social media tweets related to power outages, we conducted experiments using zero-shot and few-shot learning. Our hypothesis is that Language Models pretrained with limited data could achieve high performance in outage detection tasks over baseline models. Results show that while classical models outperform zero-shot Language Models, few-shot fine-tuning significantly improves their performance. For example, with 10% fine-tuning, BERT achieves 81.3% accuracy (+15.3%), and GPT achieves 74.5% accuracy (+8.5%). This has practical implications for analyzing and localizing outages in scenarios with limited data availability.
  Our evaluation provides insights into the potential of few-shot fine-tuning with Language Models for power outage detection, highlighting their strengths and limitations. This research contributes to the knowledge base of leveraging advanced natural language processing techniques for managing critical infrastructure.

</details>


### [175] [Transformer-based segmentation of prosodic boundaries in Brazilian Portuguese](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.07408)
*Rodrigo de Freitas Lima,Julio Cesar Galdino,Marcos Vinicius Treviso*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 SAMPA，一种基于 Whisper large-v3 微调的巴西葡萄牙语 (BP) 韵律分段模型，在 NURC-SP 和 MuPe-Diversidades 数据集上分别达到 F1=0.731 和 0.796，模型能利用形句法、语义及韵律线索检测边界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 英语韵律分段已有深度学习方法取得优异效果，但巴西葡萄牙语仍主要依赖规则或传统机器学习方法，缺乏端到端的深度学习方案。

Method: 以 Whisper large-v3 为基础模型，在人工标注的 NURC-SP 语料上微调，训练目标为同时转录语音并插入显式终止韵律边界标记；评估多种训练与测试时过滤配置，并进行 MuPe-Diversidades 域外测试。

Result: 最佳模型在保留测试集上 F1=0.731，在 MuPe-Diversidades 上 F1=0.796，性能具竞争力；通过 n-gram 与声学可视化分析，证实模型依据形句法、语义和韵律线索进行边界预测。

Conclusion: SAMPA 为巴西葡萄牙语提供了有效的端到端韵律分段基线，展示了 Whisper 微调在低资源语言韵律边界检测中的潜力，且模型能捕捉多层次语言学线索。

Abstract: Automatic prosodic segmentation identifies boundaries between speech units from acoustic and linguistic evidence. Although recent deep learning approaches have produced strong results for English, automatic segmentation for Brazilian Portuguese (BP) still relies mostly on rule-based or traditional machine-learning methods. This paper presents SAMPA, a Whisper-based segmenter that transcribes BP speech while inserting explicit markers for terminal prosodic boundaries. We fine-tune Whisper large-v3 on manually segmented recordings from the NURC-SP dataset and evaluate different training and test-time filtering configurations, including out-of-distribution testing on the MuPe-Diversidades dataset. SAMPA achieves competitive boundary-detection performance across settings, with the best models reaching F1=0.731 on the held-out test split and F1=0.796 on MuPe-Diversidades. Finally, through n-gram and acoustic-visual analyses, we show that our model follows morphosyntactic, semantic, and prosodic cues for detecting prosodic boundaries.

</details>


<div id='cs.LG'></div>

# cs.LG [[Back]](#toc)

### [176] [Web Agent Agentic Reinforcement Learning Decision Model Under Multi-Cost and Failure Risk](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23857)
*Qianli Ma,Limengxi Yue,Shuyang Xu,Yanpei Shi,Hongrui Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向Web智能体的约束强化学习模型，将页面访问、搜索请求、外部API调用统一建模为长期决策过程，引入多维成本向量（请求数、延迟、失败惩罚）与CVaR尾部风险控制，通过拉格朗日对偶更新实现预算约束，有效平衡完成率、成本与风险。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实Web环境中智能体交互受限于请求预算、时间延迟、反爬虫限制及操作失败风险。仅优化任务成功率的策略常导致‘高成功但高成本’或‘低风险但保守失败’等不可用现象，亟需在完成率、成本与风险间实现自适应平衡。

Method: 提出约束智能体强化学习框架：1) 统一页面访问、搜索、API调用为带成本的长期决策过程；2) 构建多维成本向量（累计请求数、总延迟、失败惩罚），通过拉格朗日对偶更新实现预算合规；3) 引入CVaR风险项抑制高失败概率路径的过度探索；4) 实现完成率、成本、风险的自适应权衡。

Result: 在30-70个站点/页面模板、800-1500个端到端任务（信息抽取、价格比较、表单提交、跨页导航）上实验，交互步长20-120，工具规模30-200。与无约束RL、预算约束RL、规则/脚本智能体对比：同等完成率下，C-PS降低22%-31%，高失败惩罚下失败率降低18%-26%；固定预算下完成率提升10%-16%，验证了约束建模对实际部署的必要性与有效性。

Conclusion: 该工作系统性地将多维成本约束与尾部风险控制引入Web智能体决策，通过约束强化学习实现了完成率、成本与风险的三维平衡，显著优于现有基线，为实际Web智能体部署提供了可落地的理论框架与实证支持。

Abstract: Intelligent agent interactions in real-world web environments are commonly constrained by request budgets, time delays, anti-crawling restrictions, and operational failure risks. Strategies solely optimizing task success rates often exhibit unusable phenomena such as "high success but high cost" or "low risk but conservative failure." This paper proposes a constrained agentic reinforcement learning model for web agents, unifying page access, search requests, and external API calls into a unified long-term decision-making framework with associated costs. It simultaneously incorporates cost budget constraints and tail risk control into the optimization objective: constructing a multidimensional cost vector comprising cumulative request count, total latency, and failure penalties to achieve budget compliance via Lagrange dual updates, while employing a CVaR risk term to suppress excessive exploration of high-failure-probability paths, thereby achieving an adaptive balance among "completion rate, cost, and risk."
  Experiments were conducted across 30-70 site/page templates and 800-1,500 end-to-end web tasks, including information extraction, price comparison, form submission, and cross-page navigation. Interaction sequences spanned 20-120 steps with tool scales of 30-200. Performance was benchmarked against unconstrained RL, budget-constrained RL, and rule-based/scripted web agents, quantifying task completion rates, cost-per-success, failure rates, and policy stability.
  Results demonstrate that at equivalent completion rates, our method reduces C-PS by 22%-31% and lowers failure rates by 18%-26% under high failure penalties. Under fixed budgets, task completion rates increase by 10%-16%, highlighting the necessity and effectiveness of constraint modeling for practical web agent deployment.

</details>


### [177] [PolyGraph: Plan-Buffered CUDA Graphs for Adaptive Speculative Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23861)
*Junchao Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PolyGraph提出一种计划缓冲机制，通过捕获单一最大网格图并在每次重放前写入动态形状（仅28字节），解决自适应推测解码中CUDA Graph固定启动配置的问题，将64个形状特定图减为1个，预服务构建时间从3915 ms降至93 ms，且P50延迟与基线持平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自适应推测解码中活跃批次大小B和草稿长度d每步动态变化，导致验证宽度M=B×d不固定，而CUDA Graph仅支持固定启动配置。现有系统被迫预捕获大量形状、运行时捕获新形状或填充至最大草稿，引入显著开销和延迟劣化。

Method: PolyGraph捕获一个最大网格图，在每次重放前将当前活跃形状写入GPU内存（仅传输28字节）。自定义Triton内核在执行时跳过超出该形状的瓦片，同时保持图拓扑、内存分配、数据布局、指针及启动网格完全固定。

Result: 在NVIDIA H800上运行Qwen2.5-3B维度的合成轨迹：用1个图替代64个形状特定图，P50步延迟17.7 ms vs 基线17.8 ms；预服务图构建时间从3915 ms降至93 ms。固定草稿对照实验显示：零填充浪费时P99差异可忽略，100%填充浪费时P99降低18.7%。

Conclusion: PolyGraph确立了面向自定义内核的有界工作形状机制，而非生产级服务系统。证据仅限于单GPU合成轨迹，但证明了通过动态形状写入避免填充负载的有效性，为自适应推测解码的高效CUDA Graph复用提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Adaptive speculative decoding changes the active batch size B and draft length d from one decode step to the next, whereas a CUDA Graph replays a fixed launch configuration. The resulting verification width M = B d forces serving systems to pre-capture many shapes, capture new ones on the serving path, or pad every step to the largest draft. We present PolyGraph, a plan-buffer mechanism for custom Triton kernels that avoids this choice. PolyGraph captures one maximum-grid graph and writes the active shape to GPU memory before each replay. Kernels skip tiles beyond that shape, while graph topology, allocations, layouts, pointers, and launch grids remain fixed; the update transfers only 28 bytes. On one NVIDIA H800, a trace-driven prototype with Qwen2.5-3B dimensions replaces 64 shape-specific graphs with one, matches the warmed baseline in observed step latency (17.7 vs. 17.8 ms P50), and reduces measured pre-serving graph-build time from 3,915 to 93 ms. Fixed-draft controls show that the benefit comes from avoiding padded payload: the P99 difference from MaxPad is negligible at zero padding waste but reaches an 18.7% reduction at 100% waste. Our evidence establishes a bounded work-shape mechanism for custom kernels, not a production serving system, and is limited to synthetic traces on one GPU.

</details>


### [178] [Forecasting Patient Trajectories from the Electronic Health Records with Action-Conditioned World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23862)
*Simon A. Lee,Jiahang Hank Sha,Soomin Chung,Kai Akamatsu,Eran Halperin,Jeffrey N. Chiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种用于电子健康记录（EHR）的预测世界模型，将患者病史表示为动作条件下的潜在轨迹，通过显式分离患者状态与临床动作并学习其演化动态，实现了时间分辨预测、多步推演和动作条件模拟，在参数量仅为基础模型1/30的情况下达到竞争性性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有EHR建模主要依赖自回归token预测，未显式区分患者潜在状态与观测到的临床动作，难以进行动作敏感的反事实推理和长程时序模拟，亟需一种能显式建模患者状态演化且对干预敏感的世界模型框架。

Method: 核心为状态依赖的线性化预测器，在潜在空间中通过状态与动作条件化的转移算子传播局部状态变化；编码器将观测映射为潜在状态，解码器将自由推演的轨迹还原至临床特征空间，支持时间分辨预测、多步推演及动作条件模拟。

Result: 生成的潜在轨迹保留了下游预测信号、时序结构及亚群统计关系；解码后的临床测量预测在分类与生存分析任务上与大规模EHR基础模型性能接近但参数量减少30倍；扰动动作序列导致轨迹相应变化，验证了动态对动作的敏感性。

Conclusion: 世界建模为从纵向EHR学习显式、时间索引的患者演化表示提供了互补框架，通过显式分离状态与动作实现了可解释、可干预的患者轨迹模拟，为临床决策支持奠定了基础。

Abstract: We introduce a predictive world model for electronic health records (EHR) that represents patient histories as action conditioned latent trajectories. Rather than modeling clinical events solely through autoregressive token prediction, our framework explicitly separates patient states from observed clinical actions and learns their evolution through a state and action conditioned transition operator. At its core is a state dependent linearization predictor that propagates local changes in latent patient state, enabling time resolved prediction, multi step rollout, and action conditioned simulation. Empirically, we show that generated latent trajectories preserve downstream predictive signal, temporal structure, and subgroup level statistical relationships present in encoder derived representations. We further decode free running rollouts into the original clinical feature space and evaluate future clinical measurements against observed values using task matched forecasting baselines, demonstrating that the learned dynamics retain predictive information beyond latent space agreement. Across binary classification and time to event tasks, EHR WM achieves competitive, though task dependent, performance relative to substantially larger EHR foundation models while using a 30x smaller parameter footprint. Finally, perturbing observed action sequences produces corresponding changes in generated trajectories, demonstrating the action sensitivity of the learned dynamics. Together, these results support world modeling as a complementary framework for learning explicit, time indexed representations of patient evolution from longitudinal EHR.

</details>


### [179] [SAGE-CP: When Marginal Coverage Hides Route-Conditional Failures in Adaptive VLM Ensembles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23864)
*Mushir Akhtar,M. Tanveer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 SAGE-CP（路由感知一致性预测）框架，通过冻结路由决策并为每条计算路径单独校准，在保持边际覆盖率的同时实现路径级的有限样本覆盖保证，显著提升了最差路径覆盖率并减少了路径间覆盖率差距，同时大幅降低计算成本和能耗。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自适应 VLM 集成通过早退简单样本、升级困难样本来节省计算，但单一一致性阈值仅能保证边际覆盖率，在个别计算路径上条件覆盖率可能严重失效（最低降至 max{0, 1-α/π}），导致路径级可靠性缺失。

Method: 1. 在开发数据上学习路由器并冻结路由决策；2. 将路由器创建的操作组（早退组与升级组）作为 Mondrian 分裂一致性预测的分层变量；3. 对每组分别校准得分，得到路径级预测集。此管线称为 SAGE-CP。

Result: 在 10 个基准、4 个冻结 VLM、5 个对齐划分上：SAGE-CP 与全局校准均达到 0.900 边际覆盖率（目标 0.90），但 SAGE-CP 将平均最差路径覆盖率从 0.623 提升至 0.887，路径覆盖率差距从 0.324 降至 0.025；平均预测集大小从 1.893 增至 2.212（仍小于全集成的 2.486），单图源模型调用仅 1.177 次（减少 70.6%）；批次延迟降低 58.8%-63.4%，GPU 能耗降低 55.7%-57.5%。路径级可靠性在 6 种固定查询比例下保持，细粒度退出深度组揭示稀有路径需更多校准数据。

Conclusion: 路由机制带来计算节省，而路径分层校准为路由器创建的操作路径提供了有限样本覆盖保证，实现了计算效率与路径级可靠性的双重提升。

Abstract: Adaptive VLM ensembles save computation by stopping early on easy images and escalating harder ones. Although a single conformal threshold can make the final predictor marginally valid, it can still fail severely along individual computational routes. We characterize this failure precisely: if a route has prevalence pi, marginal 1-alpha coverage allows its conditional coverage to fall to max{0, 1-alpha/pi}. To address this mismatch, we learn the router on development data, freeze all routing choices, and calibrate the returned score separately for early exits and escalated inputs. We call this pipeline SAGE-CP. Its calibration step applies Mondrian split conformal prediction to the operational groups created by the router. Under exchangeability, the resulting prediction sets achieve finite-sample coverage within each route. Across 10 benchmarks, 4 frozen VLMs, and 5 aligned splits, both global calibration and SAGE-CP achieve 0.900 marginal coverage at a 0.90 target, but their route behavior differs substantially. SAGE-CP raises mean worst-route coverage from 0.623 to 0.887 and reduces the mean route-coverage gap from 0.324 to 0.025, using the same routed scores and 1.177 source calls per image. The stronger guarantee increases the mean prediction-set size from 1.893 to 2.212; nevertheless, the sets remain smaller than those of the full ensemble (2.486) while requiring 70.6 percent fewer source calls. The route-level reliability persists across 6 fixed query fractions, while finer exit-depth groups demonstrate the need for additional calibration data on rare routes. Across 5 datasets, SAGE-CP also reduces measured batch-one latency by 58.8 to 63.4 percent and gross GPU energy by 55.7 to 57.5 percent relative to full inference. Thus, routing provides computational savings, while route-stratified calibration attaches coverage guarantees to the operational paths created by the router.

</details>


### [180] [Announced Breaks Separate Conformal Reliability from Frequency Calibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23917)
*Karl Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于预告边界的重置规则，用于共形推断的在线校准，通过两种审计（逐时可靠性审计和频率校准审计）评估其性能。理论上证明该重置规则（边界后经验分位数）在独立分数下达到极大极小逐时速率，在有界分数下通过递归重置实现频率间隙为阶数1/n。实验表明，在合成断点、电力市场改革和货币政策决策等真实场景中，该方法在逐时审计和频率审计上均优于或持平多种自适应基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有在线共形推断方法在分布发生突变（如政策变更、市场改革）后难以快速校准覆盖率。本文旨在利用预先公告的边界（如政策生效日）作为分区点，设计重置机制，同时满足逐时可靠性（覆盖率接近名义水平）和频率校准（窗口内误差率匹配名义水平）两种审计标准，解决突变后的快速适应问题。
