Previous work has attempted to formalize this idea by defining the \textit{empowerment}, a measure of how many future states an agent can realize; states with higher empowerment require more exploration as there are more futures to explore. However, existing methods for estimating empowerment require online policy rollouts in the environment. We propose the first method for estimating empowerment from unlabeled prior data, without any environment interaction. By jointly learning an empowerment-maximizing policy together with its discounted state-occupancy measure, our estimator can be trained on unlabeled trajectories generated from any unknown policy. We demonstrate that our empowerment estimator qualitatively gives intuitive empowerment measures and show that the pretrained estimator can be used to improve exploration in the online goal-conditioned reinforcement learning setting. Code is available at \url{https://github.com/ishirgarg/offline-empowerment}.

</details>


### [247] [VBO-MI: A Differentiable Black-Box Optimization Framework via Variational Mutual Information Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24491)
*Farhad Mirkarimi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 VBO-MI，一种完全基于梯度的贝叶斯优化框架，无需高斯先验或变分后验假设，采用 Actor-Critic 架构（action-net 导航输入空间，variational critic 估计代理信息信号）和轻量级代理模型（回放缓冲区），每轮仅需一批真实函数查询，在高维合成函数及真实任务（Rover 轨迹、Lunar Lander、病虫害防治）上达到或优于基线性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实任务常需优化仅能通过有噪评估访问的昂贵黑盒函数。GP 方法随观测数立方级扩展，BNN 方法受限于昂贵的后验采样（如 HMC）和高维采集函数内循环优化。需要一种无强先验假设、全梯度、查询高效的 BO 方法。

Method: VBO-MI 采用 Actor-Critic 架构：action-net 通过梯度更新在输入空间导航；variational critic 估计代理信息信号指导探索。引入轻量级代理模型，利用回放缓冲区的观测数据拟合目标函数，使每轮仅需一批真实函数查询即可实现端到端梯度流。理论分析证明了训练目标和代理估计器的收敛性，以及近似最优解的存在性。

Result: 在高维合成函数及 Rover 轨迹规划、Lunar Lander、病虫害防治等真实任务上，VBO-MI 表现与各基线持平或更优，显著降低了真实函数查询次数。

Conclusion: VBO-MI 通过全梯度、无强先验假设的 Actor-Critic 框架和轻量级代理模型，有效解决了高维黑盒优化中 GP 扩展性差和 BNN 后验采样昂贵的问题，实现了查询高效且性能优越的贝叶斯优化。

Abstract: Many real-world tasks require optimizing expensive black-box functions accessible only through noisy evaluations, a setting commonly addressed with Bayesian optimization. While Gaussian processes(GPs) and Bayesian neural networks have driven significant progress, GP-based methods scale cubically with observations, and BNN-based approaches remain burdened by expensive posterior sampling such as Hamiltonian Monte Carlo, and inner-loop acquisition optimization in high-dimensional setting. In this work, we propose VBO-MI, a fully gradient-based BO framework that requires no assumptions on a Gaussian prior or a variational posterior family over $f$. While our framework uses gradient-based updates to train the internal action and information-estimation networks, it treats the objective function $f$ as a strict black box, requiring only zeroth-order evaluations. To enable end-to-end gradient flow, we employ an actor-critic architecture consisting of an action-net to navigate the input space and a variational critic to estimate a surrogate information signal for exploration. Additionally, we design a lightweight surrogate that approximates the objective from observed data using a replay buffer, which reduces the total required real function queries to one batch per iteration. We provide theoretical analysis for our framework, establishing convergence of its training objective and surrogate estimator, and showing, that near-optimal solutions exist. We evaluate our method on a diverse suite of benchmarks, including high-dimensional synthetic function and complex real-world tasks such as Rover Trajectory planning optimization, the Lunar Lander, and Pest Control problems. Our experiments demonstrate that VBO-MI provides the same or superior optimization performance over the various baselines.

</details>


### [248] [CoTs remain monitorable when being unfaithful requires computation: Replicating and Extending the Necessity Effect Across Eleven Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24495)
*Arav Dhoot,Yixiong Hao,Zephaniah Roe*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文复现并扩展了 Emmons et al. (2025) 关于思维链（CoT）忠实性的研究，在来自六个模型家族的十一款模型上测试代理任务，发现 CoT 必要性效应普遍存在，但 CoT 必要性与不忠实性之间的关系呈现任务特异性和模型特异性。结果支持在不安全行为需要非平凡计算时进行 CoT 监控，并表明 CoT 不忠实性的特性对模型和设置敏感。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先前工作表明模型的思维链（CoT）内容并不总是准确反映其推理过程。Emmons et al. (2025) 发现模型可在不透露的情况下遵循提示，但复杂提示会迫使计算进入 CoT；然而该结论仅在 Gemini 模型上验证，且数据和代码未开源。因此需要跨模型复现并扩展研究范围。

Method: 在六个模型家族的十一款模型上复现 Emmons et al. 的代理任务，并将研究扩展至五类提示线索（其中四类为新增）和三个难度等级，系统测量 CoT 必要性与不忠实性。

Result: CoT 必要性效应推广至所有测试模型：所有模型在简单线索下均显著高于无提示基线；隐性复杂线索遵循率对大多数模型回落至基线附近。CoT 必要性与不忠实性的关系因任务和模型而异。对于某些提示类型，模型即使能在单次前向传播中解码提示，也会在 CoT 中显式表达其遵循行为。

Conclusion: 研究结果支持在不安全行为涉及非平凡计算时实施 CoT 监控；同时揭示 CoT 不忠实性的特性高度依赖于具体模型和实验设置。

Abstract: While a LLM's chain of thought (CoT) is a promising approach to interpreting model outputs, prior work shows CoT's content does not always accurately reflect the reasoning process. Emmons et al. (2025) finds that models can follow a question hint without revealing so in its chain of thought, but when the hint is sufficiently complex the computation is forced into the CoT. This claim, however, has only been tested on Gemini models, and the datasets and code is closed source. We replicate their proxy task across eleven models from six families and find the necessity effect generalizes. Every model follows simple cues above a no-hint baseline, while concealed complex-cue following falls back near baseline for most models. We also extend the study from Emmons et al. (2025) to measure CoT-necessity and unfaithfulness across five cue families (four of them new) and three difficulty levels. The relationship between when CoT is necessary and unfaithfulness is task-specific and model-specific. For some hint types, models often verbalize their hint-following behavior even when the hint can be decoded in a single forward pass. These results support the case for CoT monitoring when unsafe behavior requires non-trivial computation, and that properties of CoT unfaithfulness are sensitive to model and setting.

</details>


### [249] [TideKV: Delayed KV Eviction via Layer-Wise Chunked Prefill for Memory-Efficient Long-Context LLM Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24499)
*Yu Wang,Zhu Wang,Ning Hu,Yifan Guo,Xiu Ma,Bin Guo,Zhiwen Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TideKV 提出了一种层优先的延迟驱逐架构，通过在每个 Transformer 层内处理所有提示块、仅在活跃层保留完整提示的 KV 缓存并在层结束时驱逐，显著降低了长上下文推理预填充阶段的峰值内存占用，同时保持了推理质量和最终缓存大小。在多个平台上实验表明，该方法在 A100 上将 64K 上下文的构建期瞬态内存降低 83.89%，在 RTX 4090 上仅增加 1.06% 首 token 时间并支持 128K 预填充，在 Jetson 上成功完成 128K 而对比方法内存溢出。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长上下文大语言模型推理受限于提示预填充阶段的峰值内存。现有 KV 缓存压缩方法虽能降低解码阶段内存，但通常需要完整提示预填充以保留全局上下文，导致构建期峰值依然很高；而在线块级驱逐虽能更早降低内存，但因各层未观测完整提示而可能损害缓存构建和解码质量。因此需要一种能在保持全提示感知选择的同时，大幅降低构建期峰值内存的方法。

Method: TideKV 采用层优先的延迟驱逐策略：在每个 Transformer 层内顺序处理所有提示块，仅在当前活跃层保留完整提示的 KV 缓存，待该层计算完成后再进行驱逐。这种调度保证了每层都能基于完整提示信息做选择，同时仅需为单层分配完整 KV 缓存，大幅减少了激活值和临时内存占用。

Result: 实验显示 TideKV 保持了被评估压缩方法的推理质量和最终缓存大小。在 A100 上 64K 上下文构建期瞬态内存降低 83.89%；在 RTX 4090 上 64K 时首 token 时间仅增 1.06% 并支持 128K 预填充；在 Jetson 上成功完成 128K 而同类后预填充压缩方法内存溢出。

Conclusion: 层末延迟驱逐策略在不牺牲缓存效用的前提下，显著扩展了可行的上下文长度，为资源受限平台上的长上下文推理提供了实用的内存优化方案。

Abstract: Long-context large language model (LLM) inference is important for modern intelligent applications but remains constrained by peak memory during prompt prefill. Existing KV cache compression reduces decoding memory but typically requires full-prompt prefill to preserve global context, retaining a high construction peak. Online chunk-level eviction lowers memory earlier but selects before each layer has observed the complete prompt, potentially degrading cache construction and decoding. We present TideKV, an on-GPU cache-construction architecture using layer-major delayed eviction. TideKV processes all prompt chunks within each Transformer layer, retains full-prompt KV only for the active layer, and evicts at layer end. This schedule preserves full-prompt-aware selection while reducing activation and temporary memory. Experiments across multiple computing platforms show that TideKV preserves the inference quality and final cache size of the evaluated compression methods. At 64K on A100, it reduces the construction-time transient footprint by 83.89%. On RTX 4090, it increases time to first token by only 1.06% at 64K and enables 128K prefill. TideKV also completes 128K on Jetson, whereas matched post-prefill compression runs out of memory on both resource-constrained platforms. These results show that delayed layer-end eviction substantially expands feasible context lengths without sacrificing cache utility.

</details>


### [250] [HiPPO Functional Memory: Coordinate-Queryable Attention for Irregular Time Series](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24501)
*Zhaodong Guo,Haoyun Feng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 HiPPO Functional Memory (HiPPO-FM)，一种功能记忆注意力算子，将不规则时间序列历史编译为可复用的坐标寻址状态，通过固定秩函数空间写入观测并直接进行坐标评估，实现了高效的连续坐标查询与重用，在多项任务上超越强基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有不规则时间序列模型通常保留依赖观测的表示，每次查询都需重新处理历史，计算冗余大且难以在任意坐标高效查询。需要一种将历史压缩为紧凑、可重用的功能状态，支持直接坐标寻址且无需重复编码。

Method: HiPPO-FM 采用核平滑 HiPPO 坐标与 Gram 基读出构建共享写/读机制，利用观测支持的自注意力在压缩前获得内容相关表示，将观测写入固定秩函数空间，通过匹配的函数几何直接评估任意查询坐标。理论上刻画了有限维查询空间并推导误差分解，区分函数几何近似误差与学习记忆失配误差。

Result: 在连续坐标重建（Spiral 数据集）、20 个 UEA 不规则时间序列分类数据集、真实世界外推预测及多个不规则事件序列基准上，HiPPO-FM 持续优于强基线，达到最优或极具竞争力的性能。编码后的紧凑功能状态可跨不同查询集复用，无需重新处理观测历史。

Conclusion: HiPPO-FM 通过函数记忆注意力实现了不规则时间序列的高效坐标寻址表示，显著降低了重复计算开销，同时保持了强建模能力，为连续时间序列建模提供了可扩展且理论有保证的解决方案。

Abstract: Irregular time series require models to answer temporal queries at arbitrary coordinates, yet existing approaches typically retain observation-dependent representations that must be repeatedly resolved for each query. We introduce HiPPO Functional Memory (HiPPO-FM), a functional-memory attention operator that compiles an irregular history into a reusable coordinate-addressable state. Instead of storing observation-indexed tokens or latent trajectories, HiPPO-FM writes observations into a fixed-rank functional space and performs direct coordinate evaluation through matched functional geometry. Kernel-smoothed HiPPO coordinates and Gram-based readout define a shared write/read mechanism, while observed-support self-attention enables content-dependent representations before compression. We characterize the induced finite-dimensional query space and derive an error decomposition separating functional geometry approximation from learned-memory mismatch. Across continuous-coordinate reconstruction, irregular representation learning, real-world extrapolation, and event-sequence prediction, HiPPO-FM consistently improves strong irregular time-series baselines, achieving strong reconstruction accuracy on Spiral, competitive performance across 20 UEA datasets, improved real-world extrapolation, and superior results on several irregular event benchmarks. After encoding, the compact functional state can be reused across different query sets without reprocessing the observation history.

</details>


### [251] [BEM: Learning Bregman Divergences for Concept Erasure in Flow Matching Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24508)
*Mohamed-Hicham Leghettas,Markus Püschel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出BEM（Bregman擦除匹配），通过双层优化学习Bregman散度，用于从文生图模型中擦除有害概念，同时保留无关生成能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有概念擦除方法使用欧几里得损失微调模型，但平方距离只是Bregman散度家族的一个成员；不同散度对擦除和保留的影响不同，需要自适应选择最优散度。

Method: 提出BEM，利用双层优化学习Bregman散度，使微调模型在未见提示上遗忘目标概念，同时保持无关生成不变。

Result: 实验针对裸露、暴力、真实身份和版权角色；在GEM评估协议下，BEM在大多数设置上擦除更多概念，血腥暴力不安全率从53.9%降至14.4%，裸露FID从8.64降至6.64，保留能力在某些概念上保持，在其他概念上下降。

Conclusion: BEM通过学习最优Bregman散度实现更有效的概念擦除，但在保留无关能力方面仍有提升空间。

Abstract: Concept erasure removes harmful, private, or copyrighted concepts from text-to-image models while preserving their other abilities. Leading models such as FLUX and Stable Diffusion 3 are trained with flow matching, and erasure methods for them fine-tune the model toward a guided teacher's velocities under a Euclidean loss. Yet the squared distance is only one member of a larger family: Bregman divergences are exactly the losses under which flow matching recovers the correct velocity field, and each member shapes differently what is erased and what is preserved. We introduce BEM (Bregman erasure matching), which is, to our knowledge, the first to learn this divergence through bi-level optimization, so that the fine-tuned model forgets the concept on unseen prompts while its unrelated generations stay unchanged. In the experiments we target the suppression of nudity, violence, real identities, and copyrighted characters. Under the evaluation protocol of GEM, BEM removes more of the concept than GEM on most settings, cutting the unsafe rate on bloody gore from 53.9% to 14.4% and the FID on nudity from 8.64 to 6.64, while retention holds on some concepts and degrades on others.

</details>


### [252] [What "Form'' of Uncertainty Does Conformal Prediction Quantify?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24510)
*Soroush H. Zargarbashi,Mohammad Sadegh Akhondzadeh,Rebekka Burkholz,Aleksandar Bojchevski*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究共形预测（CP）中全样本CP与分割CP输出集合大小的差异，发现该差异直接关联贝叶斯后验方差（即模型的认知不确定性）。该差异包含两个对立效应：额外校准点带来的模型精度提升（减小集合）与模型在测试点对各标签的“可塑性”（增大集合）。后者随模型增强或校准数据增加而消失。模型的可塑性本身（通过估计后验方差）可作为量化认知不确定性的有效工具，实验表现与最先进方法相当。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 共形预测作为一种事后校准方法，能提供分布自由的覆盖率保证，其输出集合大小常被视为不确定性的度量。然而，全样本CP与分割CP在集合大小上的差异尚未被充分理解，特别是该差异与模型认知不确定性（epistemic uncertainty）的关系不明确。本文旨在揭示这一差异的理论本质，并探索其作为认知不确定性量化工具的潜力。

Method: 理论分析全样本CP与分割CP集合大小差异的分解，将其关联至贝叶斯后验方差；识别两个对立效应：额外校准数据带来的精度提升效应与模型在测试点的标签可塑性效应；提出利用模型可塑性（通过估计后验方差）直接量化认知不确定性，无需量化为预测集合；在多个实验设置中与最先进不确定性量化方法对比评估。

Result: 证明集合大小差异等于两个效应之和：训练更多数据带来的精度提升（负贡献）与模型可塑性（正贡献）；可塑性效应随模型容量增强或校准数据增加而衰减，符合认知不确定性的已知性质；基于可塑性/后验方差的不确定性估计器在多种基准上达到最先进水平。

Conclusion: 共形预测中全样本与分割版本的集合大小差异本质上反映了模型的认知不确定性。模型的可塑性（通过后验方差估计）提供了一种无需构建预测集合即可直接量化认知不确定性的有效方法，性能可与现有最佳方法媲美，为不确定性量化提供了新的理论视角和实用工具。

Abstract: Conformal prediction (CP) is a post-hoc calibration method that returns prediction sets with distribution-free coverage guarantees, and the size of the output set is often interpreted as a notion of uncertainty. We show that the difference in set size between full and split CP is directly connected to Bayesian posterior variance, which is the epistemic uncertainty of the model. Essentially, this difference in set size is an aggregation of two opposite effects: (1) better model accuracy and therefore smaller set size achieved by training over extra calibration points, and (2) the "formability" of the model at test point towards every possible label. The latter effect vanishes with stronger models or more calibration data (as epistemic uncertainty is known for that behavior). It turns out that the model's formability itself (without the quantization effect of prediction sets, and through estimating the posterior variance) is a useful tool to quantify the epistemic uncertainty. In our empirical evaluation it performs on par with the state of the art in many setups.

</details>


### [253] [TopoCompile: Molecular Generation with Exact Global Count Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24511)
*Xiang Wu,Rong-Hua Li,Quanqing Xu,Kangfei Zhao,Guoren Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TopoCompile是一种分子生成方法，结合自回归组件树生成器和动态规划编译器，可在推理时精确满足分子大小、元素组成、环数量等全局计数约束，无需重新训练即可支持不同目标组合，在四个基准测试中实现100%精确有效产率，显著优于基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的基于性质条件的分子生成器虽能引导生成朝向目标性质，但无法保证精确满足全局计数约束（如分子大小、元素组成、环含量等）。需要一种方法在推理阶段强制保证这些非负、组件可加性的整数计数约束被精确满足，同时不需要为每个新目标重新训练模型。

Method: TopoCompile将分子表示为完整环系统和单个原子的树结构，使每个支持的计数在组件上具有可加性。使用自回归Transformer为组件选择和连接动作打分，动态规划编译器在每一步屏蔽无法完成目标满足的动作。通过约束解码保证支持的非负、组件可加性整数计数的精确相等性。该方法在推理时应用，使同一训练生成器无需重训即可支持不同目标和计数组合。

Result: 在四个基准测试中，TopoCompile对常见和罕见的四计数目标组均实现100%精确有效产率；各数据集中最强基线在罕见目标上仅达到44.9%或更低。在无条件生成中，在所有四个基准数据集上均达到最高有效率或有效-唯一-新颖（V.U.N.）指标。

Conclusion: TopoCompile通过组件树表示和动态规划约束解码，解决了分子生成中精确满足全局计数约束的难题。该方法具有推理时灵活适配不同约束、无需重训练的优势，在精确约束满足和生成质量上均显著超越现有基线，为可控分子设计提供了有效方案。

Abstract: Molecular generation designs novel molecules with desired structures and properties. Global count constraints specify molecular size, elemental composition, and ring content without prescribing detailed structure. Property-conditioned generators steer generation toward such targets but do not guarantee exact satisfaction. We introduce TopoCompile, which combines an autoregressive component-tree generator with a dynamic-programming compiler for supported component-additive integer counts. TopoCompile represents molecules as trees of intact ring systems and individual atoms, making each supported count additive over components. At each step, an autoregressive Transformer scores component and attachment actions, while the compiler masks actions with no target-satisfying completion. Within the fixed component vocabulary and typed attachment rules, constrained decoding guarantees exact equality for supported non-negative, component-additive integer counts. Applied at inference time, these checks let the same trained generator support different targets and count combinations without retraining. Across four benchmarks, TopoCompile achieves 100% Exact-valid yield for Common and Rare four-count target groups; the strongest baseline within each dataset reaches 44.9% or less on Rare targets. In unconditional generation, it achieves the highest validity or valid-unique-novel (V.U.N.) among the compared methods across all four benchmark datasets.

</details>


### [254] [ProbePO: Sparse Probes, Redistributed Credit for Critic-Free LLM Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24515)
*Diyi Hu,Ruizhong Qiu,Lin Qiu,Hanghang Tong,Hanqing Zeng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ProbePO 是一种新的强化学习方法，通过预算受限的部分解测量来改进 GRPO 的信用分配，在数学推理任务上显著提升准确率并大幅降低训练时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的可验证奖励强化学习将单一终端奖励分配给整个推理轨迹，难以归因个别推理步骤的贡献。GRPO 将群组归一化优势广播到每个响应 token，而更细粒度的方法通常依赖密集的辅助 rollout 或分支方案，这些方案也会改变用于策略更新的数据分布。

Method: 将缺失的中间信用分配建模为预算受限的测量问题：在有限的 rollout 预算下，选择哪些部分解进行评估，以及如何利用其价值估计来细化信用。ProbePO 使用无奖励的不确定性分数选择部分解状态，在有限的续写预算下估计其期望验证器奖励。ProbePO 重新分配而非替换 GRPO 的轨迹级优势到各 token，同时保持每条轨迹的平均 token 级优势不变；探测续写仅作为测量手段，不改变训练数据分布。

Result: 在跨越 1.5B-7B 参数的三个 DeepSeekMath 和 Qwen 系列模型上，ProbePO 持续优于 GRPO，在 18 个模型-基准对比中有 16 个达到最高准确率。对比密集探测的 VinePPO（在 DeepSeekMath-7B 上），ProbePO 在全部六个基准上均取得更高准确率，且端到端训练时间减少 76%。

Conclusion: ProbePO 通过预算受限的部分解测量实现了高效且有效的细粒度信用分配，在保持 GRPO 优势不变的前提下显著提升推理任务性能，且训练效率远超密集探测基线。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards assigns one terminal reward to an entire reasoning trajectory, obscuring how individual reasoning steps contributed to the outcome. GRPO broadcasts a group-normalized advantage to every response token, while finer-grained approaches often rely on dense auxiliary rollouts or branching schemes that can also alter the data used for policy updates. We cast the missing middle as budgeted measurement: with a limited rollout budget, which partial solutions should be evaluated, and how should their value estimates refine credit? ProbePO selects partial-solution states with a reward-free uncertainty score and estimates their expected verifier rewards under a capped continuation budget. ProbePO redistributes, rather than replaces, GRPO's trajectory-level advantage across tokens while preserving each trajectory's mean token-level advantage; probe continuations serve only as measurements. Across three DeepSeekMath and Qwen-family models spanning 1.5B-7B parameters, ProbePO consistently outperforms GRPO and achieves the highest accuracy among the four evaluated methods in 16 of 18 model-benchmark comparisons. Against dense-probing VinePPO on DeepSeekMath-7B, ProbePO achieves higher accuracy on all six benchmarks with 76% less end-to-end training time.

</details>


### [255] [Structured Latent Dynamics for Long-Horizon Embodied World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24534)
*Kevin Chen,Yu-Wei Zhan,Haoran Liang,Sen Cui,Changshui Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 HWM（结构化动力学框架），通过在学习的相空间中用广义坐标和动量表示潜在状态，并利用耗散哈密顿动力学进行长时域预测，显著提升了具身世界模型的预测稳定性和物理一致性。实验表明其在多个基准上均取得性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成式世界模型虽能生成视觉上合理的动作条件未来，但其无约束的潜在转移模块在递归推演中会逐渐偏离连贯的物理演化，导致长时域预测不可靠。

Method: 引入 HWM 框架：将骨干潜在状态映射到由广义坐标和动量组成的学习相空间，通过耗散哈密顿动力学传播未来状态，再经可学习的逆接口映射回原始潜在表示。该框架可无缝集成到现有世界模型架构中，配合多步转移监督使结构化推演与真实观测诱导的潜在轨迹保持对齐。

Result: 受控仿真实验显示，HWM 在速度、加速度和加加速度估计上更准确，并大幅降低长时域能量漂移。在三种具身世界模型设定（Ctrl-World、EVAC、Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B）上评估：RoboCasa 任务成功率相对提升 2.7%；真实 AgiBot World 数据上，Ctrl-World 的 nDTW 提升 9.7%，EVAC 的 Logic 提升 8.4%。

Conclusion: 显式结构化潜在状态演化（基于哈密顿动力学）能有效增强具身世界模型的长时域预测稳定性与物理合理性，且具有良好的架构兼容性和泛化能力。

Abstract: Reliable long-horizon prediction remains a central challenge for embodied world models. Although recent generative models can synthesize visually plausible action-conditioned futures, their latent dynamics are typically learned through unconstrained transition modules, which may gradually deviate from coherent physical evolution as predictions are recursively rolled forward. We investigate whether explicitly structuring latent state evolution can improve the stability and utility of such imagined trajectories. To this end, we introduce HWM, a structured dynamics framework that represents backbone latents in a learned phase space consisting of generalized coordinates and momenta. Future states are propagated through dissipative Hamiltonian dynamics and mapped back to the original latent representation through a learnable inverse interface. The resulting formulation can be integrated into existing world-model architectures without redesigning their perception or decoding components, while multi-step transition supervision encourages the structured rollout to remain aligned with the latent trajectories induced by real observations. Controlled simulation experiments show that HWM produces more accurate estimates of velocity, acceleration, and jerk and substantially reduces long-horizon energy drift relative to unstructured latent dynamics. We further evaluate the approach across three distinct embodied world-model settings, covering single-arm multi-view prediction with Ctrl-World, dual-arm single-view prediction with EVAC, and task-oriented single-arm prediction with Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B. On RoboCasa, incorporating HWM into Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B yields a 2.7% relative improvement in task success. On real-world AgiBot World trajectories, it improves nDTW by 9.7% with Ctrl-World and Logic by 8.4% with EVAC.

</details>


### [256] [From Score to Diagnosis: Search-Independent Post-Diagnosis for Symbolic Regression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24535)
*Qian Li,Yuxiao Hu,Juncheng Liu,Yanhao Jia,Yuntian Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出PostDiag，一种搜索无关的共享反馈机制，用于改进多种符号回归（SR）求解器。通过补丁级特征剖析（PFP）捕捉局部行为，量化骨架表达风险与稳定性风险，构建诊断风险平面（DRP）指导LLM编辑器进行干预，并经轻量级适配器回传给原求解器。实验表明PostDiag在多种LLM与GP基SR求解器上均能稳定提升精度并加速收敛。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有SR求解器虽搜索机制多样，但普遍依赖低信息量的标量适应度，难以解释骨架为何失效或该如何修正。近期方法虽引入增强反馈，但强耦合特定搜索流程，难以跨求解器复用。因此需要一种可共享、与搜索解耦的反馈机制，统一解决不同求解器面临的同一瓶颈。

Method: 提出PostDiag：1）补丁级特征剖析（PFP）提取水平、趋势、粗糙度等局部特征；2）基于PFP量化骨架表达风险（拟合候选与观测对比）与骨架稳定性风险（自助法重拟合后的变异性）；3）诊断风险平面（DRP）融合双风险，判定骨架保留/修复/简化/重写，补丁级差异提供干预证据；4）LLM编辑器执行诊断引导干预，经轻量适配器将验证后修订回传原求解器。

Result: 在多个基于LLM与基于GP的SR求解器上实验，PostDiag持续提升求解精度并加快收敛速度，验证了其作为通用反馈机制的有效性与可移植性。

Conclusion: PostDiag通过搜索无关的诊断反馈框架，成功将细粒度的局部行为分析与LLM驱动的干预编辑相结合，为异构SR求解器提供了可复用的性能增强路径，显著缓解了标量适应度信息不足的核心瓶颈。

Abstract: Symbolic regression (SR) solvers employ diverse search mechanisms, yet most rely on the same low-information scalar fitness. Such scores provide little guidance on why a skeleton fails or how it should be revised. Recent methods develop new methods to address this bottleneck. Their enhanced feedback mechanisms are tightly coupled to their search processes and are difficult to reuse across diverse SR solvers. Instead, we ask whether a shared feedback mechanism can further improve diverse solvers facing the same bottleneck. To this end, we propose PostDiag, a search-independent feedback mechanism, which can be shared to different SR solvers. PostDiag introduces Patch-wise Feature Profiling (PFP) to capture local behavior through patch-wise features of level, trend, and roughness. Based on PFP, PostDiag quantifies Skeleton Expressiveness Risk by comparing the fitted candidate with the observations, and Skeleton Stability Risk by measuring variability of behavior after bootstrap refitting. The Diagnostic Risk Plane (DRP) combines two risks to determine whether a skeleton should be preserved, repaired, simplified, or rewritten, while the patch-wise discrepancies provide evidence for the intervention. An LLM editor then performs the diagnosis-guided intervention, and the validated revision is returned to the original solver through a lightweight adapter. Experiments across multiple LLM-based and GP-based SR solvers show that PostDiag consistently improves accuracy and accelerates convergence.

</details>


### [257] [A Multi-Step Inertial ADMM Algorithm for Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24536)
*Hao Li,Qingsong Wang,Xihong Yan,Chengcheng Yan,Deren Han*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出多步惯性ADMM算法MiFedADMM，利用服务端多步历史迭代构建高阶外推加速联邦学习收敛，理论上证明O(1/K)收敛率，实验验证优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习中ADMM面临通信开销大和系统异构性导致的性能瓶颈，需要加速收敛的方法。

Method: 提出MiFedADMM算法，在服务端聚合后利用多步历史迭代构建高阶外推，加速收敛。

Result: 在温和假设下证明单步变体收敛性，推导出O(1/K)收敛率；在合成和真实数据集上实验表明优于现有方法。

Conclusion: MiFedADMM通过多步惯性外推有效加速联邦学习中ADMM的收敛，具有理论保证和实验验证。

Abstract: Federated learning has recently emerged as an important paradigm for large-scale distributed model training, which can be naturally formulated as a class of distributed learning problems. The alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM) is a widely used approach for solving such problems. However, its practical performance is often hindered by significant communication overhead and system heterogeneity. In this paper, we propose a multi-step inertial ADMM algorithm, called MiFedADMM, for federated learning. The proposed method leverages multiple historical iterates on the server side to construct a higher-order extrapolation after each aggregation to accelerate the convergence behavior. Under mild assumptions, we establish convergence results for the single-step variant of the proposed method and derive an O(1/K) convergence rate. Numerical experiments on both synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate the effectiveness and improved performance of the proposed method compared with existing approaches.

</details>


### [258] [Theory-Guided Instance-Dependent Early Stopping via Second-Order Loss Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24540)
*Ahad Bin Islam Shoeb,Jamal Uddin Tanvin,Kamrul Hasan,Alve Reduan,Imtiaz Ahmed*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了理论引导的实例相关早停方法（TG-IES），为实例相关早停（IES）中使用的二阶损失差分准则提供了理论依据，推导了噪声校准的掌握阈值和条件稳定性界，并从训练统计中自动确定停止阈值和耐心参数，在CIFAR-10/100上实现了53%-58%的反向传播实例节省，准确率损失仅0.1-0.9个百分点，ResNet-18/CIFAR-10上达到35.7%的FLOP归一化节省。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的实例相关早停（IES）方法使用二阶损失差分准则来跳过损失已稳定样本的反向传播，但该准则缺乏理论证明。作者旨在建立该准则的理论基础，并用基于训练运行统计的自动校准阈值取代IES中手工选择的阈值。

Method: TG-IES在显式假设下分析二阶损失差分准则，推导噪声校准的掌握阈值和实例排除的条件稳定性界。证明二阶差分在特定信噪比下相对于一阶和三阶差分具有有利的偏差-方差权衡，且其信号同时包含梯度漂移项和曲率项。停止阈值和耐心参数从训练运行统计中导出，而非人工设定。

Result: 在CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100的主要卷积设置上，TG-IES节省53%-58%的反向传播实例，准确率与完全训练相差0.1-0.9个百分点；ResNet-18/CIFAR-10主设置对应35.7%的FLOP归一化节省。方法可迁移至ViT-Tiny，但节省幅度较小且带来适度的准确率损失。

Conclusion: 研究为二阶实例相关早停提供了理论基础，表明在所研究的假设和实验设置下，理论引导的校准能显著降低训练计算量。

Abstract: Instance-dependent early stopping (IES) reduces training computation by skipping backpropagation for examples whose losses have stabilized, but the second-order loss-difference criterion used by IES lacks a theoretical justification. We develop Theory-Guided Instance-Dependent Early Stopping (TG-IES), which analyzes this criterion under explicit assumptions and derives a noise-calibrated mastery threshold and a conditional stability bound for instance exclusion. We show that second-order differencing has a favorable bias-variance trade-off over first- and third-order differences in a specific signal-to-noise regime, and that its signal contains both gradient-drift and curvature terms. TG-IES derives its stopping threshold and patience from training-run statistics rather than using the manually selected threshold of IES. Across CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100, TG-IES saves 53-58% of backpropagation instances in its main convolutional settings while keeping accuracy within 0.1-0.9 percentage points of full training; in the primary ResNet-18/CIFAR-10 setting, this corresponds to 35.7% FLOP-normalized savings. The method also transfers to ViT-Tiny, where it achieves smaller savings and incurs a modest accuracy cost. These results provide a theoretical basis for second-order instance-dependent early stopping and show that theory-guided calibration can substantially reduce training computation under the assumptions and experimental settings studied.

</details>


### [259] [No-Regret Revenue Maximization in Sequential Market Making Under Inventory Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24562)
*Davide Maran,Marcello Restelli,Francesco Emanuele Stradi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究序列做市中如何在未知买卖方估值下最大化收益，通过最小化遗憾度平衡库存风险。仅观察交易成败时，遗憾度和库存界为O(T^{2/3})；若能看到失败交易的完整订单簿数据，则改进至O(√T)。同时证明了更严格的逐轮库存限制会强制更高的最小遗憾度，揭示了根本权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在序列做市中，做市商需在T轮中通过设定买卖价格维持低风险库存并最大化收益。买卖方估值未知，且交易基于价格阈值独立发生。核心挑战是如何在信息不完全情况下（仅知成交与否，或能观察失败订单）最小化遗憾度并控制库存风险。

Method: 采用遗憾度最小化框架设计算法。两种信息场景：1）仅观察交易成败（带状反馈），设计基于置信区间的定价策略，平衡探索与利用；2）能观察失败交易的完整订单簿数据（全信息反馈），利用额外信息加速学习。理论分析建立遗憾度与库存的上界，并通过构造对抗性估值分布证明下界，揭示库存约束与遗憾度的权衡。

Result: 带状反馈下，遗憾度和库存界为O(T^{2/3})；全信息反馈下改进至O(√T)。下界结果证明：若要求每轮库存偏差严格受限（如o(√T)），则最小遗憾度必然更高（Ω(T^{2/3})），确立了逐轮库存控制与累积遗憾度的根本权衡。

Conclusion: 论文量化了信息反馈粒度对做市性能的影响：完整订单簿数据显著降低遗憾度和库存风险。同时揭示了库存管理严格性与学习效率的不可兼得性，为做市商算法设计提供了理论基准：在库存约束允许的前提下，应尽可能利用失败交易信息以达到最优√T级性能。

Abstract: Market makers keep trading efficient by setting bid and ask prices for buyers and sellers. In sequential market making, trades happen independently based on price thresholds, requiring the market maker to maintain balanced, low-risk inventory over T rounds. This paper studies how to maximize revenue with unknown buyer and seller valuations using regret minimization. When the market maker only sees trade success or failure, an algorithm achieves regret and inventory bounds proportional to T to the power of 2/3. When full order book data is available for failed trades, regret and inventory limits improve significantly to the square root of T. We also establish a fundamental trade-off via a lower bound, by proving that tighter round-by-round inventory limits strictly force higher minimum regret.

</details>


### [260] [Representations Have Trajectories: Characterizing Temporal Representation Dynamics in Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24571)
*Shivaprasad B. Gowda,Sparsh Mittal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过大规模实证研究发现神经网络训练过程中存在三种几何轨迹：持久高秩、塌缩-恢复和持久低秩，并识别出破坏性表征塌缩（DRC）为一种病理机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度神经网络表现出隐式低秩简单性偏置，但其在优化过程中的时间后果、表征几何的演化动态以及不同架构的几何优化行为差异尚不清楚。

Method: 大规模实证研究，追踪训练全过程中的表征几何演化，分析不同神经架构在优化过程中的秩动态变化模式。

Result: 发现三种反复出现的几何轨迹：持久高秩、塌缩-恢复、持久低秩。识别出破坏性表征塌缩（DRC）导致表征容量持续丧失。塌缩-恢复在受控实验中与成功优化相关，但在真实模型中几何轨迹与优化结果的关系依赖于配置。

Conclusion: 表征几何在训练中动态演化，为理解深度神经网络如何学习提供了新视角。

Abstract: Recent work has shown that deep neural networks exhibit an implicit low-rank simplicity bias. In this paper, we investigate the questions that naturally arise from this observation. What are the temporal consequences of low-rank simplicity bias during optimization? How does representation geometry evolve throughout optimization rather than only at convergence? Do different neural architectures exhibit distinct geometric optimization behaviors? To answer these questions, we conduct a large-scale empirical study tracking representational geometry throughout training. We find that neural networks follow three recurring geometric trajectories: persistent high-rank, collapse-and-recovery, and persistent low-rank. We further identify Destructive Representation Collapse (DRC) as a pathological regime in which representations collapse to rank-one and fail to recover, leading to a sustained loss of representational capacity. While collapse-and-recovery is consistently associated with successful optimization in controlled settings, experiments on real-world models show that the relationship between geometric trajectories and optimization outcomes is configuration dependent. Overall, our findings suggest that representation geometry evolves dynamically during training and provide a new perspective on how deep neural networks learn.

</details>


### [261] [DeliMF: Gated Cross-Attention Fusion of Structured Time Series and Clinical Text for Early Intensive Care Delirium Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24585)
*Yibo Yang,Zerui Huang,Haomiao Yang,Zixia Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出DeliMF，一种融合结构化时间序列数据与临床自由文本（放射科报告）的多模态框架，用于预测ICU患者入院首日后的谵妄风险。通过门控交叉注意力机制自适应融合两模态，在MIMIC-IV队列上显著优于基线模型，尤其在有临床文本的患者上提升明显，且在无文本患者上不损失性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 谵妄在ICU患者中高发且预示不良预后，现有预测模型仅依赖结构化EHR数据（生命体征、实验室指标、用药），忽略了同一时间窗口内临床自由文本笔记中包含的结构化数据无法编码的关键信息，导致早期识别谵妄的窗口期被错过。

Method: DeliMF采用双流编码器架构：结构化信号经时间Transformer编码，时间戳放射科报告经临床文本编码器编码，再通过门控交叉注意力模块融合。门控机制为每位患者学习文本模态权重，若患者无文本则门控关闭，模型自动退化为纯结构化模型，从设计上保证对缺失文本的鲁棒性。

Result: 在仅含首次发作谵妄的MIMIC-IV队列上，DeliMF显著优于各基线模型，在有临床文本的患者亚组提升最明显，在无文本患者上性能不降反增。消融实验证实多模态融合与门控交叉注意力的贡献，病例研究表明融合临床文本能挽回仅靠结构化数据遗漏的谵妄病例。

Conclusion: DeliMF证明了在ICU早期预测任务中充分利用被忽视的临床自由文本的价值，其门控融合设计兼顾了有文本患者的性能增益与无文本患者的鲁棒性，为谵妄的早期识别与及时干预提供了实用的多模态预测工具。

Abstract: Delirium affects a large fraction of intensive care unit (ICU) patients and foreshadows longer stays, lasting cognitive decline, and higher mortality. Flagging the patients who will become delirious within the first day of admission would give clinicians a window to intervene. Yet state-of-the-art predictors rely only on the structured electronic health record (EHR) of vital signs, laboratory values, and medications, while overlooking the free-text clinical notes written in the same window, which carry information the numbers cannot encode. To this end, we present DeliMF, a multimodal framework that fuses the structured time series with clinical text. It encodes the structured signals with a temporal Transformer and the time-stamped radiology reports with a clinical text encoder, and fuses the two through a gated cross-attention module. The gate learns a per-patient weight on the text; when a patient has no note the gate closes and DeliMF reduces to its structured-only form, giving robustness to missing text by construction. On an incident-only MIMIC-IV cohort, DeliMF improves significantly over the baselines, particularly on patients who carry clinical text, while losing nothing on those without. Ablation studies confirm the contribution of multimodal fusion and gated cross-attention, and a case study further shows that fusing clinical text with the structured stream recovers delirium cases that the structured data alone misses. We hope DeliMF encourages early ICU prediction to make fuller use of the overlooked clinical text and contributes to the early identification and timely intervention of delirium.

</details>


### [262] [AdamPM: Memory-Efficient LLM Optimization via Moment Pooling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24598)
*Xiaowei Ji,Lishan Xu,Jianing An,Jie Luo,Wenjun Wu,Lei Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出AdamPM（带池化矩的Adam），一种简单且内存高效的Adam变体，通过将相邻的二阶矩条目按行或列分组并共享均值，将二阶矩内存需求降低至原始的1/s（s为组大小），在保持模型性能和训练速度的同时大幅减少优化器状态内存。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Adam因其优化性能和训练稳定性成为大语言模型预训练的主流选择，但其逐元素的一阶和二阶矩估计带来巨大内存开销。现有内存高效优化器往往引入额外计算开销或需额外超参数调整，限制了实际应用。

Method: AdamPM将相邻的矩条目沿行或列维度分组，每组用单一共享均值表示。系统研究了对一阶和二阶矩均池化的效果，确定二阶矩池化为有效设计。组大小为s时，二阶矩内存降为原始的1/s。该方法可直接继承Adam的超参数设置，易于集成进现有Adam实现。

Result: 在语言模型预训练、微调及多模态学习的大量实验中，AdamPM在保持模型性能和训练速度的同时，显著降低了优化器状态内存占用。

Conclusion: AdamPM是一种简单、实用且内存高效的Adam变体，无需额外超参数调整即可大幅减少二阶矩内存，适合大规模语言模型训练场景。

Abstract: Adam is widely used for training large language models (LLMs) owing to its strong optimization performance and training stability, but its element-wise estimation for the first and second moments incur substantial memory overhead. Although numerous memory-efficient optimizers have been proposed, many incur additional computational overhead or require additional tuning of hyperparameters. Consequently, Adam remains a dominant and reliable choice for LLM pre-training. We propose AdamPM (Adam with Pooled Moments), a simple and memory-efficient variant of Adam that groups adjacent moment entries along the row or column dimension and represents each group by a single shared mean. AdamPM can well inherit Adam's hyperparameter settings and is readily integrated into existing Adam optimizer implementations, with less memory overhead. We systematically investigate pooling of both first and second moment estimates and identify second moment pooling as the effective design. With a group size of $s$, AdamPM reduces second moment memory to $1/s$ of the original requirement. Extensive experiments on language model pretraining, fine-tuning and multimodal learning demonstrate that AdamPM maintains model performance and training speed while substantially reducing optimizer-state memory. Our code is available at \url{https://github.com/jixiaowei95/AdamPM}.

</details>


### [263] [TCMScience: An Autonomous Scientist for Traditional Chinese Medicine](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24601)
*Yanlan Kang,Ruiqi Liu,Xinpei Gu,Tzu-Yi Lei,Shuai Xu,Xukun Zhang,William Cheng-Chung Chu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出 TCMScience，一个面向中医药研究的自主知识发现智能体，通过可信内核、科学编译器与声明-支撑契约，将大模型提议与执行权限分离，实现异构证据类型的推理边界保持与跨资源协同分析。系统集成 117 个公开源连接器、444 个类型化操作、150 个原生工具及大规模中医药数据枢纽。在葛根芩连汤网络药理学案例中，证据契约显著改变了可报告结论；治理消融实验证实双层控制可将错误输出降至零。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 中医药研究涉及古籍文本、药物实体、分子实验、计算预测与临床研究等多元证据类型，自主科研智能体需在保持各证据类型推理边界的前提下，协调异构资源的跨域分析，避免大模型直接生成不可验证的结论。

Method: 采用三层架构：可信内核负责权限边界与执行隔离；科学编译器将计划编译为类型化操作，执行受显式权限约束；声明-支撑契约在发布前对候选发现进行溯源、研究设计与声明范围的合规性校验。能力注册表包含 117 个公开源连接器（444 类型化操作，29 领域）、150 个原生工具（12 领域）；中医药数据枢纽收录 136 个数据库、76 个数据集规范、84,294 条方剂溯源记录。提供浏览器与本地执行两种模型无关的工作流接口。

Result: 葛根芩连汤网络药理学分析中，将全蛋白组背景替换为实测蛋白背景后，显著通路数从 66 降为 0；纳入阴性筛选记录后识别出 9 条通路，含药物代谢信号作为机制假设保留。治理消融实验针对 26 类 121 个构造错误输出：无治理释放 121 个错误，仅领域层释放 57 个，仅内核释放 7 个，双层均启用时释放 0 个；全部 10 个合规对照均被保留。

Conclusion: 实验确立了对已知失效模式的互补控制，证明显式证据契约能从根本上改变智能体被许可报告的结论，为可信自主科研智能体提供了可复现的工程范式。

Abstract: Traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) research connects classical texts, medicinal entities, molecular assays, computational predictions, and clinical studies. An autonomous research agent must preserve the inferential boundaries between these evidence types while coordinating analysis across heterogeneous resources. We introduce TCMScience, a scientific knowledge-discovery agent that separates language-model proposals from execution and release authority. Its architecture combines a trusted kernel, a scientific compiler, and claim-support contracts: plans are compiled into typed operations, execution is bounded by explicit permissions, and candidate findings are checked against source provenance, study design, and claim scope before release. The full capability registry contains 117 public-source connectors with 444 typed operations across 29 domains and 150 native tools across 12 domains; the TCM data hub catalogs 136 databases, 76 dataset specifications, and 84,294 formula-source records. These resources support model-independent workflows through browser and local execution interfaces. In a network-pharmacology analysis of Gegen Qinlian Tang, replacing the whole-proteome background with the assayed-protein background changed the number of significant pathways from 66 to zero; incorporating inactive screening records identified nine pathways, including drug-metabolism signals retained as mechanistic hypotheses. A governance ablation over 121 constructed erroneous outputs spanning 26 classes released 121 errors without governance, 57 with the domain layer, seven with the kernel, and zero with both layers. All 10 compliant controls were retained. These results establish complementary control of known failure modes and show how explicit evidence contracts change the conclusions an agent is permitted to report.

</details>


### [264] [How Much Do Activation Monitors Benefit from Original Model Computations?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24613)
*James Oldfield,Shawn Im,Jay J Culligan,Philip Torr,Sharon Li,Adel Bibi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文研究激活监测器对原始行为生成计算的依赖程度，发现虽无需原始轨迹也能恢复大部分性能，但原生训练监测器仍保持微弱且一致的优势（最多0.014 AUROC），且在释义后行为标签翻转的样本上表现更优，揭示了基于简单特权信息（如答案logit边距）基线的局限性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究开始质疑激活是否提供了理解模型行为的独特窗口，需要系统评估激活监测器的成功在多大程度上依赖于对原始行为生成计算的访问权限，以及是否存在原始计算提供额外预测价值的场景。

Method: 在固定目标模型和监测架构下，对比在不同计算上下文（如文本内容、聊天格式等受控变化）的轨迹上训练和评估的监测器，测量其预测原始执行行为的能力；涉及4个模型和2个反事实监测任务。

Result: 1) 无原始轨迹也能恢复大部分监测性能；2) 原生训练监测器持续优于最强控制组，优势达0.014 AUROC；3) 原生监测器在释义导致行为标签翻转的样本上显著提升；4) 该视角暴露了基于答案logit边距等简单特权信息基线的局限性。

Conclusion: 原生监测器访问优势在整体上虽微弱，但强调了识别何时原始模型计算提供额外预测价值的评估方法的重要性，为理解激活监测的基础机制提供了新视角。

Abstract: One powerful way to safeguard AI systems is to monitor their internal computations--where signs of undesirable behavior might be more easily detectable than from models' inputs and outputs alone. However, recent studies begin to question the premise that activations provide a unique window into model behavior. In this paper, we study how much of activation monitors' success depends on access to the original behavior-generating computations. Within a fixed choice of target model and monitoring architecture, we compare how well monitors trained and evaluated on trajectories that differ in computational context can predict the behavior of the original execution, after the transcript is changed in a controlled manner (e.g., its exact text, or chat formatting). We first find that much performance can be recovered without access to the original behavior-generating trace (in up to 4 models across 2 counterfactual monitoring tasks), but a mild yet consistent advantage to native-trained monitors remains, outperforming strongest controls by up to 0.014 AUROC. Interestingly, we find monitors trained with native access have notable uplift on original examples whose behavioral label changes under paraphrasing. We further find this a useful lens to expose limitations of baselines that use simple forms of privileged information (i.e., answer logit margins). While our results show the advantage of native monitor access is modest in aggregate, they highlight the importance of evaluations that identify if and when original model computations provide additional predictive value.

</details>


### [265] [Uncovering Semantic Hierarchies in Text-Attributed Graphs via Variational EM-based LLM-GNN Synergy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24624)
*Yunhui Liu,Xudong Jin,Qizhuo Xie,Chunhui Zhao,Xiao Luo,Tao Zheng,Bin Chong,Tieke He*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出 SHiFT 方法，结合大语言模型（LLM）的推理能力与图神经网络（GNN）的结构表示能力，在期望最大化（EM）框架下为文本属性图学习显式语义层次结构，实现了最先进性能并生成高质量可读分类体系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文本属性图表示学习主要在扁平语义空间运作，忽视了真实数据固有的粗到细层次粒度，无法充分利用层次结构组织人类知识的优势。

Method: SHiFT 采用 EM 范式：E 步利用 LLM 作为专家分类学家诱导显式语义树，引入轻量级映射与诊断策略，仅在检测到异常时手术式更新层次以减少推理成本；M 步从聚类划分、拓扑骨架、语义概念三互补视角对齐 GNN 编码器与诱导层次。理论上将 SHiFT 解释为广义变分 EM 算法。

Result: 大量实验表明 SHiFT 不仅达到最先进性能，还能发掘高质量、人类可读的分类体系。

Conclusion: SHiFT 成功弥合了层次知识组织与扁平表示学习的鸿沟，通过 LLM 与 GNN 在 EM 框架下的协同，实现了高效、可解释的文本属性图层次表示学习。

Abstract: While hierarchical structures are intrinsic to organizing human knowledge, current representation learning on text-attributed graphs predominantly operates on flat semantic spaces, overlooking the rich coarse-to-fine granularity inherent in real-world data. To bridge this gap, we propose SHiFT, which synergizes the reasoning power of LLMs with the structural representation capability of GNNs within an Expectation-Maximization (EM) paradigm. In the E-step, we harness LLMs as expert taxonomists to induce an explicit semantic tree, introducing a lightweight Mapping & Diagnosis strategy that reduces inference costs by surgically updating the hierarchy only when anomalies are detected. In the M-step, we align the GNN encoder with this induced hierarchy from complementary perspectives, including clustering partition, topological skeleton, and semantic concepts. Theoretical analysis interprets SHiFT as a generalized Variational EM algorithm. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SHiFT not only achieves state-of-the-art performance but also uncovers high-quality, human-readable taxonomies. Our code can be found at https://github.com/Cloudy1225/SHiFT.

</details>


### [266] [EdgeKernelBench: Unified LLM-Driven Kernel Generation for Edge Backends](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24648)
*Yuhua Zheng,Xueyi Chen,Xinze Zou,Xin Li,Haoji Hu,Huan Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 EdgeKernelBench 和 LEKA，解决 LLM 在异构边缘后端生成高性能内核的系统性评估与优化问题。EdgeKernelBench 提供统一 IR 部署框架和分层基准测试；LEKA 通过分层 IR 组织优化，显著提升 Fast@1.0 指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 边缘部署面临硬件异构、软件栈碎片化、资源预算紧张等挑战，现有工作多关注服务器 GPU，缺乏针对多样化边缘后端的系统性 LLM 内核生成研究。

Method: 1) 构建 EdgeKernelBench：统一 IR 捕获可复用的计算、调度与内存决策，通过编译器接口连接各目标后端；分层基准覆盖从单算子到紧凑模型图的渐进程序作用域。以 TVM 为参考编译器，在异构边缘后端验证。2) 提出分层边缘内核智能体（LEKA）：采用分层 IR 组织优化流程，指导 LLM 逐层优化内核。

Result: 单次生成下，最佳模型 Correct@1 为 64.5%，但 Fast@1.0 仅 25.5%，功能正确性难以稳定转化为性能增益。在智能体评估子集上，LEKA 达到 43.5% Fast@1.0，显著优于直接生成（13.0%）和 Claude Code（26.1%），且基础模型与优化预算相同。

Conclusion: EdgeKernelBench 与 LEKA 共同实现了跨边缘后端 LLM 生成内核的统一评估与分层优化，弥补了边缘侧内核生成研究的空白。

Abstract: Recent works show that LLMs can generate kernels with strong performance on server GPUs. Edge deployment presents distinct challenges because the hardware is heterogeneous, the software stacks are fragmented, and the resource budgets are tight. LLM kernel generation across diverse edge backends has yet to be studied systematically. We introduce EdgeKernelBench, which combines a unified IR deployment framework with a hierarchical benchmark for edge workloads. The unified IR captures reusable computation, scheduling, and memory decisions and connects to each target backend through a compiler interface. The benchmark spans progressively larger program scopes, from individual operators to compact model graphs, across representative edge application domains. We instantiate the design with TVM as a reference compiler and validate it across heterogeneous edge backends. With a single generation attempt, the best model achieves 64.5% Correct@1 but only 25.5% Fast@1.0. This gap shows that functional correctness does not consistently translate into performance gains. We therefore introduce the Layered Edge Kernel Agent (LEKA), which organizes optimization through a layered IR. On the agent evaluation subset, LEKA achieves 43.5% Fast@1.0, compared with 13.0% for direct generation and 26.1% for Claude Code. LEKA and Claude Code use the same base model and optimization budget. Together, EdgeKernelBench and LEKA support unified evaluation and layered optimization of kernels generated by LLMs across edge backends.

</details>


### [267] [Contrastive Adversarial Training for Robust Graph Neural Networks under Label Poisoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24685)
*Manshika Charvi Bissessur,Melis Ilayda Bal,Michael Muehlebach*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 CoLAT（对比标签翻转对抗训练），一种面向图神经网络标签投毒攻击的对比对抗训练框架，通过结构感知的对比检测模型识别标签-结构不一致性，利用对比嵌入选择高风险节点指导对抗标签翻转，在多个基准上持续超越现有防御方法并能高效扩展到大图。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图神经网络（GNN）在建模关系数据方面有效，但易受标签投毒攻击：少量损坏的训练标签可通过消息传播在图中传播错误。现有防御主要针对标签噪声设计，依赖鲁棒损失或启发式数据清洗，难以区分对抗性投毒与自然困难样本，因此针对标签投毒的防御仍处于未充分探索状态。

Method: 提出 CoLAT 框架，核心是结构感知检测模型，利用对比学习识别标签-结构不一致性。不同于侧重表征学习的先前对比方法，CoLAT 利用对比嵌入选择高风险节点，指导训练期间的对抗标签翻转。该交替优化不仅执行结构感知对抗训练，还隐式清洗部分损坏标签，提升对多种攻击的鲁棒性。

Result: 在多个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，CoLAT 在不同投毒强度下持续优于现有防御方法，同时能高效扩展到大规模图。

Conclusion: CoLAT 通过将对比学习与对抗训练相结合，针对图上的节点分类任务提供了一种新颖的标签投毒鲁棒防御方案，有效解决了现有方法无法区分对抗投毒与自然困难样本的问题，并在实验中展示了优越的鲁棒性和可扩展性。

Abstract: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) are effective for modeling relational data but are vulnerable to label poisoning, where a small number of corrupted training labels can propagate errors across the graph via message passing. Despite this risk, defenses against label poisoning remain underexplored: existing methods are primarily designed for label noise and often rely on robust losses or heuristic data cleaning that fail to distinguish adversarial poisoning from naturally hard examples. In this paper, we propose CoLAT (Contrastive Label-flipping for Adversarial Training), a novel contrastive adversarial training framework tailored for robust node classification on graphs. The core of our approach is a structure-aware detection model that uses contrastive learning to identify label-structure inconsistencies. Unlike prior contrastive methods that focus on representation learning, CoLAT leverages contrastive embeddings to select high-risk nodes that guide adversarial label-flipping during training. This alternating optimization not only performs structure-aware adversarial training but also implicitly sanitizes some corrupted labels, improving robustness against diverse attacks from the literature. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks show that CoLAT consistently outperforms existing defenses under various poisoning intensities while scaling efficiently to large graphs.

</details>


### [268] [Native Probability Outputs for Clinical Triage: An Evaluation of Calibration and Decision Accuracy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24692)
*Liang You,Zhiyin Zhou,Dawei Tang,Chuchu Wu,Jingzhuo Hu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文评估决策模型 Jev 在患者面向分诊任务中的表现，对比四个通用语言模型和三个基线。Jev 虽然宏平均 F1 排名第四，但多类别 Brier 得分最低（校准最好），在 HealthBench 上也表现最佳。然而 Jev 在四动作任务中漏报澄清需求，单独询问信息充分性虽提高召回率，但也导致过度澄清分配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 患者面向分诊需要恰当的护理建议并识别信息不足的情况。研究旨在评估返回预定义动作概率的决策模型 Jev 是否同时支持这两种判断。

Method: 使用 CARE-Bench 基准，在 439 个公开病例的 925 个决策点上，将 Jev 与四个通用语言模型和三个与输入无关的基线进行比较；另在 453 个 HealthBench 对话上进行补充评估。指标包括宏平均 F1、多类别和二分类 Brier 得分、急诊转诊判断等。

Result: 公开测试集上 Jev 宏平均 F1 排名第五中的第四（0.461），但多类别 Brier 得分最低（0.610），较均匀预测改进 18.7%（95% CI 4.9–31.1%）。Noul 二分类 Brier 优于 Choice（0.215 对 0.276）。HealthBench 上 Jev Brier 得分仍最低（0.299），但测量的是不同的急诊转诊判断。Jev 结合了较低概率误差与漏报澄清需求；单独询问信息充分性提高召回，但也产生频繁的不必要澄清分配。

Conclusion: Jev 在概率校准方面表现优异（Brier 得分最低），但在四动作分诊任务中存在漏报澄清需求的问题。单独评估信息充分性虽能提升召回率，但会导致过度触发澄清动作。未来工作需在校准与动作覆盖之间取得更好平衡。

Abstract: Patient-facing triage requires an appropriate care recommendation and recognition of when information is insufficient. We evaluate whether Jev, a decision model that returns probabilities over predefined actions, supports both judgments. Using CARE-Bench, we compare Jev with four general-purpose language models and three input-independent baselines across 925 decision points from 439 public cases. On the public test subset, Jev ranks fourth of five models by macro-F1 (0.461) but has the lowest observed multiclass Brier score (0.610), an 18.7\% improvement over uniform prediction (case-bootstrap 95\% interval, 4.9--31.1\%). Noul has lower binary Brier than Choice (0.215 versus 0.276). A evaluation of 453 HealthBench conversations again gives Jev the lowest observed Brier score (0.299), but measures a distinct emergency-referral judgment. Jev combines lower probability error with missed clarification needs in the four-action task. Asking about information sufficiency separately increases recall but also produces frequent unnecessary clarification assignments.

</details>


### [269] [Tensor Network Datamodels for Training Data Attribution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24721)
*Farzaneh Heidari,Md Rifat Arefin,Louis Jaburi,Guillaume Rabusseau*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出张量网络数据模型(TNDM)，利用低秩张量网络建模训练单元间的非加性交互作用，在仅观测极少量训练子集的情况下，显著优于线性数据模型，能预测移除数据的效果、度量单元重要性、识别交互并选择有用子集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 线性数据模型给训练单元分配固定贡献，无法表示非加性联合效应；真实训练数据常存在互补或冗余组，导致高阶子集函数，需要紧凑的低秩表示来捕捉这些交互。

Method: 引入张量网络数据模型(TNDM)，使用低秩张量网络(如张量列车TT和CP分解)从训练数据子集映射到训练结果，学习子集函数，证明互补/冗余训练组可诱导高阶子集函数且具紧凑低秩表示。

Result: 在受控推理任务上，TNDM仅观测约0.0061%的所有可能训练子集，TNDM-TT将预测NMSE较线性数据模型降低89%，且仅需一半观测子集即超越所有基线；在事实关联微调中，TNDM-CP使保留集R²从0.579提升至0.668。

Conclusion: 紧凑低秩张量网络模型能有效捕捉训练数据间的组合依赖关系，显著提升预测性能，并支持多种训练数据分析任务，证明低秩张量网络是建模非加性训练数据效应的有力工具。

Abstract: Datamodels predict how a model's behavior changes when different parts of its training data are included or removed. However, linear datamodels assign fixed contributions to training units and cannot represent non-additive joint effects. We introduce Tensor Network Datamodels (TNDMs), which use low-rank tensor networks to model dependencies among training units while keeping the representation compact. TNDMs learn a map from subsets of the training data to the outcome of training on those subsets, allowing them to represent interactions among several training units. We prove that complementary and redundant training groups can induce high-degree subset functions with compact low-rank representations. A single fitted TNDM can then be used for several training data questions, including predicting the effect of removing data, measuring the importance of individual training units, identifying interactions between training units, and selecting useful subsets of the training data. We evaluate TNDMs on controlled tasks designed to contain strong interactions, as well as standard fine-tuning settings for classification and reasoning. On a controlled reasoning task, TNDMs outperform every baseline while observing only half as many training subsets, and TNDM-TT reduces prediction NMSE by $89\%$ relative to the linear datamodel after observing approximately $0.0061\%$ of all possible training subsets. In factual-association fine-tuning, a single TNDM-CP raises held-out $\mathrm{R}^2$ from $0.579$ to $0.668$ over the linear datamodel. These results demonstrate that compact low-rank models improve prediction when training data effects depend on combinations of training groups.

</details>


### [270] [fxBench: Evaluating and Understanding Formula Suggestions in Spreadsheets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24729)
*Sanket Mhatre,Sumit Gulwani,Vu Le,Yasharth Bajpai,Gust Verbruggen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 fxBench 基准集（基于 Sheetpedia 的 503 个公式建议任务），将公式建议问题分解为四大能力（收集上下文、理解上下文、理解意图、编写公式），并系统评估了现有与新方法，揭示了各能力的瓶颈；最佳配置仅达 58.8% 准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电子表格是最常用的计算工具，公式是其核心。主流软件（Excel、Sheets）已提供主动公式建议，但缺乏真实电子表格上的公开基准，难以量化评估与对比不同方法的上下文收集、意图理解、公式生成等关键能力。

Method: 1. 构建 fxBench：从 Sheetpedia 人工策划 503 个任务，并标注描述意图的单元格以确定上下文选择的理论上限。2. 将任务分解为四能力。3. 评估大小模型在不同上下文表示（含低 token 高覆盖的稠密格式）下的表现。4. 微调小模型学习稠密格式。5. 对失败模式进行定量与定性分析。

Result: 稠密上下文格式在低 token 数下实现高理论覆盖；微调小模型可有效理解该格式；但在公式编写能力上仍存在显著瓶颈，最佳配置仅达 58.8% 正确建议率。

Conclusion: fxBench 为公式建议提供了首个真实数据基准；研究表明上下文表示与模型规模均非唯一瓶颈，公式编写能力（理解意图与生成正确公式）是当前主要短板，未来研究应聚焦于提升模型对电子表格语义与公式逻辑的深度理解。

Abstract: Spreadsheets are among the most widely used tools for computations, and formulas are their core building blocks. Besides agentic spreadsheet tools, proactive formula suggestions enable significant productivity gains and are now available in popular spreadsheet software (Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets). Such suggestions pose interesting challenges: the right context must be collected and represented for a machine learning model, which must then be able to write a correct formula, in a way that is fast and cheap enough to trigger on every = (or subsequent keystrokes for auto-completion) without taking users out of their editing flow. Surprisingly, there is no public benchmark for formula suggestions on real spreadsheets. In this paper, we therefore (1) introduce fxBench as a manually curated benchmark of 503 formula suggestion tasks based on Sheetpedia, (2) break down the formula suggestion problem into four capabilities (gather context, understand context, understand intent, write formula) that a formula suggestion system requires, and (3) evaluate existing and new approaches to understand bottlenecks in these capabilities that pose interesting research directions. Specifically, we annotate each benchmark with the cells that describe intent to determine the theoretical performance limit of a given context selection strategy, we evaluate performance of small and large models on different representations of context, including a dense format with high theoretical coverage at low token counts, and we fine-tune smaller language models to show that we can learn to understand such dense formats. Additionally, we perform quantitative and qualitative analysis on failure modes to understand bottlenecks in the formula writing capability; the best configuration only achieved 58.8% correct suggestions.

</details>


### [271] [How Does Muon Work in Private Deep Learning? Scalable Differentially Private Training via Orthogonalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24736)
*Alexander Gaponov,Grigory Malinovsky,Egor Shulgin,Peter Richtarik*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 DP-Muon，一种 Muon 优化器的差分隐私变体，通过线性最小化预言机 (LMO) 分析正交化更新，证明在固定噪声尺度下收敛率为 O(K^{-1/4}) 且无需假设有界梯度即可达到标准的 (√d/(nε))^{1/2} 隐私-效用界；实验显示图像分类任务上 DP-Muon 优于或持平 DP-SGD 和 DP-Adam，语言建模任务上最优优化器随批大小变化：小批量下 DP-Muon 最优，接近隐私最优批大小时 DP-Adam 最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有深度学习优化器需在计算效率与形式化数据隐私间平衡。Muon 等正交化更新规则虽表现优异且可扩展，但其在差分隐私 (DP) 下的行为尚未被理解，亟需将其改造为差分隐私版本并给出理论收敛与隐私-效用保证。

Method: 提出 DP-Muon：基于 Muon 的正交化更新，引入逐样本裁剪与高斯噪声。利用线性最小化预言机 (LMO) 分析裁剪效应，证明其主要影响为梯度的正向缩放，LMO 对此不敏感，仅残留由梯度中心方差控制的小方向扰动进入优化误差。据此推导收敛速率与隐私-效用界，并系统研究学习率、动量、批大小等超参数在隐私约束下的最优配置。

Result: 理论：固定噪声尺度下收敛到依赖于裁剪阈值的邻域，速率为 O(K^{-1/4}) (对数因子忽略)；按 (ε,δ) 预算标定噪声时，无需假设有界梯度即达成 DP-SGD 的标准 (√d/(nε))^{1/2} 隐私-效用界。实验：图像分类上 DP-Muon 匹配或超越 DP-SGD 和 DP-Adam；语言建模上最优优化器随批大小变化——小批量下 DP-Muon 最优，接近隐私最优批大小时 DP-Adam 最优。

Conclusion: DP-Muon 成功将 Muon 的正交化更新扩展到差分隐私场景，通过 LMO 分析揭示了裁剪的良性效应，获得了不依赖有界梯度假设的强理论保证，并在图像分类与语言建模任务上展示了极具竞争力的实证性能，同时揭示了隐私约束下超参数最优选择的新规律。

Abstract: Training deep neural networks requires optimizers that balance computational efficiency with formal data privacy. While orthogonalized update rules, such as the recently introduced Muon optimizer, have shown strong empirical performance and scalability, their behavior under Differential Privacy (DP) is not yet understood. In this paper, we propose DP-Muon, a differentially private variant of the Muon optimizer. By analyzing Muon's orthogonalized updates through the lens of a Linear Minimization Oracle (LMO), we show that the leading effect of per-example clipping is a positive rescaling of the gradient, to which the LMO is blind, so that only a small directional residual controlled by the centered gradient variance enters the optimization error. This yields an $\mathcal O(K^{-1/4})$ convergence rate, up to logarithmic factors, to a clipping-dependent neighborhood at a fixed noise scale and, with noise calibrated to a fixed $(\varepsilon,δ)$ budget, the standard $(\sqrt d/(n\varepsilon))^{1/2}$ privacy--utility bound of DP-SGD, without assuming bounded gradients. Furthermore, we investigate the hyperparameter landscape of DP-Muon and document how the optimal learning rate, momentum, and batch size change under privacy. Empirically, on image classification DP-Muon matches or improves on DP-SGD and DP-Adam, whereas on language modeling the best optimizer depends on the batch size, with DP-Muon best at small batches and DP-Adam best near the privacy-optimal batch size.

</details>


### [272] [Gaussian Process Bandits with Paired Auxiliary Observations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24737)
*Weibo Huang,Qing Feng,Ruihao Zhu,Cheng Hua*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 AI-GPB（辅助信息高斯过程强盗）方法，利用离线低成本辅助数据减少贝叶斯优化中的方差，无需辅助均值近似目标函数，即可通过配对观测误差相关性实现显著的遗憾界改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 贝叶斯优化（BO）在昂贵黑箱优化中广泛应用，但观测噪声降低了每次评估的信息量，减缓后验学习。许多应用中存在低成本辅助数据，若能有效利用这些离线数据，可显著提升在线优化效率。

Method: AI-GPB 结合离线辅助均值估计与在线配对观测学习的修正系数，利用配对观测误差间的相关性进行方差缩减，且不要求辅助均值近似目标函数。建立了有限样本高斯过程置信界和遗憾保证，给出了 Matérn 核下的显式累积遗憾和简单遗憾收敛速率。

Result: 在多个连续 BO 基准测试（不同景观、不同维度）中，AI-GPB 相较标准 GP-UCB 持续降低累积遗憾和简单遗憾，即使配对相关性中等且辅助均值来自有噪离线数据时依然有效。

Conclusion: AI-GPB 通过理论保证和实验验证，证明了利用辅助数据相关性可显著提升贝叶斯优化样本效率，为带噪黑箱优化提供了实用且理论扎实的方差缩减框架。

Abstract: Bayesian optimization (BO) is widely used for expensive black-box optimization, yet observation noise makes each evaluation less informative and slows posterior learning. Standard BO learns from costly outcomes gathered during optimization. In many applications, however, low-cost auxiliary data are available beforehand. We introduce Auxiliary-Informed Gaussian Process Bandit (AI-GPB), a variance-reduction method that combines an offline estimate of the auxiliary mean with a correction coefficient learned from paired online observations. Notably, it exploits correlation between paired observation errors without requiring the auxiliary mean to approximate the objective. We establish finite-sample GP confidence bounds and regret guarantees, including explicit cumulative and simple regret rates for Matérn kernels. Numerical experiments across continuous BO benchmarks with varied landscapes and dimensions show consistent reductions in cumulative and simple regret relative to vanilla GP-UCB, even when within-pair correlation is moderate and the auxiliary mean is estimated from noisy offline data.

</details>


### [273] [From Overparameterised Expressions to Parsimonious Models: Fisher-Geometric Pruning for Symbolic Regression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24753)
*Veronica Guidetti,Luca La Rocca,Fabrício Olivetti de França,Gabriel Kronberger*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Fisher-Geometric pruning (FGP)，一种后处理模型简化框架，用于解决遗传编程符号回归（GPSR）产生的表达式过大、含休眠分支和过拟合噪声的问题。FGP结合最大似然解处的局部信息几何与可解释参数边界的兼容性检验，通过符号收缩和重拟合实现候选简化，仅在交叉验证预测风险保持在容差内时接受。实验表明FGP能大幅降低结构复杂度，同时保持甚至提升泛化精度，在简洁性和泛化能力上取得最一致的联合增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 遗传编程符号回归（GPSR）常返回不必要大的表达式，包含休眠分支和精细调整的代数构型以拟合采样噪声。现有的复杂度控制策略（如多目标大小-精度搜索或嵌入适应度函数的信息准则）作用于模型搜索过程中的句法表示，缺乏对已拟合模型的后处理简化机制。

Method: Fisher-Geometric pruning (FGP)是一种作用于已拟合模型的后处理简化框架。核心方法：1) 结合最大似然解处的局部信息几何与可解释参数边界的显式兼容性检验；2) 建立参数方向分类学，分离局部敏感性与可约边界的接近度，处理不可识别方向和通过零约束、渐近极限、符号参数识别实现的简化；3) 通过符号收缩和重拟合实现候选简化，仅当交叉验证预测风险保持在规定容差内时接受简化。

Result: 在受控诊断问题和GPSR生成的帕累托前沿上评估FGP。两种设置下，FGP均大幅降低结构复杂度，同时保持甚至提升样本外精度。与竞争性剪枝策略和消融实验对比显示，通过结合几何筛选、边界兼容性和预测验证，FGP在简洁性和泛化能力上获得最一致的联合增益。

Conclusion: FGP作为一种后处理模型简化框架，有效补充了现有的搜索阶段复杂度控制方法。其通过几何筛选、边界兼容性检验和预测验证的三重机制，实现了模型结构复杂度的显著降低与泛化性能的保持/提升的最佳平衡，为符号回归模型的实用化部署提供了重要技术支撑。

Abstract: Genetic programming symbolic regression (GPSR) often returns expressions that are larger than necessary, with dormant branches and finely tuned algebraic configurations that fit sampling noise. Existing complexity-control strategies, such as multi-objective size-accuracy search or information criteria embedded in the fitness function, act on syntactic representations during model search. We introduce Fisher-Geometric pruning (FGP), a post-hoc model-reduction framework that acts on fitted models and can complement these techniques.
  FGP combines local information geometry at the maximum-likelihood solution with explicit compatibility tests for interpretable parametric boundaries. A taxonomy of parametric directions separates local sensitivity from proximity to reducible boundaries, enabling the treatment of unidentifiable directions and reductions through zero constraints, asymptotic limits, and signed parameter identifications. Candidate reductions are realised by symbolic contraction and refitting, then accepted only when their cross-validated predictive risk remains within a prescribed tolerance.
  We evaluate FGP on controlled diagnostic problems and Pareto fronts generated by GPSR. Across both settings, FGP substantially reduces structural complexity while preserving, and often improving, out-of-sample accuracy. Comparisons with competing pruning strategies and ablations show that, by combining geometric screening, boundary compatibility, and predictive validation, FGP yields the most consistent joint gains in parsimony and generalisation.

</details>


### [274] [Paired-Outcome Learning for Selective Spacecraft Attitude Capture under Torque Limits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24763)
*Donghe Chen,Jia Deng,Zehao Jia,Lin Cheng,Shengping Gong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种配对结果学习方法，用于扭矩限制下的航天器姿态捕获，通过选择性修改基线控制器，在不引入回归的情况下将聚合积分姿态误差降低4.67%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扭矩限制的航天器姿态捕获需要根据不确定的制动权限调整机动速度；更快的设置虽能降低平均跟踪误差，但可能恶化个别机动，因此需要一种基于基线的选择性学习方法来平衡平均性能提升与个别回归风险。

Method: 提出配对结果方法，结合三个机制：(1) 具有不同速度包络的物理可解释延续策略；(2) 分别预测任务失败与成功配对跟踪增益；(3) 依赖上下文的拒绝机制，执行未改变的基线。使用配对仿真提供标签，按上下文分离训练、验证、校准。在Basilisk仿真环境中进行108个开发上下文、324次标注滚动、48个测试上下文中的624次评估回合实验。

Result: 选择性控制器相对于分支基线将聚合积分姿态误差降低4.67%，实现17次改进、31次完全持平、零回归；始终使用快速替代方案虽降低4.81%但恶化11个案例。增益出现在主轴、近轴、制动边界及选定噪声/漂移机动中；一般耦合情况保留基线。消融实验显示分支承诺、主动查询或分数减法无额外聚合收益。

Conclusion: 证据支持一种受限的经验权衡：平均改进与个别回归之间存在权衡，但未建立闭环安全保证。该方法在不引入回归的前提下实现了平均性能提升，适用于特定机动类型，但在一般耦合情况下仍依赖基线。

Abstract: Torque-limited spacecraft attitude capture requires adapting the maneuver speed to uncertain braking authority. Faster settings can reduce average tracking error while worsening individual maneuvers, making selective modification of an existing controller a baseline-relative learning problem. A paired-outcome method combines three mechanisms: physically interpretable continuation policies with different speed envelopes, separate prediction of task failure and successful-pair tracking gains, and context-dependent rejection that executes the unchanged baseline. Complete paired simulations provide labels under common plant parameters and measurement seeds; training, validation, and calibration are separated by context. Basilisk experiments use 108 development contexts, 324 labeling rollouts, and 624 evaluation episodes across 48 test contexts, including disclosed post-freeze diagnostics. The selective controller reduces aggregate integrated attitude error by 4.67% relative to the branch baseline, with 17 improvements, 31 exact ties, and no observed regressions. Always using the fast alternative achieves a 4.81% reduction but worsens 11 cases. Gains occur in principal-axis, near-axis, braking-boundary, and selected noise/drift maneuvers; general coupled cases retain the baseline. Ablations show no additional aggregate benefit from branch commitment, active querying, or score subtraction. The evidence supports a restricted empirical trade-off between average improvement and individual regression, without establishing a closed-loop safety guarantee.

</details>


### [275] [Global Convergence in Deep Networks via the Second Law of Thermodynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24775)
*Matan Tsipory,Ofir Gaash,Itamar Harel,Nathan Srebro,Daniel Soudry*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究有限宽度过参数化深度神经网络在L2正则化连续时间朗之万动力学下的收敛性，引入受热力学第二定律启发的变度量不等式，证明注入噪声有助于保持NTK稳定性而不限制权重靠近初始化，给出非渐近训练损失上界，实验表明雅可比矩阵可偏离初始化，脱离惰性训练区域。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有有限宽度过参数化神经网络收敛分析常假设参数保持在初始化附近，忽略噪声作用，而经验表明随机性能改善优化和泛化，因此需要填补这一理论空白。

Method: 研究L2正则化连续时间朗之万动力学（各向同性噪声）训练前馈网络，引入变度量不等式控制时变参数分布下的关键性质，利用NTK最小特征值在初始化时的更锐利下界，证明噪声有助于高概率保持NTK稳定性而不将权重限制在初始化小邻域。

Result: 推导出期望训练损失的非渐近上界，给出宽度和噪声温度的显式条件保证收敛到有限损失下界；实验验证网络雅可比矩阵可从初始化发生显著变化，脱离常见的惰性训练区域。

Conclusion: 噪声注入能促进有限宽度过参数化网络在非惰性区域的收敛，为随机优化在深度学习中的理论理解提供新视角。

Abstract: Existing convergence analyses of finite-width overparameterized deep neural networks under standard parameterization often rely on parameters remaining close to their initialization and typically neglect the role of noise, despite empirical evidence that stochasticity can improve optimization and generalization. To bridge this gap, we study $L_2$-regularized continuous-time Langevin dynamics (CLD) with isotropic noise, for training feedforward networks with smooth activations. We introduce a change-of-measure inequality, inspired by the second law of thermodynamics, that enables control of key properties of the training dynamics under the time-evolving parameter distribution. Leveraging a sharpened lower bound on the minimum eigenvalue of the Neural Tangent Kernel (NTK) at initialization, we show that injected noise helps preserve NTK stability with high probability without confining the weights to a small neighborhood of their initialization. As a result, we derive a non-asymptotic upper bound on the expected training loss. Our analysis yields explicit conditions on width and noise temperature that guarantee convergence to a finite loss floor. Finally, we experimentally show the network Jacobian can change from initialization, departing the commonly analyzed lazy regime.

</details>


### [276] [Process-Aware Event Log Augmentation for Process Prediction under Labeled Data Scarcity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24777)
*Sjoerd van Straten,Alessandro Padella,Marwan Hassani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出SiamSA-PPM，一种结合孪生学习与统计数据增强的自监督预测性流程监控框架，解决深度学习PPM面临的标签数据稀缺和真实日志变异性低的问题，在下一活动和最终结果预测任务上达到SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习预测性流程监控（PPM）方法受限于标注数据稀缺和真实事件日志变异性低，难以学习泛化的前缀表示，限制了预测性能。

Method: 提出SiamSA-PPM自监督框架：1) 基于控制流语义和频繁行为模式的新型变换方法，生成语义有效的真实轨迹变体；2) 结合孪生网络学习，无需标签监督即可学习泛化前缀表示；3) 统计学驱动的数据增强策略保证生成变体的过程感知有效性。

Result: 在多个真实事件日志上进行大量实验（含穷尽超参数调优），证明过程感知增强的价值。相比SOTA基线，在下一活动预测和最终结果预测两项任务上均达到竞争性或优越的预测性能。

Conclusion: SiamSA-PPM通过过程感知的自监督数据增强有效解决了PPM中的数据稀缺和低变异性问题，为无监督流程表示学习提供了新范式，代码已开源。}

Abstract: Predictive Process Monitoring (PPM) forecasts future events of ongoing business processes based on event logs. However, deep learning PPM approaches are often limited by labeled data scarcity and the low variability of real-world logs. To address this, we introduce SiamSA-PPM, a self-supervised framework combining Siamese learning with statistically grounded data augmentation. It employs novel transformation methods that leverage control-flow semantics and frequent behavioral patterns to generate realistic, semantically valid trace variants, learning generalizable prefix representations without labeled supervision. Extensive experiments on real-world event logs with a wide range of variability, incorporating exhaustive hyperparameter tuning, demonstrate the value of this process-aware augmentation. Compared to state-of-the-art baselines, SiamSA-PPM achieves competitive or superior predictive performance in both next activity and final outcome prediction tasks. An open source implementation of our method is publicly available under https://github.com/SvStraten/SiamSA-PPM-Extension..

</details>


### [277] [First-Order LoRA Training with Phone NPUs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24816)
*Xu Zheng,Wei Cheng,Zhuomin Chen,Dongkuan Xu,Mo Sha,Jingchao Ni,Dongsheng Luo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种在移动设备NPU上高效进行LLM LoRA微调的系统，将冻结权重的三类矩阵乘法（前向、激活重计算、输入梯度）卸载到NPU执行，同时在CPU上保留训练图、适配器和优化器，通过复用驻留权重瓦片和前向反量化器避免转置权重拷贝，采用梯度敏感度精度选择和逐行范围保护保证FP16梯度可用性，并融合CPU算子、重叠NPU与适配器计算、支持可恢复执行和热节流，实现后台持续训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有设备端微调受限于NPU推理接口不支持输入梯度计算，且首阶段训练步骤仍需乘以冻结基础模型权重（前向、激活重计算、输入梯度三次），在CPU/GPU上效率低、功耗高；NPU已驻留推理权重，利用其加速冻结权重乘法可大幅降低训练开销。

Method: 系统将三类冻结权重矩阵乘法映射到NPU执行，输入梯度内核复用驻留权重瓦片和前向反量化器，避免转置权重拷贝并保证前向/反向使用相同有效权重；根据梯度敏感度选择精度，对FP16输出施加逐行范围保护；运行时融合剩余CPU算子，重叠NPU执行与适配器计算，提供可恢复执行和热节流机制支持后台作业。

Result: 在两款高通骁龙平台上对Qwen和Llama四款LLM评测，覆盖夜间个性化（手机端标签）和LaMP-2基准；相比优化CPU训练器、手机GPU训练器、仅前向训练及GPU训练参考基线，该系统在保持模型质量的同时显著降低延迟和能耗，实现可持续的后台微调。

Conclusion: 该工作展示了将NPU推理硬件复用于训练冻结权重操作的可行性，通过系统级协同设计解决了精度、内存、调度和热管理挑战，为移动设备上的私有数据个性化LLM微调提供了实用方案。

Abstract: On-device fine-tuning lets a large language model (LLM) learn from its user's private data without uploading it. Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) reduces the trainable parameters, but each first-order training step still multiplies by the frozen base-model weights during the forward pass, activation recomputation, and input-gradient computation. A phone's neural processing unit (NPU) already holds these weights for inference; using it for training also requires computing input gradients, which its inference interface does not support. We present a system that runs all three frozen-weight products on the NPU while keeping the training graph, adapters, and optimizer on the CPU. Its input-gradient kernels reuse the resident weight tiles and the forward dequantizer, avoiding a transposed weight copy and ensuring forward and backward use the same effective weights. To preserve usable gradients, the system selects precision by gradient sensitivity and applies a per-row range guard for half-precision (FP16) outputs. Its runtime fuses the remaining CPU operators and overlaps NPU execution with adapter computation, while resumable execution and thermal pacing let training proceed as a background job. We evaluate it on two Qualcomm Snapdragon platforms using four LLMs from the Qwen and Llama families. Our workloads cover nightly personalization with labels supplied on the phone and the public LaMP-2 benchmark; comparisons include an optimized CPU trainer, a phone-GPU trainer, forward-only training, and GPU-trained references.

</details>


### [278] [Pair-Aware Optimization: Coordinating Exploration and Refinement for Jailbreaking LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24823)
*Juanyang Xu,Zheng Wang,Xingyu Zhao,Siddartha Khastgir,Andi Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文系统研究了大语言模型代理的越狱攻击，比较了一阶(FO)和零阶(ZO)优化方法的互补性与顺序，提出ZO-FO混合框架配合Pair-aware优化和随机解码，实验证明混合优化优于单一优化器，且优化顺序显著影响攻击效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于优化的越狱攻击主要使用FO梯度方法或ZO函数值反馈方法，但两者的互补性和优化顺序尚未充分探索。此外，单一贪婪输出无法捕捉随机生成带来的多样化推理轨迹和动作。

Method: 系统研究四种策略：纯ZO、纯FO、ZO->FO、FO->ZO；开发ZO-FO框架：ZO优化搜索对抗前缀，FO优化细化对应后缀；引入Pair-aware优化保留多个前缀候选、条件性细化后缀并选择最优前缀-后缀对；采用一致随机解码覆盖优化和评估阶段。

Result: 在恶意指令和恶意环境基准上，混合优化显著优于单一优化器方法；优化顺序(ZO->FO优于FO->ZO)对性能有实质影响；随机生成视角下的攻击效果优于确定性贪婪解码。

Conclusion: FO与ZO优化具有互补性，ZO先探索再FO细化的顺序最优；Pair-aware机制有效协调前后缀联合优化；随机解码能更全面评估代理越狱鲁棒性，为构建更安全的LLM代理提供了新视角。

Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents are vulnerable to adversarial inputs that induce attacker-specified malicious behaviors, commonly referred to as jailbreaking. Existing optimization-based jailbreak attacks primarily employ first-order (FO) methods that leverage gradient information or zeroth-order (ZO) methods that rely on function-value feedback. However, their complementarity and optimization ordering remain underexplored. We systematically investigate four strategies: pure ZO, pure FO, ZO->FO, and FO->ZO, and develop a ZO-FO framework that explores adversarial prefixes through ZO optimization and refines their corresponding suffixes through FO optimization. To coordinate the two processes, we introduce Pair-aware optimization, which retains multiple prefix candidates, conditionally refines their suffixes and selects among the resulting prefix-suffix pairs. We further investigate agent jailbreaking from a more general stochastic-generation perspective, where the same adversarial input can induce diverse reasoning trajectories and actions that a single greedy output cannot capture. Accordingly, we adopt consistent stochastic decoding during both optimization and evaluation. Experiments across malicious-instruction and malicious-environment benchmarks demonstrate that hybrid optimization improves attack effectiveness over single-optimizer methods, while optimization order substantially influences performance.

</details>


### [279] [Compose the Horizon: Parameter-Shared Blockwise Forecasting under a Sequential-Compute Trade-off](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24826)
*Zeyan Li,Weiheng Li,Shengda Zhuo,Libing Chen,Min Chen,Yin Tang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出递归功能分解（RFD）方法，用于长时域预测。与传统一次性输出完整未来的预测器不同，RFD 复用紧凑算子按顺序发射连续的未来块，将存储参数换取顺序计算。RFD 将时域映射分解为三个参数共享的块预测，块占据不相交的未来区间并拼接而非相加，每个发射的块加入滚动上下文以条件化下一次应用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有长时域预测器通常一次性输出完整未来。本文探讨是否可以复用紧凑算子来发射连续的未来块，用顺序计算换取存储参数，从而实现更高效的长时域预测。

Method: 递归功能分解（RFD）将时域映射分解为三个参数共享的块预测。这些块占据不相交的未来区间并通过拼接（而非作为趋势、季节或残差分量相加）组合。每个发射的块加入滚动上下文，作为下一次算子应用的条件。模型使用 0.08-0.46M 参数，采用顺序通道方式执行。

Result: 在受控三种子实验中：移除前向反馈会损害所有四个评估数据集的性能，而阻断其梯度影响很小，表明有用信号是不断演化的预测状态本身；重复应用共享算子持续有帮助，但效果不如扩宽算子。顺序通道执行在高通道数下比迭代基线更慢且更消耗内存。在冻结长上下文评估中，对比十个强基线家族，RFD 在 24 个对比单元中 23 个记录更低测试误差（跨协议对比：RFD 用 512/720 步上下文，基线用 96 步）。

Conclusion: RFD 证明了紧凑的参数共享算子可以通过顺序块预测有效生成长时域预测。演化的预测状态本身携带有用信号，重复应用算子虽有帮助但不如扩宽算子有效。顺序执行在高通道数下存在计算权衡，但在长上下文设置下表现优于强基线。

Abstract: Most long-horizon forecasters emit the complete future in one pass. We ask whether a compact operator can instead be reused to emit contiguous future blocks, trading stored parameters for sequential computation. Recursive Functional Decomposition (RFD) factorizes the horizon mapping into three parameter-shared block predictions. The blocks occupy disjoint future intervals and are concatenated, not added as trend, seasonal, or residual components, and each emitted block joins the rolling context that conditions the next application. In controlled three-seed experiments, removing forward feedback hurts all four evaluated datasets while stopping gradients through it changes little, so the useful signal is the evolving forecast state itself; reapplying the shared operator helps consistently, but by less than widening it. The model uses 0.08--0.46M parameters, yet its sequential channel-wise execution is slower and more memory-intensive than an iterative baseline at high channel count. In a frozen long-context evaluation against ten strong baseline families, RFD records lower test error in 23 of 24 cells; the comparison is cross-protocol, with RFD using 512/720-step context and the baselines using 96.

</details>


### [280] [Recurrent Temporal Restricted Boltzmann Machines as Unsupervised Encoders for Biomechanical Movement Sequences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24829)
*Wafi Sharif,Nicholas LaHaye*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文实现并评估了循环时序受限玻尔兹曼机(RTRBM)作为生物力学运动数据的无监督编码器，验证其在SIT-FUSE分割流程中的应用，但发现循环结构的收益证据不一，且在步态数据上学习的嵌入未优于简单通道汇总统计量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生物力学运动记录是连续高维时间序列，现有无监督表征学习流程多独立处理每帧丢弃时序结构，而基于能量的模型鲜有针对生物力学信号的改造，因此需要一种能捕捉运动随时间演化的循环概率模型。

Method: 将RTRBM改造为连续值信号，堆叠成深层架构，集成进SIT-FUSE分割管线；在模拟肌骨伸展任务及两个真实步态数据集上评估，采用聚类、重构、未见受试者步速分类等任务，并与非循环、非概率基线（含移除循环连接的对照）对比。

Result: 嵌入聚类无标签恢复了朝向目标的运动结构并能迁移至未见回合；步态数据上在非线性探针下优于PCA和自编码器基线。但移除循环连接在伸展任务未造成可测性能损失，且简单通道汇总统计量分类步速至少不劣于嵌入。

Conclusion: RTRBM是一个可用且已验证的SIT-FUSE编码器，但循环机制带来的收益证据不一，且在步态任务上学习到的嵌入未能超越简单统计特征。

Abstract: Biomechanical movement recordings are continuous, high-dimensional time series, and analyzing them without manually labeling them requires representations that capture how movements evolve over time. Most unsupervised representation-learning pipelines, however, treat each observation frame independently and discard this temporal structure, while energy-based models that could capture it have not extensively been adapted to biomechanical signals. So, this paper implements the Recurrent Temporal Restricted Boltzmann Machine (RTRBM), a recurrent energy-based model, into an unsupervised encoder that maps windows of movement data to fixed-length embeddings, and tests what its recurrent structure contributes. We adapt the model to continuous-valued signals, stack it into a deep architecture, and integrate it into the SIT-FUSE segmentation pipeline. We evaluate the embeddings on simulated musculoskeletal reaching and on two real gait datasets, using clustering, reconstruction, and walking-speed classification of unseen subjects, and compare them against non-recurrent and non-probabilistic baselines, including a control that removes the recurrent connection. Clustering the embeddings recovers movement structure tied to progress toward the target without any labels, which also transfers to unseen episodes. On gait data, the embeddings outperform PCA and autoencoder baselines under a nonlinear probe. However, removing the recurrent connection does not yield a measurable loss on the reaching task, and simple per-channel summary statistics classify walking speed at least as well as the embeddings. The model is therefore a working, verified encoder for SIT-FUSE, while the evidence for a benefit of recurrence is mixed, and the learned embeddings did not outperform simple summary statistics on gait.

</details>


### [281] [A Statistical Viewpoint on Adam, Shampoo and Muon](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24839)
*Tetiana Parshakova,Robert M. Gower,Paulo Orenstein*

Main category: cs.LG
