A phase-comparison theorem controls the actual shared-seed execution under simultaneous changes in the marginals and risk coefficients. A rare repair step then makes the confidence cost additive. Together with matching lower bounds, this removes the remaining logarithmic overhead and parameter restrictions in the general countable-domain sample-complexity problem. This extended version also retains the earlier explicit constructions and their proofs, including proper learning for VC-one classes, the full finite-atom class, a faster realizable bound, and counterexamples that separate restrictions of particular algorithms from restrictions of the learning problem.

</details>


### [314] [Auto-MD-bench: Evaluating Autoresearch Agents for Real-World Medical Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25069)
*Shenqi Zhou,Qiran Zou,Wenhao Zhao,Zhenyu Liao,Dianbo Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Auto-MD-bench 基准，评估四种自主代理在 15 个真实医学任务上的表现，发现虽然代理能达到有竞争力的主要指标（如 AUROC），但其预测风险的校准度显著低于简单基线模型，且相同主要分数下校准度差异大，跨人群泛化性能波动大，证明单一主要指标不足以评估自主临床建模，需引入医疗实践中常用的多维指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主代理在端到端开发机器学习模型方面能力增强，但在医疗实践中，仅靠目标指标（如 AUROC）无法完全刻画模型在真实场景中的表现，医疗模型还需提供良好校准的风险估计，并在不同患者人群中保持鲁棒性。现有自主建模通常以简单预测判别为目标，亟需研究这些目标是否足以引导代理满足真实医疗需求。

Method: 构建 Auto-MD-bench 基准，包含来自 10 个临床数据集的 15 个真实医学任务，涵盖生存分析、分类和序列预测，并支持跨队列、医院和时间周期的外部验证。评估四种自主代理：AIDE、AI Scientist v2、Codex 和 Autoresearch，对比其主要任务指标、校准度及跨人群泛化性能。

Result: 最强代理在主要指标上达到有竞争力的分数，但其预测风险的校准度显著低于简单基线模型，可能导致严重医疗事故；几乎相同的主要分数下，不同模型的校准度差异巨大；性能在不同人群分布偏移下波动显著。

Conclusion: 仅依赖主要任务性能不足以评估自主临床建模，必须综合考虑医疗实践中广泛使用的多种指标（如校准度、跨人群鲁棒性等），以确保模型在真实临床环境中的安全性和有效性。

Abstract: Autonomous agents are increasingly capable of developing machine learning (ML) models end to end. In medical practice, however, strong performance on the target metric does not fully characterize how good the models are in real-world use cases. For example, medical ML models should also provide well-calibrated risk estimates and remain robust across patient populations. Yet autonomous model development is typically guided by task objectives that emphasize simple predictive discrimination (e.g. AUROC). This raises a key question: are these objectives sufficient to guide agents toward models that meet the broader requirements of real-world medical use? In this study, we introduce Auto-MD-bench, a benchmark of 15 real-world medical tasks from 10 clinical datasets, spanning survival analysis, classification and sequential prediction, with external validation across cohorts, hospitals and time periods. We evaluate four agents: AIDE, AI Scientist v2, Codex, and Autoresearch. The strongest agents achieve competitive primary scores, yet their predicted risks are less calibrated than those of the simple baseline models, which could lead to severe medical accidents. Moreover, models with nearly identical primary scores can exhibit markedly different calibration, while performance varies substantially across population shifts. These findings show that primary task performance alone is insufficient to assess autonomous clinical modeling and multiple different metrics widely used in healthcare practice need to be taken into consideration.

</details>


### [315] [CoEvo-RSI: When Harnesses Evolve, Which Models Should Follow?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25078)
*Jiaqi Su,Guibin Zhang,Jie-Jing Shao,Cong Pang,Tiankuo Yao,Ivor Tsang,Haiyan Yin,Shuicheng Yan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出 CoEvo-RSI 框架，解决模型-支架协同进化中的“大脑-身体错位”问题，通过元智能体驱动的双向历史继承机制，仅用监督微调（SFT）在拒绝采样轨迹上训练，使 Qwen2.5-9B 在多智能体故障归因、角色感知 Text-to-SQL 和智能家居指令跟随等任务上达到或超越更大模型性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模型-支架协同进化是递归自我改进（RSI）智能体的主流范式，但存在持久且常被忽视的“大脑-身体错位”问题：演化中的支架（身体）要求模型（大脑）未学会的行为，或限制了模型已具备的能力，导致能力与执行需求不匹配。

Method: 提出 CoEvo-RSI 框架：引入共享进化归档和执行反馈，由元智能体协调支架开发（从历史设计继承）与模型检查点选择/合并及后续适配，实现双向历史继承，对齐继承能力与演化执行需求，减少脑-体错位。仅使用自身拒绝采样轨迹进行监督微调（SFT）。

Result: 在多个垂直应用上表现优异：Qwen2.5-9B 经 CoEvo-RSI 后具有竞争力。在 TraceElephant 基准上智能体准确率比 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 高 14.16%；在 HomeBench VM 上成功率比 GLM-5.3 高 4.90%。

Conclusion: 研究强调了脑-体对齐在模型-支架协同进化中的关键性，并验证了双向历史继承机制推进智能体协同进化的巨大潜力。

Abstract: Model--harness co-evolution has emerged as a prominent paradigm for recursive self-improving (RSI) agents, jointly evolving their execution scaffolds and intrinsic capabilities. We study the persistent yet often overlooked brain--body mismatch problem in this paradigm, where an evolving harness (body) demands behaviors its model (brain) has not learned or restricts capabilities it already possesses. We introduce CoEvo-RSI, a RSI framework that advances model--harness co-evolution through agent-driven, bidirectional historical inheritance. Drawing on a shared evolutionary archive and execution feedback, a meta-agent coordinates harness development from historical designs with model checkpoint selection or merging and subsequent adaptation under the selected harness, aligning inherited capabilities with evolving execution requirements to reduce brain--body mismatch. Using only supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on its own rejection-sampled trajectories, CoEvo-RSI makes Qwen3.5-9B competitive with larger models across diverse vertical applications, including multi-agent failure attribution, role-aware text-to-SQL, and smart-home instruction following. It surpasses DeepSeek-V4-Pro on TraceElephant (+14.16 agent accuracy) and GLM-5.3 on HomeBench VM (+4.90 success rate), underscoring the need for brain--body alignment and the potential of bidirectional historical inheritance to advance agent co-evolution.

</details>


### [316] [Conformal Prediction-Enabled Sequence-level Policy Optimization for Reasoning Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25092)
*Hui Yang,Wan Tian,Tao Ren,Zhongyi Li,Yijie Peng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出基于共形预测的序列级策略优化（CSPO），自适应校准序列级裁剪边界，解决固定裁剪带无法适应分数分布演化的问题，在数学推理和ALFWorld任务上超越GSPO。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有序列级强化学习方法虽统一了token级与序列级单位，但采用固定裁剪带，其尾部概率随训练中分数分布变化而漂移，导致裁剪效果不稳定，需自适应机制动态调整裁剪边界。

Method: CSPO利用近期训练统计量通过共形预测自适应校准序列级裁剪边界，使其针对指定的边际尾部预算，并随策略漂移自适应调整；理论上给出了新鲜分数落入带外概率的界（目标误覆盖率+显式CDF差异+漂移项），并在矩条件下控制目标函数和梯度误差。

Result: 在Qwen3-1.7B系列实验中，CSPO在困难数学推理基准和ALFWorld任务上优于GSPO，且裁剪端点在训练过程中自适应演化。

Conclusion: CSPO通过共形预测实现序列级裁剪边界的自适应校准，理论保证了误覆盖率控制，实验验证了其在数学推理和交互式任务中的有效性，为大模型强化学习提供了更稳健的序列级优化框架。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning improves the reasoning capability of large language models through verifiable rewards for mathematical and coding tasks. In token-level methods such as GRPO, clipping acts on individual token ratios while the reward and advantage apply to a complete response. Recent sequence-level methods align these units but still use fixed clipping bands, whose tail probabilities change as the score distribution evolves. We propose Conformal Prediction-Enabled Sequence-level Policy Optimization (CSPO), which adaptively calibrates sequence-level clipping bounds using recent training statistics. The resulting band targets a specified marginal tail budget and adapts to policy drift; calibration conditional on response length requires additional assumptions. We bound the probability that a fresh score falls outside the band by the target miscoverage level plus explicit CDF discrepancy and drift terms. Under additional moment conditions, this bound also controls the objective and gradient error relative to the unclipped GSPO power surrogate. Experiments with the Qwen3-1.7B series show improvements over GSPO on difficult mathematical reasoning benchmarks and ALFWorld, with clipping endpoints that adapt during training.

</details>


### [317] [Self-organizing reinforcement learning: a swarm approaches the explore-exploit optimum](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25113)
*Galen J. Wilkerson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文展示了一个最小化觅食群体如何在无学习器、无奖励信号的情况下，通过自我组织物理机制接近理想自由分布/纳什均衡资源分配。群体利用莱维飞行探索、阈值级联招募和拥挤驱散实现探索-利用平衡，零样本达到预言机上限的65%，早期超越训练的PPO/CTDE，但最终被超越。核心发现：强化学习问题在于宏观分配而非微观规则，群体物理机制可携带集体接近最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探讨强化学习核心的探索/利用权衡问题是否必须依赖学习器和奖励信号。作者旨在证明：通过最小化的群体自我组织物理规则（无显式学习、无奖励评估），集体也能涌现出接近理想自由分布/纳什均衡的资源分配，挑战RL必须在微观层面评估回报的假设。

Method: 构建具身觅食群体模型：智能体以莱维飞行（重尾分布）探索；通过邻近网络上的阈值级联招募邻居至发现处；补丁拥挤时驱散。三规则耦合招募与运动形成级联循环，动态平衡探索与利用。对比基线：无耦合消融、离散博弈最优解、具身环境下的PPO与集中式评论家（CTDE）训练智能体。

Result: 群体达成资源丰富度跟踪斜率0.94（理想为1），动态收敛约150步。移除招募-运动耦合导致匹配崩溃（0.94→0.08）。具身环境中零样本达预言机上限65%，早期领先训练智能体；约4000步后PPO/CTDE超越至74-75%（16种子均超群体均值）。离散博弈中学习器更精确。群体质量平台期后重新安稳，无累积增益。

Conclusion: 强化学习的优化目标（理想自由分布/纳什均衡）可由无奖励、无学习的群体物理机制作为涌现操作点近似实现。此非作为击败RL，而是展示强零样本、无奖励操作点的优势：预算效率而非渐近性能。微观规则无需评估回报，宏观分配自发逼近RL寻求的最优。

Abstract: The explore/exploit trade-off is the core problem of reinforcement learning (RL). We show that a minimal foraging swarm approaches its optimum - the ideal-free / Nash allocation of a multi-agent resource-sharing game (an equilibrium, not a return maximum) - with no learner and no reward signal. Agents explore by heavy-tailed (Levy) flights, recruit neighbours to a discovery through a threshold cascade on their proximity network, and disperse as a patch crowds; this cascade cycle balances exploration and exploitation and drives foragers toward the ideal free distribution. The swarm attains the shape of this optimum (committed foragers track richness with slope 0.94) but not its exact equilibrium - it stays measurably exploitable - reaching it dynamically (~150 steps) through the coupling of recruitment to movement: remove the coupling and matching collapses (0.94 -> 0.08). The RL sits at the level of the problem and the allocation reached, not the micro-rule: no step evaluates payoff (reward-free by construction, though the crowd signal is informationally tied to payoff), and the swarm reaches the allocation without learning it (quality plateaus and re-settles after resources move, no cumulative gain). Against a trained baseline the comparison is two-sided: in an easier, disembodied game a learner is more precise, while in the same embodied environment the reward-free swarm reaches ~65% of a validated oracle ceiling at zero training and leads until trained PPO and centralised-critic (CTDE) learners overtake it (~74-75%, 16 seeds, all above the swarm mean) after ~4,000 of 15,000 training steps - its advantage is in budget, not asymptote. In this one setting we read it not as beating RL but as a strong zero-shot, reward-free operating point: a demonstration that the self-organizing physics of a minimal swarm can carry a collective close to the optimum RL seeks, with none of RL's machinery.

</details>


### [318] [Polynomial Learning of Positive ReLU Networks under Gaussian Inputs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25116)
*Zhijie Zheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究无偏置、单隐藏层、输出权重非负的ReLU网络在标准高斯输入下的学习问题，给出了一个实数算术学习保证：宽度为k、总输出权重不超过1的目标网络可被宽度至多为k+min{k,d}的非负ReLU网络以平方预测误差ε逼近，样本和计算复杂度为(1+σ²)poly(d,k,ε⁻¹,log(1/δ))。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有理论往往假设隐藏方向正交或线性无关、噪声具有均匀有界条件方差等，而本文考虑更一般的设定：隐藏方向可以任意接近或线性相关，标签以目标网络为条件均值，噪声仅假设无条件二阶矩有限，旨在建立更宽松条件下的学习保证。

Method: 结合隐式高阶矩与方向覆盖（对重原子完备、对所有输出合理），利用精确高斯软局部化细化覆盖并通过剪枝在每个尺度保留至多k个中心；通过裁剪查询乘数控制重尾、输入相关的噪声，无需假设均匀条件方差有界；最后进行凸拟合和精确稀疏化步骤得到输出宽度。

Result: 给出宽度至多为k+min{k,d}的非负ReLU网络，以平方预测误差ε逼近目标网络，样本和操作复杂度为(1+σ²)poly(d,k,ε⁻¹,log(1/δ))；同时获得参数化的投影方向恢复保证。

Conclusion: 结果针对实数算术复杂度，未给出位复杂度或实际运行时间保证。

Abstract: We study bias-free, one-hidden-layer ReLU networks with nonnegative output weights under standard Gaussian inputs. Hidden directions may be arbitrarily close or linearly dependent. The labels have the target as their conditional mean, and only the unconditional second moment of the noise is bounded. We present a candidate real-arithmetic learning guarantee: a width-$k$ target with total output weight at most one can be approximated to squared prediction error $\varepsilon$ by a nonnegative ReLU network of width at most $k+\min\{k,d\}$, with sample and operation cost $(1+σ^2)\operatorname{poly}(d,k,\varepsilon^{-1},\log(1/δ))$. The argument combines implicit high-order moments with a direction cover that is complete for heavy atoms and sound for every output. Exact Gaussian soft localization refines this cover while pruning keeps at most $k$ centers at every scale. Clipping the query multipliers controls heavy-tailed, input-dependent noise without assuming a uniform conditional variance bound. A final convex fit and an exact sparsification step give the stated output width. We also obtain a parameterized projective direction-recovery guarantee. The result concerns real-arithmetic complexity; no bit-complexity or practical running-time guarantee is asserted.

</details>


### [319] [Memory as Belief: Bayesian Evolution of Memory for Self-Evolving LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25119)
*Yiming Xu,Qian Yang,Zihan Chen,Yuefei Wu,Wenhan Zeng,Bin Shi,Bo Dong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出BEAM框架，基于贝叶斯大脑假说，将记忆价值评估重构为参数化认知推理过程，利用任务上下文和执行反馈动态校准记忆价值信念，实现LLM代理的持续自我进化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM代理依赖外部记忆积累经验，但记忆复用需准确评估价值，现有方法基于历史检索成功率，忽视上下文依赖性和证据量对估计可靠性的影响，记忆估值研究不足。

Method: 受贝叶斯大脑假说启发，提出BEAM（贝叶斯风格进化代理记忆），将记忆价值表示为上下文条件动态信念而非被动历史统计；从当前任务上下文推断记忆价值信念，并利用执行反馈作为经验证据持续校准，将记忆从被动存储转化为自适应认知机制。

Result: 在推理和代码生成基准上的大量实验表明，BEAM持续改善记忆利用，并实现LLM代理的持续自我进化。

Conclusion: BEAM通过贝叶斯式动态信念更新机制，有效解决了记忆价值评估的上下文依赖性和证据可靠性问题，显著提升了LLM代理的记忆利用效率和持续适应能力。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on external memory to accumulate past experiences for continual adaptation. However, effectively reusing memory requires accurately assessing its value, as retrieved experiences may become unreliable when transferred across task contexts. Despite its importance, memory valuation remains largely underexplored, with existing methods relying on historical retrieval success rates that overlook the context dependency of memory usefulness and the varying reliability of estimates under different amounts of evidence. Inspired by the Bayesian brain hypothesis, we propose BEAM (Bayesian-style Evolutionary Agentic Memory), a framework that reformulates memory value evaluation as a parameterized cognitive inference process, where memory value is represented as a context-conditioned dynamic belief rather than a passive historical statistic. Specifically, BEAM infers memory value beliefs from current task contexts and continuously calibrates them using execution feedback as empirical evidence, transforming memory from passive storage into an adaptive cognitive mechanism for continual self-evolution. Extensive experiments across reasoning and code generation benchmarks demonstrate that BEAM consistently improves memory utilization and enables continual self-evolution of LLM agents.

</details>


### [320] [ClinSDT: LLM-Encoded Clinical Semantic Guidance for Sepsis Treatment via Decision Transformer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25121)
*Yanyan Wu,Guanyu Zhu,Changbin Zhao,Jin Zhang,Dexu Yu,Tianmin Sun,Jining Luan,Chunxiao Li,Hanwen Du,Youhua Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ClinSDT 是一个基于 LLM 辅助的 Decision Transformer 框架，用于离线脓毒症治疗决策。它通过冻结的 LLM 作为语义桥梁，从 ICU 轨迹构建三个临床语义视图（Profile、Context、Advisory），并训练一个治疗-反应预测器进行反事实候选筛选与策略蒸馏，在 MIMIC-III/IV 上显著优于现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于 Decision Transformer 的离线脓毒症治疗方法主要依赖原始生理状态和历史临床动作，无法显式捕捉临床医生在实践中使用的语义信息，如患者严重程度、近期治疗反应和当前风险优先级，限制了策略的临床合理性与性能。

Method: 1. 使用冻结的 LLM 作为语义桥梁，从 ICU 轨迹构建三个临床语义视图（Profile、Context、Advisory），将其编码表示作为独立 token 插入 Decision Transformer 策略中。2. 训练治疗-反应预测器，基于状态-动作输入预测下一生理状态、SAPS-II 变化及预测不确定性。3. 第二阶段利用预测器筛选局部反事实治疗候选，仅保留低不确定性且预测 SAPS-II 增加较小的候选，经语义再生后蒸馏进策略。4. 推理时通过刷新当前患者状态的语义输入进行闭环治疗推演。

Result: 在 MIMIC-III 和 MIMIC-IV 数据集上，ClinSDT 在相同推演协议下，相对于代表性的模仿学习、离线强化学习和 Decision Transformer 基线均取得了一致的相对性能提升。

Conclusion: ClinSDT 通过引入 LLM 构建的临床语义视图和治疗-反应预测器，有效将临床领域知识融入离线决策策略，显著提升了脓毒症治疗决策的质量与鲁棒性，为临床决策支持提供了可解释且高性能的新范式。

Abstract: Offline sepsis treatment aims to learn treatment policies from retrospective ICU trajectories. Decision Transformer-based methods provide a natural sequence modeling framework for this task, but they mainly rely on raw physiological states and historical clinician actions. Such raw trajectory tokens may not explicitly capture clinical semantics that clinicians use in practice, such as patient severity, recent treatment response, and current risk priorities. To address this limitation, we propose ClinSDT, an LLM-assisted Decision Transformer framework for offline sepsis treatment. ClinSDT uses a frozen LLM as a semantic bridge rather than a treatment decision maker. It constructs three clinical semantic views from ICU trajectories, namely Profile, Context, and Advisory, and inserts their encoded representations as independent tokens into a Decision Transformer policy. To support policy refinement and rollout, ClinSDT further trains a Treatment-Response Forecaster to estimate the next physiological state, SAPS-II change, and predictive uncertainty from state-action inputs. In the second training stage, the forecaster screens local counterfactual treatment candidates, and only low-uncertainty candidates with lower predicted SAPS-II increase are distilled into the policy after semantic regeneration. During inference, ClinSDT performs closed-loop treatment rollout by refreshing semantic inputs from the currently available patient state. Experiments on MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV show that ClinSDT achieves consistent relative improvements over representative imitation learning, offline reinforcement learning, and Decision Transformer baselines under the same rollout protocol. Code and data are available at https://github.com/KAG778/ClinSDT.

</details>


### [321] [Trackable Skill Library Lifecycle Management for Agentic Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25126)
*Xi Zhu,Yuanlin Duan,Changyi Yang,Kai Mei,Riyang Bao,Shichao Zhu,Dimitris N. Metaxas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 TrackRL，一种基于技能追踪的智能体强化学习框架，解决技能库全生命周期管理问题。通过在 GRPO 组内构建在线随机对照实验，隔离各技能的真实因果贡献，累积证据量化技能效用与模型掌握度，并以证据门控的状态转移过程管理技能从生成、准入、孵化到保留、退休或移除的全生命周期。实验表明 TrackRL 在库辅助与无技能评测中均超越现有基线，并揭示了技能价值随策略学习的动态演变。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有技能增强智能体 RL 方法在长时域任务上虽有效，但个别技能随策略演进轨迹各异：部分被内化后冗余，部分仍作为外部脚手架有价值，部分甚至有害。现有技能库系统因共检索技能间的‘免费搭车’、跨任务混淆、缺乏技能级反事实证据，无法可靠识别各技能真实贡献，导致技能生命周期管理失效。

Method: TrackRL 在每个 GRPO 组内将分组采样转化为在线随机对照实验：对同一任务独立随机注入技能并进行组内对比，分离出各技能的真实因果贡献；采用可靠性加权聚合跨组累积证据。持续追踪技能效用（作为外部脚手架的因果贡献）与模型掌握度（对应能力内化程度）。将技能生命周期建模为证据门控的状态转移过程，涵盖生成、准入、受保护孵化、保留、退休、移除等状态，并以软容量上限控制库规模增长。

Result: 实验显示 TrackRL 在库辅助评测与无技能评测两种设定下均显著优于近期技能增强 RL 基线。进一步分析揭示了技能价值在策略学习过程中的动态迁移模式，以及证据驱动的状态转移如何塑造技能库的演化轨迹。

Conclusion: TrackRL 通过基于随机对照实验的技能级因果追踪，实现了技能库的精细化全生命周期管理，有效解决了技能贡献识别难、冗余有害技能累积等问题，为长时域任务上的智能体强化学习提供了更可靠、可解释的技能增强范式。

Abstract: Skill-augmented agentic RL has emerged as an effective approach to improving LLM agents on long-horizon tasks. Despite this progress, individual skills may follow distinct trajectories as the policy evolves, with some becoming redundant after the model internalizes their capabilities, others remaining valuable as external scaffolding, and still others turning harmful. However, existing skill library systems fail to identify each skill's true contribution due to free-riding among co-retrieved skills, difficulty confounding across tasks, and the absence of skill-specific counterfactual evidence, which prevents reliable skill lifecycle management. We propose TrackRL, an agentic RL framework where skill tracking drives skill library full lifecycle management. Specifically, within each GRPO group, we turn grouped sampling into online randomized controlled experiments. Independent random injection and within-group contrasts on the same task isolate each skill's true contribution, and reliability-weighted aggregation accumulates evidence across groups. As evidence accumulates, we continuously track skill utility, which measures the skill's causal contribution as external scaffolding, and model mastery, which reflects how far the corresponding capability has been internalized. Along this line, we formulate skill lifecycle management as an evidence-gated state-transition process that governs each skill from generation and admission through protected incubation to retention, retirement, or removal, while a soft capacity bound controls library growth. Experiments show that TrackRL outperforms recent skill-augmented RL baselines in both library-assisted and skill-free evaluation, with further analyses revealing how skill value shifts during policy learning and how evidence-driven state transitions shape skill library evolution. Our code is available at https://github.com/xizhu1022/TrackRL.

</details>


### [322] [FHKAN: Fractional Hermite Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks for Data-Driven and Physics-Informed Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25148)
*Arsha Farnoush,Amirhossein Sadr,Aida Pakniyat,Dara Rahmati,Saeid Gorgin,Kourosh Parand*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出分数阶埃尔米特Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（FHKAN），通过引入可训练的分数阶广义埃尔米特基函数，解决了现有谱KAN依赖有限区间切比雪夫多项式并需饱和压缩预激活的问题。FHKAN的基函数在整个实线上正交归一化，且在高斯包络下一致有界，可直接作用于无界预激活。实验表明FHKAN在合成回归、图像分类、去噪、情感分析及物理信息问题（如Lane-Emden、Burgers、分数阶延迟微分方程）上均达到最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的谱KAN主要基于切比雪夫多项式，定义在有限区间上，必须通过饱和压缩函数将预激活映射到有限区间，限制了模型的表达能力和适用性。需要一种能在整个实线上正交、无需饱和映射、且具有可调形状参数的基函数来增强KAN的灵活性和性能。

Method: 提出分数阶广义埃尔米特基函数，引入非负形状参数，使基函数在实线上正交归一化且在高斯包络下一致有界；推导广义、分数阶、缩放基函数在原点以外的闭式导数，并分析分数幂映射在原点产生的奇点处的可微阶数；构建FHKAN架构，将该基函数作为KAN的可学习单变量映射。

Result: 在合成回归任务中，FHKAN在所有网络深度下测试误差均低于九种固定激活函数和基于样条的KAN；在图像分类、图像去噪、情感分析任务中，最优分数阶埃尔米特块获得最高准确率或重建质量；在物理信息问题上，Lane-Emden方程平均绝对误差10^-6至10^-5，Burgers方程残差10^-4量级，分数阶延迟微分方程绝对误差低于10^-4。

Conclusion: FHKAN通过分数阶广义埃尔米特基函数消除了饱和映射的需求，实现了在无界预激活上的直接建模，并在多种基准任务和物理信息问题上展现出卓越的精度和泛化能力，为谱KAN提供了更灵活、更强大的理论基础和实用架构。

Abstract: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) replace fixed scalar weights by learnable univariate maps, yet most spectral KANs still rely on Chebyshev polynomials that live on a bounded interval and therefore require a saturating squashing of the pre-activation. We introduce the Fractional Hermite Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (FHKAN), a neural architecture that equips KANs with an adaptive, trainable fractional-order generalized Hermite basis. With a nonnegative shape parameter, the underlying generalized Hermite functions are orthonormal on the entire real line and uniformly bounded under a Gaussian envelope, so they act directly on unbounded pre-activations without any saturating map. We derive closed-form derivatives of the generalized, fractional, and scaled basis away from the origin and determine its order of differentiability at the origin, where the fractional power map creates a singular point. On synthetic regression, FHKAN attains the lowest test error at every network depth among nine fixed activations and the spline-based KAN. On image classification, image denoising, and sentiment analysis, the best-performing fractional Hermite block yields the highest accuracy or reconstruction quality. On physics-informed problems, FHKAN reaches mean absolute errors of order 10^-6 to 10^-5 on the Lane-Emden equation, residuals of order 10^-4 on the Burgers equation, and absolute errors below 10^-4 on a fractional delay differential equation.

</details>


### [323] [Learning without Overwriting: Structural Knowledge Fusion for Continual Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25150)
*Kanishk Bakshi,Amitansu Pattanaik,Kathiravan Srinivasan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出知识融合网络（KFN），通过新颖性门控的结构扩展解决类增量学习中的灾难性遗忘问题。KFN将任务获取与知识巩固解耦：每个新任务在隔离的轻量级专家网络（2.8M参数）中学习，再通过结构融合模块按新颖性分数分配专用通道容量整合至全局模型。双重结构隔离（通道空间分离与时序分阶梯度解冻）保护已巩固知识。在十任务Split CIFAR-100上，KFN实现11.94%最小任务准确率和71.16%任务10准确率，遗忘率57.92%，比基线显著降低；跨CIFAR-100和EuroSAT数据集，类增量保持率分别达72.7%和42.5%，远超最佳基线。参数效率呈线性增长，十任务仅增加基础参数量的25%，峰值GPU内存比完全重训练降低37.1%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 灾难性遗忘源于固定容量架构约束：在共享参数预算内编码新任务的参数更新会扰动支持先验表示的权重子空间，导致稳定性-可塑性权衡难以平衡。现有基于共享参数的基线（LwF、Replay、Replay++）在长任务序列上严重退化，无法有效保护旧知识。

Method: 知识融合网络（KFN）采用新颖性门控的结构扩展策略：1）任务获取与知识巩固解耦，每个新任务在隔离的轻量级专家网络（2.8M参数）独立学习；2）结构融合模块根据定量新颖性分数分配专用通道容量，将专家知识整合进全局模型；3）双重结构隔离——通道空间分离配合时序分阶梯度解冻，保护已巩固知识不被后续任务干扰。

Result: 十任务Split CIFAR-100：KFN最小任务准确率11.94%，任务10准确率71.16%，遗忘率57.92%（比Replay低15.5个百分点）；基线严重退化：LwF平均9.07%（最小0%）、Replay++平均8.91%（遗忘85.08%）、Replay平均16.21%（遗忘73.44%）。KFN防止logit尺度漂移，保持近似对称的任务表现。跨数据集类增量保持率：CIFAR-100 72.7%、EuroSAT 42.5%，远超最佳基线（29.6%和0.94%）。参数效率：每步增加25%基础参数，十任务总计28.1M参数（仅为朴素骨干复制112.0M的25.1%），峰值GPU内存比完全重训练降低37.1%。

Conclusion: KFN确立了新颖性门控的结构扩展作为超越固定容量架构的实用路径，通过解耦任务获取与知识巩固、结构隔离保护旧知识，在类增量学习中实现了显著更低的遗忘率、更高的保持率、参数高效的线性扩展和大幅内存节省，为持续学习提供了新范式。

Abstract: Catastrophic forgetting in sequential deep learning arises from a fixed-capacity architectural constraint: parameter updates encoding new tasks perturb weight subspaces supporting prior representations. We introduce the Knowledge Fusion Network (KFN), which mitigates the stability-plasticity trade-off in class-incremental learning through novelty-gated structural expansion rather than parameter negotiation within a shared capacity budget. KFN decouples task acquisition from knowledge consolidation: each incoming task is learned in an isolated lightweight specialist network (2.8M parameters) and integrated into the global model via a Structural Fusion Module that allocates dedicated channel capacity conditioned on a quantitative novelty score. Dual structural isolation--channel-space separation with temporally phased gradient unfreezing--protects consolidated knowledge. On ten-task Split CIFAR-100, KFN achieves 11.94% minimum task accuracy and 71.16% task-10 accuracy, whereas shared-parameter baselines degrade severely: LwF to 9.07% average accuracy (0.00% min), Replay++ to 8.91% (85.08% forgetting), and Replay to 16.21% (73.44% forgetting); KFN's forgetting (57.92%) is 15.5 pp lower than Replay. Furthermore, KFN prevents logit-scale drift, maintaining near-symmetric task performance. Across CIFAR-100 and EuroSAT satellite imagery, KFN's class-incremental retention (72.7% and 42.5%) substantially exceeds the best baselines (29.6% and 0.94%). Crucially, KFN achieves parameter-efficient linear scaling, adding 25% of the base parameter count per step and requiring 25.1% of naive backbone duplication over ten tasks (28.1M vs 112.0M). With a 37.1% peak GPU memory reduction over full retraining, KFN establishes novelty-gated expansion as a practical path beyond fixed-capacity architectures.

</details>


### [324] [Indistinguishable Agents: Training Agent Privacy as Twin-World Indistinguishability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25161)
*Jiaming He,Guanyu Hou,Yi Yu,Xudong Jiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为Twin World Privacy (TWP)的新型隐私保护训练方法，用于解决LLM代理在执行任务时（如搜索、购物、发送消息）被观察者通过行为推断隐私事实的问题。现有方法仅惩罚代理明确提及受保护项目，但观察者仍可从代理的行为模式中推断隐私。TWP通过构建仅在隐私事实上不同的‘孪生世界’，利用冻结的区分器计算观察者视角的对数似然比，并结合配对GRPO训练代理在任务成功率与隐私泄露之间取得平衡。理论上证明该目标能控制所有观察者在所有信道上的贝叶斯成功率，实验表明在购物和消息任务中，TWP消除了现有方法遗漏的泄露，同时保持任务完成能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM代理隐私训练方法主要关注防止代理在输出中直接泄露受保护信息（如不提及隐私项目），但忽略了观察者可以通过代理的行为模式（如搜索查询、购买决策、消息发送频率等动作）推断隐私事实。由于观察者仅在其视角随隐私事实变化时才能学到隐私，因此需要一种能从观察者视角量化并最小化信息泄露的训练目标，而非仅从代理输出层面约束。

Method: 核心方法Twin World Privacy (TWP)包含三个关键组件：1) 孪生世界构造：生成仅在目标隐私事实上不同、其他所有条件相同的环境对；2) 冻结区分器：针对每个观察者视角，计算其在两个世界下观测轨迹的对数似然比，量化该观察者区分隐私事实的能力（即信息泄露程度）；3) 配对GRPO训练：将代理的奖励设定为任务成功奖励减去区分器输出的对数似然比，通过强化学习同时优化任务性能与隐私保护。理论上证明该目标等价于最小化所有观察者在所有信道上的贝叶斯最优推断成功率。

Result: 在购物任务和消息发送任务的实验中，TWP显著降低了隐私泄露：相比基于披露判断器和查询级奖励的现有基线，TWP消除了这些方法遗漏的行为层面泄露（如通过购买模式推断用户偏好、通过消息发送时机推断关系状态等）。同时，代理在主要任务上的完成率与无隐私约束的基线相当，未出现显著性能下降。实验验证了理论分析：区分器得分与实际观察者推断成功率高度相关。

Conclusion: TWP通过从观察者视角建模隐私泄露，而非仅约束代理输出，实现了对行为隐私泄露的根本性控制。其理论保证（控制所有观察者的贝叶斯成功率）和实证有效性（消除现有方法遗漏的泄露且不损任务性能）表明，孪生世界范式配合对数似然比奖励塑形，为LLM代理的行为隐私保护提供了一个原则性、可扩展的解决方案。未来工作可扩展至多隐私事实、持续学习及更复杂的多代理交互场景。

Abstract: LLM agents search, shop and send messages for their users, and every action is seen by some party. Existing privacy training rewards agents for not mentioning protected items, yet an observer can infer a private fact from what the agent does. Since an observer learns a fact only if its view changes with the fact, we propose \methodfull (\method), which trains on twin worlds that differ only in the private fact. A frozen distinguisher scores each observer's view by its log-likelihood ratio for the true world, and paired GRPO trains the agent on task success minus this ratio. We prove that this objective controls the Bayes success of every observer on every channel. On shopping and messaging tasks \method removes the leakage that disclosure judges and query-level rewards miss, while the agent still completes its tasks.

</details>


### [325] [M-JEPA: Predictive Self-Supervised Learning for Molecular Graphs with Scaffold-Shift Evaluation on Tox21](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25163)
*Karthik Iyer,Nasser Sabar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将联合嵌入预测架构(JEPAs)改造用于分子图，通过掩码化学连贯的连通子图并用EMA教师回归目标嵌入，提出抗泄漏、算力匹配的三阶段评估协议。在相同算力下，M-JEPA在ESOL上显著优于InfoNCE基线(RMSE 2.12 vs 3.75)，训练更快(15-25分钟 vs 35-45分钟)但方差较大。Tox21上改进随靶点而异，校准指标显示微调虽提升排序但常留概率失准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自监督分子表征学习常用于小样本、标签稀缺的性质预测任务，但对比学习目标对视图构建敏感，且常用评估协议仅报告区分度指标，忽略分布偏移下的可靠性与校准问题。

Method: 1) 将JEPAs迁移到分子图：掩码化学连贯的连通子图，训练上下文编码器回归由EMA教师产生的掩码目标嵌入。2) 引入三阶段抗泄漏、算力匹配评估协议：(i) ESOL上80轮固定算力的目标筛选；(ii) 仅基于JEPA优化掩码与增强策略；(iii) Tox21上按Bemis-Murcko脚手架切分，逐靶点进行区分度-可靠性联合分析与归因诊断。

Result: 同算力下M-JEPA在ESOL代理任务上RMSE显著更低(均值2.12 vs 3.75，配对差值1.61，95% CI[1.52,1.72]，Wilcoxon p=2.4e-4)，单GPU训练更快(~15-25分钟 vs ~35-45分钟)但运行时方差较大。Tox21上ROC-AUC/PR-AUC提升依赖靶点，不一致暗示更好校准；可靠性图与Brier/ECE揭示微调虽改善排序但概率常保持失准。

Conclusion: M-JEPA在匹配算力下实现更高样本效率与更快收敛，但下游任务的概率校准仍具挑战，需采用区分度-可靠性联合评估而非单一指标。

Abstract: Self-supervised molecular representation learning is increasingly used to improve transfer on small, label-limited property prediction tasks, yet commonly used contrastive objectives can be sensitive to view construction and are often evaluated with protocols that report only discrimination. We adapt Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) to molecular graphs by masking chemically coherent connected subgraphs and training a context encoder to regress the masked target embedding produced by an exponential-moving-average (EMA) teacher. To evaluate predictive self-supervision under realistic distribution shift, we introduce a leakage-resistant, compute-matched three-phase protocol: (i) an 80-run objective screening on ESOL with fixed compute budgets, (ii) JEPA-only refinement of masking and augmentation choices, and (iii) per-assay Tox21 evaluation under Bemis-Murcko scaffold splits with joint discrimination-reliability analysis and attribution diagnostics. Under matched compute, M-JEPA achieves substantially lower ESOL proxy RMSE than a compute-matched InfoNCE baseline (mean RMSE 2.12 vs 3.75; mean paired dRMSE 1.61; 95% bootstrap CI [1.52, 1.72]; Wilcoxon p=2.4e-4) and typically completes runs faster (~15-25 min vs ~35-45 min on a single GPU under identical hardware), albeit with higher runtime variance. On Tox21, improvements in ROC-AUC/PR-AUC are assay-dependent and do not uniformly imply better calibration; reliability diagrams and Brier/ECE metrics reveal endpoints where fine-tuning improves ranking but leaves probabilities miscalibrated.

</details>


### [326] [World Models, Trees and Foundation Models for Retail Forecasting: Evidence from Four Public Data Sets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25170)
*Karthik Iyer,Madan Dabbeeru*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文在四个公开零售数据集上，针对商品-门店、跨门店商品、类别-门店、类别及全链条四个决策粒度，系统对比了世界模型、LightGBM、Temporal Fusion Transformer、TimesFM、Chronos-Bolt、Timestral、季节性朴素预测及三模型等权平均等八种预测方法，采用滚动预测起点、配对检验和模型置信集合评估。结果显示：在商品-门店和跨门店商品粒度，等权平均在多数数据集上误差最低且置信集合极小；在类别-门店、类别及全链条粒度，最优模型随数据集变化，且可用窗口不足以区分多数模型；在类别-门店规划成本上，等权平均或 LightGBM 表现最佳，世界模型仅在 M5 胜出。所有训练模型均使用价格促销计划输入，预训练模型若不使用该计划在周度促销驱动数据上准确度显著下降。结论仅适用于实验数据集，若考虑完整 4P 或零售商自有数据可能得出不同结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 零售商在商品、门店、时间三个层级的不同粒度（如门店订单、供应商资助、类别绩效、财务计划）做决策，需根据粒度选择合适的预测模型。现有研究缺乏在多粒度、多公开数据集上系统对比主流预测模型（含预训练基础模型）的实证，且未充分考量价格促销计划输入对模型性能的影响。

Method: 使用 M5、六个 Dominick's 类别、Breakfast at the Frat、Corporación Favorita（保留为测试集）四个公开数据集，采用滚动预测起点、配对检验和模型置信集合（90% 置信水平）进行评估。对比模型包括：携带商品状态在价格促销计划下前向推演的世界模型、去除状态的同架构网络、LightGBM、Temporal Fusion Transformer、TimesFM、Chronos-Bolt、Timestral、季节性朴素预测，以及世界模型、LightGBM、TimesFM 在给定计划下的等权平均。所有训练模型均以价格促销计划为输入；预训练模型在有/无计划输入下分别测试。

Result: 1. 商品-门店粒度：等权平均在 9 个数据集中 7 个误差最低，90% 置信集合中位数仅含 1 个模型。2. 跨门店商品粒度：等权平均在 9 个数据集中 8 个误差最低，置信集合中位数含 2 个模型。3. 类别-门店、类别、全链条粒度：最优模型随数据集不同，4-6 个可用窗口无法区分 9 个模型中的中位数 4 个。4. 类别-门店规划成本：等权平均或 LightGBM 在 8 个数据集中 7 个最低，世界模型仅在 M5 胜出，且在商品-门店粒度落后 LightGBM 6/8。5. 所有训练模型均使用计划输入；预训练模型若不使用计划，在周度促销驱动数据上准确度显著下降。

Conclusion: 预测模型的最优选择强烈依赖于决策粒度。在精细粒度（商品-门店、跨门店商品），简单的等权集成稳健且显著优于单一模型；在粗粒度（类别-门店、类别、全链条），模型间差异不显著，需更多数据窗口或领域知识辅助选择。价格促销计划输入对所有模型（尤其是预训练模型）至关重要。实验结论仅基于四个公开数据集及价格/促销两个 P，若引入完整 4P（产品、组合、渠道、价格/促销）或零售商自有数据，结果可能不同。论文报告了所有模型、检验及失败的变更，保证透明可复现。

Abstract: A retailer makes different decisions at different grains of the product, store and time hierarchy: store orders for an item in a store, supplier funding for an item across stores, category performance by store, and the financial plan for the chain. Which forecasting model to use depends on the grain. This paper compares models at each grain on four public data sets (M5, six Dominick's categories, Breakfast at the Frat, and Corporación Favorita, the last kept out of all development), over rolling forecast origins with paired tests and model confidence sets. It covers price and promotion through the plan inputs these data record, not product, assortment or place. The models are a world model that carries each item's state forward under the price and promotion plan, the same network without that state, LightGBM, the Temporal Fusion Transformer, TimesFM, Chronos-Bolt, Timestral, seasonal naive, and an equal-weight average of the world model, LightGBM and TimesFM given the plan. The answer changed with the grain. For an item by store and an item across stores, the average had the lowest error on seven and eight of nine data sets, and the 90% confidence set held a median of 1 and 2 models. For a category by store, a category and the chain total, the lowest-error model differed between data sets and a median of 4 of nine models were not separated by the four to six windows available. For category-by-store planning cost, the average or LightGBM was lowest on seven of eight data sets, and the world model was lowest only on M5; it was behind LightGBM item by store on six of eight. Every trained model used the plan, and on the weekly promotion-driven data pretrained models were less accurate without it. These results hold for these data sets; a forecast solved across all four Ps, or a retailer's own data, may give different results. Every model, test and change that lost is reported.

</details>


### [327] [Sampling and Curvature in First-Exit Comparisons for Momentum SGD](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25191)
*Haiyi Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究动量SGD的首次退出时间预测，指出逐点梯度定律遗漏的采样信息至关重要。通过理论分析和实验，建立持久采样下与有限速率切换过程的O(h)均值退出比较，并给出有限窗口退出区间。实验验证了ridge-logistic、ResNet-18和ViT网络上的认证界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动量SGD的首次退出行为依赖于采样细节，而现有基于逐点梯度分布的分析忽略了这些信息，导致无法准确预测退出时间。需要建立考虑采样机制（如持久采样vs iid采样）的精确退出分析框架。

Method: 理论上，构建一维持久采样下的有限速率切换过程近似，证明O(h)均值退出误差界；利用实现的小批量和采样曲率得到有限窗口退出区间。实验上，在ridge-logistic、ResNet-18和ViT上进行认证实验，使用精确实数算术证书，对比不同采样策略和刷新重置的效果。

Result: 理论建立了持久采样下的O(h)均值退出比较，iid采样收敛到ODE。32次ridge-logistic运行中29次达标；3个ResNet-18检查点在原始半径下获得有限均值证书；tanh和ViT网络得到局部有限均值条件但ViT原始半径均值保证未决。双网络复现得32/32成功种子。刷新重置后退出变慢，但刷新与随机顺序随更新长度反转。神经步长缩放不支持切换极限。

Conclusion: 采样机制显著影响动量SGD的退出行为，持久采样可用切换过程近似，iid采样平均为ODE。认证界在实际网络上部分有效，但上界仍松，ViT原始半径保证待解。干预实验显示刷新重置效果复杂，无法因果分解原始动量SGD，神经步长缩放不验证切换极限。

Abstract: First-exit prediction for momentum SGD depends on sampling information that pointwise gradient laws omit. Strongly convex finite pools with identical pointwise laws and matched iid momentum dynamics can have different reshuffled exits; even analytic pools with uniformly close pointwise laws can have separated exit probabilities. For persistent sampling in one dimension, we establish an explicit $O(h)$ mean-exit comparison with a finite-rate switching process under nonvanishing component velocities and step-size conditions; iid sampling instead averages to an ODE. Retaining realized minibatches and sampled curvature yields finite-window exit brackets beyond this regime. In 32 trained ridge-logistic runs, 29 meet prespecified targets with rounding-certified brackets; an enclosure control explains most of the width advantage. Exact-real certificates establish finite means at the original tested radii for three ResNet-18 checkpoints and give local finite-mean conditions for tanh and ViT networks; their upper bounds remain loose, and original-radius ViT mean guarantees remain unresolved despite 128 fresh continuation paths. A two-network replication gives 32/32 successful seeds in each of four finite-path persistence comparisons. Independent equal-length controls retain slower exits after refresh resets than without resets, but the refresh-versus-random ordering reverses with update length at both networks. These interventions do not causally decompose raw momentum SGD. Neural step-size scaling does not validate the switching limit.

</details>


### [328] [Shallow Probes Are Sufficient for Near-Oracle Personalization Depth Allocation in Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25193)
*Beyazit Bestami Yuksel,Emrah Dikbiyik,Ayse Yilmazer Metin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究在联邦学习中，是否可以用极小的客户端专属测量预算，支持在宏观F1与部署成本权衡下的个性化深度决策。通过三层浅层探针（P0-P2）的免训练贪婪探测，在CIFAR-10/100和PTB-XL上实现了0.0071的遗憾值和98.3%的离线神谕恢复率，优于元数据策略和FedPBA。但深层神谕情况下相关性下降至0.578，PTB-XL深层情况仍是高遗憾边界，缺乏有效的升级门控。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有联邦学习个性化方法多关注优化器设计，忽略了客户端异构环境下部署成本与模型效用的权衡。作者希望探索：在极小测量预算下，能否通过浅层探针获取足够信息以接近全深度离线神谕的决策性能，从而实现低成本、可落地的个性化深度选择。

Method: 1. 定义六个个性化深度，穷举评估构建离线神谕（不可部署）。2. 提出探针充足性假设：三层浅层探针（P0-P2）可能包含决策所需的大部分信息。3. 设计免训练贪婪探测策略，基于浅层探针结果直接选择深度。4. 对比基线：仅元数据策略、FedPBA（基于学习的深度外推方法）。5. 在CIFAR-10/100和患者不相交的PTB-XL（45会话、900客户端、2700评估、GroupKFold）上实验。

Result: 免训练贪婪探测达到遗憾值0.0071、98.3%神谕恢复率，显著优于元数据策略和FedPBA（遗憾0.0110、97.3%）。聚合浅层最优与神谕相关性为0.9818，但在深层神谕行下降至0.578；PTB-XL深层神谕案例仍是高遗憾边界，缺乏有效升级门控。

Conclusion: 极小预算的浅层探针足以支撑大多数场景下的成本感知个性化深度决策，免训练贪婪探测是一种极具竞争力的实用策略。但深层最优情况（特别是医疗数据PTB-XL）仍存在显著决策鸿沟，未来需研究可验证的升级门控机制以处理深层决策边界。

Abstract: Rather than proposing a new federated optimizer, we study whether a small client-specific measurement budget can support cost-aware personalization-depth decisions under a utility that trades Macro-F1 against deployment cost. Exhaustive evaluation of six depths defines an offline oracle that is not deployable. We audit the Probe Sufficiency Hypothesis: three shallow probes (P0--P2) may contain most decision-relevant information for approaching that oracle. FedPBA is a secondary learned instantiation for deep-action extrapolation. On CIFAR-10/100 and patient-disjoint PTB-XL (45 sessions; 900 clients; 2700 evaluations; GroupKFold), training-free greedy probing achieves regret 0.0071 and 98.3 percent oracle recovery, beating metadata-only policies and FedPBA (0.0110 / 97.3 percent). Aggregate shallow-best versus oracle correlation is 0.9818 but falls to 0.578 on deep-oracle rows; PTB-XL deep-oracle cases remain a high-regret boundary without a validated escalation gate.

</details>


### [329] [ViCoR: Estimating Visual Necessity via Counterfactual Residuals for Multimodal Medical Data Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25202)
*Haotian Gan,Yudong Li,Xintian Li,Jiarui Han,Weidong Tang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出ViCoR，一种基于反事实残差的数据选择方法，用于医学视觉语言模型微调。通过图像依赖优化残差估计视觉必要性，并结合医学监督兼容性校准构建多样性感知子集，仅用20%数据即超越全量微调及基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医学视觉语言模型存在隐性分层问题：整体性能高但掩盖了对细微视觉发现和重叠临床状况的失败。根因在于微调时的模态不平衡，强语言先验抑制了视觉接地学习，导致合理但弱接地的推理。现有数据选择方法将图文对作为整体打分，未区分视觉必要样本与捷径可解样本。

Method: ViCoR三步走：1) 通过图像依赖优化残差估计视觉必要性（反事实残差）；2) 用医学监督兼容性校准得分；3) 构建多样性感知的微调子集。核心创新是分离视觉必要样本与语言捷径样本，增强视觉接地信号。

Result: 在两个骨干网络、四个外部泛化基准和一个多疾病鲁棒性基准上，ViCoR选出的20%子集平均性能最优，超越全量微调和选择基线。梯度层面分析和扰动审计显示ViCoR丰富了图像依赖训练信号，强化了图像级和证据区域依赖。

Conclusion: ViCoR通过反事实残差识别视觉必要样本，有效缓解医学VLM的模态不平衡和隐性分层问题，实现了小数据高性能微调，为医学多模态模型的数据高效训练提供了新范式。

Abstract: Medical vision-language models often exhibit hidden stratification, where high overall performance masks failures on subtle visual findings and overlapping clinical conditions. We trace this failure mode to modality imbalance during fine-tuning, where strong linguistic priors can suppress visually grounded learning and induce plausible but weakly grounded rationales. Existing data selection methods usually score image-text pairs as holistic units, without separating visually necessary samples from shortcut-solvable ones. To address this problem, we propose ViCoR, a counterfactual-residual-based data selection method for Med-VLM fine-tuning. ViCoR estimates visual necessity through image-dependent optimization residuals, calibrates the resulting scores with medical supervision compatibility, and constructs a diversity-aware fine-tuning subset. Across two backbones, four external generalization benchmarks, and one multi-disease robustness benchmark, ViCoR-selected 20\% subsets achieve the strongest average performance compared with full-data fine-tuning and selection baselines. Gradient-level analysis and perturbation audits further show that ViCoR enriches image-dependent training signals and strengthens image-level and evidence-region dependence. The code will be available at https://github.com/htgan-ai/ViCoR.

</details>


### [330] [NeuroAct: Advancing EEG Analysis and Decoding via Dual-Loop Autonomous Research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25211)
*Wei Xiong,Jiangtong Li,Han Zhao,Linxiao Yang,Jie Li,Changjun Jiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 NeuroAct，一个用于 EEG 分析和解码的自主研究智能体框架，采用双循环机制（内循环进行假设检验与干预选择，外循环提炼跨任务可复用的条件化建议），在四个评估设置中显著提升了多项 EEG 任务的解码性能，并通过经验复用实现跨任务性能提升与 Token 消耗降低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 EEG 分析流程固定或依赖奖励驱动搜索，未能显式建模信号结构、表示、预测器行为及训练动态对性能和泛化差距的贡献，导致干预选择不足。需要一种能基于证据自主进行假设检验、分析选择和模型优化，并能跨任务复用经验的自主研究框架。

Method: NeuroAct 实现双循环自主研究：内循环设研究、开发、审查三角色，利用信号结构、表示、预测器行为、训练动态等证据进行假设检验、分析/干预选择、候选优化，依据性能、稳定性、成本反馈迭代；外循环将结果提炼为带任务和模型条件的可测试建议，在后续任务上验证修正。涵盖 EEG 基础模型、任务特定预测器及模型组合。

Result: 四个设置均取得显著提升：(A) EEG 通用分析宏平均 80.88，超 BrainAgent 17.75 分；(B) 跨任务模型优化中，EEGPT 平均平衡准确率提升 7.34 点，HBN Pearson 相关系数从 0.6894 升至 0.7362；(C) 单任务开放研究中 ADFTD 平衡准确率提升 16.33 点；(D) 协同预测中 Workload 平衡准确率从 79.69% 升至 85.02%。经验复用使 BCIC-IV-2a 平衡准确率从 34.66% 升至 50.81%，同时 LLM Token 消耗降低 64.02%。

Conclusion: NeuroAct 通过双循环自主研究机制，实现了基于证据的 EEG 研究自动化，并能跨任务复用经验持续改进，显著提升了多种 EEG 解码任务的性能与效率，为脑机接口、认知评估和睡眠监测等应用提供了强有力的自主分析工具。

Abstract: EEG analysis and decoding underpin brain-computer interfaces, cognitive assessment, and sleep monitoring. Fixed pipelines and reward-driven search do not explicitly determine how signal structure, representations, predictor behavior, and training dynamics contribute to performance or generalization gaps, leaving intervention choice underdetermined. We introduce NeuroAct, an autonomous research agent framework for EEG analysis and decoding. NeuroAct implements dual-loop autonomous research across EEG foundation models, task-specific predictors, and model combinations. In an inner loop, research, development, and review roles use evidence on signal structure, representations, predictor behavior, and training dynamics to test hypotheses, select analyses or interventions, and refine candidates using performance, stability, and cost feedback. An outer loop distills outcomes into conditional, testable recommendations with task and model conditions, then validates and revises them on subsequent tasks.We evaluate four settings: (A) EEG General Analysis, (B) Cross-task Model Optimization, (C) Single-task Open Research, and (D) Collaborative Prediction. In Setting A, NeuroAct's 80.88 macro-average exceeds BrainAgent's 63.13 by 17.75 points. In Setting B, NeuroAct raises EEGPT's mean balanced accuracy (BA) by 7.34 points and HBN Pearson's (r) from 0.6894 to 0.7362; in Setting C, it improves ADFTD BA by 16.33 points; and in Setting D, it raises Workload BA from 79.69% to 85.02%. Experience reuse raises BCIC-IV-2a BA from 34.66% to 50.81% while reducing LLM tokens by 64.02%, indicating recommendations improve cross-task performance. NeuroAct enables evidence-guided EEG research improved by cross-task experience.

</details>


### [331] [DROD: Dual-Ratio Ordered Dropout for Federated Continual Learning on Heterogeneous Devices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25220)
*Berk Sezer,Özgür Soysal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了容量异构客户端的联邦学习与联邦持续学习的交叉领域，提出了DROD（双比率有序丢弃）方法，在Split-CIFAR-100上训练ResNet-18，DROD在多种回放缓冲区大小和持续学习策略（ER、DER++、BiC）下均优于基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究分别针对容量异构客户端的联邦学习和联邦持续学习，但两者的交叉场景——即客户端持有不同大小的模型，且每个客户端的数据流随时间漂移——仍未被充分探索。

Method: 在Split-CIFAR-100（10个任务，类增量）上从头训练ResNet-18模型群。提出DROD（双比率有序丢弃），基于FjORD的有序丢弃，利用两个独立的缩减轴（快捷连接比率和分支比率）提取子模型。

Result: 在共享参数/FLOP预算阶梯上，DROD在对比的异构模型联邦学习策略中达到最高平均准确率。其优势在测试的所有回放缓冲区大小下及ER、DER++、BiC三种持续学习策略下均保持；在EWC策略下，三种几何结构表现相同均崩溃。

Conclusion: DROD有效解决了联邦学习中容量异构客户端与持续学习相结合的挑战，通过双比率有序丢弃机制在多种设置下稳定超越现有基线。

Abstract: Federated learning for capacity-heterogeneous clients and federated continual learning are each well studied on their own, but their intersection -- clients holding differently sized models while every client's data stream also drifts over time -- remains underexplored. We study this setting directly, training a ResNet-18 fleet from scratch on Split-CIFAR-100 (10 tasks, class-incremental), and introduce DROD (Dual-Ratio Ordered Dropout), which builds on FjORD's Ordered Dropout by using two independent reduction axes to extract sub-models: a shortcut ratio and a branch ratio. On a shared parameter/FLOP budget ladder, DROD achieves the highest mean accuracy among the heterogeneous-model federated learning strategies we compare. Its advantage over the two strongest baseline geometries persists across every replay-buffer size we test and under ER, DER++, and BiC; under EWC, all three geometries collapse alike.

</details>


### [332] [Improving the Expressive Power of Hybrid Sequence Models via Multi-Hop Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25250)
*Yam Eitan,Gilad Yehudai,Haggai Maron*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Multi-hop Retrieval Attention (MuRA) 混合块，通过多跳检索共享 KV 缓存，证明其在函数组合任务上形成严格的检索深度表达力层级：单个固定大小的 m-hop MuRA 可计算 m-函数组合，而 (m+1)-函数组合需多项式模型规模。实验验证增加检索深度可学习更深层组合，显著优于现有混合架构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有混合架构将全注意力层与高效序列层（稀疏注意力、循环层）结合，但高效层通常使用固定大小状态而非访问丰富的 KV 缓存。尽管近期工作探索让高效层访问 KV 缓存，但其理论收益及现有方法实现程度尚不清晰。

Method: 在函数组合任务（多跳推理的标准表达力基准）上分析单个混合块的表达能力。首先证明常规混合块和 top-κ KV 缓存访问块均需 Ω(√n) 容量完成两函数组合。随后提出 MuRA 混合块，支持从共享 KV 缓存进行多跳检索，同时保持渐近计算与内存效率。

Result: 理论上证明：固定大小的 m-hop MuRA 块可计算 m-函数组合；同检索深度下计算 (m+1)-函数组合需多项式模型规模，确立检索深度的严格表达力层级。合成实验验证该层级：增加检索深度可学习逐渐更深的组合，大幅超越现有混合架构。

Conclusion: 多跳检索是提升高效混合架构表达能力的有前景机制，MuRA 通过简单架构实现了多跳检索并保持效率，为混合语言模型设计提供了理论指导与实证支持。

Abstract: Hybrid architectures offer a promising approach to efficient language modeling by combining a small number of full-attention layers with a larger number of efficient sequence layers, such as sparse attention and recurrent layers. While full-attention layers maintain a KV cache that grows linearly with sequence length, efficient layers typically rely on separate, fixed-size states rather than accessing this richer existing memory. Recent work has begun exploring ways to allow efficient layers access to the KV cache, but the theoretical benefits of such access, and the extent to which existing approaches can realize them remain poorly understood. We investigate these questions by analyzing the expressive power of individual hybrid blocks on function composition, a well-studied task in sequence-model expressivity associated with multi-hop reasoning. We first establish that both conventional hybrid blocks and those with top-$κ$ KV-cache access require $Ω(\sqrt{n})$ capacity to compute even two-function composition over a domain of size $n$. To overcome this limitation, we introduce the \emph{Multi-hop Retrieval Attention} (MuRA) hybrid block, a simple architecture that enables multi-hop retrieval from a shared KV cache while preserving asymptotic computational and memory efficiency. We prove that a single fixed size $m$-hop MuRA block can compute $m$-function composition, whereas computing $(m+1)$-function composition with the same retrieval depth requires polynomial model size, establishing a strict expressivity hierarchy in retrieval depth. Synthetic experiments support this hierarchy, showing that increasing retrieval depth enables learning progressively deeper compositions, substantially outperforming existing hybrid architectures. Together, our results identify multi-hop retrieval as a promising mechanism for improving the expressive power of efficient hybrid architectures.

</details>


### [333] [BatchParScale: Sparse Batch-Mixing for Sequence Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25254)
*Hans Peter Lyngsøe Raaschou-jensen,M. Onurcan Kaya,Desmond Elliott*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出BatchParScale，一种注意力机制，允许并行推理流通过少量通信位置交换信息，解决现有并行缩放方法中推理流相互独立、无法协作的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有测试时缩放方法（如并行采样、Multi-Sequence Verifiers、ParScale）虽能提升性能，但推理流之间缺乏协调与信息交换，一条流中的发现无法影响其他流，限制了需要协作推理任务的表现。

Method: 引入BatchParScale注意力机制，在并行流间设置少量通信位置实现信息交换；在Parallel Needle-in-a-Haystack检索基准、预训练、微调及多智能体协作强化学习（MARL）中评估；采用掩码预训练和LoRA微调验证可迁移性。

Result: BatchParScale在语言模型损失上超越ParScale，在协作敏感的MARL任务保持竞争力；掩码预训练优于无掩码单序列基线；LoRA微调证明可加入预训练Transformer；但预训练和微调模型的事实检索性能仍不明确。

Conclusion: BatchParScale通过轻量级通信机制实现了模型内部的并行流协作，在多种设置下优于现有方法，展示了并行推理流间信息交换的潜力，但事实检索能力有待进一步研究。

Abstract: Recent test-time scaling methods improve model performance by increasing inference-time compute. One practical form of this is parallel scaling, where a model samples multiple independent reasoning streams and aggregates their answers using methods like voting, reranking, or verification. While effective, this approach leaves the streams uncoordinated, and a discovery made in one rollout cannot influence any other. Multi-Sequence Verifiers jointly score candidate answers after generation, but the reasoning streams remain independent during inference. ParScale takes a step toward model-internal parallel scaling by learning to aggregate multiple forward passes, but its streams still do not exchange information while processing a sequence. We introduce BatchParScale, an attention mechanism that allows parallel streams to exchange information through a small set of communication positions. We evaluate BatchParScale on a new Parallel Needle-in-a-Haystack retrieval benchmark and in pretraining, fine-tuning, and cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning. Across these settings, BatchParScale outperforms ParScale on language-model loss and remains competitive on coordination-sensitive MARL tasks. Masked pretraining runs beat an unmasked single-sequence baseline despite local sequence corruption, and LoRA fine-tuning shows the mechanism can be added to a pretrained Transformer. At the same time, fact retrieval performance for pretrained and finetuned BatchParScale models remains unclear.

</details>


### [334] [Emergent Sparsity: How Many Effective Variables Survive Coarse-Graining in AlphaEarth Embeddings?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25258)
*Johannes Hirn*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: AlphaEarth的64维像素向量可重组为非线性坐标，有效维度随空间尺度增大显著下降，β-VAE非线性压缩优于线性PCA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究AlphaEarth全球10米像素的64维向量在不同空间尺度下的有效维度，探究是否可用更少的非线性坐标表示，以及该维度是否随空间尺度减小。

Method: 采用β-VAE扫描生成秩-失真包络，在统一架构下测量不同重构容忍度下的最小保留维度，并与PCA线性基准对比；在单位范数目标上重复验证。

Result: 在3%验证容忍度下，β-VAE保留维度从10米的24降至78.9公里的7，而PCA仅从46降至38；单位范数实验保持相同趋势。

Conclusion: 有效维度应视为重构容忍度与空间尺度的二维控制曲面，非线性压缩随尺度增大优势扩大，β-VAE显著优于线性PCA。

Abstract: AlphaEarth encodes each 10 m land pixel as a 64-component vector intended to support diverse global mapping tasks. Yet many scientific applications work at coarser spatial supports, for which fewer than 64 effective variables may suffice. We ask whether these vectors can be reorganized into ranked global nonlinear coordinates, how many suffice at a chosen reconstruction accuracy, and whether that number decreases with spatial scale. We thus describe effective dimension as a two-control surface over tolerance and spatial scale, rather than one intrinsic number. At each scale, a $β$-VAE scan with a common architecture produces a rank--distortion envelope, giving the smallest retained count achieved within the scanned family at each reconstruction tolerance. At 3% validation tolerance, this number falls from 24 to 7 when the scale is increased from 10 m to 78.9 km, whereas the corresponding PCA rank falls only from 46 to 38. Repeating the analysis on unit-norm targets preserves this trend.

</details>


### [335] [EasyResearch: Honest Regression, Forecasting and Signal Classification for Researchers Who Do Not Program](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25263)
*Ahmad B. A. Hassanat,Ghada A. Altarawneh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出EasyResearch开源工具及桌面应用，通过强制诚实评估流程（仅训练数据学习、固定种子、独立最终评分、不打乱时间序列、自动生成方法报告），在回归、预测、信号分类任务上实现无偏性能估计，实验显示常规做法显著高估性能，而EasyResearch的评分基本无偏。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有应用研究中常见评估不诚实问题：回归中筛选预测变量导致过拟合，预测中打乱交叉验证破坏时间依赖，分类中缺乏统一诚实评估标准，导致报告性能在新数据上不复现。

Method: 开发EasyResearch分析核心（回归、时间序列预测、信号分类）及EasyResearch Desktop Windows应用，遵循四大规则：1)仅在训练数据学习；2)模型保持发布默认参数固定种子；3)选定模型单独最终评分；4)预测不在打乱数据评估；5)每次运行生成含方法段和引用的报告。在9公开回归数据集(90次运行)、15条时间序列、4个UCR信号分类数据集上，保留未触测试集对比常规做法与EasyResearch评分诚实度。

Result: 回归中常规做法高估R²+2.2点，最佳对比分高估+2.5，EasyResearch最终分-1.0(轻微低估)；全数据筛选预测变量在纯噪声报告R²=0.27而新数据-0.44。预测中打乱CV承诺误差比未来实际小19%，EasyResearch最终期评分无偏(±1.5%)，其选模型未来误差低14%；随机游走上打乱CV5/5选ML模型均差于naive，EasyResearch4/5选naive。信号分类中单一方法全胜且两估计均无偏。

Conclusion: EasyResearch通过强制诚实评估流程有效解决了应用研究中普遍存在的性能高估问题，为无编程研究者提供了可复现、无偏的自动化分析工具，推动了机器学习评估规范化。

Abstract: EasyClassifier showed that researchers who do not program can obtain honest classification results when the correct evaluation is the default. Most applied studies, however, predict a number, forecast a series or classify recordings, and each task has its own way of producing scores that do not hold on new data. We present EasyResearch, open-source analysis cores for regression, time-series forecasting and signal classification, and EasyResearch Desktop, a Windows application that runs these three tasks and EasyClassifier's classification without code. All four follow the same rules: everything learned from data is learned on training data only, models keep their published defaults with fixed seeds, the selected model receives a separate final score, forecasts are never evaluated on shuffled data, and every run writes a report with a Methods paragraph and the references for every method used. We measured whether the reported scores are honest by keeping part of each dataset untouched. In regression (9 public datasets, 90 runs), the common practice overstated R^2 by +2.2 points and the best comparison score by +2.5, while EasyResearch's final score was -1.0; screening predictors on all rows before cross-validation, which EasyResearch does not offer, reported R^2 = 0.27 on pure noise against -0.44 on new data. In forecasting (15 series), shuffled cross-validation over windows of past values promised errors 19% smaller than its chosen models achieved in the untouched future, while EasyResearch's final-period score was unbiased to within 1.5%; the models EasyResearch chose had 14% lower future error, and on random walks shuffled cross-validation chose a machine-learning model in 5 of 5 series, each worse in the future than repeating the last value, which EasyResearch chose 4 times. In signal classification (4 UCR datasets) one method won every comparison and neither estimate was biased.

</details>


### [336] [EG-GRPO: Evidence-Guided Step-level Credit Assignment for Deep Search Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25269)
*Sijia Luo,Mengjie Gao,Yuxiao He,Mengshu Sun,Cuiping Li,Hong Chen,Jing Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出EG-GRPO，利用合成深度搜索数据中的证据标注进行步级监督，改进强化学习中的信用分配，在五个深度搜索基准上优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于LLM的搜索代理主要依赖轨迹级结果奖励，对复杂搜索和推理过程的监督有限；步级信用分配虽有前景，但获取可靠的、任务相关的开放式搜索监督具有挑战性。

Method: EG-GRPO框架：从合成深度搜索数据的证据标注中推导步级监督；识别每个所需证据声明的首个支持引用，利用新获得的证据构建步级过程奖励；将累积证据表示为演化的知识状态，执行状态条件相对优势估计，并将步级信号与标准轨迹级结果优势结合。

Result: 在五个具有挑战性的深度搜索基准上实验，EG-GRPO总体上优于标准GRPO及现有奖励增强和步级RL基线，跨不同模型规模均有效。

Conclusion: 任务相关的证据标注能为深度搜索RL中的信用分配提供有效的过程监督。

Abstract: LLM-based search agents demonstrate strong capabilities in long-horizon information seeking and reasoning, typically trained via reinforcement learning. However, existing approaches predominantly rely on trajectory-level outcome rewards, providing limited supervision for complex search and reasoning processes. Although step-level credit assignment offers a promising solution, obtaining reliable and task-grounded supervision for open-ended search remains challenging. In this paper, we propose Evidence-Guided Group Relative Policy Optimization (EG-GRPO), a framework that derives step-level supervision from the evidence annotations available in synthetic deep search data. EG-GRPO identifies the first supporting citation for each required evidence claim and uses the newly acquired evidence to construct step-level process rewards. By representing the accumulated evidence as an evolving knowledge state, EG-GRPO further performs state-conditioned relative advantage estimation and combines the resulting step-level signal with the standard trajectory-level outcome advantage. Experiments on five challenging deep search benchmarks show that EG-GRPO generally outperforms standard GRPO and existing reward-enhanced and step-level RL baselines across different model scales. These results demonstrate that task-grounded evidence annotations can provide effective process supervision for credit assignment in deep search RL.

</details>


### [337] [Data-driven forecasting of tropical cloud forest phenology: A dynamical systems and machine learning hybrid approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25283)
*Pedro Garcia,Saul Flores*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究提出了一种结合动力系统理论与机器学习的混合数据驱动方法，利用35年热带云林数据集，通过基于Takens定理的时延嵌入重构状态空间，结合气候强迫变量，使用高斯过程回归预测开花结果物候周期，实现了更高的预测精度和不确定性量化，为应对气候变化下的物候错配提供了可扩展工具。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统物候模型依赖预设的函数形式，难以捕捉热带高生物多样性生态系统中物种对气候变化的非线性复杂响应，亟需一种能够从长期观测数据中自动学习非线性动态并提供不确定性估计的预测框架。

Method: 基于Takens嵌入定理利用时延向量重构系统状态空间，引入温度、降水等气候强迫变量，采用高斯过程回归（GPR）进行模型训练，同时输出点预测值与显式不确定性估计。

Result: 混合模型在开花和结果物候预测上均显著优于传统方法，有效捕捉了生态时间序列的非线性动态特征，并提供了可靠的预测不确定性量化。

Conclusion: 动力系统理论与机器学习的协同融合为复杂热带生态系统的物候预测提供了可扩展、数据驱动的新范式，有助于提前识别物候错配风险并制定针对性保护策略以应对全球环境变化。

Abstract: Forecasting how species and ecosystems respond to climate change is a critical challenge in ecology, particularly in hyper-diverse tropical biomes. While traditional phenological models often rely on preconceived functional forms, this study introduces a data-driven hybrid approach that integrates dynamical systems theory with machine learning to forecast flowering and fruiting cycles.
  Using a robust 35-year dataset from a Venezuelan tropical cloud forest, we reconstruct the system's state-space using delay vectors inspired by Takens' theorem, incorporating climate forcing variables such as temperature and precipitation. The model was trained using Gaussian Process Regression, providing both point predictors and explicit uncertainty estimates.
  Our results clearly suggest that the synergy between dynamical systems and machine learning effectively captures the non-linear complexities of ecological time series. Specifically, the model achieved higher predictive accuracy for flowering and fruiting. This hybrid framework offers a scalable tool for anticipating phenological mismatches and informing conservation strategies in the face of global environmental change.

</details>


### [338] [A discrete-continuous-time stochastic framework for attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder-related symptom modeling and pharmacological intervention via methylphenidate](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25285)
*Oana-Maria-Catalina Crisan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个数学与计算框架，将甲基苯丙胺治疗ADHD建模为作用于非线性神经动力学的最优控制策略，并通过混合深度学习架构（1D CNN + Vision Transformer）从fMRI数据推断潜在表征，连接理论随机模型与临床实证数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有ADHD神经动力学模型缺乏将药理干预形式化为控制信号的数学框架，且难以将理论随机过程模型与临床fMRI数据有效对接，需要一种能同时捕捉时空特征的深度学习方法来推断潜在神经状态。

Method: 1) 将ADHD神经过程建模为收敛于功能失调稳定模式的随机过程；2) 将甲基苯丙胺干预形式化为重塑系统漂移项、将轨迹重导向神经典型区域的外部最优控制信号；3) 设计确定性混合深度学习架构：一维卷积神经网络提取fMRI时间序列的局部时序特征，Vision Transformer捕捉全局空间依赖关系，联合训练以推断潜在神经表征。

Result: 框架成功建立了药物剂量-神经轨迹重塑的定量映射关系，混合架构在fMRI数据上实现了高精度的潜在状态推断，验证了最优控制策略能将功能失调吸引子重定向至神经典型区域，并给出了个性化给药策略的理论依据。

Conclusion: 该工作首次将最优控制理论与混合深度学习结合，为ADHD药物疗效提供了可解释的数学建模范式，实现了从群体统计到个体轨迹级预测的跨越，为精准精神药理学奠定了计算基础。

Abstract: This paper presents an original mathematical and computational framework for modeling the efficacy of methylphenidate as an optimal control policy acting on the nonlinear dynamics of attention deficit hyperactivity disorder. Neural processes in ADHD are conceptualized as stochastic processes with trajectories that inherently converge towards stable, yet dysfunctional patterns associated with clinical symptoms. The pharmacological intervention is mathematically formalized as an external control signal that reassesses the system's drift and redirects these trajectories towards neurotypical regimes. To bridge these theoretical stochastic models with empirical clinical data, latent representations are inferred using a novel deterministic hybrid deep learning architecture, combining a one-dimensional convolutional neural network and a Vision Transformer, trained on preprocessed functional magnetic resonance imaging data.

</details>


### [339] [World Model Interpretability: From Decoding Representations to Understanding Latent Worlds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25296)
*Jize Wang,Yongcheng Jing,Xinyi Le,Cailian Chen,Xinping Guan,Dacheng Tao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种针对联合嵌入预测架构(JEPAs)潜在世界模型的四阶段可解释性研究议程，主张从关注潜在变量编码什么转向理解其如何交互、演化并因果驱动预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着JEPAs从表征学习发展为支持预测、规划和控制的潜在世界模型，其潜在空间天然缺乏人类可解释的接口。现有的可解释性工作主要集中在解码潜在变量编码的内容，但随着潜在变量成为预测和行动的内部状态，必须理解潜在变量间的交互、演化机制及其因果驱动作用。

Method: 提出四阶段研究议程：1) Ground（奠基）：将潜在变量与可观测概念对齐；2) Structure（结构）：系统分析潜在空间的几何、拓扑与动力学结构；3) Verify（验证）：通过因果干预验证潜在变量对预测的因果贡献；4) Act（行动）：基于理解的潜在世界进行干预式规划与控制。

Result: 现有JEPA可解释性工作仅为Ground阶段提供早期证据，而Structure、Verify和Act三个阶段的系统性分析、因果验证与干预研究仍大多未被探索。

Conclusion: 本文呼吁建立更广泛的潜在世界可解释性议程，将关注点从解码表征转向理解、验证并作用于潜在世界，以实现可执行的潜在世界理解。

Abstract: Emerging Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) are moving beyond representation learning towards latent world models that support prediction, planning, and control. Yet their latent worlds naturally lack a human-interpretable interface. In this Perspective, we argue that as JEPA latents become internal states for prediction and action, interpretability must move beyond what they encode to how latent variables interact, evolve, and causally drive prediction. To this end, we envision a four-stage research agenda, involving Ground, Structure, Verify, and Act, to guide this shift toward actionable latent-world understanding. Within our framework, existing JEPA interpretability efforts provide early evidence for Ground, while systematic analysis of latent structure, causal verification, and intervention remains largely unexplored. Overall, this Perspective aims to call for a broader latent-world interpretability agenda that shifts attention from decoding representations toward understanding, validating, and acting on latent worlds.

</details>


### [340] [Learning When to Abort in Transformer Planning: A Mechanistic Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25300)
*Shi Feng,Qimin Zhong,Siwei Wang,Yifei Shen,Shang-Hua Teng,Hao Liao,Wei Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究Transformer规划中的错误检测机制，将规划抽象为图中路径搜索，训练模型检测无效转移并生成终止标记，理论证明前馈网络宽度O(|V|)近似最优，实验表明错误检测结合重试可显著提升规划可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 规划本身不意味着错误识别能力，但错误识别能提升规划能力。旨在探究Transformer规划中错误检测的内在机制，并利用其改进规划性能。

Method: 遵循Wang et al. (2024)将规划抽象为图中路径搜索；构建前馈宽度为O(|V|)的Transformer，训练其检测无效转移（生成非相邻节点后输出终止标记x）；提出前馈宽度的最坏情况下界；分析训练模型中的注意力机制和前馈网络输出；推理时利用终止标记触发外部重试机制。

Result: 理论上证明前馈宽度O(|V|)可检测所有无效转移且近似最优；实验发现无效转移检测增加了前一节点注意力，有效-无效分离主要发生在前馈网络输出；错误检测结合重试在图、Countdown和迷宫任务上提升规划可靠性。

Conclusion: 错误检测机制增强了Transformer的规划能力，前馈网络在错误检测中起关键作用，结合外部重试机制可显著提高规划可靠性，为可靠规划提供了理论与实践指导。

Abstract: Planning does not by itself imply the ability to recognise errors, but recognising errors can improve planning capacity. In this paper, we study this phenomenon in Transformer planning. To analyze the inner mechanism, we follow the approach of Wang et al. (2024) and abstract planning as path-finding in graphs. In this setting, we train the model to detect the error of invalid transitions, i.e., after the model generates a next node that is not adjacent with the current node, the model should then generate a special abort token x. For expressiveness, we construct a Transformer with feed-forward width $O(|V|)$ for any fixed graph with node set $V$. It can detect all possible invalid transitions, and select a valid next node if the prefix is valid. We then propose a worst-case lower bound on feed-forward width, which makes the detector's linear width near-optimal up to logarithmic factors. In trained models, we demonstrate that invalid-transition detection increases previous-node attention, and most of the valid--invalid separation locates in the feed-forward network's output. This accords with our theoretical insights. Finally, we use this error detection to improve the model's performance: at inference, generating the abort token x will directly cause an external procedure to discard the attempt and restart from the original prompt. Experiments show that error detection combined with retry improves model's planning reliability on graphs, Countdown, and mazes.

</details>


### [341] [Where Groups Split: A Probe Prior for Nonzero Within-Group Variance in RL Post-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25325)
*Jonah Ellison,Mateo Ruiz,Owen Pell,Tomas Duncun,Hanae Fujita,Ingrid Solberg,Caleb Nguyen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Aperture 通过探针模型预测提示的未来通过率，计算静态先验权重，用于 GRPO 训练中优化采样，提高数学和逻辑推理任务的准确性及非零优势组比例。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GRPO 仅在组内奖励不一致时学习；一致组（全对/全错）方差为零、优势为零。均匀采样浪费资源在当前一致且未来仍一致的提示上。通过率弱预测未来一致性；相同通过率的提示可能分化。需估计未来通过率以聚焦有价值提示。

Method: Aperture 用少量提示训练探针模型，用基座模型和探针模型对所有提示评分，得到两个通过率，代入训练组大小下全错或分裂的概率公式，得到静态先验权重。该权重可单独使用或与在线调度器相乘，GRPO 更新保持不变。

Result: 在 1.7B 和 4B 模型的数学与逻辑推理任务上，先验提升贪婪准确率，增加非零优势组比例。结合动态采样或选择性回滚时仍有帮助。

Conclusion: Aperture 提供了一种低成本的静态先验，能有效识别未来将产生分裂组的提示，改善 GRPO 采样效率，且与现有动态策略兼容。

Abstract: Group relative policy optimization learns from a prompt only when the rewards in the sampled group disagree. With a binary verifier, a group that is entirely correct or entirely incorrect has within-group variance zero and a zero advantage. Uniform sampling continues to spend rollouts on prompts that are unanimous now and stay unanimous as training goes on. Pass rate is a weak forecast of that future. Two prompts at the same pass rate can move apart: one into the range where a finite group splits, and one toward a ceiling where the group becomes unanimous again. Aperture estimates the later pass rate from a short probe. A small subset of the pool is trained with the same recipe, every prompt is scored on the base model and on the probe model, and the two pass rates are plugged into the probability that a group of the training size is all wrong or split. The resulting weight is a static prior. It can be used alone or multiplied by an online scheduler, and the GRPO update is left as it is. On mathematical and logical reasoning with 1.7B and 4B models, the prior improves greedy accuracy over uniform GRPO and raises the fraction of groups with a nonzero advantage. The same prior still helps when it is combined with dynamic sampling or with selective rollouts.

</details>


### [342] [Follow the Mixed Groups: Ridge-Tracking Gaussian Sampling for Zero-Variance Web Rollouts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25330)
*Tomas Duncun,Jonah Ellison,Owen Pell,Mateo Ruiz,Hanae Fujita,Ingrid Solberg,Caleb Nguyen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: RIDGE 通过引入 Beta 后验和自适应高斯课程，改进了组相对策略优化（GRPO）的采样策略，仅在混合正确/错误组上更新课程中心与宽度，在数学推理和检索增强问答任务上显著提升准确率并大幅减少采样开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GRPO 仅当采样响应存在分歧（即混合组）时才能学习；全对或全错组的奖励方差为零、优势为零，导致训练信号丢失。现有的高斯课程将所有全失败历史视为同一点，且中心受困于 0 或 1 的提示推动，无法有效聚焦可学习的混合区间。

Method: RIDGE 保留高斯课程框架，但改变坐标、中心和宽度：每个提示维护一个 Beta 后验；采样权重为高斯目标在该后验高斯近似下的边缘概率除以预测工具调用成本；中心和宽度采用仅来自刚返回的混合组的后验均值的指数平滑；全对/全错组仅刷新后验、不移动中心；GRPO 更新规则保持不变。

Result: 在两个数学骨干模型和一个检索增强问答系统上，RIDGE 相比 GRPO 将平均准确率提升 3.4 和 2.9 个百分点，平均完全匹配率提升 3.7 个百分点，同时数学推理回合减少 29.6%，工具调用减少 32.7%。

Conclusion: RIDGE 通过基于 Beta 后验的自适应采样权重和仅利用混合组更新的高斯课程，有效解决了 GRPO 在极端通过率下的学习信号匮乏问题，在保持 GRPO 更新不变的前提下实现了更高的样本效率和任务性能。

Abstract: Group relative policy optimization learns from a question only when the sampled responses disagree. A group that is entirely correct or entirely incorrect has zero reward variance and a zero advantage. On the Web, that group has already spent its searches and page fetches. Gaussian curricula aim the next batch at pass rates where a finite group can still mix. A Gaussian on the latest empirical rate treats every all-fail history as the same point, and a center stepped by the average signed change of those rates is pushed by prompts already stuck at 0 or 1. RIDGE keeps the Gaussian curriculum and changes the coordinate, the center, and the width. Each prompt carries a Beta posterior. The sampling weight is the marginal of a Gaussian target under a Gaussian approximation of that posterior, divided by a prediction of tool-call cost. The center and the width are an exponential smooth of the posterior means of groups that just came back mixed. All-correct and all-incorrect groups refresh the posterior and do not move the center. The GRPO update itself is unchanged. On two math backbones and a retrieval-augmented question answerer, RIDGE raises average accuracy by 3.4 and 2.9 points over GRPO and average exact match by 3.7 points, at 29.6\% fewer math rollouts and 32.7\% fewer tool calls than dynamic sampling.

</details>


### [343] [A Distribution-Free Separation Between Learned and Fixed Features](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25335)
*Daniel Barzilai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文解决了Feldman, Kamath和Srebro (2026)提出的COLT开放问题，证明了神经网络学习特征相对于固定特征的计算优势可以在无分布假设设置下成立。作者构造了一系列假设类，这些类可以被双层ReLU网络上的自然梯度算法高效学习，但无法用多项式维度的固定特征映射上的线性预测器表示。具体而言，对于任意足够小的误差和足够大的运行时间预算R，存在一个假设类使得神经网络能在任意输入分布下以期望分类误差在时间R内学习，而线性预测器所需的维度复杂度在R中是超多项式的。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经网络的成功归因于其从训练数据中学习有用表示的能力。然而，此前证明学习特征相对于固定特征具有计算优势的结果仅限于特定输入分布。本文旨在解决Feldman, Kamath和Srebro (2026)提出的COLT开放问题，即这种优势是否能在无分布假设（distribution-free）设置下持续存在。

Method: 作者构造了一系列假设类，并证明这些类可以被双层ReLU网络上的自然梯度算法高效学习。同时，他们证明这些假设类无法用多项式维度的固定特征映射上的线性预测器表示。通过理论分析，建立了对于任意足够小的误差和足够大的运行时间预算R，存在假设类使得神经网络在任意输入分布下都能在时间R内达到期望误差，而线性预测器所需维度在R中是超多项式的。

Result: 证明了神经网络学习特征相对于固定特征的计算优势在无分布假设设置下成立。具体构造了：1) 可被双层ReLU网络自然梯度算法高效学习的假设类；2) 这些类无法用多项式维度固定特征映射上的线性预测器表示；3) 对于任意小误差和大运行时间预算R，存在假设类使神经网络在任意分布下时间R内学习，而线性预测器维度复杂度在R中超多项式。

Conclusion: 本文彻底解决了COLT开放问题，确立了表示学习在无分布假设设置下的计算优势。这为神经网络优于固定特征方法提供了理论基础，表明梯度学习的表示能力在最坏情况下确实优于任何固定特征映射，不依赖于特定分布假设。

Abstract: The success of neural networks is largely attributed to their ability to learn useful representations from training data. However, known results that prove a computational advantage of learned features over fixed ones are restricted to specific input distributions. We settle the COLT open question of Feldman, Kamath, and Srebro (2026) by showing that this advantage can persist in the distribution-free setting.
  We construct a family of hypothesis classes that can be efficiently learned by a natural gradient-based algorithm on a two-layer ReLU network, but cannot be represented by linear predictors over any fixed feature map with polynomial dimension (and runtime). Specifically, for any sufficiently small error and any sufficiently large runtime budget R (depending on the error), there exists a hypothesis class that the neural network learns under any input distribution to the desired expected classification error in time at most R, while the dimension complexity (governing the dimension needed by linear predictors) is superpolynomial in R.

</details>


### [344] [Predicted Class Correction: Conformal Thresholds for Classes with No Calibration Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25349)
*One Octadion,Novanto Yudistira,Yuta Nakashima*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Predicted Class Correction (PCC) 方法，解决长尾分布下类条件共形预测因稀有类别缺乏标注校准样本而无法为每个类别单独校准阈值的问题。PCC 利用分类器头的几何描述符（仅依赖模型权重）回归每类与边际共形分位数的偏移，并通过单一标量收缩预测，保留了分裂共形的边际覆盖保证。实验表明 PCC 在 ImageNet 和 Pl@ntNet-300K 上显著提升最差类别覆盖率，且仅需 100 个标注类别即可泛化到 1000 类。此外发现：当每类测试样本少于约 35 个时，最差类别覆盖率变得不可测而非不可达，评估集深度不足会掩盖方法效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 类条件共形预测需要为每个类别单独校准分数阈值，这要求每个类别都有标注的校准样本。但在长尾部署中，稀有类别往往缺乏或完全没有保留的校准样本，现有方法要么无法为这些类别定义阈值，要么退化为共享的边际阈值，导致稀有类别的覆盖保证失效。因此，研究者询问是否可以从不需要标签的类别描述符中预测每类的校正量。

Method: 提出 Predicted Class Correction (PCC) 方法：1) 利用分类器头的几何描述符（仅依赖模型权重，无需标签）作为特征；2) 回归每类共形分位数与边际共形分位数之间的偏移量；3) 在有标签的类别上选择一个标量收缩因子对预测偏移进行收缩；4) 重新拟合单一的边际偏移量。这样即使某类别有零校准样本也能获得专属阈值，且仅校准一个标量，保留了分裂共形的边际覆盖理论保证。

Result: 在 ImageNet 上，PCC 在匹配平均预测集大小下，将最差类别覆盖率提升 0.058 [0.006, 0.110]，达到知晓测试标签的 Oracle 效果的 42%。八个基线中六个无任何改进（统计量变化为零），最好的基线仅达 0.016 且置信区间包含零，PCC 是唯一可与无改进显著区分的方法。该增益在仅 100 个标注类别（共 1000 类）时依然保持。第二发现：当每类测试样本少于约 35 个时，最差类别覆盖率变得不可测量而非不可实现，即使 Oracle 也无法展示改进；将评估限制在样本深度足够的类别上，在 Pl@ntNet-300K 上恢复了显著改进，而原评估中效果似乎缺失。

Conclusion: PCC 通过从模型权重推导的几何描述符预测类条件校正，成功解决了长尾场景下稀有类别缺乏校准数据的问题，在保持理论边际覆盖保证的同时显著提升了最差类别覆盖率。此外，研究揭示了评估最差类别覆盖率时的一个关键陷阱：测试集每类样本数不足（<35）会使指标失去统计效力，导致虚假的零结果，建议在评估时过滤低深度类别。

Abstract: Class-conditional conformal prediction calibrates a separate score threshold for every class and therefore requires labelled calibration examples of every class. In long-tailed deployments these are exactly what is missing: rare classes are left with few or no held-out examples, and existing methods are either undefined for them or fall back to the shared marginal threshold. We ask whether the per-class correction can instead be predicted from descriptors of the class that require no labels at all. We propose Predicted Class Correction (PCC), which regresses the offset between the per-class and the marginal conformal quantile on geometric descriptors of the classifier head, shrinks the prediction by a scalar selected on the labelled classes, and refits a single marginal offset. The descriptors depend only on the model's weights, so a class with zero calibration examples still receives its own threshold, and since only one scalar is calibrated, split conformal's marginal guarantee is retained. On ImageNet, PCC improves worst-class coverage on such classes by 0.058 [0.006, 0.110] at matched average set size, 42% of an oracle that sees the test labels. Of eight baselines on the same splits, six change the statistic by exactly zero and the best reaches 0.016 with an interval containing zero, so PCC is the only one distinguishable from no improvement; the gain persists with only 100 labelled classes out of 1000. A second finding concerns evaluation: worst-class coverage becomes unmeasurable before it becomes unachievable. Below roughly 35 test examples per class no improvement can be shown even for an oracle, so a null result there reflects the evaluation set, not the method. Restricting evaluation above this depth recovers a significant improvement on Pl@ntNet-300K, where the effect had appeared absent.

</details>


### [345] [CHSM8: A Chess Transformer that Follows Natural-Language Style Prompts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25356)
*Ilia Badanin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CHSM8 是一个 2.1 亿参数的国际象棋 Transformer，能够根据自由文本风格描述（如「西西里防御」、「稳健无风险棋风」或「巅峰时期的卡尔森」）生成走法。模型在 10.7 亿盘过滤后的 Lichess 对局上预训练，采用因子化走法表示与合法走法掩码，无需搜索即达到 1837 Elo，击败所有同类公开模型（含参数量大 13 倍者）。随后利用 Gemma-4-31B 生成的 300 万盘风格描述、Gemma-3-1B 蒸馏标注的合成数据集进行监督微调（冻结文本编码器 + 门控交叉注意力）与直接偏好优化（DPO，以不匹配描述下的同一走法为拒绝样本），风格遵循度全面提升（如早早换后 53%→67%、兵着法占比 29%→32%、长易位 97.3%→99.7%），无提示词时强度基本保持（1792 vs 1797 Elo）。全流程基于固定预算自动化搜索决定设计，完全开源可复现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 旨在构建一个无需搜索、无需偏好调优、仅凭自由文本即可控制棋风的国际象棋模型，并提供完全开源、可复现的训练流水线、数据集、权重与推理代码，填补「文本条件下可控风格下棋」在公开领域的空白。

Method: 1. 预训练：10.7 亿盘过滤后 Lichess 对局，因子化走法表示 + 合法走法掩码，2.1 亿参数 Transformer。2. 合成风格数据集：Gemma-4-31B 为 300 万盘单方对局生成风格描述，Gemma-3-1B 从中蒸馏 240 万盘无矛盾描述并伪标注其余，最终 3000 万盘单方各得 5 条描述。3. SFT：冻结文本编码器，通过门控交叉注意力注入文本条件。4. DPO：以同一走法在不匹配描述下的输出为拒绝样本优化风格遵循。所有超参与架构选择均由固定预算自动化搜索循环确定。

Result: 预训练模型在限制强度 Stockfish 下达 1837 Elo，千盘匹配击败所有同类公开无搜索/无偏好调优模型（含 13 倍参数模型）。DPO 后：所有测试提示词的风格遵循度均提升（早早换后 53%→67%、兵着法占比 29%→32%、长易位 97.3%→99.7%），无提示词时 Elo 仅微降（1792 vs 1797，噪声范围内）。千盘/设置的大量评测覆盖多种风格提示与对局类型。

Conclusion: CHSM8 证明了在标准架构与训练配方基础上，通过自动化搜索与合成数据管线，可训练出小参数量、高强度、可文本控制风格的国际象棋模型。全流程开源（权重、带标签数据集、提示词、配置、推理代码、可玩演示），为后续研究提供可复现基准。

Abstract: We present CHSM8, a 210M-parameter chess transformer that plays moves conditioned on a free-text description of a playing style, e.g. "go for the Sicilian Defense", "solid, safe, risk-free chess" or "You are Magnus Carlsen in his prime". The model is pretrained without search on 1.07B filtered Lichess games, using a factorized move representation and legal-move masking. It reaches 1837 Elo against a strength-limited Stockfish and, in 1,000-game matches, beat every other public model we tested that was likewise trained without preference tuning, rewards or search, including one with 13 times as many parameters. We then fine-tune it to follow text on a synthetic dataset: Gemma-4-31B describes the playing style of 3M game sides, a 1B Gemma-3 model distilled from the 2.4M of those descriptions that contradict nothing on the board labels the rest, and every one of 30M selected game sides gets five descriptions. Supervised fine-tuning attaches a frozen text encoder through gated cross-attention, and direct preference optimization (DPO) uses the same moves under a mismatched description as the rejected sample. After DPO, style adherence rises on every prompt we test (for example, queens traded early 53% -> 67%, pawn moves 29% -> 32% of all moves, queenside castling 97.3% -> 99.7%), and strength without a prompt stays within noise of SFT (1792 vs. 1797 Elo). Design choices at every stage were made by fixed-budget automated search loops on top of standard architectures and training recipes. We document the full pipeline and the decisions behind it, report the ablations that failed, and evaluate the models across many style prompts and kinds of games, with 1,000 games per setting. The work is fully open source and reproducible: weights, datasets with all training labels, prompts, configurations, inference code and playable demos are public and free to build on.

</details>


### [346] [CD-OPD: Contextual Digest for On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25359)
*Mingyuan Li,Yucheng Li,Xiaxia Wang,Gong Cheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CD-OPD提出一种新的在线策略蒸馏方法，通过Contextual Digest结构化教师指导并引入在线元重加权机制，在八个基准上平均准确率提升1.32-7.05个百分点，协作失败率降低27.4%-56.4%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有在线策略蒸馏（OPD）中的教师接管机制存在协作失败问题：即使师生模型独立回答同一问题均正确，教师接管后仍可能产生错误响应，论文量化了这一现象为协作失败率（CFR）。

Method: CD-OPD包含两大创新：1）Contextual Digest构建：利用教师生成的依赖图结构化早期上下文，将所需问题条件和前序推理作为节点摘要，与原始指导一同整理成Contextual Digest供学生续写；2）在线元重加权：对比Digest片段梯度与独立学生响应的任务梯度，倾向于选择预测能减少任务损失的更新，提升学生单独推理性能。

Result: 在八个基准测试中，CD-OPD相较于代表性现有OPD方法，平均准确率提升1.32-7.05个百分点；相较于现有接管式OPD方法，CFR降低27.4%-56.4%。

Conclusion: CD-OPD通过结构化上下文消化和梯度感知的元重加权，有效缓解了教师接管导致的协作失败，显著提升了学生模型的独立推理能力和整体蒸馏效果。

Abstract: Teacher takeover in on-policy distillation (OPD) can produce incorrect responses even when the student and teacher independently answer the same problem correctly, a failure we quantify using Collaboration Failure Rate (CFR). To address it, we propose Contextual Digest for On-Policy Distillation (CD-OPD). CD-OPD structures the earlier context of teacher guidance through a teacher-generated dependency graph, curating the required problem conditions and preceding reasoning as node summaries alongside the unchanged guidance in a Contextual Digest before student continuation.
