Two results follow. First, representation dominates: every representation close to raw RTL reaches a pass rate of at most 0.17, while the configuration reaches 0.83 with no training at all. Once the model emits the configuration, every training regime achieves a pass rate between 0.89 and 1.00. Second, raw RTL hits a hard output-length limit: a 512-bit design requires 44,237 tokens of flat Verilog compared with just 69 tokens for the configuration. Consequently, raw generation becomes infeasible above 32-bit data words rather than merely inaccurate. A model trained from scratch with fewer than 50 million parameters, combined with the verified generator, achieves 0.89 formal equivalence, compared with 1.00 for a 32-billion-parameter fine-tuned model, while using approximately 1600 times less inference energy per correct design. Inference energy also dominates amortized training energy. The lesson is to learn the interface, not the implementation.

</details>


### [414] [Typed Decision Models under Prevalence Shift: Decision Training, Calibration, and Implicit Priors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26325)
*Abdul Rahman Iqbal,Muhammad Fawad Nasim,Amir Saleem*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究类型决策模型（TDMs）在标签分布偏移下的校准性能与阈值稳健性，对比三种TDMs（Jev、Tev1-4B、Nimble-9B）、其骨干模型及微调分类器，在五个公开数据集上进行模拟偏移实验。发现决策训练并非普遍有益：Nimble-9B在意图任务校准更好但金融情感任务Macro-F1下降12分；中等偏移下Jev的ECE和阈值风险仅在金融情感任务显著劣于微调DeBERTa；EM先验修正（无需标签）可降低ECE，但有标签重校准效果更好。总体而言，TDMs既不普遍优于骨干模型，也不独特脆弱于偏移，其主要弱点是无偏移时已存在的误校准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有评估存在两大空白：一是厂商决策训练的增益未与骨干模型在相同读出条件下分离；二是TDMs仅在测试集类分布下测试。部署中类频率变化，固定测试集上的校准不一定在阈值应用处成立。因此需要探究：决策训练是否相对于自身骨干模型提升性能？TDMs的校准与阈值是否能像微调分类器一样抵御流行度（标签）偏移？

Method: 选取三种TDMs（Jev、Tev1-4B、Nimble-9B）、其对应骨干模型及两个微调分类器，在五个公开数据集的相同决策任务上，通过模拟标签偏移进行对比。实验设计包含35个配对测试，所有测试方案在计算前固定。此外进行探索性分析，平均2000个偏移场景。引入EM先验修正，使用模型在开发集上的平均预测作为先验（无需标签），并对比有标签重校准效果。

Result: 1. 决策训练非普遍有益：Nimble-9B（仅比Qwen3.5-9B多一LoRA适配器）在意图任务校准更好，但在金融情感任务Macro-F1下降12.0个百分点。2. 中等偏移下，Jev的ECE和阈值风险仅在金融情感任务显著劣于微调DeBERTa，分别增大1.7和2.5个百分点；平均2000个偏移场景后，各数据集差距均不超过1个百分点。3. EM先验修正（无标签）在Jev ECE最高的两个数据集上分别降低2.7和1.8个百分点，但有标签重校准降低幅度远大于此。

Conclusion: 测试的三种TDMs既不普遍优于其骨干模型，也不独特脆弱于分布偏移；对于校准问题，其主要弱点是即便没有偏移时已存在的误校准。论文已公开所有输入、代码和输出。

Abstract: Typed decision models (TDMs) return a probability over caller-defined options, and Jev is described by its vendor as calibrated. But in deployment class frequencies change, so calibration measured on a fixed test set need not hold where thresholds are applied. Existing evaluations leave two gaps: the gains of vendor decision training have not been separated from those of the backbone under an identical readout, and TDMs have been tested only at the test set's class distribution. We ask whether decision training improves a model over its own backbone, and whether a TDM's calibration and thresholds withstand prevalence (label) shift as well as a fine-tuned classifier's. We compare three TDMs (Jev, Tev1-4B, Nimble-9B), their base models and two trained classifiers on identical decisions from five public datasets under simulated shift, with 35 paired tests fixed before any test was computed. First, decision training is not uniformly beneficial: Nimble-9B, which differs from Qwen3.5-9B only by a LoRA adapter, is better calibrated on intent tasks but 12.0 Macro-F1 points worse on financial sentiment. Second, under moderate shift Jev's expected calibration error (ECE) and threshold risk grow significantly more than a fine-tuned DeBERTa's only on financial sentiment, by 1.7 and 2.5 percentage points; averaged over 2,000 shift scenarios (exploratory), the gap is at most one point on every dataset. Third, EM prior correction with the model's mean development prediction as its prior needs no labels and lowers Jev's ECE under shift by 2.7 and 1.8 points on the two datasets where it is highest, although labelled recalibration lowers it far more. The three TDMs we tested are neither uniformly better than their backbones nor uniquely fragile under shift; for calibration, their main weakness is the miscalibration they already have without shift. We release all inputs, code and outputs.

</details>


### [415] [Out-of-Distribution Detection in Continual Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25901)
*Nimeshika Udayangani,Flora D. Salim,Christopher Leckie,Sarah Erfani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种无需回放缓冲的持续学习框架，用于解决分布外（OOD）检测问题。受Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（KAN）启发，利用其局部神经可塑性缓解灾难性遗忘；设计任务自适应分类器TA-KAN，通过任务特定的激活局部性控制减轻新近偏见并增强ID-OOD可分性；提出几何引导的OOD评分，无需过去ID数据即可补充分类器置信度。实验表明该方法在OOD检测和ID分类上均达到最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 持续学习中的OOD检测面临双重挑战：一是避免灾难性遗忘，二是在无法访问历史任务ID数据的情况下识别未知样本。现有方法依赖回放缓冲或假设封闭世界设定，限制了实际部署的可扩展性与可靠性。

Method: 1. 引入基于KAN的框架，利用其固有的局部神经可塑性缓解灾难性遗忘。2. 设计任务自适应分类器TA-KAN，通过任务特定的激活局部性控制减轻新近偏见，增强ID与OOD样本的可分性。3. 提出几何引导的OOD评分，结合TA-KAN分类器置信度，无需历史ID数据即可实现有效OOD检测。

Result: 在多个OOD-CL基准上，该方法显著提升OOD检测性能，同时保持强劲的ID分类准确率，达到最先进水平。

Conclusion: 本文提出的TA-KAN框架与几何引导OOD评分有效解决了无回放持续学习中的OOD检测难题，为真实场景下的可扩展、可靠部署提供了新思路。

Abstract: Out-of-distribution detection in continual learning (OOD-CL) is highly challenging, as it requires (i) learning a sequence of tasks without catastrophic forgetting, and (ii) identifying unknown samples (OOD) without access to known (in-distribution (ID)) data from past tasks, where standard confidence-based OOD scores tend to degrade. Existing methods largely rely on a rehearsal buffer of past data or assume closed-world settings, limiting their scalability and reliability in real-world scenarios. In this paper, we propose a novel OOD detection framework for rehearsal-free continual learning, inspired by Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KAN), which mitigate catastrophic forgetting via their inherent local neuroplasticity. To better leverage KAN in OOD-CL, we introduce a task-adaptive classifier architecture, TA-KAN, which mitigates recency bias and enhances ID--OOD separability through task-specific control of activation locality. Furthermore, we propose a geometry-guided OOD score that complements TA-KAN classifier confidence without relying on past ID data. Our method significantly improves OOD detection while maintaining strong ID classification performance, achieving state-of-the-art results in OOD-CL.

</details>


### [416] [An Analysis of Semantic and Spatio-Temporal Co-evolution for Edge Classification on Dynamic Text-Attributed Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25906)
*Tyler Bonnet,Marek Rei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种统一文本-图对齐框架，在动态文本属性图上实现文本嵌入与图拓扑的协同演化，通过轻量级Transformer适配器和语言模型维护目标，在不增加过大计算开销的情况下提升边分类性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有动态图架构通常冻结预训练语言模型生成的文本特征向量以保持语义结构，但这放弃了让文本表示与网络拓扑共同演化的潜在收益。需要一种方法在保持语义完整性的同时，实现文本表示与时空图结构的自适应协同演化。

Method: 提出统一文本-图对齐框架：1) 引入轻量级Transformer适配器更新token级文本表示，利用对比预训练目标的时空梯度；2) 设计语言模型维护目标锚定演化中的文本嵌入，防止语义扭曲；3) 在动态文本属性图基准上评估边分类任务。

Result: 在Dynamic Text-Attributed Graph Benchmark上，该框架在多样化Web相关领域持续优于冻结文本基线。表征分析显示：降低各向异性，提升文本嵌入的线性可分性；有效将结构和时序信息编码进语义空间。计算效率分析证实无需承担典型端到端联合训练的高昂开销。

Conclusion: 锚定的文本-图协同演化能够在保持语义完整性的前提下，自适应地融合时空拓扑信息，显著提升动态边分类性能，且计算开销可控，为动态文本属性图建模提供了高效实用的范式。

Abstract: Dynamic edge classification on text-attributed Web graphs, such as review networks, community forums, and news-derived knowledge graphs, requires high quality, adaptive semantic representations in the context of network evolution. Existing dynamic graph architectures typically initialize text feature vectors with pretrained language models and hold them static during training to preserve their semantic structure, forgoing the potential benefits of allowing them to co-evolve with network topology. In this work, we investigate the effects of enabling such co-evolution with a unified text-graph alignment framework that integrates a lightweight Transformer adapter to update token-level text representations via spatio-temporal gradients from a contrastive pretraining objective. To prevent detrimental semantic distortion, a language model maintenance objective anchors the evolving text embeddings to their original semantic structure. Evaluations on the Dynamic Text-Attributed Graph Benchmark demonstrate that this anchored text-graph co-evolution consistently improves upon the edge classification performance of frozen-text baselines across diverse Web-related domains. Representational analyses reveal that the framework reduces anisotropy, improving the linear separability of text embeddings, and effectively encodes structural and temporal information into the semantic space. A computational efficiency analysis confirms that this beneficial semantic and spatio-temporal co-evolution is achieved without incurring the prohibitive computational overhead typical of end-to-end joint training.

</details>


### [417] [An Empirical Study of Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning for Mixture-of-Experts LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26370)
*Minglei Li,Peng Ye,Haonan He,Jingqi Ye,Qingyu Yang,Tao Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对大模型参数高效微调（PEFT）在混合专家（MoE）架构上的应用缺乏系统配方的问题，开展大规模系统实证研究，确立了“仅适配专家权重 + LoRA/DoRA + 零负载均衡系数”的最优组合，并提出 MoE²-LoRA 权重级重设计，在 Qwen3 上以更少可训练参数显著提升上游指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着 MoE 架构在大规模模型中普及，现有 PEFT 方法缺乏针对 MoE 的系统性设计指南（如适配哪些模块、粒度、PEFT 算法选择、负载均衡目标权重），导致实践中难以在下游任务性能与通用能力保持间取得最佳权衡。

Method: 在三种 MoE 主干模型上，系统探究四个核心设计维度：① 适配模块选择（专家、路由器、全 MoE 模块等）；② MoE 模块适配粒度（模块级 vs. 专家级 vs. 权重级）；③ PEFT 方法对比（LoRA、DoRA、Adapter 等）；④ 负载均衡系数对下游-保持权衡的影响。实验覆盖下游任务与通用知识任务。

Result: 四大关键发现：1) 仅适配专家权重在同等参数预算下实现最高下游性能且通用能力保持最优；2) 原生专家权重更新的下游-保持权优于旁路专家或整个 MoE 模块的 Adapter 方案；3) LoRA 与 DoRA 共同界定出最高下游精度的最强工作区；4) 任何非零负载均衡系数均不能帕累托优于零基线。MoE²-LoRA 重设计将模块级旁路池迁移至原生专家权重，在 Qwen3 上使四个上游指标提升 2.4–17.9 点，可训练参数减少 17%，平均下游代价仅 +3.2 点。

Conclusion: 研究为 MoE 模型的 PEFT 提供了完整实证配方：推荐采用专家级原生权重更新 + LoRA/DoRA + 零负载均衡损失。MoE²-LoRA 的权重级重设计验证了该配方的有效性，实现了参数效率与性能的双重提升。

Abstract: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods are critical for adapting large models under resource-constrained settings. However, as mixture-of-experts (MoE) architectures, which offer efficient inference at massive parameter scales, gain increasing prevalence in the community, a critical gap arising from the lack of systematic recipes for applying PEFT to MoE models. To narrow this gap, we conduct a large-scale systematic study that investigates a set of essential design recipes, including which modules should be adapted, which granularity should be used to adapt MoE modules, which PEFT method to use, and to what extent should the load-balancing objective be used, across three MoE backbones on downstream tasks and general knowledge tasks. Our experiments yield several key insights. First, adapting MoE experts alone achieves the highest downstream performance with competitive general capability retention under a comparable parameter budget. Second, native expert-weight updates offer a better downstream--retention trade-off than adapters that bypass experts or entire MoE modules. Third, LoRA and DoRA together define the strongest operating region for high downstream accuracy among the evaluated PEFT methods. Fourth, no nonzero load-balancing coefficient Pareto-dominates the zero baseline. We finally evaluate a weight-level redesign of MoE$^2$-LoRA on Qwen3. Moving its module-level bypass pool into native expert weights improves all four upstream endpoints by 2.4 to 17.9 points with 17% fewer trainable parameters and a 3.2-point average downstream cost.

</details>


### [418] [Maestro: Agentic Formal Proof Development by Coordination](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25920)
*Haoyu Li,Zeren Shui,Yuhao Zhang,Ferhat Erata,Benjamin Mikek,Murali Krishna Ramanathan,Hao Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Maestro，一种用于 Lean 的证明器框架，通过全局协调处理证明失败：证明器报告失败原因，协调器根据全局视角决定响应（指导、修正或回溯重规划），并扩展至经反例验证的代码合成。在多个数学与软件验证基准上，Maestro 显著优于原生编码代理及现有证明系统，在研究级数学问题上提升最大。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有证明系统采用分治策略，将困难证明义务递归分解为更简单的引理，但无法区分引理抗拒证明的不同原因（指导不足、陈述错误、分解缺陷）。失败尝试仅报告失败本身，响应局限于失败节点，不考虑整体证明计划，导致系统可能沿着错误方向持续分解直到预算耗尽，使整个证明尝试失败。

Method: Maestro 引入全局协调机制：证明器需报告失败原因而非仅报告失败；协调器拥有整个证明的全局视图，据此选择恰当响应——指导卡住的证明器、修正错误引理、或回撤有缺陷的子树并重新规划。同一框架扩展至经验证的代码合成：经检查的反例将代码送回修复。

Result: 在四个前沿 LLM、七个数学与三个软件验证基准上评估。Maestro 在未被原生代理（Claude Code 或 Codex）饱和的每个基准上均证明更多目标，研究级数学增益最大。配合 Claude Opus 5，在 2026 年 6 月 arXivLean 发布的 48 个定理中自行发现 34 个证明（原生代理 19 个）。在共享基准上超越所有已发表证明系统：PutnamBench 669/672、Lean-IMO-Bench 59/60、IMO 2026 6/6。

Conclusion: Maestro 的全局协调方法有效解决了现有证明系统无法诊断失败原因、盲目分解导致整体失败的问题，在形式化数学证明与经验证代码合成任务上均达到最先进水平，显著提升了 LLM 在高难度数学与软件验证中的自动化能力。

Abstract: Lean is increasingly used to verify mathematical proofs and software produced by LLM agents, but writing formal proofs remains hard. Existing prover systems take a divide-and-conquer approach that recursively decomposes hard proof obligations into easier lemmas and splits again any lemma that resists proof. However, a lemma can resist proof for different reasons, including insufficient guidance, a false statement, or a flaw in the decomposition that produced it. Existing systems cannot tell these apart as a failed attempt reports little beyond its failure, and responses are confined to the failing node without considering the rest of the proof or revising the plan above it. The system may thus keep decomposing obligations along a flawed proof direction until the budget runs out, causing the whole proof attempt to fail. We introduce Maestro, a Lean prover harness that handles failures through global coordination. Provers report why they failed, not just that they failed, and a coordinator that sees the whole proof chooses an appropriate response, such as guiding a stuck prover, correcting a false lemma, or retracting a flawed subtree and replanning it. The same harness extends to verified code synthesis, where a checked counterexample sends the code back for repair. We evaluate Maestro with four frontier LLMs on seven mathematics and three software verification benchmarks. It proves more targets than each model's native coding agent (Claude Code or Codex) on every benchmark the agent has not already saturated, with the largest gains on research-level mathematics. With Claude Opus 5, it discovers its own proofs of 34 of the 48 theorems in the June 2026 release of arXivLean, against 19 for the native agent. It also outperforms all published prover systems on every benchmark they share, solving 669/672 PutnamBench, 59/60 Lean-IMO-Bench, and 6/6 IMO 2026.

</details>


### [419] [Strength Controls Change How Interventions Compare Across Sparse Autoencoder Codes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26489)
*Jinchen Zhang,Zheyuan Liu,Yihan Zhu,Meng Jiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文比较了稀疏自编码器(SAE)代码干预在不同强度控制(范数匹配与输出校准)下的效果，发现全输出KL校准在整体补丁缩放下优于总范数匹配，但位置级缩放下位置级范数匹配表现更好；答案排除校准在主谓一致比较中减小差距但在性别重拟合中增大差距，校准可作为残差分歧的诊断工具。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 由于改变SAE代码会同时改变干预方向和幅度，比较干预效果需要指定保持什么不变的强度控制。范数匹配和输出校准提供了不同的控制，但干预在强度匹配后是否在不同代码间产生不同效果仍不清楚。

Method: 在Gemma和Llama模型中，针对固定特征组，比较全输出KL校准与总范数匹配、位置级范数匹配、答案排除校准等不同强度控制下的干预效果，使用NNLS重拟合、全输出KL校准等方法，在构造的性别一致、主谓一致等子集上评估。

Result: (1) 整体补丁缩放：全输出KL校准比总范数匹配留下更小的平均效果差距；在新Llama输入上，总范数匹配丢失11个参考迁移，而全输出校准保留所有迁移决定。(2) 位置级缩放：在小规模匹配性别一致子集上，位置级范数匹配比全输出校准留下更小的观测平均差距。(3) 答案排除：相比未缩放NNLS，答案排除校准减小主谓一致比较的差距但增大性别重拟合差距；全输出KL校准也减小范数匹配构造候选的较大差距，但多个设置下匹配覆盖不完整。

Conclusion: 校准利用被评估输入的输出，可作为残差分歧的诊断工具；不同强度控制在不同场景下表现不同，需根据具体任务选择合适的控制方式。

Abstract: Changing sparse autoencoder (SAE) codes can alter both intervention direction and magnitude, so comparing intervention effects requires a strength control specifying what is held equal. Norm matching and output calibration provide different controls, but whether interventions yield different effects across codes after strength matching remains unclear. We compare intervention effects under these controls for fixed feature groups in Gemma and Llama and observe: (1) Whole-patch scaling. With one coefficient per input, full-output Kullback-Leibler (KL) calibration leaves smaller mean effect gaps from the encoder-based reference intervention than total-norm matching for nonnegative least-squares (NNLS) refits. On new Llama inputs, total-norm matching loses 11 reference transfers, whereas full-output calibration preserves every transfer decision. (2) Positionwise scaling. On a small matched gender-agreement subset, positionwise norm matching leaves smaller observed mean gaps than full-output calibration. (3) Answer exclusion. Compared with unscaled NNLS, answer-excluded calibration reduces gaps in the measured subject-verb agreement comparisons but increases them for gender refits. Full-output KL calibration also reduces larger gaps for norm-matched constructed candidates, although matching coverage is incomplete in several settings. Since calibration uses the evaluated input's outputs, it serves as a diagnostic of residual disagreement.

</details>


### [420] [UtilityBench: Measuring Language Model Utility When Errors Have Different Costs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25924)
*Qifeng Lei,Zhiyong Yang,Zitai Wang,Shilong Bao,Linchao Zhang,Qianqian Xu,Qingming Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出基于效用的评估范式，开发了包含15,000个实例的UtilityBench基准，利用最差缩放量化错误严重性，并引入UtilityAUC指标衡量模型响应排序下的效用曲线面积。实验发现，更高的准确率或更先进的架构并不一定带来更高的UtilityAUC，揭示了语言模型在解题能力与负责任决策之间的鸿沟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有语言模型评估协议将所有错误视为同等重要，忽略了现实世界中错误后果的严重性差异（如医疗领域单一错误可能危及患者安全）。需要一种能够显式纳入错误后果差异的评估范式，引导模型根据场景真实重要性做出回答或拒答决策。

Method: 1. 提出效用导向评估范式；2. 构建UtilityBench基准（15,000个可验证实例），采用最差缩放（Best-Worst Scaling）量化错误严重性，获得数据驱动的成本估计；3. 引入UtilityAUC指标，计算模型响应排序确定的效用曲线下面积，实现超越错误频率的效用偏好对齐；4. 理论分析证明UtilityAUC能区分标准准确率和AURC失效情况下的模型差异。

Result: 在20个最先进模型上的实证评估显示：更高的准确率或更先进的架构不能可靠地转化为更高的UtilityAUC，凸显了语言模型评估中问题解决能力与负责任决策能力之间的差距。

Conclusion: 论文确立了效用导向的评估新范式，通过UtilityBench和UtilityAUC为语言模型在高风险场景下的负责任部署提供了量化工具，揭示了现有模型在效用对齐方面的不足，呼吁未来研究关注错误后果的差异化权衡而非单纯追求准确率提升。

Abstract: As language models are increasingly deployed in real-world scenarios with important outcomes, the impact of their mistakes often extends far beyond what correctness can capture. In domains like medicine, a single error can lead to serious consequences and put patient safety at risk. However, mainstream evaluation protocols still treat all errors as equal, overlooking the spectrum of real-world costs. To address this, we propose a utility-based evaluation paradigm that explicitly incorporates the varying consequences of errors. Guided by this principle, we develop UtilityBench, a large-scale benchmark of 15,000 instances with verifiable answers, quantifying error severity using Best-Worst Scaling to elicit meaningful, data-driven cost estimates. These quantified utilities shape when a model should answer or abstain, guiding it to make decisions that align with the true importance of each scenario. As another merit, we introduce UtilityAUC, a metric that measures the area under the utility curve determined by a model's response ordering, thereby enabling utility preference alignment beyond error frequency. Our theoretical analysis demonstrates that UtilityAUC can distinguish between models where standard accuracy and AURC fall short. Empirically, evaluating 20 state-of-the-art models, we find that greater accuracy or more advanced architectures do not reliably translate to higher UtilityAUC, highlighting a gap between problem-solving ability and responsible decision-making in language model evaluation.

</details>


### [421] [A Fisher-Geometric View of Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26525)
*Liu Kaiyuan,Zhuang Ziyuan,Ma Haoxuan,Gu Yannian,Song Mingfei,Weng Rongxiang,Ye Jieping*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文证明了模型合并与多教师在线蒸馏在二阶近似下等价，提出了两阶段的残差治理分支合并（RGBM）方法：第一阶段在任务向量子空间进行Fisher合并，第二阶段利用域残差谱控制分支训练与回写，在零额外联合训练步数下超越全量多教师蒸馏。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模型合并虽快但被视为启发式，多教师在线蒸馏虽分布匹配但算力大且跨任务梯度冲突。作者旨在统一这两条路线，揭示其本质联系，并据此设计更高效、理论有保证的巩固流程。

Method: 1. 理论层面：证明在同源专家共享盆地内，多教师在线蒸馏目标在二阶近似下等于Fisher合并目标，最小化器即闭式Fisher合并。2. 算法层面：提出RGBM。Phase 1 将合并限制在任务向量子空间，利用系数同时混合任务向量与隐式奖励，在无标签提示上求解残差程序，得到能量归一化的域残差谱。Phase 2 依据谱门控：低残差域钝化，高残差域（谱隙以上）训练隔离分支，再以校准收缩回写。

Result: 在两个开源巩固基准上，仅Phase 1合并即匹配或超越全量训练的多教师蒸馏；RGBM在零额外联合训练步数下进一步提升；所有无门控回写（包括从合并点继续联合蒸馏）均低于RGBM。

Conclusion: 模型合并并非启发式，而是二阶最优蒸馏的闭式实现。RGBM通过残差谱门控实现了参数高效、免联合训练的专家巩固，为大规模基础模型统一提供了理论落地的新范式。

Abstract: Consolidating specialized foundation models into a unified generalist is a central goal of post-training. Two approaches are in common use: model merging, which is fast but treated as a heuristic, and multi-teacher on-policy distillation, which matches distributions but demands heavy rollout compute and suffers from cross-task gradient conflict. We show that the two are one objective seen at different orders. Within a shared basin of homologous specialists, the multi-teacher on-policy distillation objective is, to second order, exactly the Fisher-merging objective. Its minimizer is therefore the Fisher merge, a classic model-merging method given by a closed-form combination of the specialists, so merging is optimal, to second order, as a closed-form stage of distillation. Building on this identification, we propose Residual-Governed Branch-and-Merge(RGBM), a two-phase consolidation procedure. Concretely, a full-parameter Fisher merge is intractable on foundation models, so Phase~1 restricts the merge to the task-vector subspace. Extending tangent-space analyses of merging, we show that the same coefficients that mix task vectors also mix implicit rewards, which lets a residual program on unlabelled prompts solve for them. The program minimizes the worst per-domain residual and reports its energy-normalized values as the domain residual spectrum. Phase~2 lets this spectrum govern what may be added: RGBM passivates domains with low normalized residuals, trains isolated branches only for domains above the spectral gap, and writes back the admitted updates with calibrated shrinkage. On two open-source consolidation suites, the Phase~1 merge alone matches or outperforms fully trained multi-teacher distillation, and RGBM improves on it further with zero extra joint-training steps, whereas every un-gated write-back, including continued joint distillation from the merge, falls below it.

</details>


### [422] [The KV-Surgeon: Compensation-Aware Offline KV-Cache Compaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25933)
*Moritz Wagner,Christophe Roux,Max Zimmer,Sebastian Pokutta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 KV-Surgeon，一种用于离线 KV-cache 压缩的方法，通过二次代理模型和闭式解实现贪心联合移除与补偿，显著提升长上下文问答在高压缩率下的成本-精度 Pareto 前沿。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离线 KV-cache 压缩旨在降低重复查询固定上下文的成本，核心难点在于决定保留或删除哪些缓存条目。现有方法独立为每个候选条目打分，忽略了 softmax 重归一化导致的非线性耦合：移除一个条目会改变所有剩余条目的注意力权重。

Method: KV-Surgeon 利用校准数据以可计算方式建模条目间交互。推导出二次代理目标，获得联合最优贪心移除决策及剩余条目补偿的闭式解，并提供更快的变体进一步降低计算开销。

Result: 在 QuALITY、LongHealth、Long Code Arena 基准上，KV-Surgeon 在所有评测压缩率下均显著推进 4B-30B 参数稠密及 MoE 模型的成本-精度 Pareto 前沿。50× 压缩时，问答准确率比注意力匹配（SOTA）最高提升 4 个百分点；更快变体仅需 SOTA 两成成本即超越其性能。

Conclusion: KV-Surgeon 通过二次代理有效处理了 KV-cache 压缩中的注意力耦合问题，实现了最优联合移除与补偿，在极高压缩率下大幅改善精度-成本权衡，并提供极低开销的高性能变体。

Abstract: Offline compaction of the key--value cache (KV-cache) reduces the cost of repeatedly querying a fixed context by constructing a smaller cache once and reusing it subsequently. The central challenge of compaction is deciding which cache entries to delete and which to retain. Existing methods score each candidate for deletion on its own, with the rest of the cache being held fixed. However, softmax renormalization of the attention operation couples these decisions in a nonlinear manner: removing one entry changes the attention weights of every remaining one. In this work, we introduce KV-Surgeon, which uses calibration data to take interactions into account in a tractable way. We derive a quadratic surrogate that admits closed-form expressions for jointly making the optimal greedy removal decision as well as compensation within the remaining entries. On QuALITY, LongHealth, and Long Code Arena, and at every evaluated compaction ratio, KV-Surgeon substantially advances the cost--accuracy Pareto frontier of dense and mixture-of-experts models from 4B to 30B parameters. At $50\times$ compaction, KV-Surgeon improves question-answering accuracy by up to four points over attention matching (Zweiger et al., 2026), the state of the art, at comparable cost. Lastly, we introduce an even faster variant, which also exceeds the state of the art while requiring only two fifths of its cost.

</details>


### [423] [Graph-to-Table Interfaces Control Relational Generalisation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25993)
*Alessandro Cagiano,Lorenzo Molfetta,Gianluca Moro,Matteo Zignani,Pasquale Minervini*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究图到表系统中的三个组件（编码器、上下文构造器、表格解码器）能否独立评估，通过在多个数据集和模型上的匹配比较实验发现：组件间存在强交互作用，单一组件的评估结论会随其他组件变化而改变，编码器评估需联合考虑上下文和解码器，面板级结论还依赖评估与聚合协议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图到表系统包含编码器、上下文构造器、表格解码器三大设计选择，现有研究缺乏系统性分析这些组件能否独立评估，以及组件间交互如何影响整体性能和泛化能力。

Method: 采用匹配比较实验设计，在保持流程其余部分和评估协议不变的前提下，逐个替换单一组件。实验覆盖逻辑回归、CatBoost、TabPFN-3三种解码器，在CLUTRR、57个GraphLog世界、57个知识图谱数据集上进行系统评估。

Result: 1. CLUTRR上绝对位置编码能完美拟合短路径但泛化较差，因支持前缀形成捷径在长路径失效；关系计数特征泛化更好。2. GraphLog上编码器偏好取决于解码器，关系计数表示随CatBoost树深增加而退化。3. 跨知识图谱，冻结ULTRA分数加入局部特征稳定有益，反向则效果小且不稳定。4. 点式TabPFN-3读出在48/57数据集上不如原生ULTRA。

Conclusion: 编码器评估无法孤立进行，必须联合考虑上下文构造器和表格解码器；面板级结论还依赖具体的评估指标和聚合方式。组件间存在复杂交互，系统设计需整体优化而非单点改进。

Abstract: Graph-to-table systems combine three design choices: an encoder that maps relational evidence to feature rows, a context constructor that selects labelled examples, and a tabular decoder. We investigate whether these components can be evaluated independently through matched comparisons that change one component while holding the rest of the pipeline and the evaluation constant. Across logistic regression, CATBOOST, and TABPFN-3 on CLUTRR, 57 GraphLog worlds, and 57 knowledge graphs, we show that conclusions about one component can change when the others change. On CLUTRR, absolute positional encodings maintain all distinctions among the evaluated queries and fit the short-path setting nearly perfectly; yet, they generalise worse than relation-count features because the supported prefix acts as a shortcut that breaks down on longer paths. On GraphLog, encoder preference depends on the decoder, while the relation-count representation degrades as CatBoost tree depth increases. Across different knowledge graphs, adding the frozen ULTRA score to local features is consistently useful, whereas adding local features to the score has a smaller and less stable effect. A pointwise TABPFN-3 readout using the full encoder underperforms native ULTRA on 48 of 57 datasets. These results show that encoder assessment depends jointly on context and decoder, while panel-level conclusions can also depend on evaluation and aggregation protocols.

</details>


### [424] [Which Model for Which Role? Cost-Efficient Pareto Recommendation for LLM Agentic Workflows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26676)
*Qian Xie,Wenyue Hua,Yueli He,Sripad Karne,Armaan Agrawal,Nikos Pagonas,Eugene Wu,Kostis Kaffes,Tianyi Peng,Nairen Cao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Cost-Coupled Gittins (CC-Gittins)，一种多目标扩展的单目标成本感知 Gittins 搜索，用于 LLM Agent 工作流中模型角色分配的帕累托推荐。该方法利用评估成本与部署成本的耦合关系，交替搜索高质量与低部署成本，复用评估结果，仅以约 10% 的穷举评估成本恢复大部分真实帕累托前沿，30% 成本下恢复大部分前沿且假阳性极少。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM Agent 工作流常为不同角色选择不同模型，用户需在任务质量、部署成本（及延迟）间权衡。寻找优秀分配需评估大量候选，评估成本高昂。现有单目标成本感知搜索难以直接扩展至多目标帕累托优化，且忽略了评估成本与部署成本的正相关耦合特性。

Method: CC-Gittins 扩展单目标 Gittins 指数至多目标，维护质量与部署成本的不确定性调整估计。搜索交替进行：一轮针对高质量（固定成本预算），一轮针对低成本（固定质量阈值），每轮评估的候选同时更新两个目标的估计。利用评估成本与部署成本的耦合（部署贵的模型评估也贵），通过 Gittins 类指数动态分配评估预算。每批次后推荐在不确定性调整下非支配的分配。

Result: 在八个包含 2-5 角色、最多 1,681 候选分配的质量-成本矩阵基准上，CC-Gittins 以约 10% 穷举评估成本恢复真实帕累托前沿的显著比例；在 30% 成本下恢复大部分前沿且假阳性极少。引入延迟作为第三目标时同样有效。

Conclusion: CC-Gittins 通过利用评估-部署成本耦合和多目标 Gittins 搜索，高效解决了 LLM Agent 角色分配的多目标优化问题，显著降低了寻找帕累托最优配置的搜索成本，为实际部署提供了实用的权衡推荐框架。

Abstract: LLM agentic workflows increasingly employ different models for specialized roles. Users may prefer different trade-offs between task quality and deployment cost, sometimes also considering latency. Finding good assignments incurs a separate search cost from evaluating multiple candidates. We introduce Cost-Coupled Gittins (CC-Gittins), a multi-objective extension of single-objective cost-aware Gittins search for Pareto recommendation. It exploits the coupling between evaluation and deployment costs: assignments that cost more to deploy also cost more to evaluate. The search alternates between seeking higher quality and lower deployment cost, reusing each evaluation to inform both searches. After each batch, CC-Gittins recommends assignments that are nondominated under uncertainty-adjusted estimates of quality and deployment cost. We evaluate CC-Gittins on eight quality--cost matrices from workflows with two to five roles and up to 1,681 candidate assignments. We also evaluate the method with latency as a third objective. Across the eight benchmarks, CC-Gittins recovers a substantial fraction of the true Pareto frontier at roughly 10% of the exhaustive-evaluation cost, and recovers most of the frontier with few false positives by 30%.

</details>


### [425] [PnP-CF: A Consensus Flow-Matching Solver for General Inverse Problems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26000)
*Dibyanshu Kumar,Magda Gregorova*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了 PnP-CF (Consensus Flow) 框架，将基于流匹配的去噪器与 ADMM 对偶变量更新及时间自适应回拉机制相结合，有效解决了线性和非线性逆问题，特别是包含预训练神经网络前向算子的非线性逆问题，在现有方法失效的情况下依然表现优异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的 Plug-and-Play (PnP) 方法在利用连续时间深度生成模型作为先验求解逆问题时，求解器与生成模型采样器之间的相互作用和共识至关重要，但现有方法在非线性逆问题（特别是神经网络前向算子）上表现不佳甚至失效，亟需一种能促进共识并稳定求解的框架。

Method: PnP-CF 框架包含三个核心组件：(1) 基于流匹配的去噪器作为生成先验；(2) ADMM 风格的对偶变量更新机制；(3) 时间自适应回拉操作，结合随机和确定性分量将中间状态拉回到流概率路径上。这两个特征协同工作以稳定算法并促进求解器与采样器之间的共识。

Result: 实验表明 PnP-CF 在标准线性逆问题上达到与最先进基线相当的重建质量，并能优雅地扩展到非线性逆问题，包括由预训练神经网络实现的前向算子，在这些现有方法产生不满意结果或完全失效的场景中表现出色。

Conclusion: PnP-CF 通过流匹配去噪器、ADMM 对偶更新和时间自适应回拉的结合，有效解决了逆问题求解器与生成模型采样器之间的共识问题，为含神经网络前向算子的非线性逆问题提供了一个鲁棒且高质量的求解框架。

Abstract: Plug-and-Play (PnP) methods using continuous-time deep generative models as learned data distribution priors enable synthesizing high-quality solutions of model-based inverse problems. The quality of the solutions depends critically on the interplay and consensus between the inverse problem solver and the generative model sampler. We revisit a recently introduced flow-based PnP framework, which we refer to as PnP-CF (Consensus Flow), and extend its application to nonlinear inverse problems, including those with learned neural-network forward operators. PnP-CF combines a flow-matching denoiser with (i) ADMM-like dual variable updates and (ii) a time-adaptive pullback onto the intermediate flow probability path that combines a stochastic and a deterministic component. We discuss how these two features stabilize the algorithm and promote consensus, and demonstrate on a set of experiments that PnP-CF not only solves standard linear inverse problems with quality at least comparable to state-of-the-art baselines, but also extends gracefully to nonlinear inverse problems, including forward operators realized by pretrained neural networks, for which existing methods produce unsatisfactory results or fail completely.

</details>


### [426] [Intra-Rubric Reward Divergence: Mitigating Rubric Hacking through Latent Dimension Recovery and Balancing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26685)
*Jianqiang Xia,Han Xu,Dianxi Shi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文发现基于评分标准的强化学习存在“评分标准作弊”问题，即模型为优化总分而牺牲特定子维度质量，提出 FRDA 和 RSDC 两种方法分别缓解维度不平衡和维度缺失，实验表明两方法均能提升响应质量且训练更稳健。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在基于评分标准的强化学习中，模型倾向于通过牺牲某些子维度质量来换取总分提升，导致“评分标准内部奖励发散”；同时存在维度不平衡（策略偏向覆盖度高的维度）和维度缺失（奖励与真实质量存在系统性差距）两大问题，限制了性能与训练鲁棒性。

Method: 提出两种互补方法：(1) 公平竞赛维度聚合（FRDA），让生成在各子维度内部单独竞争，缓解评分标准不平衡；(2) 残差语义维度补全（RSDC），从整体偏好信号中挖掘隐含的评价维度，补全评分标准覆盖。

Result: 在聊天、科学、医疗三个领域的实验中，FRDA 有效缓解了评分标准作弊，带来更稳定的改进；RSDC 优于单一奖励训练和朴素多奖励聚合，生成整体质量更高的响应。

Conclusion: 通过分解评分标准揭示子维度奖励发散现象，并针对维度不平衡和缺失分别设计 FRDA 与 RSDC，显著提升了基于评分标准强化学习的鲁棒性与生成质量，为奖励建模提供了新思路。

Abstract: Rubric hacking limits both performance and training robustness in rubric-based reinforcement learning. By decomposing rubrics into sub-dimensions, we reveal the Intra-Rubric Reward Divergence: as the total rubric score increases, certain sub-dimension scores systematically decrease, suggesting the model sacrifices specific quality aspects to optimize the aggregated objective. From the sub-dimension perspective, we observe two phenomena: (1) dimension imbalance, causing the policy to favor heavily covered dimensions; (2) dimension absence, leading to a systematic gap between rewards and true quality. To mitigate these issues, we propose Fair-Race Dimension Aggregation (FRDA), which has generations compete within each dimension separately to mitigate rubric imbalance, and Residual Semantic Dimension Completion (RSDC), which mines evaluation dimensions implicitly encoded in a holistic preference signal to complete rubric coverage. Experiments in chat, science, and medical domains indicate that FRDA mitigates rubric hacking with more stable improvements, while RSDC outperforms both single-reward training and naive multi-reward aggregation, yielding generally higher-quality responses.

</details>


### [427] [Scenario Generalization and Sector Transfer in Real Surface Irrigation Surrogate Modelling with Tabular Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26005)
*Alessandro Cagiano,M. Aybars Seyhan,Fabiola Gangi,Matteo Zignani,Daniele Masseroni*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究表格代理模型用于灌溉规划中最大水深预测，评估梯度提升树、神经表格模型、AutoML和表格基础模型在同扇区泛化和跨扇区迁移两种制度下的表现。主要发现：在固定8/32同扇区划分下，代理模型表现优异，尤其使用原始空间坐标；跨扇区迁移显著更难，因为目标扇区坐标和几何不同。扇区框架归一化空间坐标可改善结构相似扇区间的迁移，但无法解决跨形状泛化。总体而言，表格代理模型适用于同扇区场景筛选，但鲁棒的跨扇区迁移仍是开放问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 地表灌溉规划需要筛选大量运行条件和空间配置，而高保真浅水方程（SWE）模拟计算成本高昂，亟需更快的代理模型来加速场景筛选。

Method: 构建表格代理模型预测最大水深，输入为无人机获取的田间形态、地形、水文、空间和场景描述符，每行代表一个灌溉场景下的空间网格。评估梯度提升树、神经表格模型、AutoML和表格基础模型（TFMs）在两种制度下的性能：同扇区泛化（观测有限配置后预测同扇区未见场景，采用固定8/32划分）和扇区外迁移（将源扇区知识迁移至未见目标扇区）。

Result: 1) 在固定8/32同扇区划分下，代理模型达到强性能，原始空间坐标尤为有效；2) 扇区外迁移难度大幅增加，因目标扇区坐标系和几何形状不同；3) 扇区框架归一化空间坐标可改善结构相似扇区间的迁移，但无法解决跨形状泛化问题。

Conclusion: 表格代理模型在固定划分下适用于同扇区灌溉场景筛选，但鲁棒的跨扇区迁移仍是未解决的开放问题。

Abstract: Surface irrigation planning requires screening many operating conditions and spatial configurations, while high-fidelity shallow-water-equation (SWE) simulations are expensive. We study tabular surrogate models for predicting maximum water height from drone-derived field morphology, terrain, hydrological, spatial, and scenario descriptors, where each row represents a spatial cell under one irrigation scenario. To assess deployment feasibility, we evaluate gradient-boosted trees, neural tabular models, AutoML, and tabular foundation models (TFMs) under two regimes: same-sector generalization, where a model predicts unseen scenarios after observing a limited set of configurations in the same sector, and sector-out transfer, where knowledge learned from source sectors is transferred to an unseen sector. The main findings are twofold: a) under the evaluated fixed 8/32 same-sector split, surrogates achieve strong performance, especially with raw spatial coordinates; b) sector-out transfer is substantially harder because the target sector has different coordinates and geometry. Sector-frame normalization of spatial coordinates improves transfer across similarly structured sectors, but does not solve cross-shape generalization. Overall, tabular surrogates appear useful for same-sector scenario screening under this fixed split, while robust transfer to unseen sectors remains open.

</details>


### [428] [Parallel Language Models via Variational Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26693)
*Felix Draxler,Robin C. Geyer,Daniel Geyfman,Farrin Marouf Sofian,Justus Will,Philipp Hildebrandt,Giosue Migliorini,Prakhar Srivastava,Gagan Sai Trinadh Duggaraju Peddiraju,Kushagra Pandey,Jorge da Silva Gonçalves,Elijah Tavares,Jan Niklas Groeneveld,Yang Meng,Julia E. Vogt,Stephan Mandt*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出并行语言模型（PLMs），通过引入潜在辅助变量实现单次前向传递中生成相互一致的多个 token，显著降低推理延迟。PLMs 使用变分下界训练，结合自回归损失与并行解码损失。实验表明，PLMs 在 80M 到 3B 参数规模上达到接近自回归模型的预训练损失，推理加速随模型规模按幂律增长。后训练后，1.3B 参数 PLM 在数学、编码和指令遵循基准上匹配或超越同规模自回归模型，推理加速 2.3-5.7 倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归语言模型每次前向传递仅生成一个 token，导致推理延迟高，尤其在模型扩大时更严重。现有并行生成方法（如离散扩散模型）在质量与速度的帕累托前沿上表现不佳。需要一种能在单次前向传递中生成多个一致 token、且训练目标简单、保持自回归级质量的方法。

Method: 提出并行语言模型（PLMs），引入潜在辅助变量路由依赖关系，使模型能在一次前向传递中生成多个相互一致的 token。训练使用变分下界，该目标分解为自回归损失加上并行解码损失，允许从单一训练目标优化并行生成能力。

Result: 预训练阶段，PLMs 在 80M 到 3B 参数规模上达到接近自回归模型的预训练损失，推理加速遵循模型大小的幂律关系。后训练后，1.3B 参数 PLM 在数学、编码和指令遵循基准上匹配或超越同规模自回归模型，推理速度提升 2.3-5.7 倍。PLMs 在质量与速度的帕累托前沿上优于自回归基线和离散扩散基线。

Conclusion: 并行生成可以通过单一训练目标以自回归级质量进行训练。PLMs 证明了并行语言建模在保持模型质量的同时能实现显著推理加速，为大规模语言模型高效部署提供了新范式。代码将开源。

Abstract: Autoregressive language models emit one token per forward pass. This causes high inference latency, in particular as models are scaled up for quality. In this paper, we introduce Parallel Language Models (PLMs), which generate mutually consistent tokens in one forward pass by routing dependencies through latent auxiliary variables. PLMs are trained using a variational bound that reduces to an autoregressive loss plus a parallel decoding loss. Empirically, PLMs are on a faster and better Pareto frontier than autoregressive and discrete diffusion baselines. Pretrained PLMs achieve near-autoregressive pretraining loss on model scales of 80M to 3B parameters, and speedup follows a power law in model size. When post-trained, our 1.3B model matches or exceeds an identically trained autoregressive model on math, coding, and instruction-following benchmarks, speeding up inference $2.3\text{-}5.7\times$. Together, we show that parallel generation can be trained from a single training objective at autoregressive quality. We will make our code available at https://github.com/mandt-lab/plm.

</details>


### [429] [ProtGlycanDock: Towards Accurate Protein-Glycan Docking with Tailored Dataset, Benchmark and Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26009)
*Minghao Xu,Jiaze Song,Jinyu Wang,Wentao Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文构建了首个蛋白-糖基对接基准ProtGlycanDock，系统评估了十种现有方法，并提出两种微调技术（糖基拓扑特征增强输入、糖基能量损失优化构象）结合通用分子结构预测模型，实现了最先进的蛋白-糖基对接性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 蛋白-糖基相互作用主导多种生物学过程，准确的对接预测至关重要，但该领域长期缺乏专门的数据集、基准测试和模型，严重阻碍了研究进展。

Method: 1. 构建ProtGlycanDock基准，包含蛋白泛化和糖基泛化两种设定；2. 评估三类十种方法：基于物理的对接方法、基于机器学习的对接模型、分子结构预测模型；3. 提出两种微调技术注入糖基构象知识：用糖基拓扑特征增强模型输入，用糖基能量损失绑定构象优化。

Result: 基准测试显示AlphaFold 3在现有方法中表现最优；两种提出的微调技术可有效结合，在蛋白-糖基对接任务上达到SOTA性能；分层基准分析和案例研究揭示了当前模型的优势与局限。

Conclusion: ProtGlycanDock填补了蛋白-糖基对接领域的基准空白，提出的微调策略显著提升了通用结构预测模型在该任务上的表现，相关分析为未来模型改进提供了重要洞见。

Abstract: Performing accurate protein-glycan docking is critical to understanding protein-glycan interactions which govern many biological processes. However, this important task is hampered by the lack of tailored datasets, benchmarks and models for protein-glycan docking. To fill this blank, we first curate a standard benchmark ProtGlycanDock for training and evaluating protein-glycan docking models under both protein and glycan generalization settings. On this benchmark, we evaluate ten models in three categories, physics-based docking methods, machine-learning-based docking models and molecular structure prediction models. To obtain more precise binding poses, we further propose two finetuning techniques to inject the knowledge of glycan conformations into a general-purpose molecular structure prediction model. These two techniques respectively augment model inputs with glycan topological features and refine glycan binding pose with a glycan energy loss. Benchmark results show the superiority of AlphaFold 3 among existing methods, and the two proposed finetuning techniques can be well combined to achieve a state-of-the-art model for protein-glycan docking. Also, we perform stratified benchmark analysis and case studies to better understand the strengths and weaknesses of current models, providing insights for future model improvements. We maintain datasets at https://huggingface.co/datasets/ProtGlycanDock/ProtGlycanDock and source codes at https://github.com/kasawa1234/ProtGlycanDock

</details>


### [430] [Copying Under Repetition: From Prefix Matching to Position Hashing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26722)
*Anxin Guo,Tianlong Huang,Chenxiao Yang,Zhiyuan Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究Transformer在长重复字符串复制任务中的表现，发现前沿LLMs在随机文本复制上表现良好，但在长重复字符块上常出现过度或截断错误。作者提出一种基于VO-rotations（注意力值与输出的RoPE风格旋转）的两层Transformer，利用小质数周期编码距离，结合中国剩余定理实现精确距离区分，从而在任意重复下完成复制并正确终止。同时证明了基于序列有限精度softmax累积的Transformer（如NoPE、ALiBi）存在宽度无关的不可能性结果：当相同token运行超过饱和阈值时，logits不再变化，若阈值随N亚线性增长则无法同时完成长全相同复制并正确停止。实验表明基线Transformer在训练范围内仍失败，而训练后的VO模型能泛化至约5005长度并达到近乎完美的准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决前沿大语言模型在处理长重复字符串时出现的复制过度或截断错误，探究Transformer在复制任务中的理论极限，并设计一种能在任意重复下精确复制并正确终止的架构。

Method: 提出两层Transformer，采用O(log log N)位精度和O(log N / log log N)宽度，引入VO-rotations（注意力值与输出的旋转位置编码），使用小质数周期对分隔符锚点的距离进行模编码，利用中国剩余定理将多个周期性编码联合区分所有所需距离，设计单一检索规则选择下一个源token或结束标记。同时理论分析基于序列有限精度softmax累积的Transformer（仅含加性注意力偏置且最终变为常数）的不可能性结果。

Result: 理论上证明VO-rotations模型能复制任意长度至设计地平线N的字符串并在任意重复下正确终止；证明基于有限精度softmax累积的Transformer存在宽度无关的不可能性：若饱和阈值随N亚线性增长，则无法同时完成长全相同复制并正确停止。合成实验显示基线Transformer在训练范围内仍无法处理长重复字符串，而训练后的VO模型泛化至约5005长度（所选质数周期乘积）并达到近乎完美的准确率。

Conclusion: VO-rotations机制通过周期性模编码距离并结合中国剩余定理，有效解决了长重复字符串复制中的定位与终止难题，展示了理论上的可行性与实验上的优越泛化能力。同时揭示了基于加性注意力偏置且软饱和的Transformer架构在长重复复制任务上的根本局限性，解释了前沿LLMs类似的终止错误现象。

Abstract: Frontier LLMs can copy random text almost flawlessly, yet they often overrun or truncate long blocks of repeated characters. In repeated strings, matching local content no longer reliably identifies where copying should continue or when it should stop. Nevertheless, we show that a two-layer transformer with $O(\log\log N)$-bit precision and $O(\log N/\log\log N)$ width can copy every string up to a chosen design horizon $N$ and terminate correctly under arbitrary repetition. We use RoPE-style rotations of attention values and outputs (VO-rotations) with small prime periods to encode distances from delimiter anchors modulo those primes. By the Chinese Remainder Theorem, these periodic encodings jointly distinguish all required distances, allowing one retrieval rule to select either the next source token or the end marker. In contrast, we prove a width-independent impossibility result for copying under sequential finite-precision softmax accumulation. It applies to transformers whose only positional input is an additive attention bias that eventually becomes constant, including NoPE and a recursive implementation of ALiBi. Once an identical-token run exceeds the resulting saturation threshold, further repetitions leave the logits unchanged. If this threshold grows sublinearly with $N$, these models cannot both complete a long all-identical copy and stop correctly, a pattern resembling the termination errors of frontier LLMs. In synthetic copying experiments, baseline transformer models fail on long repeated strings even within the training range. Trained VO models, by contrast, generalize beyond the training lengths with near-perfect accuracy up to length $\approx 5005$, the selected primes' period product.

</details>


### [431] [Truncate or Not? A Scaling Study of Looped Transformers with Truncated Backpropagation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26030)
*Xuyuan Xiong,Siyu Chen,Zihan Shao,Yue Su,Weiyang Jin,Ping Luo,Zhuoran Yang,Xihui Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 循环Transformer通过共享层增加深度而不增加参数，使用BPTT训练。研究通过约600次实验联合改变模型大小、训练token数、前向/后向循环次数，拟合统一缩放定律。结果显示全BPTT优于截断BPTT，最优设置为两个完整循环，实验验证其以少27%非嵌入参数和仅多8%训练计算量超越非循环最优模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究循环Transformer中截断BPTT节省计算但可能削弱循环优势的权衡，系统探究模型规模、训练token、循环次数对性能的影响，建立统一缩放定律指导最优配置。

Method: 开展近600次训练实验，联合变化模型大小、训练token数、前向和后向循环次数，拟合统一缩放定律，通过有效参数量捕捉循环和截断效应，分析不同计算预算下的最优超参数配置。

Result: 缩放定律显示全BPTT在联合优化前向/后向循环时优于截断；同等计算量下，较少循环的全BPTT优于截断设置；固定模型大小时，最优循环数和训练token随计算量增长；模型大小也可变时，两个完整循环为最佳循环设置。实验验证：两循环全BPTT以少27%非嵌入参数、仅多8%训练计算量实现更低损失。

Conclusion: 循环Transformer配合全BPTT可显著提升参数效率，最优策略为使用两个完整循环，这在参数量和计算量权衡上优于标准Transformer，为大模型训练提供了更高效的架构选择。

Abstract: Looped transformers reuse a shared block of layers to increase computational depth without increasing the number of trainable parameters. They are trained with backpropagation through time (BPTT). To save training compute, BPTT is often truncated to the last few loops, although this may weaken the benefit of looping. To study this tradeoff systematically, we jointly vary model size, training tokens, and forward and backward loop counts across nearly 600 training runs and fit a unified scaling law that captures the effects of looping and truncation through effective parameters. Despite the training-compute savings of truncation, our fitted law favors full BPTT when forward and backward loop counts are jointly optimized. In matched-compute runs, full BPTT through fewer loops consistently outperforms truncated settings of the same compute. The law further shows that at fixed model size, the compute-optimal loop count and training-token budget both grow with compute. When model size is also free, the law identifies two fully trained loops as the best looped setting. Experimentally, this setting achieves lower loss than the compute-optimal non-looped model with about 27% fewer non-embedding parameters and only 8% more training compute.

</details>


### [432] [recAMPLIFY: Large-Scale Pretraining of Recursive Protein Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26747)
*Saurav Jha,Qianli Liao,Robert Vernon,Sarath Chandar,Quentin Fournier*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 recAMPLIFY，一种基于递归预训练的蛋白质语言模型，通过权重共享的 Transformer 核心在可调循环次数中迭代优化残基级隐藏状态。在参数量减少 56% 的情况下，recAMPLIFY 超越同规模训练的 AMPLIFY-350M。进一步引入 Gated Mixture Recurrence (GMR)，利用学习到的残差门控混合递归中访问的各层隐藏状态，统一自适应停止与门控机制，将期望层深降低达 37%。机制分析表明残差门控控制递归稳定性，停止深度与生物学性质相关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有蛋白质语言模型主要依赖扩大模型规模和数据量，成本高且易记忆。测试时缩放虽为互补路径，但为自回归 LLM 设计的方法难以直接迁移到掩码编码器：缺乏生成循环，氨基酸也不具备推理语言的表达能力。因此需要针对掩码蛋白语言模型设计适配的测试时计算扩展机制。

Method: 1. 递归预训练：将权重共享的 Transformer 核心应用于掩码 pLM，在可变循环次数中迭代细化残基对齐的隐藏状态，实例化为 recAMPLIFY（155M 唯一参数，2T tokens 训练）。2. Gated Mixture Recurrence (GMR)：为每个蛋白从递归访问的隐藏状态序列中学习概率加权混合，引入标量、低秩或逐维度的残差门控，控制每轮更新的接纳程度，将停止与门控统一为单一自适应计算目标，PonderNet 风格停机为无门控特例。

Result: recAMPLIFY 在参数减少 56% 情况下，提升 CASP 接触预测恢复率及四项监督任务中三项性能，折叠准确率提高 22.5%。叠加 GMR 后，期望层深最多降低 37%，精度权衡随任务而异。机制分析显示残差门控调控训练深度外的递归稳定性，停止深度追踪生物学性质。

Conclusion: 递归预训练与门控混合机制为掩码蛋白语言模型提供了高效的测试时计算扩展范式，在大幅降低参数量与计算深度的同时保持甚至提升性能，且自适应停止深度编码了生物学相关信息，为蛋白质表征学习提供了新的可解释性视角。

Abstract: Protein language models (pLMs) are powerful tools for protein annotation and mutation-effect prediction, but progress has largely depended on scaling model size and data, making them expensive and prone to memorization. Test-time scaling offers a complementary path, but methods developed for autoregressive LLMs do not transfer directly: masked encoders lack a generation loop, and amino acids do not verbalize in a reasoning language. Instead, we adapt recursive pretraining to masked pLMs, where a weight-tied Transformer core refines residue-aligned hidden states over an adjustable number of cycles. We instantiate this recipe as recAMPLIFY, a pLM with 155M unique parameters trained on the same 2T tokens as AMPLIFY-350M. Despite 56% fewer parameters, it improves CASP contact recovery and three out of four supervised tasks, notably raising fold accuracy by 22.5%. Because optimal depth for recAMPLIFY varies across tasks and assays, we then introduce Gated Mixture Recurrence (GMR), a framework that decodes each protein from a probability-weighted mixture of hidden states visited during recursion. GMR employs a learned residual gate at scalar, low-rank, or per-dimension resolution to control how much of each cycle's proposed update is accepted into the state. This unifies halting and gating into a single adaptive computation objective while recovering PonderNet-style halting as a special case without gates. Layered on top of recAMPLIFY, GMR further reduces expected layer depth by up to 37%, although the accuracy trade-off varies by task. Mechanistic analyses show that residual gating controls recurrence stability beyond the trained depth and that halt depth tracks biological properties.

</details>


### [433] [FinHopper: A Progressive Multi-Hop Benchmark for Complex Financial Agents with Step-wise Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26036)
*Yuxuan Wu,Miaopei Lin,Qiufang Ying,Lin Dan,Hao Zhao,Qirui Liu,Yuteng Shen,Shaohui Wu,Weihong Luo,Xiku Du,Xing Tang,Hao Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FinHopper 是一个面向复杂金融智能体的多跳检索基准，覆盖 1-6 跳推理深度，提供金标准中间答案以支持过程级评估。实验表明公开搜索工具虽必要但不充分，模型随跳数增加性能急剧下降，最佳模型仍远逊于人类专家，过程感知评分揭示了仅看最终答案隐藏的部分推理进展。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有通用多跳问答基准未能捕捉金融领域特有的严格答案条件依赖：每个中间答案都是精确的类型化约束（实体、日期、事件、数值指标），微小错误会级联导致错误检索轨迹。因此需要专门针对金融多跳推理的基准与评估体系。

Method: 设计基于状态转移的合成框架，将验证过的原子金融问答模式组合成保持依赖关系的链条；随后进行针对性合成内验证、模型集成检查及金融专家公开搜索验证，构建 FinHopper 基准。实验评估 20 种 LLM-Agent 配置，对比最终答案与过程级指标。

Result: 公开搜索工具虽必要但不充分；随跳数增加性能急剧下降；最佳模型仍远低于人类专家水平；过程感知评分揭示了仅评估最终答案会掩盖的部分推理进展。

Conclusion: FinHopper 为金融多跳推理提供了可控深度、过程级可评估的基准，暴露了当前 LLM-Agent 在复杂金融检索中的脆弱性，强调过程级监督与错误级联缓解的重要性。

Abstract: Financial agents are expected to answer factual investment queries through open search, but financial multi-hop retrieval differs from general multi-hop QA in a crucial way: each intermediate answer is an exact typed constraint, such as an entity, date, event, or numerical indicator, that determines the next query. This strict answer-conditioned dependency makes small intermediate errors cascade into plausible but wrong search trajectories. We introduce FinHopper, a benchmark for complex financial agents with controlled reasoning depth from 1 to 6 hops, covering stocks, funds, and macroeconomic facts, with gold intermediate answers for process-level evaluation. To construct FinHopper at scale, we design a state-transition-based synthesis framework that composes verified atomic financial QA patterns into dependency-preserving chains, followed by targeted in-synthesis verification, model-ensemble checking, and public-search validation by financial experts. Experiments with 20 LLM-agent configurations show that public search tools are necessary but insufficient: performance drops sharply as hop depth increases, the best model remains far below human experts, and process-aware scoring reveals partial reasoning progress hidden by final-answer-only evaluation. The benchmark is available at https://github.com/justajustin/FinHopper/.

</details>


### [434] [HarnessPro: Recursive Harness Self-Improvement with Pareto Optimization for Performance-Cost Trade-offs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26770)
*Zhuoshi Pan,ZhiYuan Feng,Yukuo Cen,Honglin Lin,Junru Lu,Zhongxia Chen,Shuo Yang,H. Vicky Zhao,Jie Tang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: HarnessPro是一种无标签的马甲演化方法，通过LLM生成的测试评估候选马甲，利用专门代理诊断执行轨迹并按不同性能-成本优先级规划更新，采用归一化加权平方距离选择提供lite/medium/heavy三种模式，在多个基准上实现性能提升与成本降低的双重收益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的递归自我改进（RSI）方法虽能提升马甲性能，但往往伴随更高的执行成本，缺乏在不同部署预算下灵活权衡性能与成本的机制。

Method: HarnessPro采用无标签评估：用LLM生成的测试替代真实标签评估候选马甲；专门代理诊断执行轨迹，按性能优先、成本优先、平衡三种优先级规划更新并实现为候选马甲；引入归一化加权平方距离选择机制，输出cost-focused (lite)、balanced (medium)、performance-focused (heavy)三种马甲供不同预算部署；选中的马甲进入下一轮迭代，利用执行反馈进一步优化。

Result: 在Terminal-Bench 2、SWE-Bench Pro、ProgramBench三个基准上，使用GPT-5.5+Codex时，HarnessPro heavy模式相对RHO平均通过率提升2.0个百分点，单任务成本平均降低26.1%；使用GLM-5.2+Claude Code时优势依然成立。

Conclusion: HarnessPro通过无标签评估与多目标选择机制，成功在无需真实标签的情况下实现马甲的性能与成本双优化，为不同部署预算提供了可选的马甲配置，具有良好的泛化性和实用价值。

Abstract: Harness development plays a crucial role in building capable AI agents. Recent approaches improve harnesses through recursive self-improvement (RSI), but their performance gains often come with higher execution costs. We introduce HarnessPro, a label-free method for evolving harnesses to improve task performance while reducing execution cost. In this setting, candidate harnesses are evaluated using LLM-generated tests without access to ground-truth solutions or official tests. Specialized agents diagnose execution trajectories, plan updates with different performance-cost priorities, and implement them as candidate harnesses. Rather than returning a single harness, HarnessPro uses normalized weighted squared-distance selection to provide cost-focused (lite), balanced (medium), and performance-focused (heavy) harnesses for different deployment budgets. Selected harnesses enter the next iteration, where execution feedback guides further updates. Our experiments cover Terminal-Bench 2, SWE-Bench Pro, and ProgramBench, using GPT-5.5 with Codex and GLM-5.2 with Claude Code. Across these benchmarks using GPT-5.5 with Codex, the heavy mode of HarnessPro achieves an average pass-rate gain of 2.0 percentage points and an average per-task cost reduction of 26.1% relative to RHO. This advantage also holds when using GLM-5.2 with Claude Code. Code is available at https://github.com/pzs19/HarnessPro

</details>


### [435] [Provable Adversarial Detection: Prime Quantization meets Gromov--Wasserstein](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26102)
*Manohar Kaul,Sadbhavana Babar,Aditya Ramesh,Aditya Saibewar,Fumiyoshi Kasahara,Maki Inui,Hiroaki Kurihara*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于几何视角的对抗样本检测方法，构建两个互补度量空间（CNN嵌入空间Z和素数量化空间P），利用两空间间的几何差异实现可证明的对抗检测，并建立了首个严格的分离理论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有对抗检测方法依赖启发式规则，缺乏理论保证；旨在从几何角度解决何时可证明检测对抗扰动的根本问题。

Method: 构建两个互补度量空间：标准CNN嵌入空间Z（对抗样本表现显著位移）和新型素数量化空间P（通过数论离散化吸收微小扰动，保持判别性），利用跨空间几何差异检测对抗样本，并建立像素级吸收界、邻域直径集中、Gromov-Wasserstein分离定理及风险控制等理论保证。

Result: 理论上证明对抗样本在两空间间产生不可避免的几何不一致性；实验验证理论预测，在多种攻击类型和模型家族上取得一致强劲的检测性能。

Conclusion: 该框架为对抗检测提供了首个严格分离理论，结合几何不一致性与数论量化，实现了可证明的检测保证和实际高性能。

Abstract: Adversarial vulnerability persists across modern vision architectures from CNNs to vision language models (VLMs), yet existing detection methods rely on heuristics without theoretical guarantees. We address the fundamental question of when adversarial perturbations can be provably detected from a geometric perspective. Our key insight is that adversarial perturbations cannot simultaneously preserve geometric structure across spaces with fundamentally different properties. Accordingly, we construct two such complementary metric spaces. First, we use a standard CNN embedding space $Z$, where adversarial samples exhibit significant displacement patterns. Second, we build a novel prime-quantized space $P$, that absorbs small perturbations through number-theoretic discretization, resulting in minimal displacement, while preserving discriminability. We then leverage the geometric discrepancies across spaces $Z$ and $P$ to detect adversarial samples. To the best of our knowledge, we establish the first rigorous separation theory for adversarial detection, proving that adversarial samples create unavoidable geometric inconsistencies across both spaces. Our framework provides theoretical guarantees including pixel-level absorption bounds, neighborhood diameter concentration, Gromov-Wasserstein (GW) separation theorems, and practical risk control. Extensive experiments validate our theoretical predictions and achieve consistently strong detection performance across a wide range of attack types and model families.

</details>


### [436] [Learning from a Bandit Learner](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26103)
*Michela Petriconi,Nicolas Menet,Claire Vernade*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出了一种逆向强盗方法，推断演示者的主观信念（内部次优间隙估计）而非真实奖励参数，针对无悔随机策略（如Thompson采样）实现逐步反演，揭示了稳定性-覆盖率权衡，给出可靠反演条件及误差保证，实验验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典逆向强盗方法旨在恢复真实奖励参数，但实际中演示者往往基于主观信念决策；本文旨在从演示者的手臂选择分布中直接推断其内部次优间隙估计，解决策略收敛导致的反演不稳定与信息轮数不足的权衡问题。

Method: 针对采用随机策略（如Thompson采样）的无悔演示者，刻画了一类可逐步反演的算法族，利用手臂选择分布直接恢复间隙估计；理论分析建立了反演可靠的条件（如策略收敛速度、概率质量集中度），并给出估计误差的理论保证。

Result: 理论上确立了稳定性-覆盖率权衡：演示者概率质量集中于单一手臂时反演病态化，信息轮数取决于策略收敛速率；在特定条件下反演可靠，并给出误差界。模拟实验验证了分析，展示了条件如何影响间隙恢复效果。

Conclusion: 该工作为逆向强盗学习提供了新视角——从观测策略推断主观信念而非真实奖励，揭示了反演的固有权衡与可行条件，为实际应用中基于演示者行为的奖励推断提供了理论指导。

Abstract: Classical inverse bandit methods typically aim to recover true reward parameters. In contrast, we infer a demonstrator's subjective beliefs, specifically its internal estimates of suboptimality gaps. We consider no-regret demonstrators that follow randomized policies, such as Thompson sampling, and characterize a family of algorithms for which per-step inversion is possible. This enables gap estimates to be recovered directly from the arm-selection distribution. Our analysis identifies an inherent stability-coverage trade-off: inversion becomes ill-conditioned as the demonstrator concentrates its probability mass on a single arm, while the number of informative rounds depends on the rate at which its policy converges. We establish conditions under which inversion is reliable and provide theoretical guarantees on the resulting estimation error. Experiments on simulated data support the analysis and illustrate how these conditions affect gap recovery in practice.

</details>


### [437] [WeAct: Dynamic Weight Switching as Agent Actions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26847)
*Rui Shi,Xunjian Yin,Jiacheng Sang,Zichuan Liu,Shuyan Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: WeAct提出一种基于LoRA适配器的动态能力组合方法，将适配器选择纳入智能体动作空间，实现长时程任务中的按需能力调用，避免灾难性遗忘，在多个基准上超越全微调和静态适配器合并方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时程智能体需从交织轨迹中学习多样化能力，共享参数更新易导致灾难性遗忘；传统联合训练和静态适配器合并固定参数配置，无法适应不同阶段的能力需求。

Method: WeAct在冻结骨干网络上训练独立的能力专用LoRA适配器，将适配器选择加入智能体动作空间，利用模型原生工具调用接口实现共享上下文中的按需能力组合。

Result: 在八个深度研究基准上，Qwen3-32B配合WeAct平均准确率比全微调提升6.2%（计算量更少），比最强静态LoRA合并提升27.5%；支持模块化持续适应，新增代码计算适配器和更新写作适配器均不影响骨干及其他适配器。

Conclusion: WeAct通过动态适配器选择解决长时程智能体的灾难性遗忘和能力组合问题，实现高效、模块化的持续学习，显著提升性能。

Abstract: Long-horizon agents must learn heterogeneous capabilities from interleaved trajectories. Updating shared parameters to learn new capabilities can degrade previously acquired ones, resulting in catastrophic forgetting. As a trajectory unfolds, different stages may require different capabilities, yet conventional joint training and static adapter merging maintain a fixed parameter configuration throughout execution. We introduce WeAct (Weight-level Internal Actions), which trains independent capability-specific LoRA adapters over a frozen backbone and adds adapter selection to the agent's action space. These internal actions use the model's native tool-calling interface for on-demand capability composition in a shared context. Across eight deep-research benchmarks, Qwen3-32B with WeAct improves average accuracy by 6.2% relative to full fine-tuning counterparts despite using less compute, and by 27.5% relative to the strongest static LoRA-merging method. WeAct also supports modular continual adaptation, by adding a new code computation adapter to expand the agent's capabilities and updating the existing writing adapter to improve report quality. Both updates leave the backbone and other adapters unchanged, supporting modular continual adaptation in agents.

</details>


### [438] [Declarative Explanations for Graph Neural Networks: A Demonstration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26104)
*Cibo Yu,Haitong Tang,Yinghui Wu,Arijit Khan,Tingting Zhu,Tingyang Chen,Xiangyu Ke*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出了SliceGXQ，一个用于大规模图上GNN逐层解释的端到端声明式交互式查询与探索系统，包含可视化界面、类SPARQL解析器和集成执行可视化工作流，支持模型调试、误分类诊断及欺诈检测分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GNN虽在图分析任务中有效，但其“黑盒”特性导致逐层行为难以理解，且难以应用于大规模图。现有工具缺乏交互式、声明式的逐层解释查询能力，阻碍了模型调试与大规模图解释。

Method: 构建SliceGXQ系统：(1) 交互式图形用户界面，支持数据集、模型与解释配置；(2) 轻量级类SPARQL解析器，允许用户指定目标节点、层、解释模式与约束；(3) 集成执行与可视化工作流，底层调用SliceGX解释引擎，实现端到端的逐层解释查询与探索。

Result: 演示了用户如何诊断误分类节点、识别关键层与影响消息、执行针对性模型调试，并完成大规模图解释与欺诈检测分析。系统源码与演示视频已开源。

Conclusion: SliceGXQ填补了大规模图上GNN逐层解释的交互式查询空白，通过声明式语言与可视化工作流降低了解释分析门槛，为模型调试与实际业务（如欺诈检测）提供了实用工具。

Abstract: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have proven effective for graph analytical tasks, yet their "black-box" nature complicates the understanding of their layer-wise behavior and hinders their application to large graphs. We demonstrate SliceGXQ, an end-to-end declarative and interactive system for querying and exploring layer-wise explanations for GNNs over large-scale graphs. In particular, SliceGXQ provides (1) an interactive graphical user interface for dataset, model, and explanation configuration; (2) a lightweight SPARQL-like parser that allows users to specify target nodes, layers, explanation modes, and constraints; and (3) an integrated execution and visualization workflow that invokes SliceGX as its underlying explanation engine. We demonstrate how users can diagnose a misclassified node, identify problematic layers and influential messages, and perform targeted model debugging, together with large-scale graph interpretation and fraud-detection analysis. Our demonstration video and source code are available at https://github.com/jinzhaoqet/SliceGXQ.

</details>


### [439] [From Retrieval to Recognition:Knowledge-Enhanced Post-training of Time Series Foundation Models for Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26114)
*Zhen Liu,Yucheng Wang,Yingpeng Du,Tianjun Wei,Qianli Ma,Min Wu,Jie Zhang,Zhu Sun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出 Retrieval-to-Recognition (R2R) 后训练范式，通过检索增强方式将显式知识与预训练时间序列基础模型（TSFM）的隐式参数嵌入融合，显著提升下游分类任务性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 TSFM 后训练主要依赖隐式参数微调，导致任务相关信息与大量无关知识在海量参数空间中纠缠，难以精准激活下游分类所需的有用知识。

Method: R2R 引入解耦查询编码器提取判别性模式，从构建的知识库中检索实例级数值知识，并将检索到的显式知识与 TSFM 的隐式参数嵌入融合，实现参数层面和特征层面的联合知识迁移。

Result: 在 158 个时间序列数据集上的实验表明，R2R 持续提升最先进 TSFM 的分类性能；消融实验和知识增强研究进一步验证了框架的有效性。

Conclusion: R2R 作为即插即用的后训练范式，通过显式知识检索与隐式参数融合，使 TSFM 能更高效地回忆预训练阶段学到的任务相关模式，为时间序列分类迁移提供了新的解决思路。

Abstract: Time series foundation models (TSFMs) have achieved notable progress in classification tasks through large-scale pretraining. However, their post-training practice mainly focuses on implicit parameter fine-tuning, where task-relevant information is entangled with abundant irrelevant knowledge in vast parameter spaces. This may hinder TSFMs from precisely activating useful knowledge for downstream classification. To this end, we propose Retrieval-to-Recognition (R2R), a plug-and-play post-training paradigm that adapts pretrained TSFMs to time series classification. Rather than pretraining a new foundation model, R2R improves how existing TSFMs are post-trained: it introduces a decoupled query encoder to extract discriminative patterns and retrieve instance-level numerical knowledge from a constructed knowledge base. The retrieved explicit knowledge is then fused with the TSFM's implicit parametric embeddings, enabling joint knowledge transfer at both the parameter and feature levels. In this way, R2R allows TSFMs to recall task-relevant patterns learned during pretraining, improving the efficiency of knowledge utilization in downstream classification transfer. Experiments on 158 time series datasets show that R2R consistently improves the classification performance of state-of-the-art TSFMs. Ablation and knowledge-enhanced studies further validate the effectiveness of the proposed framework.

</details>


### [440] [Variance-Aware Non-Stationary Bandits:All-Budget Regret Bounds and Adaptation Costs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26116)
*Xiaojin Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文研究非平稳多臂老虎机中方差-变异权衡，给出在方差预算Q和变异预算B下的极小化极大动态遗憾界：min{T, A + √(AQ) + (AQBT)^{1/3} + √(AT) min{B, √B}}（对数因子内）。通过校准阶段、观测裁剪和原始均值参考控制残差，平衡裁剪偏差与监控成本；下界用固定非自适应构造匹配。还量化了适应成本：在确定性单改进族上，静态遗憾预算存在匹配的最坏情况变化遗憾前沿，暗示单策略竞争所有预算确定性Oracle速率时有Ω((T/A)^{1/4})损失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工作虽知低奖励方差降低估计成本，但未充分刻画方差与均值变异预算如何共同决定非平稳环境下的根本极限。需精细化方差-变异权衡，给出同时依赖Q（方差预算）和B（变异预算）的紧致极小化极大动态遗憾界，并理解自适应策略面对未知预算时的固有代价。

Method: 1. 安全校准阶段：对小预算识别包含所有存活臂未来均值的公共区间。2. 观测裁剪：将观测裁剪到更宽区间，降低重启先前混合静态遗憾算法的成本。3. 原始均值分析参考：用原始均值（而非裁剪均值）作为分析基准，控制残差而不计入裁剪均值的变异。4. 平衡裁剪偏差与监控成本，封闭小预算噪声区间。5. 下界构造：固定非自适应实例族匹配上界。6. 适应成本分析：在确定性单改进族上推导静态遗憾预算与变化遗憾的最坏前沿。

Result: 1. 极小化极大期望动态遗憾界：min{T, A + √(AQ) + (AQBT)^{1/3} + √(AT) min{B, √B}}，对数因子内紧致。2. 确定性边界Q=0无对数因子精确刻画。3. 固定非自适应构造给出匹配下界。4. 适应成本：在单改进族上，静态遗憾预算存在匹配的最坏变化遗憾前沿，包含有限改进脉冲；单策略竞争所有预算确定性Oracle速率导致Ω((T/A)^{1/4})遗憾损失。5. 无预算低噪声调度问题仍独立待解。

Conclusion: 论文建立了非平稳多臂老虎机中方差预算Q与变异预算B联合决定的极小化极大动态遗憾紧致表征，揭示了方差-变异权衡的精细结构。提出的校准-裁剪-原始均值参考框架有效平衡了估计、监控与偏差成本。适应性分析表明，不知预算时单一策略无法同时达到所有确定性Oracle速率，存在根本的Ω((T/A)^{1/4})适应损失。预算无关的低噪声调度仍为开放问题。

Abstract: Low reward variance reduces estimation cost, but does not eliminate monitoring of arms that may improve while unobserved. We refine the variance--variation tradeoff and characterize how both costs depend on supplied variance and variation budgets in bounded, non-stationary multi-armed bandits. Let $A$ be the number of arms, $T$ the horizon, $B$ a bound on consecutive mean variation excluding the initial vector, and $Q$ a bound on the sum of the largest per-round reward variances. For every admissible pair $Q,B$, the minimax expected dynamic regret is, within a single logarithmic factor, \[
  \min\{T,\;A+\sqrt{AQ}+(AQBT)^{1/3}
  +\sqrt{AT}\min\{B,\sqrt B\}\}. \] The deterministic boundary $Q=0$ is characterized without logarithms. For small positive budgets, a safe calibration phase identifies a common interval containing all future means of surviving arms. Clipping observations to a wider interval reduces the cost of restarting a prior hybrid static-regret algorithm; an original-mean analytical reference controls its residuals without charging the variation of clipped means. Balancing clipping bias and monitoring closes the small-budget noisy regime. Fixed oblivious constructions give the matching lower bound. We also quantify adaptation costs: on a disclosed deterministic one-improvement family, a stationary-regret budget has a matching worst-case change-regret frontier, including a finite improvement pulse. This implies an $Ω((T/A)^{1/4})$ loss when one policy competes with all supplied-budget deterministic oracle rates. The budget-free low-noise scheduling problem remains separate.

</details>


### [441] [Optimal Multi-Kernel Combination for Online Multi-Label Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26123)
*Tingting Zhai,Wei Liu,Renjian Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种新颖的在线多核组合方法用于大规模多标签分类，解决了单核方法依赖预选核和核选择方法无法充分利用多核互补信息的问题。通过设计高效鲁棒的在线单核多标签方法，并将最优凸组合学习形式化为结构风险最小化问题，开发改进的交替优化过程，实现核分类器与组合系数的解耦更新，理论证明渐近收敛到最优固定凸组合，实验在11个数据集和7个指标上展现整体优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流式场景下的多标签分类面临数据分布未知的挑战。现有在线核方法依赖单一预选核，易陷入次优选择；虽OKS-OMC实现数据驱动核选择，但未能充分利用多核互补信息且遭遇核化诅咒。需一种能融合多核优势、避免核化开销且具备理论保证的在线多核学习方法。

Method: 1) 设计高效鲁棒的在线单核多标签分类器；2) 将多核分类器的最优凸组合学习形式化为结构风险最小化问题；3) 开发改进的交替优化：组合系数通过直接最小化目标函数更新，各核分类器通过最小化代理上界更新；4) 该过程解耦核分类器与组合系数学习，支持单核方法独立并行更新，加速收敛。

Result: 理论证明算法渐近收敛到事后视角下最优固定单核模型的最优固定凸组合。消融实验证实各组件优于OKS-OMC对应组件。在11个数据集和7个评价指标上的综合评估显示，该方法在整体性能上超越现有在线多标签分类方法。

Conclusion: 提出的多核组合方法通过结构风险最小化框架和交替优化机制，有效融合多核互补信息，规避核化计算瓶颈，具备坚实理论收敛保证与显著实证优势，为大规模流式多标签分类提供了更优解决方案。

Abstract: Multi-label classification is particularly challenging in streaming scenarios, where data arrives sequentially. Online kernel methods offer a promising solution. However, prevailing methods rely on a single preselected kernel, making them prone to suboptimal choices since the global data distribution is unknown in advance in online settings. Although the recent method, Online Kernel Selection for Online Multi-label Classification (OKS-OMC), enables data-driven kernel selection, it fails to fully harness the complementary information from multiple kernels and encounters the curse of kernelization. To address these limitations, this paper introduces a novel online multi-kernel combination method for large-scale multi-label classification. First, an efficient and robust online single-kernel multi-label method is designed. Second, learning an optimal convex combination of multiple multi-label kernel classifiers is formalized as a structural risk minimization problem. An improved alternating optimization procedure is developed, in which the combination coefficients are updated by directly minimizing the objective function, while each kernel classifier is updated by minimizing a surrogate upper bound. This procedure decouples the learning of kernel classifiers from combination coefficients, allowing independent classifier updates via our single-kernel method and accelerating convergence to high-quality solutions. Our multi-kernel method is proven to asymptotically converge to the optimal fixed convex combination of the best fixed single-kernel models chosen in hindsight. Ablation studies confirm that our method's components outperform their counterparts in OKS-OMC. Comprehensive evaluations across 11 datasets and seven metrics demonstrate our method's overall superiority over existing online multi-label methods.

</details>


### [442] [Nash-MOPD: Optimizing Task Trade-offs in Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26124)
*Siyuan Gan,Bo Yang,Linjian Meng,Boyan Wang,Xiaolong Qi,Jing Huo,Yang Gao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Nash-MOPD，一种基于局部极大极小博弈的自适应领域调度器，用于多教师在线策略蒸馏（MOPD）。它利用现有的反向 KL 散度统计量，在局部模型下最大化最小的预测比例下降，从而将更多提示词分配给需要更多样本才能获得可比改进的领域。实验表明，Nash-MOPD 在步数 100 时即超越两个基线在数学和代码任务上的最终检查点分数，并在九项指标中有八项领先，六项数学和代码准确率指标均为最佳或并列最佳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多教师在线策略蒸馏（MOPD）需在有限的优化步数和采样预算下融合多个领域专家教师。固定采样比例无法适应学习进度；D³-MOPD 虽然利用反向 KL 散度及其近期下降幅度动态调整比例，但倾向于分配更多资源给已快速改进的领域，导致改进较慢的领域获得样本不足。需要一种能自适应响应学习进度、保障慢速改进领域获得足够训练的调度策略，且不增加额外教师查询或采样开销。

Method: 提出 Nash-MOPD：构建一个局部极大极小博弈，利用现有的教师-学生反向 KL 散度统计量作为局部模型。博弈的均衡策略最大化最小的预测比例下降（即最坏情况的相对改进），从而自动将更多提示词分配给需要更多样本才能实现同等比例改进的领域。该调度器仅使用已有统计量，无需额外教师查询或采样。

Result: 在 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B 上，步数 100 时 Nash-MOPD 的数学和代码检查点分数均超过 Fixed 和 D³-MOPD 的最终分数；在 Qwen3-8B-Base 上达到 Fixed 的最终水平。在报告的九项指标中有八项领先，且在所有六项数学和代码准确率指标上均为最佳或并列最佳。

Conclusion: Nash-MOPD 通过局部极大极小博弈实现自适应领域采样分配，有效解决了固定比例僵化和 D³-MOPD 偏向快速改进领域的问题。它能动态响应学习进度，保障慢速改进领域获得足够训练，且不增加额外开销，在数学和代码推理任务上显著优于现有基线。

Abstract: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) aggregates the capabilities of multiple domain-expert teachers into a single student model. However, all domains in MOPD share the student's finite budget of optimization steps and rollouts. Fixed uses constant domain sampling ratios based on corpus sizes; by contrast, D$^3$-MOPD adjusts the ratios using the teacher-student reverse-KL divergence and its recent decrease. However, favoring large recent decreases can direct more training toward domains that already improve quickly, while domains that improve more slowly may receive too few examples. To address inflexible allocation and the risk of giving insufficient training to domains that improve more slowly, we propose Nash-MOPD, an adaptive domain scheduler based on a local minimax game using existing reverse-KL statistics. The equilibrium maximizes the smallest predicted proportional reduction under the local model and gives more prompts to domains that need more examples for comparable improvement. Consequently, Nash-MOPD responds to changing learning progress and supports domains that improve more slowly without extra teacher queries or rollouts. At step 100, Nash-MOPD exceeds both baselines' final mathematics and code checkpoint scores on DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B and reaches Fixed's on Qwen3-8B-Base. Furthermore, it leads eight of nine reported metrics and is best or tied best on all six mathematics and code accuracy metrics, respectively.

</details>


### [443] [Dynamical Batching: How Class-Cycling Training Shapes the Internal Structure of Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26156)
*Nicolás Ratier-Werbin,Samuel Lozano,Miguel Ruiz-García*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究发现周期性改变训练批次的类别组成（动态批次Dynamical Batching）可以改变神经网络的性能和内部组织结构：在标准均匀批次训练失败的容量受限网络中，DB能成功拟合数据；且DB下网络权重在类别专用状态间切换时涉及更小且更持久的权重集合。在CIFAR-10上，DB也能适度提升容量受限卷积网络的测试精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 受非平衡系统启发，在相关子目标间循环可使解决方案间切换更高效。研究旨在探究训练批次中类别强调的时间分布如何同时影响神经网络最终达到的解及其内部组织结构。

Method: 提出Dynamical Batching (DB)采样协议：周期性强调每个类别，同时保持损失函数和优化器不变；对比Uniform Batching (UB，每个mini-batch类别比例相等)。在合成数据集（三臂螺旋）和CIFAR-10上，使用容量受限的MLP、宽度受限的ResNet-10及另一卷积网络进行实验，追踪个别权重动态。

Result: 1) 三臂螺旋上：UB下容量受限MLP精度停滞远低于完美，DB下成功拟合训练数据。2) DB下类别专用状态间的切换由更小的权重集合承载，且该集合跨周期显著更持久（在所有合成数据集及能同时在两协议下拟合的宽网络中均观察到）。3) 这种组织特征是协议特征而非收益预测器：即使DB不提升精度时也会出现。4) CIFAR-10上：DB适度提升通道收窄ResNet-10和另一容量受限卷积网络的测试精度。

Conclusion: 类别强调在时间上的分布方式能同时塑造神经网络达到的解和网络的内部结构。动态批次通过周期性类别强调，诱导出更高效的权重重组模式，在容量受限场景下尤为有效。

Abstract: We investigate whether cyclically varying the class composition of training batches can modify both the performance and the internal organization of neural networks. Motivated by nonequilibrium systems, in which cycling between related sub-goals can make switching between their solutions increasingly efficient, we introduce Dynamical Batching (DB), a sampling protocol that periodically emphasizes each class while leaving the loss and the optimizer unchanged, and compare it with Uniform Batching (UB), in which every mini-batch has equal class proportions. In the regime where standard training fails, DB changes the outcome: on a three-arm spiral, a capacity-limited MLP that plateaus far below perfect accuracy under UB fits the training data under DB. Tracking individual weights, we find that under DB the change between class-specialized states is carried by a smaller set of weights than under UB, and that this set is markedly more persistent from cycle to cycle, on every synthetic dataset we test and in a wider network that fits the data under both protocols. This organization is a signature of the protocol rather than a predictor of its benefit: it appears equally where DB leaves accuracy unchanged. On CIFAR-10, the same protocol modestly improves the test accuracy of a channel-narrowed ResNet-10, a standard residual architecture, and of a second capacity-limited convolutional network. These results show that how class emphasis is distributed in time can shape both the solution a network reaches and the internal structure of the network.

</details>


### [444] [TaQFormer: A Treatment-as-Query Transformer with Data-Fusion for Multidimensional Treatment Modeling in Coupon Allocation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26199)
*Jiahong Li,Zeqin Yang,Yu Xiang,Zhifan Jiang,Jingqi Ma,Enzheng Hua,Jixing Xu,Jun Wu,Fei Wang,Enyun Yu,Jiecheng Guo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 TaQFormer，一种基于 Transformer 的多维度治疗效应建模方法，用于在线市场的多品类优惠券分配。通过两阶段训练（观察数据预训练 + RCT 数据 LoRA 微调）结合请求特定的融合门控，实现了对完整折扣向量的联合决策。在线 A/B 测试显示，在相同补贴成本下，业务价值提升 1.26%，并已全量上线运行数月。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线市场发放多品类优惠券时，需同时决定各品类的折扣力度，既要考虑直接效应，也要捕捉跨品类需求替代或互补效应。现有方法难以建模高维治疗向量的联合效应，且面临观察数据偏差大、RCT 数据稀缺、生产环境延迟预算严格等挑战。

Method: 1. TaQFormer：将每个治疗维度（品类折扣）表示为查询 Token，利用跨注意力机制建模完整治疗向量下的响应函数。2. 两阶段训练流水线：第一阶段在大规模但有策略偏差的观察日志上预训练学习通用结果模式；第二阶段在小规模 RCT 数据上使用 LoRA 微调，并引入请求特定的融合门控机制融合预训练与 RCT 知识。3. 生产部署检查：离线提升指标、治疗并行服务、延迟监控、14 天在线 A/B 测试。

Result: 在相同补贴成本率下，TaQFormer 使人均业务价值较生产基线提升 1.26%，显著优于生产基线和仅用 RCT 训练的模型，且满足延迟预算。模型已于 2026 年 10 月全量上线并稳定运行数月。

Conclusion: 多维度治疗建模结合观察数据预训练与 RCT 数据自适应微调，能有效支持生产环境中的联合折扣决策。该工作展示了 Transformer 架构在因果推断与治疗优化中的应用潜力，并验证了两阶段训练策略在解决数据偏差与稀缺性问题上的有效性。

Abstract: We study coupon allocation on an online marketplace offering multiple service categories. Issuing coupons requires choosing a vector of category-specific discounts, accounting for both their direct effects and cross-category demand shifts. We present TaQFormer, a treatment-as-query Transformer for this multidimensional treatment setting. Each treatment coordinate is represented as a query token, allowing cross-attention to estimate the response to the full treatment vector. To combine large but policy-biased observational logs with a smaller stream of randomized controlled trial data, we use a two-stage pipeline: observational pretraining learns general outcome patterns, followed by LoRA fine-tuning on RCT data with a request-specific fusion gate. We evaluate the resulting system through the checks required for production, including offline uplift metrics, treatment-parallel serving, latency monitoring, and a 14-day online A/B test. At essentially the same subsidy cost rate, \model increases business value per user by 1.26\% over the production baseline and significantly outperforms both the production baseline and the RCT-only model, while meeting the latency budget. It was subsequently rolled out to all marketplace traffic and has operated at full scale for several months as of October 2026. The deployment illustrates how multidimensional treatment modeling and observational pretraining, combined with adaptation using RCT data, can support effective joint discount decisions in production.

</details>


### [445] [OceanTensorCube and ST-MMT: A Multimodal Data and Transformer System for Seven-Day Forecasting of Pyropia Bleaching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26209)
*Gwangjin Kim,Cheolyoung Jang,Yosep Jo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种基于时空Transformer（ST-MMT）的海带（Pyropia）白化预测系统，能提前7天预测养殖场簇的白化概率，验证集上6种子集成模型实现全正例检出且假警报率≤3.5%，但技能随营养监测数据老化急剧下降，单模型LSTM在簇平均序列上优于单ST-MMT，仅集成模型在操作点领先。系统已部署运行于https://oceantensor.ai.kr。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 韩国海带养殖面临白化导致的经济损失，现有缺乏提前预警系统。需整合多源海洋、气象、卫星与模式数据，构建高时空分辨率（30米网格）的预测模型，为养殖户提供可操作的7天前瞻预报。

Method: 1. 构建OceanTensorCube数据立方：对齐32个通道的公开海洋、气象、海洋模式与卫星数据至30米网格。2. 设计ST-MMT模型：920万参数的时空Transformer，采用枢纽式多头交叉注意力机制在变量组间建模，输入14天窗口输出7天后白化概率。3. 采用6种子集成策略提升鲁棒性。4. 设计标注流程、评估协议及输入陈旧时的运行门控机制。

Result: 验证集上，集成模型检出所有报告阳性，假警报率≤3.5%（基于正-未标记标签的上界）。同日期控制实验证明架构能在日历固定时区分不同养殖场簇。弱点：ROC-AUC随季度营养调查老化从30天时的0.94跌至129天时的0.53；单LSTM在簇平均序列上优于单ST-MMT，仅集成模型在操作点超越基线。

Conclusion: ST-MMT集成系统实现了海带白化的实用化短期预测，但高度依赖及时的营养监测数据，单模型性能不及简单LSTM，需通过集成提升。运行门控机制确保预报仅在输入新鲜时发布，系统已投入实际运营服务。

Abstract: Bleaching of cultured Pyropia (laver) causes losses in Korean seaweed farming. We present a system that forecasts bleaching seven days ahead for farm clusters. OceanTensorCube aligns 32 channels from public marine, meteorological, ocean-model and satellite sources on a 30 m grid, and ST-MMT, a 9.2-million-parameter spatiotemporal transformer with hub-style multi-head cross-attention between variable groups, maps a 14-day input window to a seven-day-ahead bleaching probability. On the validation set, a six-seed ensemble detects every reported positive at a false-alarm rate of at most 3.5%, an upper bound because the report-based labels are positive-unlabeled. A same-date control on separately trained models indicates that the architecture discriminates between clusters when the calendar is held fixed. We also report the system's weaknesses: skill falls steeply as the quarterly nutrient survey ages (ROC-AUC 0.94 at 30 days, 0.53 at 129 days), and a single LSTM on cluster-average series outperforms a single ST-MMT, with only the ensemble leading at the operating point. We describe the labeling procedure, the evaluation protocol and the operational gate that withholds forecasts when inputs are stale. The forecasting service is operated at https://oceantensor.ai.kr.

</details>


### [446] [SEAM: Spectral Embedding Alignment and Merging for Low-Resource TTS](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26252)
*Walaa Othman,Baher Mohammad,Stamatios Lefkimmiatis,Ammar Ali*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 SEAM，一种零音频初始化方法，用于条件文本转语音（TTS）模型的词汇扩展。该方法通过频谱滤波器保留时间音素顺序，并利用闭式岭回归将新嵌入与预训练条件流形对齐，无需配对音频即可构建未见标记的嵌入。实验表明，SEAM 在三种语言和两种 TTS 架构上仅需 1/4 训练数据即可达到或接近基线性能，样本复杂度降低 75%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有条件 TTS 模型扩展词汇通常需要大量配对音频进行微调，这在低资源和跨语言场景下构成主要瓶颈。标准池化策略忽略了子标记的时序结构，导致初始化效果不佳。

Method: SEAM 从已知子标记构建未见标记的嵌入：首先应用频谱滤波器保留音素的时间顺序，然后使用闭式岭回归将新嵌入映射到预训练模型的条件流形上，实现零音频初始化。

Result: 在三种语言和两种 TTS 架构上的实验显示，SEAM 仅使用基线 1/4 的训练数据即可达到或匹配基线性能，相比随机初始化和均值池化，样本复杂度降低 75%。

Conclusion: SEAM 提供了一种轻量级、可复现且有理论支撑的词汇扩展方案，显著降低了低资源语音合成对配对音频数据的依赖。

Abstract: Expanding the vocabulary of conditional text-to-speech (TTS) models typically requires extensive fine-tuning with paired audio, creating a major bottleneck for low-resource and cross-lingual adaptation. To address this, we introduce SEAM, a zero-audio initialization method that constructs embeddings for unseen tokens from known subtokens.
