Unlike standard pooling strategies that ignore sequential structure, SEAM applies a spectral filter to preserve temporal phonetic order and uses closed-form ridge regression to align the new embeddings with the pretrained conditioning manifold. Across three languages and two TTS architectures, SEAM approaches or matches baseline performance using up to four times less training data, reducing sample complexity by 75\% compared to random initialization and mean pooling. Our approach provides a lightweight, reproducible, and theoretically grounded solution for vocabulary expansion in low-resource speech synthesis.

</details>


### [447] [Trust Your Targets: Is Target Propagation Block-Diagonal Gauss-Newton?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26283)
*Giuseppe Castiglione,Christopher Buckley,Ivor Simpson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文重新推导目标传播（TP），基于隐式范数的信任域框架，提出共轭梯度目标传播（CGTP），利用共轭梯度并行求解层局部子问题；单一自适应参数同时控制信任域与权重更新界限，KFAC 作为特例自然涌现。实验表明 CGTP 在 MNIST 和 Fashion-MNIST MLP 上达到 ADAM 与 KFAC 相当精度，外层迭代次数比 ADAM 少约 10 倍（反向传递等效计算量），且随深度保持稳定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 TP 方法声称等价于 Gauss-Newton 优化，但仅在击中目标平凡的非现实假设下成立；实际变体仅对最小二乘问题做单步梯度下降，缺乏严格理论支撑且收敛慢。需要从信任域视角重新推导 TP，建立更合理的优化框架并提升收敛效率。

Method: 1. 在隐式范数下建立信任域目标，将 TP 重构为逐层局部子问题的信任域优化。2. 提出 CGTP：使用共轭梯度法并行求解各层局部子问题，避免单步梯度下降的近似。3. 引入单一自适应参数，同时控制信任域半径与权重更新步长界限。4. 证明当用批均值雅可比替换逐样本雅可比时，KFAC 自然作为特例出现，赋予其分解阻尼变分解释。

Result: 在 MNIST 和 Fashion-MNIST 多层感知机上，CGTP 测试精度与 ADAM、KFAC 相当；外层迭代次数比 ADAM 减少约 10 倍（即反向传递等效计算量降低一个数量级）；随着网络加深仍保持训练稳定，无发散或震荡。

Conclusion: CGTP 通过信任域重新诠释 TP，结合共轭梯度并行求解层局部问题，实现了更少迭代、更稳健的深层网络训练，并将 KFAC 纳入统一变分框架，为无反向传播的二阶优化提供了实用且理论扎实的路径。

Abstract: Target propagation (TP) is a backpropagation alternative in which local targets carry the global learning signal. Prior works claim that TP performs Gauss-Newton (GN) optimisation on these targets, but the correspondence has only been established under unrealistic assumptions where hitting them exactly is trivial. Practical variants instead descend on a least-squares problem via a single gradient step. In this paper, we rederive TP from a trust region under an implicit, previously unexamined norm, and introduce CGTP (Conjugate Gradient Target Propagation), which uses conjugate gradients to solve the layer-local subproblems in parallel. A single adaptive parameter jointly controls this trust region and a matching bound on the weight update; KFAC emerges exactly as the special case where the per-sample Jacobians are replaced by their batch mean, giving its factored damping a variational grounding. On MNIST and Fashion-MNIST MLPs, CGTP matches the accuracy of ADAM and KFAC while needing orders of magnitude fewer outer iterations than ADAM (about 10x fewer backward-pass-equivalents overall), while remaining stable across depth.

</details>


### [448] [Learning SOCP Solver Dynamics with Graph Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26285)
*Adam Ghalem,Lou Salaün,Davide Rinaldi,Fragkiskos D. Malliaros*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 SOCPNet，一种递归图神经网络框架，利用求解器轨迹学习迭代求解二阶锥规划（SOCP）的过程。与单次前向传递预测解的 GNN 求解器不同，SOCPNet 通过共享 GNN 反复细化当前迭代点，并采用轨迹正则化训练，从中间迭代中学习逐步改进估计。实验表明，SOCPNet 在多个标准 SOCP 问题类上持续降低最终解误差，且训练好的模型可作为经典内点法的热启动，在不损失精度的情况下减少求解器迭代次数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典内点法虽鲁棒准确，但其迭代本质在实时或重复求解场景下计算成本高。现有基于学习的求解器多用单次前向传递直接预测最优解，未利用经典求解器产生的中间轨迹信息，限制了求解精度和泛化能力。因此需要一种能利用求解器轨迹、支持变步数推理并能逐步细化解的迭代学习框架。

Method: SOCPNet 采用递归图神经网络架构：共享的 GNN 模型在每一步接收当前迭代点并输出细化后的新迭代点，支持任意推理步数。训练时引入轨迹正则化损失，使网络从经典求解器的中间迭代轨迹中学习，逐步逼近最优解。该框架将优化问题建模为图结构，利用 GNN 捕捉变量、约束、目标函数间的稀疏关系。

Result: 在多个标准 SOCP 问题类数据集上评测，SOCPNet 相较于 SOCP-GNN 基线持续降低最终解误差。此外，将训练好的 SOCPNet 作为热启动接入经典内点法，可在不损失精度的前提下显著减少内点法的迭代次数，验证了其在混合优化流水线中的实用价值。

Conclusion: SOCPNet 通过递归 GNN 利用求解器轨迹学习迭代求解过程，突破了单次预测范式的局限，实现了更高精度的 SOCP 求解，并展示了与经典求解器无缝集成的潜力，为实时和重复求解场景提供了高效的学习型优化方案。

Abstract: Second-order cone programs (SOCPs) are a fundamental class of convex optimization problems widely applied across engineering domains. Classical interior-point methods are robust and accurate, but their iterative nature can be costly in real-time or repeated-solve settings. This has motivated learning-based solvers that approximate optimizer solutions with neural networks. Recent work has increasingly studied graph neural networks (GNNs) for linear, quadratic, and second-order cone optimization, leveraging their ability to model sparse relational structure among variables, constraints, and objective functions. Most existing GNN-based solvers compress the optimization process into a single forward pass, predicting the optimizer directly without using the intermediate trajectory produced by classical solvers. We introduce SOCPNet, a recursive GNN framework that uses solver trajectories to learn an iterative SOCP solution procedure. A shared GNN model is applied repeatedly, refining the current iterate at each step and enabling inference for a variable number of iterations. Rather than predicting the solution in a single pass, SOCPNet learns from intermediate iterates to progressively refine its estimates using a trajectory-regularized training procedure. We evaluate SOCPNet on multiple datasets spanning standard SOCP problem classes and show that it consistently reduces the final solution error relative to a SOCP-GNN baseline. Finally, we demonstrate how trained SOCPNet models can be used in a hybrid optimization pipeline by warm-starting a classical interior-point solver, reducing solver iterations without loss of accuracy.

</details>


### [449] [Toward Online Robust Zero-Sum Markov Games with Function Approximation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26286)
*Chenhao Zhou,Jiyu Wei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种乐观对偶鲁棒贝尔曼框架，用于解决在线鲁棒零和马尔可夫博弈中的算子学习与博弈求解耦合问题。该框架结合了对偶鲁棒贝尔曼拟合、乐观极小极大规划、反向验证置信集和利用者混合数据收集，实现了遗憾界的分解，分离了探索复杂度、鲁棒算子估计误差、阶段博弈求解误差和模型误设定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的鲁棒强化学习理论尚未提供算子学习视角，仅限于特定的多智能体设置。在线鲁棒零和马尔可夫博弈面临耦合的算子学习与博弈求解问题：从名义交互数据中恢复最坏情况极小极大贝尔曼算子，同时保持战略覆盖并控制阶段博弈近似误差。

Method: 提出乐观对偶鲁棒贝尔曼框架，包含四大核心组件：1) 对偶鲁棒贝尔曼拟合，2) 乐观极小极大规划，3) 反向验证置信集，4) 利用者混合数据收集。分析围绕候选值类诱导的鲁棒贝尔曼残差展开。

Result: 在明确可解释的假设下，获得了通用和投影函数近似的条件定理接口，以及表格型、分段交叉拟合线性、自归一化纯在线线性/有限秩核、投影RKHS截断等结构化制度的封闭结果。小规模数值实验验证了鲁棒性校准、战略覆盖和收益差距权衡。

Conclusion: 该框架为在线鲁棒零和马尔可夫博弈提供了统一的算子学习视角，遗憾界分解揭示了探索、估计、求解和模型误设定的独立贡献，为不同函数近似类提供了模块化的理论接口，实验验证了理论预测的权衡关系。

Abstract: Online robust zero-sum Markov games pose a coupled operator-learning and game-solving problem: from nominal interaction data, the learner must recover a worst-case minimax Bellman operator while maintaining strategic coverage and controlling stage-game approximation error. Existing robust reinforcement-learning theory does not yet provide such an operator-learning perspective beyond specialized multi-agent settings. We develop an optimistic dual robust Bellman framework that combines dual robust Bellman fitting, optimistic minimax planning, backward-validated confidence sets, and exploiter-mix data collection. Our analysis is organized around the robust Bellman residuals induced by the candidate value class and yields a regret reduction that separates exploration complexity, robust operator-estimation error, stage-game solution error, and misspecification. Under explicit interpretable assumptions, we obtain conditional theorem interfaces for general and projected function approximation, together with closed results in several structured regimes, including tabular, epochwise cross-fit linear, self-normalized pure-online linear / finite-rank kernel, and projected RKHS truncation. Small-scale numerical experiments illustrate robustness calibration, strategic coverage, and the return-gap trade-off predicted by the framework.

</details>


### [450] [CAST: Cast-Admissible Generative Design and Shape Optimization with Paired Depth Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26309)
*Jihoon Kim,Yongmin Kwon,Namwoo Kang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CAST 通过将受模具开模方向约束的三维形状生成转化为配对深度图的二维图像生成问题，结合扩散模型与有限元分析引导的优化器，实现了无倒扣的可生产零件设计，并在 SimJEB 支架数据集上显著降低了顺应性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决深度生成设计中无约束表示可能产生倒扣，导致无法从两部分模具中脱模的问题，需在保证可制造性的前提下实现形状生成与结构优化的统一。

Method: 提出 CAST 方法：选定开模方向后，用配对的顶部和底部深度图表示三维形状，每对有效深度图定义该方向上的一个材料区间，天然排除倒扣；利用扩散模型在深度图空间生成候选形状，再用有限元分析引导的优化器在同一表示空间细化边界，并引入体积惩罚项。

Result: 在 211 个 SimJEB 支架设计的有限训练数据上，对 200 个生成候选进行 FEA 引导优化，193 个候选的顺应性降低，中位数降低 36.8%；对现有支架的重构揭示了质量-刚度权衡：填充遮挡区域增加材料体积并减小位移。

Conclusion: 配对深度图表示将生成式探索与结构细化统一在同一保持拉拔方向约束的设计空间中，实现了可制造的复杂几何生成与性能优化的有效结合。

Abstract: Deep generative design can produce complex geometries, but unconstrained representations may create undercuts that prevent release from a two-part mold. We present CAST, which reformulates three-dimensional shape generation under a selected mold-opening constraint as a two-dimensional image generation problem using paired top and bottom depth images. Each valid depth pair defines one material interval along a selected mold-opening direction, so reconstructions exclude undercuts in that direction by construction. Diffusion models generate candidate shapes in this representation, and a finite element analysis (FEA) guided optimizer refines the same two boundaries. We evaluate diffusion-based generation with limited training data comprising 211 SimJEB bracket designs. On SimJEB brackets, FEA-guided refinement with a volume penalty reduced compliance in 193 of 200 generated candidates. The median reduction across all candidates was 36.8 percent in the optimization FEA model. Reconstruction of existing brackets revealed a mass--stiffness trade-off: filling occluded regions increased material volume and reduced displacement under the evaluated loads. Paired depth images thus connect generative exploration and structural refinement in a shared design space that preserves the selected pull-direction restriction.

</details>


### [451] [CIS-Transolver: A Cross-Layer Incremental-State Neural Operator for Fine-Scale Automotive Aerodynamic Flow Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26337)
*Jianglong Liu,Zhicheng Zhu,Jia Hao,Liangyue Jia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 CIS-Transolver，一种跨层增量状态神经算子，通过局部多尺度分析提取细尺度信息并编码为几何矩状态，跨层传播更新并结合 Physics-Attention 中的值表示反馈，使局部细节持续贡献于全局物理相关性建模。在三个汽车空气动力学基准测试中，该方法在全部五个预测指标上均达到最低平均相对 L2 误差，平均误差降低 8.72%，最高达 16.38%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经算子虽能高效预测复杂汽车气动流场，但谱偏置等因素限制了其在复杂几何体附近精细尺度流场变化的重构能力。现有工作主要通过信息提取和训练目标改进细尺度表征，但缺乏将提取的局部细节持续用于后续算子计算并有效融入全局流场表示的机制。

Method: CIS-Transolver 采用局部多尺度分析提取细尺度信息，将其编码为几何矩状态并在网络层间传播更新。通过跨层增量状态机制，将前层信息与 Physics-Attention 中的值表示反馈相结合，使局部细节持续参与全局物理相关性的后续建模。

Result: 在 ShapeNet-Car、AhmedML 和 DrivAerNet++ 三个公开汽车气动基准上，CIS-Transolver 在面压场、体积压强场和速度场的全部五个预测指标中均取得最低平均相对 L2 误差。与各指标最优基线相比，平均相对误差降低 8.72%，其中 ShapeNet-Car 压强预测降低 16.38%，AhmedML 速度预测降低 15.60%。

Conclusion: CIS-Transolver 通过跨层增量状态机制将细尺度建模从局部信息提取扩展到跨层持续利用，有效缓解了谱偏置导致的精细流场重构难题，为复杂几何体精细流场预测提供了新范式。

Abstract: Neural operators offer an efficient data-driven approach to rapid prediction of complex automotive aerodynamic flows. However, spectral bias and other factors limit accurate reconstruction of fine-scale flow variations near complex geometries. Existing studies improve the representation and fitting of fine-scale information mainly through information extraction and training objectives. Further study is needed to determine how extracted local details can be used continually in subsequent operator computations and contribute effectively to the overall flow-field representation. We propose CIS-Transolver, a cross-layer incremental-state neural operator that extends fine-scale modeling from local information extraction to its use across layers. The method extracts fine-scale information through local multiscale analysis and encodes it as geometric moment states that are propagated and updated across layers. By combining information from previous layers with feedback to the value representations in Physics-Attention, the method allows local details to contribute continually to subsequent modeling of global physical correlations. We systematically evaluate CIS-Transolver on three public automotive aerodynamics benchmarks, ShapeNet-Car, AhmedML, and DrivAerNet++, covering surface pressure fields and volumetric pressure and velocity fields. CIS-Transolver achieves the lowest mean relative L2 error among the evaluated methods for all five prediction metrics across the three benchmarks. The relative error reductions average 8.72% across the five metrics compared with the best baseline for each metric, reaching 16.38% for ShapeNet-Car pressure prediction and 15.60% for AhmedML velocity prediction. These results provide a new approach to fine-scale flow prediction for complex geometries.

</details>


### [452] [Logit Averaging During Training Sets a New State of the Art for Non-Invasive Speech BCI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26347)
*Miran Özdogan,Gereon Elvers,Michael Bronstein,Oiwi Parker Jones*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统比较了非侵入式脑机接口中多试次聚合策略，发现训练时logit平均这一最简单的方法在7个设置中的6个优于所有其他方法，在2025年PNPL竞赛的音素分类任务上建立新SOTA，平衡准确率比冠军高出17.4个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非侵入式BCI受限于信噪比，现有方法通过聚合同一刺激的重复试次来解决，但文献中聚合方式不一致：有的在模型输入端平均脑信号，有的在输出端平均预测，且未将聚合视为独立的架构选择。缺乏系统性比较。

Method: 评估6种聚合范式（包括训练时logit平均和3种引入的基于注意力的变体），跨越3个数据集、4个任务、2种组规模。同时建立logit平均与联合集成训练的理论联系。

Result: 训练时logit平均在6/7设置中表现最优。在PNPL 2025音素分类任务上设立新SOTA，比竞赛冠军高17.4个百分点平衡准确率。结果质疑了深度学习文献中关于联合集成训练失效原因的近期解释。

Conclusion: 多试次聚合是非侵入式神经解码的关键设计选择，训练时logit平均被确立为简单有效的默认策略。

Abstract: Non-invasive brain-computer interfaces are in practice limited by signal-to-noise ratio, and recent state-of-the-art methods address this limitation by aggregating over repeated trials of the same stimulus. Yet multi-trial aggregation has been treated inconsistently across the literature: some work averages brain signals at the model's input, other work averages predictions at the model's output, and neither treats aggregation as an architectural choice in its own right. We provide the first systematic comparison of aggregation strategies for non-invasive neural decoding, evaluating six paradigms (including logit averaging during training and three attention-based variants we introduce) across three datasets, four tasks, and two group sizes. We find that aggregation choice matters substantially: training-time logit averaging, the simplest method we propose, outperforms all others in 6 of 7 settings. On the phoneme classification setting of the 2025 PNPL competition, it sets a new state of the art, significantly outperforming the competition winner by 17.4 absolute percentage points in balanced accuracy. We further draw a theoretical connection between logit averaging and joint ensemble training, which has been shown to underperform independent ensembling in the deep learning literature; our results call into question recent explanations of why joint ensemble training fails. Together, these findings establish multi-trial aggregation as a key design choice for non-invasive neural decoding and identify training-time logit averaging as a simple, effective default.

</details>


### [453] [CTLite: Lightweight Irregular Multivariate Time Series Forecasting with Reusable Continuous-Time Summaries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26379)
*Shusen Ma,Xudong Zuo,Yangchun Xie,Yun-Bo Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出轻量级非规则多变量时间序列预测框架 CTLite，通过解耦历史摘要与学习预测，利用无参数连续时间矩编码器提取多尺度局部水平趋势，结合阻尼外推与低秩跨变量修正的紧凑读出模块，仅用 88-2,537 可训练参数即在四个真实基准上达到最优/次优精度，推理延迟降低 18.6-87.3%，且历史摘要可复用进一步降低 52% 重复预测总耗时。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法依赖学习型时间编码器，将历史表征构建与模型优化强耦合，导致参数量大、需重复处理相同观测、无法跨预测复用历史摘要，推理效率低且难以部署于资源受限场景。

Method: CTLite 采用两阶段解耦设计：(1) 无参数连续时间矩编码器，在多时间尺度计算局部水平与趋势矩，自动抑制支撑不足的斜率估计；(2) 紧凑读出模块，融合阻尼局部外推与低秩跨变量修正，显式建模观测新鲜度、目标可用性及预测视界。历史摘要与可训练参数及查询解耦，可跨优化步骤和重复预测零成本复用。

Result: 四个真实数据集实验表明：CTLite 以极少参数（88-2,537）获得最优或次优均值 MSE 与 MAE；批大小 32 下 GPU 推理延迟较最新基线降低 18.6%-87.3%；同一历史上 16 次预测复用摘要可再降总运行时间约 52%（含首次编码成本）。

Conclusion: CTLite 证明了将历史摘要与学习预测彻底解耦、采用无参数连续时间矩编码与低秩修正读出，能在保持高预测精度的同时实现极致轻量化、低延迟及历史摘要复用，为非规则多变量时间序列预测提供了高效实用的新范式。}

Abstract: Irregular multivariate time series forecasting (IMTSF) requires capturing temporal dynamics and cross-variable dependencies from sparse, asynchronous observations. Existing methods often rely on learned temporal encoders, coupling historical representation construction with model optimisation and repeatedly processing the same observations. We propose CTLite, a lightweight forecasting framework that decouples historical summarisation from learned prediction. Specifically, a parameter-free continuous-time moment encoder summarises local levels and trends at multiple temporal scales while suppressing poorly supported slope estimates. A compact readout combines damped local extrapolation with a low-rank cross-variable correction that accounts for observation freshness, target availability, and forecast horizon. Since the historical summaries are independent of trainable parameters and forecast queries, they can be reused across optimisation steps and repeated predictions for an unchanged history without altering predictions or parameter gradients. Experiments on four real-world benchmarks show that CTLite achieves the best or second-best mean MSE and MAE among the evaluated methods with only 88-2,537 trainable parameters. Under matched GPU workloads at batch size 32, CTLite reduces inference latency by 18.6-87.3% compared with the latest models, including the cost of historical encoding. Reusing summaries further reduces total runtime by approximately 52% over 16 forecast calls on the same history compared with recomputing the encoder for every call, including the initial encoding cost. The code is at: https://github.com/SSMa913/NICLab-CTLite.

</details>


### [454] [A Simple and General Approach to top-$k$ Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26407)
*Motti Goldberger,Nils Rudi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究贝叶斯 top-k 识别问题，提出一种基于代理目标的批次采样分配方法，该方法通用、简单，理论上证明其后验期望机会成本以至少最优指数衰减率的一半衰减，实验中表现优于或匹配现有最佳算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 决策者需从未知质量的项目池中选择 k 个项目，通过有限预算的自适应采样获取噪声观测，目标是最小化所选集合的期望机会成本。现有方法在批次采样、任意 k 值和多种采样分布下的通用性不足，且缺乏强理论保证。

Method: 提出一种批次采样分配策略：每轮通过最小化一个源自期望机会成本上界的代理目标来分配样本。该方法适用于批次采样、任意选择规模 k 和多种采样分布，形式简单直观。

Result: 理论证明：该方法的后验期望机会成本以指数速率衰减，速率至少达到任意采样规则所能达到的最优指数衰减率的一半。仿真实验在广泛设置下显示，该方法与各设置下的最佳现有算法相比具有竞争力，且经常优于它们。

Conclusion: 该方法为贝叶斯 top-k 识别提供了一个通用、简单且理论有保证的框架，在实践中表现优异，适合实际部署。

Abstract: This paper considers the Bayesian top-$k$ identification problem, wherein a decision maker is tasked with selecting $k$ items from a pool of items of unknown quality. To assess the items, the decision maker adaptively allocates a fixed sampling budget, where each sample of an item yields a noisy observation of its quality, with the objective of minimizing the expected opportunity cost of the selected set. We propose an approach that allocates each batch of samples by minimizing a surrogate objective derived from an upper bound on the expected opportunity cost. The approach is general: samples can be allocated in batches, the selection size $k$ is arbitrary, and it applies to many sampling distributions. It is also simple and intuitive. We prove that the method's posterior expected opportunity cost decays at an exponential rate of at least half the best rate achievable by any sampling rule. In simulations across a wide range of settings, the method is competitive with, and often improves upon, the best existing algorithm in each setting.

</details>


### [455] [Rethinking LLM Fine-Tuning via Weight Space Reparameterization: Preserving Safety during Downstream Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26443)
*Minseong Kim,Jongbok Won,Jeesup Park,Yonghee Choi,Dongjun Han*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 WSR-Tune，一种基于权重空间重参数化的微调框架，通过将安全相关信息集中到少量方向并冻结，实现下游任务适配与安全保持的同时优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型在下游任务微调时往往会削弱原有的安全对齐行为，现有方法试图在原始参数空间中识别安全相关神经元或方向，但安全信息分散导致下游更新覆盖安全参数，存在任务适配与安全保持的固有权衡。

Method: 构建安全条件基并重参数化权重矩阵，使安全相关信息集中在少量方向上；识别安全关键方向并在重参数化空间中冻结它们，仅更新剩余互补方向以适配下游任务，从而显式解耦安全与任务信息。

Result: 实验表明，WSR-Tune 在下游任务性能与安全保持之间实现了更优的权衡，验证了其在可靠 LLM 微调中的有效性。

Conclusion: 通过权重空间重参数化显式分离安全与任务方向，WSR-Tune 有效缓解了微调过程中的安全退化问题，为大模型安全微调提供了新的范式。

Abstract: Fine-tuning large language models (LLMs) on downstream tasks often weakens their previously aligned safety behavior, creating an inherent trade-off between task adaptation and safety preservation. Existing approaches attempt to mitigate this issue by identifying safety-relevant neurons, layers, or update directions in the original parameter space. However, safety-related information is often distributed across many directions in this space, causing downstream updates to overwrite parameters that encode safety behavior. We propose WSR-Tune, a Weight Space Reparameterization-based fine-tuning framework that preserves safety during downstream adaptation. Our approach constructs a safety-conditioned basis and reparameterizes the weight matrices such that safety-relevant information becomes concentrated in a small subset of directions. We then identify safety-critical directions and freeze them in the reparameterized space, while updating the remaining complementary directions for downstream adaptation. By explicitly structuring the parameter space to disentangle safety and task information, our method reduces interference between objectives and enables simultaneous preservation of safety and improvement in downstream performance. Experimental results show that our method achieves a more favorable trade-off between downstream performance and safety retention, demonstrating its effectiveness for reliable LLM fine-tuning.

</details>


### [456] [On Learning Expand-and-Sparsify Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26470)
*Alireza Asghari,Parikshit Ram,Kaushik Sinha*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了Expand-and-sparsify (EaS)表示学习：通过学习线性映射而非随机映射，在窄扩展维度下显著优于随机映射，且学习后的top-k稀疏表示（保留≤10%坐标）在各种扩展因子下均与同维度稠密ReLU层性能无差异；二值化时稀疏码优于稠密层；稀疏度上限随扩展宽度增长而提高，无固定上限。回归任务验证了第一发现，并对第二、三发现有修正。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有EaS理论依赖随机映射，要求扩展维度随输入维度指数级增长，不切实际。本文旨在探究：通过梯度下降学习映射能获得多少收益？该收益如何随扩展宽度变化？

Method: 在73个OpenML分类任务和48个回归任务上进行实验，固定数据集、扩展维度、稀疏度和数据划分，采用中位数跨数据集汇总和Wilcoxon符号秩检验进行统计比较。系统扫描不同扩展因子、稀疏度和映射学习策略（随机 vs 梯度下降学习）。

Result: 四大发现：1) 学习映射在最窄扩展时收益最大，随扩展变宽优势消失，故可用小型学习EaS层。2) 学习映射后，top-k稀疏表示（保留≤1/10坐标）在所有测试扩展因子下均与同维度稠密ReLU层性能无显著差异，但GELU和SiLU不行。3) 强制二值化时，稀疏码优于稠密层，因二值化不损害稀疏层精度却损害稠密层。4) 可达到的稀疏度随扩展宽度增加而提高，不存在固定稀疏度上限。回归任务复现发现1，并对发现2、3有限定条件。

Conclusion: 学习扩展映射使EaS在实用维度下成为可能：窄扩展下学习映射至关重要，宽扩展下随机映射足矣。学习后的稀疏top-k表示能以极低稠密度（≤10%）匹配稠密ReLU性能，且二值化鲁棒性更强。稀疏度上限随扩展宽度灵活调整，为高效稀疏表示设计提供理论指导。

Abstract: Expand-and-sparsify ($\texttt{EaS}$) representations lift an input to a much higher dimension through a linear map and keep only the $k$ largest coordinates. Existing theory builds that map at random and needs the expanded dimension to grow exponentially in the input dimension, which puts the construction out of practical reach. We ask what is gained by learning the map by gradient descent instead, and how that gain depends on how wide the expansion is. We sweep $73$ OpenML classification tasks and $48$ regression tasks under a protocol that holds the datasets, expanded dimensions, sparsity levels and splits fixed across every method, and we summarise each comparison by a median over datasets and a Wilcoxon signed rank test. We report four findings. First, learning the expansion helps most when the expansion is narrowest, and its advantage over a random map decays to nothing by the widest expansions we run, so a learned $\texttt{EaS}$ layer can be made small. Second, with the map learned, a top-$k$ representation that keeps at most a tenth of its coordinates is indistinguishable from a dense $\texttt{ReLU}$ layer of the same expanded dimension at every expansion factor we test, while GELU and SiLU are not. Third, when the representation is forced to be binary the sparse code is the better of the two, and the reason is that binarization costs it nothing while it costs the dense layer accuracy. Fourth, how sparse the representation can be is governed by how wide it is: the sparsity level that is free rises as the expansion grows, so there is no fixed limit on how sparse it can be. The regression tasks reproduce the first finding and qualify the second and third.

</details>


### [457] [A Simple and Unified Method for Gradient-Variation Regret](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26473)
*Hang Yu,Peng Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种基于带有决策移动二次惩罚的代理损失的简单统一方法，在非平稳在线学习和通用在线学习两种设置下均获得梯度变化界，并在在线博弈中改进现有保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 梯度变化在线学习与博弈论和优化相关，现有工作针对非平稳在线学习（最小化动态后悔）和通用在线学习（适应未知损失曲率）分别使用不同技术获得梯度变化界，缺乏统一框架。

Method: 提出基于带有决策移动二次惩罚的代理损失的统一方法，通过乐观到梯度变化的归约实现非平稳在线学习，并设计简单算法实现通用在线学习。

Result: 在非平稳在线学习中，该方法使广泛算法类匹配Zhao等人(2024)的速率；在通用在线学习中，获得匹配Yan等人(2024)最优通用后悔界的算法，同时放宽扩展平滑性假设；在在线博弈中改进现有保证。

Conclusion: 该统一方法简化了梯度变化在线学习的分析，同时在多个设置中达到最优或改进的理论保证，展示了代理损失加二次惩罚的强大通用性。

Abstract: Gradient-variation online learning has attracted increasing attention for its connections to game theory and optimization. It has been studied in both non-stationary online learning, which aims to minimize dynamic regret against time-varying comparator sequences, and universal online learning, which seeks to adapt to unknown loss curvature. Prior work obtained gradient-variation bounds using different techniques tailored to each setting. We propose a simple and unified method based on surrogate losses with a quadratic penalty on decision movement, yielding gradient-variation bounds in both settings. For non-stationary online learning, the method induces an optimistic-to-gradient-variation reduction, enabling a broad class of algorithms to match the rate established by Zhao et al. (2024). For universal online learning, it yields a simple algorithm that matches the optimal universal regret bounds of Yan et al. (2024) while relaxing the extended smoothness assumption. Finally, we apply our method to online games and improve on existing guarantees.

</details>


### [458] [Wet-Biased Data Pipelines Mislead the Training and Evaluation of Generative Precipitation Nowcasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26486)
*Christoph Metzl,Stefan Kapsreiter,Kianusch Vahid Yousefnia,Virginia Poli,Richard Müller,Frank Krüger,Tobias Bölle*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文揭示了降水临近预报生成模型在湿偏数据集上训练和评估时，目标依赖采样会扭曲条件分布学习，导致评估偏差掩盖训练偏差，并通过扩散模型实验证明测试采样策略能反转校准评估结果，误导下游模型开发。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前降水临近预报生成模型主要在过度代表降水事件的湿偏数据集上训练和评估，且测试用例常基于目标观测选择，这会使模型倾向于匹配选定分布而非实际部署分布，且评估偏差可能掩盖训练偏差，亟需系统分析这种采样偏差对模型校准评估的影响。

Method: 1. 理论分析目标依赖采样如何偏移生成模型学习的条件分布；2. 使用固定的卫星到雷达扩散模型，在湿偏测试集和部署代表性测试集上对比校准表现；3. 在模型训练域外、七年后的数据上复现结果；4. 以分类器自由引导为例，展示矛盾校准评估如何误导下游模型开发。

Result: 目标依赖测试采样可反转校准评估：模型在湿偏测试集上呈现欠预测，在部署代表性测试集上却表现为过预测；该现象在训练域外七年后的数据中依然成立；基于错误校准评估的分类器自由引导调整会导致模型性能在实际部署中下降。

Conclusion: 评估偏差会掩盖训练偏差，导致模型看似校准良好实则不适合实际部署。必须采用部署代表性的测试集进行评估，避免目标依赖采样带来的误导性校准结论，从而确保生成模型在真实预报场景中的可靠性。

Abstract: Generative models for precipitation nowcasting are trained and evaluated predominantly on wet-biased datasets, which over-represent precipitation events to emphasize rare extremes. Selecting test cases based on target observations is known to favor forecasts that match the selected distribution rather than the intended deployment distribution. We show analytically how this target-dependent sampling also shifts the conditional distribution learned by generative models. When training and test sampling match, even an ideal model learns precisely the distribution favored by evaluation, allowing the evaluation bias to conceal the training bias. Using a fixed satellite-to-radar diffusion model, we demonstrate that target-dependent test sampling can reverse the calibration assessment. The model appears under-predictive on a wet-biased test set but over-predictive on a deployment-representative test set. This result is replicated outside the model's training domain after a seven-year gap. Utilizing classifier-free guidance as an example, we demonstrate how the contradictory calibration assessment can misdirect downstream model development.

</details>


### [459] [Concerns in Benchmarking Jailbreaks: An Empirical Study of Attack Success Rates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26595)
*Leon Tu Nguyen,Rohan Menon,Rafael Tappe Maestro,Eric Aubinais,Chih-Hong Cheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了越狱攻击评估中攻击成功率（ASR）对生成方式与判断器的敏感性，发现不同评估程序导致攻击排名翻转，且重复采样能暴露模型残留的不安全行为，提倡采用明确成功定义、匹配响应预算、验证过的评估器及累积失败率报告。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有越狱攻击对比严重依赖 ASR，但 ASR 高度依赖响应生成策略（如温度、采样次数）与判断器（关键词匹配 vs. LLM 评估器），缺乏标准化评估协议，导致结论不可复现且可能低估真实风险。

Method: 对三个开源权重语言模型测试八种越狱攻击，采用三种评估程序：关键词匹配、遵循 StrongREJECT 评分指令的 Qwen3 评估器、以及变化尝试次数与排列；另在 Ollama 默认温度 0.8 下对每个请求采样 100 次响应，对比两种判断器下的 ASR。

Result: 低资源语言攻击在关键词匹配下平均 ASR 96.0%，在 Qwen3 评估器下仅 2.7%；改变尝试次数与排列会反转 DeepInception 与重写攻击的排名；重复采样 100 次可使关键词匹配 ASR 达 100%，但 Qwen3 评估器下仅 50%，揭示模型以概率性抑制而非稳健拒绝应对攻击。

Conclusion: 建议在越狱评估中：1) 给出显式成功定义；2) 统一响应预算（采样次数、温度）；3) 使用经验证的评估器；4) 报告重复交互下的累积失败率，而非单次生成测试。

Abstract: Jailbreak methods are commonly compared using Attack Success Rate (ASR), but these comparisons depend on how responses are generated and judged. In this paper, we examine eight attacks against three open-weight language models using three evaluation procedures. Low-resource language attacks achieve a mean ASR of 96.0% under keyword matching but 2.7% under a Qwen3 evaluator following StrongREJECT scoring instructions. Changing the number and arrangement of attempts reverses the ranking of DeepInception and rewriting. In a separate experiment, sampling 100 responses for each unchanged request at Ollama's default temperature of 0.8 yields 100% ASR under keyword matching but 50% under the Qwen3 evaluator. Beyond evaluator sensitivity, these findings raise a safety concern: repeated sampling can expose residual unsafe behavior despite an initial refusal, suggesting probabilistic suppression rather than robust exclusion. We recommend explicit success definitions, matched response budgets, validated evaluators, and reporting cumulative failure under repeated interaction rather than relying on single-generation tests.

</details>


### [460] [Bombadil: A Foundation Model for Plant Electrophysiology](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26597)
*James Kirk,Piotr Bednarski,Filip Twardy,Justin Mast,Lee von Kraus*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了Bombadil，一种植物电生理学基础模型，通过在100个植物物种、10种环境下采集的400多万小时无标签电信号上预训练，实现了跨物种、跨环境、跨任务的植物胁迫生理指标监测，解决了现有单任务模型难以扩展的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于植物电信号的机器学习模型均为单任务训练，无法跨任务、物种或环境迁移，难以满足农业、林业和园艺中大规模、多样化植物养护的需求。

Method: 构建Bombadil基础模型，利用自监督学习在来自实验室、温室、商业果园和自然森林等10种环境、100个植物物种、累计超过400万小时的细胞外差分电极记录的电信号上进行无标签预训练，学习植物电信号的通用基础特征。

Result: Bombadil能够从相同的电信号中追踪七种植物胁迫生理指标的变化，且在训练中未见过标签的物种和胁迫类型上也表现出泛化能力。

Conclusion: Bombadil作为首个植物电生理学基础模型，通过大规模多样化数据预训练实现了跨物种、跨环境、跨胁迫类型的可迁移植物胁迫监测，为精准农业和植物健康管理提供了可扩展的通用解决方案。

Abstract: Living plants, like animals, use electrical signals to carry information about their physiological state across their body, from roots to branches. These signals can be recorded, as they are in animals, from a pair of differential extracellular electrodes inserted into signal-conducting tissue. While machine-learning models have been trained to predict specific plant stress states from these signals, each of these models has been trained for only a single task and none have been designed to transfer across tasks, species, or environments. These approaches do not allow easy scaling across the wide range of species and environments that are relevant to agriculture, forestry, and horticulture for both commercial and consumer plant care.
  Here we present Bombadil, a foundation model for plant electrophysiology, pretrained without labels on over 4 million hours of electrical signals recorded from 100 plant species in ten distinct environments, including laboratories, greenhouses, commercial orchards, and natural forests. In this way, Bombadil is able to learn the fundamental features of plant electrical signals across a wide array of species and environments. Then, from those same electrical signals, Bombadil tracks changes in seven physiological indicators of plant stress, even among species and stressors with no labels in training.

</details>


### [461] [ITU-DESC: a missingness-aware machine-learning dementia risk score in the UK Biobank cohort](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26604)
*Abdullah Kavaklı,Faik Boray Tek*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出ITU-DESC痴呆风险评分，首次结合广泛特征选择与缺失偏倚显式控制，基于UK Biobank约50万参与者，使用CatBoost模型实现AP 0.138、AUC 0.853，显著优于现有模型，并发现白细胞端粒长度和肝酶等新预测因子。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有痴呆风险评分依赖固定预选特征和线性模型，或忽略队列数据中信息性缺失导致的偏倚，限制了预测性能和泛化能力。

Method: 采用无条件随机热卡填补消除缺失模式影响；重复十次不同随机种子的BorutaSHAP特征选择，保留至少八次入选的38个预测因子；训练CatBoost梯度提升决策树模型；在50,041人留出测试集评估。

Result: ITU-DESC在全因痴呆预测中平均精度0.138（95% CI 0.123-0.156），ROC AUC 0.853（0.844-0.863），显著优于最强对比模型UK Biobank痴呆风险预测模型（AP 0.118，AUC 0.841）；新识别预测因子包括白细胞端粒长度和肝酶。

Conclusion: ITU-DESC是首个将广泛特征选择与显式缺失偏倚控制相结合的痴呆风险评分，具有更高预测准确性和可解释性。

Abstract: Background: Existing dementia risk scores rely on fixed, pre-selected features and linear models, or ignore bias from informative missingness in cohort data. Here we introduce the Istanbul Technical University Dementia Risk Score (ITU-DESC), an explainable machine-learning score for incident all-cause dementia that combines broad feature selection across roughly 8,000 candidate features with explicit control of missingness bias.
  Results: We studied approximately 500,000 UK Biobank participants with a median follow-up of 16.6 years. We withheld missingness patterns from the model using unconditional random hot-deck imputation. We stabilized feature selection by repeating BorutaSHAP-based feature selection with ten random-imputation seeds and selecting predictors chosen in at least eight of the ten seeds, which yielded 38 predictors. We trained a CatBoost gradient-boosted decision-tree model and evaluated it on a holdout test set of 50,041 participants. For all-cause incident dementia, ITU-DESC achieved an average precision of 0.138 (95% confidence interval 0.123-0.156) and an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (ROC AUC) of 0.853 (0.844-0.863), significantly outperforming other risk scores, including the strongest comparator, the UK Biobank Dementia Risk Prediction model (0.118 and 0.841). We identified dementia risk predictors absent from established scores, including leukocyte telomere length and liver enzymes. Conclusions: ITU-DESC is the first dementia risk score to combine broad feature selection with explicit control of missingness bias.

</details>


### [462] [Degree Bounds for Separating Polynomial and Neural Invariants for Point Clouds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26612)
*Snir Hordan,Harm Derksen,Mircea Petrache,Nadav Dym*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对点云神经网络（如 Tensor Field Networks 和 MACE）建立了首个显式的二次多项式度数界，证明了分离 n 个点的点云（模旋转与排列）所需的不变多项式度数为 Θ(n²)。同时给出了架构完备性所需表征阶数的具体二次界，并指出在局部正则假设下，基于消息传递的模型仅需依赖局部邻域大小的不变量即可实现分离，但 MACE 仍需高阶不可约表征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的对称性感知点云神经网络（如 Tensor Field Networks、MACE）虽被证明在足够高阶表征下具备通用性（universal），但缺乏表征阶数与点数 n 的定量关系。此前仅存存在性证明，缺乏具体的多项式度数界或表征阶数界，无法指导实际架构设计。

Method: 1. 代数几何与不变量理论：构造分离点云的不变多项式，推导其度数下界与上界；2. 表征理论分析：证明 Tensor Field Networks 和 MACE 能表示任意给定度数的不变多项式，从而得出完备性所需表征阶数的显式二次界；3. 局部分析：在局部正则假设下，设计基于消息传递的模型，利用仅依赖邻域大小的不变量实现分离；4. 反例构造：展示 MACE 必须使用高阶不可约表征才能分离局部正则点云。

Result: 1. 分离 n 点点云（模旋转与排列）的不变多项式最小度数为 Θ(n²)；2. Tensor Field Networks 和 MACE 完备性所需表征阶数为 O(n²)，给出首个显式二次界；3. 局部正则条件下，消息传递模型仅需度数依赖于邻域大小（而非 n）的不变量即可分离；4. MACE 必须计算高阶不可约表征才能分离此类点云，揭示了高阶表征的必要性。

Conclusion: 本文首次为对称性感知点云网络建立了定量的表达能力界，将通用性从存在性结果转化为具体的架构设计指导。结果表明全局分离本质上需要二次复杂度，但局部正则性可降低所需不变量阶数；同时揭示 MACE 等架构必须包含高阶不可约表征，为模型设计提供了理论下界。

Abstract: Neural networks that respect the symmetries of point clouds commonly compute high-order representations of the rotation group to improve their expressivity. Such models are known to be universal, and thus able to separate any pair of point clouds, when using representations of sufficiently high order, yet no precise bound on this order, as a function of the number of points, was previously known. We establish the first quadratic lower and upper degree bounds for polynomials that separate point clouds of n points up to rotations and permutations. By showing Tensor Field Networks and MACE can express all invariant polynomials of a given degree with sufficient representation order, we additionally derive the first explicit, quadratic bound on the representation order sufficient for these architectures to be complete, replacing previous existence results with concrete guarantees. We further show that, under local regularity assumptions, point cloud separation can be achieved with a message-passing-based model using invariants whose degree depends only on the size of a local neighborhood, rather than on the size of the full point cloud. Finally, we provide counterexamples showing MACE must compute high order irreducible representations to separate locally regular point clouds.

</details>


### [463] [Global Time-Aware Conditioning (GTC): A Mechanism for Time-Aware Pediatric Sleep Representation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26618)
*Saurav Raj Pandey,Harlin Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出全局时间感知条件机制(GTC)，将睡眠全局时间信息融入自监督学习框架，在多个儿科队列的五项临床任务上显著提升F1和AUPRC，且跨队列迁移性能稳健，验证了全局时间上下文对睡眠表征学习的价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 睡眠生理特征随夜间进程动态演变（睡眠周期、呼吸稳定性、心血管动态均随时间变化），但现有自监督学习方法仅处理固定时长的短窗口，缺乏对窗口在全夜睡眠中全局时间位置的显式建模，限制了表征能力。

Method: 设计全局时间感知条件(GTC)机制，通过将每个输入窗口的全局睡眠时间（time-of-sleep）作为条件注入潜在表征，补充局部位置编码。将GTC集成到三种典型SSL框架中（如对比学习、掩码建模等），在两个独立儿科队列的五项极度类别不平衡临床任务上评估。

Result: GTC在各架构和任务上普遍提升F1分数和AUPRC，性能增益在跨队列迁移实验中依然保持，表明引入全局时间上下文能有效改善睡眠表征学习的鲁棒性和泛化能力。

Conclusion: 全局时间上下文是睡眠表征学习的关键归纳偏置，GTC作为一种轻量级即插即用模块，能显著增强SSL模型对睡眠时程动态演变的捕捉能力，具有广泛的临床应用潜力。

Abstract: Sleep physiology evolves throughout the night, with changes in sleep cycles, respiratory stability, and cardiovascular dynamics. However, self-supervised learning (SSL) methods for sleep typically process short, fixed-duration windows without explicitly modeling where each window occurs within the full sleep session. We introduce Global Time-Aware Conditioning (GTC), a mechanism that complements local positional encodings by conditioning latent representations on the global time-of-sleep of each input window. We integrate GTC into three representative SSL frameworks and evaluate them on five clinically relevant tasks with extreme class imbalance across two independent pediatric cohorts. GTC generally improves F1 and AUPRC across architectures and tasks, with gains persisting under cross-cohort transfer, highlighting the value of global temporal context for sleep representation learning.

</details>


### [464] [SleepPairNet: Learning Multimodal Pediatric Sleep Representations with Random-Pair Cross-Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26628)
*Saurav Raj Pandey,Harlin Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SleepPairNet是一种多模态自监督学习框架，通过跨注意力学习生理睡眠信号的成对交互，采用随机模态对选择策略，在呼吸任务上超越基线，在EEG任务上保持竞争力，且在外部数据集上展现更强迁移性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分析生理睡眠信号对于评估睡眠质量和检测睡眠相关疾病至关重要。学习跨生理信号的模态间关系可以为下游睡眠分析提供更丰富的表示。

Method: 提出SleepPairNet，一种多模态自监督学习框架，通过跨注意力机制学习生理信号之间的成对交互。引入随机模态对选择策略，在预训练期间让模型接触多样化的信号对，从而在测试时实现跨模态组合的灵活性。

Result: 在NCH数据集上预训练后，SleepPairNet在所有呼吸任务上均优于评估的SSL基线，在EEG相关任务上保持竞争力，并在迁移到外部CHAT数据集时展现出更强的结果。

Conclusion: SleepPairNet通过跨注意力和随机模态对选择有效学习多模态睡眠信号表示，在呼吸任务上达到最优，在EEG任务上具有竞争力，且具备良好的跨数据集泛化能力。

Abstract: Analyzing physiological sleep signals is important for assessing sleep quality and detecting sleep-related disorders. Learning inter-modal relationships across physiological signals can provide richer representations for downstream sleep analysis. We introduce \textbf{SleepPairNet}, a multimodal self-supervised learning (SSL) framework that learns pairwise interactions between physiological signals through cross-attention. We propose a random modality-pair selection strategy that exposes the model to diverse signal pairs during pretraining, enabling flexibility across modality combinations at test time. Pretrained on the NCH dataset, SleepPairNet outperforms the evaluated SSL baselines on all respiratory tasks while remaining competitive on EEG-related tasks, and shows even stronger results when transferred to the external CHAT dataset.

</details>


### [465] [VaDar: Implicit Goal Conditioning via Value Disaggregation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26629)
*Shashwat Saxena,Mehul Goel,Sreyas Venkataraman,Sarvesh Patil,Max Simchowitz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: VaDar（Value Disaggregation）是一种新的强化学习方法，用于长时程任务。它训练单个与子目标无关的策略，通过最大化各子目标评论家价值的线性组合来工作。子目标信息仅在训练时需要，消除了部署时可能昂贵或繁琐的子目标选择需求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时程任务对现代AI和机器人技术很重要，但对强化学习构成挑战。传统方法将任务分解为子目标并学习子目标条件策略，但这需要在部署时进行子目标选择，可能成本高昂或繁琐。本文旨在探索是否可以仅在训练时使用子目标信息，同时保持或提升性能。

Method: 价值分解（VaDar）：训练单个与子目标无关的策略，以最大化各子目标评论家价值的线性组合。子目标信息仅用于训练阶段的评论家学习，策略本身不条件化于子目标。通过精心设计的实验，在多个基准上与目标条件化基线进行对比。

Result: VaDar始终具有竞争力，且经常优于目标条件化等自然基线；在具有非序列目标结构和多优化目标的任务上取得成功；特别是首个解决RoboCasa套件中具有挑战性的长时程任务的算法，即使从行为克隆预训练的近零初始任务成功率开始。

Conclusion: 子目标信息通过增强评论家学习的有效性来使Actor-Critic强化学习受益，而策略目标条件化通常是不必要的。VaDar的成功表明，将子目标信息仅限于训练时的评论家学习，可以简化部署并保持甚至提升长时程任务的性能。

Abstract: Long-horizon tasks are important for modern AI and robotics, yet pose a challenge for reinforcement learning. Historically, a popular approach has been to decompose a task into subgoals, and learn a subgoal-conditioned policy to execute each subtask in sequence.
  We introduce an alternative called Value Disaggregation (VaDar), which trains a single subgoal-independent policy to maximize a linear combination of per-subgoal critic values. Because subgoal information is needed only at training-time, VaDar removes the need for possibly costly or cumbersome subgoal-selection during policy deployment. Moreover, through careful experiments, we show that VaDar (1) is always competitive with, and frequently outperforms, natural baselines like goal-conditioning and (2) succeeds on tasks with non-sequential goal structure and multiple optimization objectives. In particular, VaDar is the first algorithm to solve challenging, long-horizon tasks in the RoboCasa suite, even when starting from a policy pretrained from behavior cloning with near-zero initial task success. Taken together, VaDar's successes suggest that subgoal information benefits actor-critic reinforcement learning by enhancing the efficacy of critic learning, whereas policy goal-conditioning is often unnecessary.

</details>


### [466] [The Effectiveness and Durability of Pretraining Data Filtering in Protein Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26651)
*Aaron Maiwald,Roderick McNeill,Jaeyoung Lee,Matthew A. Clarke,Lennart Justen,Alejandro Acelas,Ivo Andrews,Giles Harper-Donnelly,Adam Moore,Sophie Rose,Oliver M. Crook,Felix Jackson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究评估了预训练过滤作为开放权重蛋白语言模型安全防护的有效性、持久性和可扩展性。发现从预训练数据中过滤病毒蛋白可显著降低模型在病毒蛋白上的性能（掩码语言建模、突变效应预测、远程接触预测），同时基本保留非病毒蛋白性能。效果随模型规模（8M至3B参数）增大而增强，但微调仅需约80美元H100算力即可恢复性能，表明该防护不持久。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着开放权重语言模型的普及，预训练过滤被广泛用作安全防护手段，但其有效性、持久性和随规模变化的特性缺乏系统实证研究，特别是在生物序列模型领域。

Method: 使用ESM-2蛋白语言模型家族（8M至3B参数），从预训练数据中过滤病毒蛋白序列，评估模型在病毒蛋白与非病毒蛋白上的掩码语言建模、突变效应预测、远程接触预测任务性能变化；进一步测试在被过滤病毒家族序列上微调恢复性能的计算成本。

Result: 1. 过滤病毒蛋白显著降低病毒蛋白任务性能，非病毒蛋白性能基本不受影响；2. 效果集中于人类感染病毒蛋白；3. 随模型规模扩大，过滤效果增强，严格过滤更有效；4. 微调仅需约80美元H100时间即可完全恢复最大模型（3B）的性能，恢复成本随规模增长但保持低廉。

Conclusion: 预训练过滤可作为中等有效的选择性性能降级手段，但无法抵御拥有少量相关数据和适度算力的攻击者通过微调恢复能力，其持久性有限。

Abstract: Pretraining filtering is one of the most common safeguards for open-weight language models. Here we study its effectiveness, durability and scalability using the ESM-2 family of protein language models. We find that filtering viral proteins from the pretraining data meaningfully degrades masked language modelling, mutation effect prediction and long-range contact prediction on viral proteins, while largely preserving performance on non-viral proteins. These effects are concentrated among proteins from human-infecting viruses, and grow as we scale models from 8M to 3B parameters. As models increase in size, we find that stringent filtering becomes more effective. However, fine-tuning on sequences from the removed viral families restores the lost performance. Although the cost to recover performance increases with model scale, even for the largest models it costs about 80 USD of H100 time. This work establishes pretraining filtering as moderately effective at selectively degrading performance on viral proteins, but not durable against fine-tuning with modest computational resources and access to relevant data.

</details>


### [467] [Nested Shared-Operator Recursion on ARC-AGI-1: An Empirical Study of HRM, TRM and URM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26666)
*Sara Neri,Eugenio Gaeta,Andrea Ceschini,Andrea Facchinetti,Giuseppe Fico*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究在递归推理模型中引入持久中间状态（嵌套结构）是否能提升预测性能，在三种架构（HRM、TRM、URM）上进行参数量匹配的对比实验，结果显示嵌套变体在令牌准确率、预测损失和精确求解率上均无稳定优势，精确求解率接近零，假设仍待验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索在递归推理模型中，通过同一算子对更快状态的重复更新来整合持久中间状态（即嵌套层级结构），是否能在参数量相当的条件下提升模型的预测性能。

Method: 在三种架构（分层推理模型HRM、微型递归模型TRM、通用推理模型URM）中操作化定义并实现嵌套结构，使用官方代码库在ARC-AGI-1基准上，将各基线模型与其参数量匹配的嵌套变体进行对比。评估训练期间有演示的任务中保留的查询，实验预算为单GPU，远低于已发布的训练协议。

Result: 在测试条件下，嵌套变体在令牌准确率、预测损失和精确求解率上均未表现出一致优势，精确求解率对所有配置均接近零。结果未能证实假设，假设仍处于开放状态。

Conclusion: 作者指出需要进一步的确证性比较，包括信息量基线、多随机种子、隔离嵌套效应的控制实验以及预定义的评估标准，以确定这种组织结构是否值得进一步开发。

Abstract: Recursive reasoning models refine persistent internal states by repeatedly applying learned operators. We investigate whether adding a persistent intermediate state that integrates repeated updates of a faster state through the same operator improves predictive performance relative to each model family's baseline at matched parameter counts. We define this organisation operationally and implement it within three architectures: the Hierarchical Reasoning Model (HRM), Tiny Recursive Model (TRM) and Universal Reasoning Model (URM). Using the official codebases on ARC-AGI-1, we compare each baseline with its parameter-matched nested variant. We evaluate held-out queries from tasks whose demonstrations were available during training. The experiments use a single-GPU budget far below the published training protocols. Under the tested conditions, nested variants show no consistent advantage in token accuracy, predictive loss or exact solving, which remains near zero for all configurations. The results therefore leave the hypothesis open. We specify a confirmatory comparison, with an informative baseline, multiple seeds, controls that isolate nesting and predefined criteria, to determine whether this organisation merits further development.

</details>


### [468] [PACT: Plan-Augmented Coordination via Trace-Graphs for Dynamic Multi-Agent Combinatorial Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26671)
*Xiao Zhou,Alex Schutz,Victor-Alexandru Darvariu,Nick Hawes*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出PACT（基于轨迹图的计划增强协调），通过在环境图中添加表示智能体计划的辅助节点，并将其与资源节点连接以指示未来依赖关系，实现了多智能体在动态组合优化问题中的主动协调与冲突解决。实验表明，PACT在动态问题中显著优于基线方法，且在大规模实例上甚至超越拥有特权信息的集中式预言机。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的多智能体神经组合优化方法假设问题实例信息完全已知，但现实世界中的问题通常是动态的：相关信息随智能体行动逐步揭示（如路径规划中到达边才发现不可通行）。现有方法无法协调智能体探索和利用渐进揭示的信息，导致协作失败。

Method: PACT将环境图扩充为包含智能体计划节点的轨迹图：辅助节点表示各智能体的计划，并与资源节点连接以标记未来依赖。在此增广图上进行消息传递，将智能体间的协调建立在环境结构之上，实现主动而非被动的冲突解决。

Result: 在动态组合优化任务中，PACT的解决质量显著优于基线方法；且在迁移到更大规模实例时表现最佳，甚至超越了拥有实例不确定性特权访问权限的集中式预言机。

Conclusion: PACT通过计划增强的轨迹图和基于图的消息传递，有效解决了动态环境下多智能体协调的难题，实现了主动冲突解决和优越的泛化能力，为动态组合优化提供了新的范式。

Abstract: Multi-agent approaches have been investigated recently as a means of improving the scalability of reinforcement learning for neural combinatorial optimization. Existing methods assume that all problem instance information is known upfront. However, real-world problems are often dynamic: relevant information is progressively revealed as the agents take actions (e.g., arriving at an edge in a routing problem only to discover it is untraversable). In such cases, existing methods fail to coordinate agents to explore and exploit the progressively revealed information. To address the arising coordination challenge, we introduce PACT (Plan-Augmented Coordination via Trace-graphs). PACT augments the environment graph with auxiliary nodes representing the plans of agents, which are connected to the resource nodes to indicate future dependencies. The proposed message-passing scheme over the augmented graph grounds inter-agent coordination in the environment and enables proactive, rather than reactive, conflict resolution. We show that PACT improves solution quality in dynamic problems relative to baselines and exhibits the best transfer to larger instances on which, remarkably, it outperforms centralized oracles with privileged access to instance uncertainty.

</details>


### [469] [GeoSplit: Selective Edge--Server Map Acquisition for Cross-User Travel-Mode Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26707)
*Zepu Wang,Luyao Niu,Ruolin Li,Jeff,Ban*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: GeoSplit是一个边缘-服务器框架，用于出行模式识别，通过分离地图证据的效用、训练时迁移和运行时选择性获取，实现了通信高效的边缘-服务器推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决网络化移动感知中本地轨迹推断与远程地理空间上下文耦合的问题，使通信决策成为预测系统的一部分，旨在减少通信开销同时保持高识别精度。

Method: 提出GeoSplit框架，包含三个核心组件：地图证据效用分离、训练时知识蒸馏迁移、运行时基于熵门控的选择性查询接口。在GeoLife数据集（10%标签）上进行用户日分组和用户不相交分组两种评估设置。

Result: 未见用户下，完整地图上下文将macro-F1从0.7154提升至0.7864；地图感知蒸馏得到仅运动学生模型macro-F1 0.7225。熵门控选择性查询仅查询39.5%轨迹，macro-F1 0.7729接近全查询的0.7738，减少60.5%应用载荷。用户日分组下查询率21.6%时性能相近。学习价值估计和概率融合无持续改进。

Conclusion: GeoSplit展示了通信高效的边缘-服务器推理在智能交通感知任务中的有效性，通过选择性地图证据获取和知识蒸馏，在大幅降低通信成本的同时保持高精度识别。

Abstract: Networked mobility sensing couples local trajectory inference with remote geospatial context, making communication decisions part of the prediction system. We present GeoSplit, an edge--server framework for travel-mode recognition that separates the utility of map evidence, its training-time transfer, and its selective acquisition at runtime. On GeoLife with 10% labels, we evaluate these components under user-day and user-disjoint grouping. For unseen users, aligned full-map context raises macro-F1 from 0.7154 to 0.7864, while map-informed distillation yields a motion-only student at 0.7225. Through a compact query interface, entropy gating achieves 0.7729 macro-F1 versus 0.7738 for all queries, querying 39.5% of trajectories and reducing application payload by 60.5%. Under user-day grouping, selective and all-query scores are similarly close at a 21.6% query rate. Learned value estimation and probability fusion offer no consistent improvement. These results illustrate communication-efficient edge--server inference for an intelligent transportation sensing task.

</details>


### [470] [Doubly Robust Learning of Heterogeneous Survival Treatment Effects under Time-Varying Treatments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26710)
*Tomàs Garriga,Munib Mesinovic,Luke De Bretton-Gordon,Gerard Sanz,Axel Brando,Tingting Zhu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种新型双稳健学习器，用于在时变治疗和历史依赖性删失下估计异质生存治疗效应（HSTEs）。该框架将干预窗口与生存时限分离，确立了Neyman正交性、速率双稳健性和准谕示效率等理论性质，并通过数值实验验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的生存学习器多考虑单一基线治疗分配，而纵向治疗效应学习器通常假设结果无删失。但在实际医疗决策中，治疗决策、患者特征和删失概率常随时间共同演变，需要对治疗和删失进行序贯调整，这使得从时变治疗的时间到事件数据中估计异质生存治疗效应极具挑战性。

Method: 提出了一种双稳健学习器框架，将干预窗口（有限治疗期）与生存时限（之后遵循自然病程）分离。该框架适用于时变治疗和历史依赖性删失，利用灵活的机器学习模型进行干扰参数估计和治疗效应回归，并建立了Neyman正交性、速率双稳健性和准谕示效率等理论性质。

Result: 通过多项数值实验评估了该学习器，结果证明了其在估计异质生存治疗效应方面的有效性。

Conclusion: 该框架为时变治疗和历史依赖性删失下的异质生存治疗效应估计提供了一个理论扎实且实用有效的双稳健学习方法，可指导医疗决策如治疗序列选择。

Abstract: Estimating heterogeneous survival treatment effects (HSTEs) from time-to-event data under time-varying treatments is important in fields such as medicine (e.g., to decide which sequence of treatments is better in terms of survival probability). However, this task is challenging because treatment decisions, patient characteristics, and censoring probability often evolve together, requiring sequential adjustment for both treatments and censoring. Existing survival learners mostly consider a single baseline treatment assignment, while longitudinal treatment-effect learners typically assume uncensored outcomes. In this paper, we introduce a novel doubly robust learner for heterogeneous survival treatment effects under time-varying treatments and history-dependent censoring. Our framework separates the intervention window from the survival horizon, with treatment prescribed for a finite period, after which care follows its natural course. We further establish the favorable theoretical properties of Neyman-orthogonality, rate double robustness and quasi-oracle efficiency. The framework accommodates flexible machine learning models for nuisance estimation and treatment-effect regression. We evaluate our learners through several numerical experiments, demonstrating their effectiveness.

</details>


### [471] [Deep Pontryagin Learning for Continuous-Time Stochastic Control with Jumps](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26718)
*Jean-Loup Dupret,Patrick Cheridito*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种深度庞特里亚金学习框架，用于高维连续时间随机控制问题，自然适应跳扩散过程。该方法将伴随学习与策略改进分离，通过显式引入庞特里亚金随机最大原理的状态敏感性信息，避免了直接策略优化中对整个时间离散化动力学的重复微分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 直接策略优化需要对整个时间离散化动力学进行反复微分，计算成本高且难以扩展到高维问题。本文旨在开发一种更高效、稳定且可扩展的方法，利用庞特里亚金最大原理将伴随学习与策略改进解耦，显式利用状态敏感性信息。

Method: 对于固定的马尔可夫控制，首先沿模拟状态轨迹通过时间反向传播奖励计算路径伴随标签，然后通过监督回归将这些标签投影到马尔可夫状态上。随后通过强制点wise汉密尔顿平稳条件更新控制。

Result: 理论上证明了投影伴随过程满足离散时间庞特里亚金原理，且当时间步长趋于零时收敛到对应的连续时间伴随反向随机微分方程的解。数值实验展示了该方法的准确性、稳定性和可扩展性。

Conclusion: 深度庞特里亚金学习框架为高维连续时间随机控制问题提供了一种原理化、可扩展且数值稳健的解决方案，特别适合跳扩散模型，在理论收敛性和实际性能上均优于直接策略优化方法。

Abstract: We develop a deep Pontryagin learning framework for high-dimensional continuous-time stochastic control problems that naturally accommodates jump-diffusions. In contrast to direct policy optimization, which repeatedly differentiates the objective through the entire time-discretized dynamics, our method separates adjoint learning from policy improvement by explicitly incorporating state-sensitivity information from the Pontryagin stochastic maximum principle. For a fixed Markov control, we first compute pathwise adjoint labels by backpropagating the reward through time along simulated state trajectories, and project these labels onto the Markov state through a supervised regression step. The control is then updated by enforcing the pointwise Hamiltonian stationarity condition. We prove that the resulting projected adjoint process satisfies a discrete-time Pontryagin principle and converges, as the time step tends to zero, to the solution of the corresponding continuous-time adjoint backward stochastic differential equation. Numerical experiments illustrate the accuracy, stability, and scalability of the approach.

</details>


### [472] [Cross-Fitting for Neural Posterior Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26733)
*Jeffrey Regier*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了交叉拟合神经后验估计（CF-NPE），通过K折交叉拟合将后验均值估计与高阶矩估计分离，解决了标准NPE在有限模拟数据下过度自信且校准不良的问题，在高维、模拟受限场景中显著提升举出对数似然和校准性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准神经后验估计（NPE）基于模拟完整数据训练条件密度估计器，其对数似然训练目标会导致模型对训练点分配任意高的密度，而正则化流、高斯编码器等灵活估计器极易过拟合，产生极端过度自信的后验近似。早停等正则化手段只能在不利的优化轨迹上选择模型，导致后验均值欠拟合而方差过拟合的权衡，无法同时优化均值和高阶矩估计。

Method: CF-NPE采用K折交叉拟合策略：首先训练K个后验均值回归器，每个回归器在K-1折数据上训练并预测剩余一折的均值；然后收集所有折的折外残差，在此基础上训练条件密度估计器建模后验的高阶矩（如方差、协方差结构）。这种样本分离机制将条件均值估计与残差分布估计解耦，避免了联合优化中的均值-方差权衡。

Result: 在合成数据实验和宇宙学应用中，CF-NPE的举出对数似然显著高于标准NPE，且通常改善了后验校准性能（如覆盖率更接近名义水平）。优势在高维参数空间和模拟预算有限的设置下最为明显。

Conclusion: CF-NPE通过交叉拟合将后验均值估计与残差分布建模分离，有效缓解了NPE在有限模拟数据下的过度自信和校准失效问题，为高维、模拟受限的科学推断任务提供了更稳健的摊销后验估计方法。

Abstract: Neural Posterior Estimation (NPE) fits an amortized conditional density estimator to a simulated training set of complete-data realizations. NPE's training objective, log-likelihood, favors posterior approximations that assign arbitrarily high density to the training points, and typical families of amortized conditional density estimators (e.g., normalizing flows, Gaussian encoders) are flexible enough to oblige. The resulting policy of extreme overconfidence translates poorly to held-out data. Early stopping and other regularizers can prevent this degeneracy, but they are limited to selecting posterior approximations along an unfavorable optimization trajectory set by in-sample residuals, where the posterior mean is underfit while the posterior variance is overfit. To avoid this trade-off, we propose Cross-Fitting NPE (CF-NPE), which uses sample splitting to separate conditional-mean estimation from the estimation of the posterior's higher moments. Using $K$-fold cross-fitting, CF-NPE fits $K$ posterior-mean regressors and then fits a conditional density estimator to the resulting out-of-fold residuals. In experiments with synthetic data and in a cosmological application, CF-NPE achieves higher held-out log-likelihood than standard NPE and typically improves calibration. CF-NPE is most useful in high-dimensional, simulation-limited settings.

</details>


### [473] [CAVA: Complementary-Label-Aware Data Valuation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26734)
*Tan-Ha Mai,Hsuan-Tien Lin,Vu Nguyen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 CAVA 方法，通过互补标签成本和标签边际解决最优传输数据估值在互补标签学习中的语义不匹配问题，实现对角噪声的准确检测与样本回收，显著提升 CLL 性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 互补标签学习（CLL）虽标注成本低，但众包或视觉语言模型易将真实类别误标为互补标签（对角噪声），导致模型被显式训练抑制正确答案。直接迁移最优传输（OT）数据估值存在语义不匹配：训练中标签 c 表示“非类别 c”，验证集中却表示“类别 c”，导致 OT 标签组成为噪声混合物，评分仅在高噪声下有效，在实际低噪声率（<1/M）下甚至反向失效。

Method: 提出 CAVA，引入互补标签成本与标签边际，将每个互补标签对传输势能的贡献解耦。标签边际在各噪声率下保持方向一致，支持无参数阈值的闭式精度检测对角噪声，并将检出样本回收为普通标签监督。

Result: 在合成与人工标注基准上，CAVA 几乎完美分离对角噪声，而直接迁移的 OT 估值甚至劣于随机。仅用少量干净验证数据，即改进所有评测的 CLL 目标。

Conclusion: 显式建模互补监督语义后，基于最优传输的数据估值变得可靠，CAVA 为大规模低成本 CLL 标注提供了鲁棒的噪声处理方案。

Abstract: Complementary-label learning (CLL) trains a classifier from labels that name a class an instance does not belong to. Such labels are cheap to collect from crowdworkers or vision-language models (VLMs), making them attractive for large-scale annotation. However, both sources can mistakenly assign the true class as the complementary label. Such annotation errors are particularly harmful in CLL because the model is explicitly trained to suppress the correct answer. Optimal transport (OT) data valuation identifies harmful samples by comparing training data with a clean validation set, but transferring it directly to CLL creates a semantic mismatch: label $c$ means not class $c$ in the training but class $c$ in the validation. We show that this makes the OT label groups noisy mixtures whose behavior depends on the noise rate. The transferred score is informative only at sufficiently high noise, becomes uninformative at the crossover rate $1/M$ for $M$ classes, and reverses below it, where practical CLL annotation typically operates. We propose CAVA, which introduces a complementary label cost and a label margin that isolates the contribution of each complementary label to the transport potential. The margin keeps a consistent direction across noise rates, detects diagonal noise with a parameter-free threshold of closed-form precision, and allows detected samples to be recycled as ordinary-label supervision. On synthetic and human-annotated benchmarks, CAVA separates diagonal noise almost perfectly where directly transferred OT valuation performs worse than random. With only a fraction of the clean validation data, it also improves every CLL objective we evaluate, showing that OT-based valuation becomes reliable once the semantics of complementary supervision are modeled explicitly.

</details>


### [474] [Trajectory Replay: Continuous-Time Mixture Transport for Lifelong Generative Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26749)
*Alessandro Palma,Charles Jones,Tristan Cinquin,Fabian J. Theis,Frederik Wenkel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出轨迹回放方法，用于持续学习中适应预训练的连续时间生成模型到顺序到来的数据，避免遗忘早期任务。该方法通过训练更新后的速度场匹配冻结的历史速度场及新任务速度场，结合稳定性-可塑性系数加权，实现了历史轨迹的高效复现，仅需少量网络评估即可访问历史轨迹。实验表明其在类别增量图像生成及生物学案例研究中优于生成回放和蒸馏基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 持续学习中，预训练的连续时间生成模型需适应顺序到来的数据而不遗忘早期任务。现有的生成回放策略虽利用生成模型合成历史样本辅助更新，但每个训练步骤都需完整轨迹模拟，累积离散化误差且可能退化历史分布。因此需要一种更高效、低误差的方法来复现历史轨迹。

Method: 提出轨迹回放：训练更新后的速度场，使其同时匹配冻结的历史速度场沿其轨迹的输出与新任务的速度场，通过稳定性-可塑性系数加权平衡。从连续时间传输视角证明，最优解按各自密度平均两个任务速度场，生成其概率路径的混合。结合均值速度蒸馏，仅需少量网络评估即可访问历史轨迹。

Result: 在类别增量图像生成基准上，轨迹回放优于生成回放和蒸馏基线。在两个生物学案例研究中，该方法将生成扰动模型扩展至新上下文和实验批次，跨越两种数据模态，同时保持治疗效应预测性能。

Conclusion: 轨迹回放通过直接匹配速度场而非生成样本，有效解决了生成回放的离散化误差累积和计算开销问题，实现了高效且高保真的持续学习，适用于图像生成及生物学数据建模等场景。

Abstract: Adapting pre-trained continuous-time generative models to sequentially incoming data without forgetting earlier tasks is a central challenge in lifelong learning. A leading strategy, generative replay, uses a generative model trained on historical tasks to augment its own continual update with synthetic samples from experience. However, it requires full trajectory simulations at every training step, which accumulate discretization errors and can degrade the replayed historical distribution. Here, we propose trajectory replay, which bypasses sample generation by training an updated velocity field to match both a frozen historical velocity along its trajectories and the incoming task's velocity field, weighted by a stability-plasticity coefficient. Through the lens of continuous-time transport, we show the resulting optimum averages the two task velocities by their respective densities and generates the mixture of their probability paths. Combined with mean velocity distillation, trajectory replay accesses historical trajectories using only a few network evaluations per continual update. Empirically, it outperforms generative replay and distillation baselines on class-incremental image generation. In two biological case studies, trajectory replay extends generative perturbation models to new contexts and experimental batches across two data modalities while preserving treatment-effect prediction.

</details>


### [475] [Simulation Priors for Rapid Adaptation in Model-Based RL for Autonomous Racing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26757)
*Adrian Remonda,Jiajun Xi,Nicklas Hansen,Marcus Greiff,Thomas Lew,John Talbot,John Subosits,Xiaolong Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PIA 是一个离线到在线的模型型强化学习框架，通过在异构低/高保真仿真轨迹上预训练世界模型，再利用不确定性正则化规划在有限真实交互中快速适应，将仿真轨迹视为有偏先验并在线修正残差失配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强化学习依赖大量交互数据，在物理系统中数据收集成本高且故障不安全，因此需要一种能在极少真实交互下快速适应的方法。

Method: 1. 在混合低保真和高保真仿真轨迹上预训练世界模型；2. 将仿真轨迹视为有偏先验；3. 通过不确定性正则化规划在有限目标域交互中在线适应模型，修正残差失配。

Result: 仿真实验中，PIA 在赛道和路面变化下适应更快，单圈时间更短且故障更少；实车实验中，在不到一小时车上交互下实现可靠的少样本适应。

Conclusion: PIA 通过利用有偏仿真先验并结合在线不确定性感知修正，实现了高效的仿真到现实迁移，在自动驾驶赛车任务中以极少的真实数据达到高性能控制。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning enables learning high-performance control policies, but its reliance on extensive interaction limits deployment on physical systems where data collection is costly, and failures are unsafe. We introduce Prior-Informed Adaptation (PIA), an offline-to-online model-based RL framework that uses structured simulation priors for rapid adaptation. PIA pretrains a world model on heterogeneous low- and high-fidelity simulated trajectories, then adapts it with limited target-domain interaction using uncertainty-regularized planning. Rather than requiring an accurate simulator for policy transfer, PIA treats simulated trajectories as biased priors whose residual mismatch is corrected during online adaptation. We evaluate PIA in autonomous racing using high-fidelity simulation and on a real full-size autonomous race car. In simulation, PIA adapts faster across track and surface shifts than strong baselines, achieving lower lap times and fewer failures. On hardware, PIA achieves reliable few-shot adaptation with less than one hour of on-vehicle interaction.

</details>


### [476] [Topological Sheaves of Irreducibility: A Theoretical Framework for Multi-Agent Task Obstructions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26777)
*Steven Motta,Davide Mambelli,Alessandro Rozza*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出拓扑层束不可约性(TSI)框架,利用层上同调分离任务兼容性障碍与系统能力,为多智能体系统中的高阶交互提供可证伪的测试。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多智能体系统在相同智能体和通信预算下,因支持不同联合交互形式而表现差异;缺乏统一理论框架区分任务层面的兼容性障碍与系统固有能力。

Method: 引入交互复形K和容量层束F,利用非零上同调H^n(K;F)定义结构签名;通过注册干预测试能力;余循环数据的余链实现当且仅当上同调类消失时可解;度-1化约产生循环空间见证与观测需求。

Result: 在15,625个度-1输入上,全智能体加性基元完美解决决策与修复;最优成对系统决策准确率88.80%(仅高出基线0.01%),修复率26.63%。在531,441个度-2四面体边界任务上,同2-骨架系统保留所有四个三智能体基元却匹配成对最优;添加填充类的四智能体基元使两任务均精确求解。状态保持鲁棒性检查保持精确性能,但未与类恢复消融成本匹配。

Conclusion: 在给定注册基元和成本模型下,TSI提供了面向任务的、可证伪的高阶交互测试,揭示了结构签名的层束相对性,为多智能体系统能力评估提供了拓扑工具。

Abstract: Multi-agent systems can differ under identical agents and communication budgets when they support different forms of joint interaction. We introduce Topological Sheaves of Irreducibility (TSI), a sheaf-theoretic framework separating task-level compatibility obstructions from system capability. A task is represented by an interaction complex $K$ and a capacity sheaf $\mathcal{F}$; nonzero $H^n(K;\mathcal{F})$ defines a structural signature, while registered interventions test capability. For cocycle data, cochain realization is solvable exactly when the represented cohomology class vanishes. Examples show that the signature is sheaf-relative, and the degree-1 reduction yields cycle-space witnesses and observation requirements. We evaluate two finite one-round models. Across 15,625 degree-1 inputs, an all-agent additive primitive solves decision and repair exactly; the optimal pairwise system reaches 88.80% on decision, one input above the 88.79% majority-class baseline, and 26.63% on repair. On a degree-2 tetrahedral-boundary task over 531,441 inputs, the same-2-skeleton system retains all four three-agent primitives yet matches the pairwise-only optimum throughout the registered separation window, whereas adding the class-filling four-agent primitive makes both tasks exact. Status-preserving robustness checks retain exact performance but are not cost-matched to the class-restoring ablation. Conditional on the registered primitives and cost models, TSI provides task-relative, falsifiable tests of higher-order interaction.

</details>


### [477] [Training with ML-labeled Data via Stochastic First- and Zeroth-Order Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26790)
*Maria-Eleni Sfyraki,Jun-Kun Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文针对真实标签获取成本高、规模化困难的问题，提出了一阶和零阶随机优化方法，用于在混合真实标签与机器学习预测标签的数据集上训练模型，并通过从线性回归到大语言模型微调的实验验证了算法的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 获取地面真实标签通常需要大量人工标注，成本高昂且难以规模化。当存在大量待标注数据点时，人工标注的可扩展性成为瓶颈。因此，研究如何利用少量真实标签与大量机器生成的（可能含噪）标签混合训练模型，具有重要的实际意义。

Method: 提出了一阶随机优化方法和零阶随机优化方法，适用于包含真实标签样本和机器学习预测标签样本的混合数据集。这些方法在训练过程中同时处理两类样本，旨在缓解预测标签可能带来的噪声影响。

Result: 通过从线性回归模型训练到大语言模型（LLM）微调的全面实证研究，展示了所提算法在含机器标签数据上的训练有效性，验证了方法在不同模型规模和任务下的鲁棒性与实用性。

Conclusion: 该工作为利用机器生成标签辅助模型训练提供了理论地优化框架和实用算法，降低了对大量人工标注的依赖，为大规模机器学习应用中的标注成本问题提供了解决思路。

Abstract: Training a machine learning (ML) model is an optimization process that typically requires a set of examples with ground-truth labels beforehand. Obtaining these ground truths usually requires laborious human effort and can be costly. The scalability of human labeling becomes a concern when there are a large number of data points that need to be labeled. To address this practical issue, we consider an optimization setting where a subset of samples has ground-truth labels, while the remaining data points were labeled by an ML predictor, which could potentially assign incorrect labels to those points. We propose both first-order and zeroth-order stochastic optimization methods for training on datasets consisting of a mix of true-labeled and ML-labeled samples. We further conduct comprehensive empirical studies from training a linear regression model to fine-tuning a large language model (LLM) to showcase the effectiveness of the proposed algorithms for training with ML-labeled data.

</details>


### [478] [On Data Scaling in Tabular ML: More Data, Better Generalization?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26794)
*Ivan Rubachev,Nikita Lazarev,Artem Babenko*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了大规模表格数据（高达1000万样本）下的训练数据缩放行为，对比了GBDT、MLP和表格基础模型在分布偏移下的性能表现，发现模型容量、验证数据使用策略对OOD泛化有关键影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有表格机器学习研究缺乏大规模（1M+）真实数据集的系统性评估，特别是缺乏对训练数据规模扩展、自然分布偏移及验证策略交互作用的深入理解。

Method: 构建8个真实大规模表格数据集（含自然分布偏移），采用随机分割作为对照。系统对比GBDT、MLP和表格基础模型的缩放趋势；通过MLP容量扫描、验证分布对比（调优/早停分布）、验证数据使用范式对比（模型选择vs上下文学习）分析分布偏移下的缩放动态。

Result: GBDT和MLP呈现相似缩放趋势，均从更多数据和算法改进获益。表格基础模型缩放行为差异大，新版本更稳定受益于大上下文。关键发现：小规模时ID/OOD性能同步提升，大规模时可能分离；MLP若用代表评估条件的验证集选择，随数据增长性能维持/提升；基础模型虽因上下文包含OOD样本而提升，但无法阻止随训练规模增大而性能恶化。

Conclusion: 大规模表格学习中，分布偏移下的缩放行为呈现复杂模式：模型架构、容量配置、验证数据代表性及使用方式（模型选择vs上下文学习）共同决定OOD泛化上限。单纯扩大训练数据不可保证OOD性能提升，需协同设计验证策略与模型容量。

Abstract: Recent work in tabular machine learning has emphasized the importance of diverse and realistic evaluation settings. The niche of large-scale (1M+) data, however, remains under-explored. To study training-data scaling, we assemble eight real-world tabular datasets with up to around ten million training examples, retaining the natural distribution shifts of the tasks and using random-split evaluation as a control. We find that GBDTs and MLP-based models show broadly similar scaling trends, with gains from both additional training data and algorithmic improvements. Tabular foundation models show more varied scaling behavior, with recent versions benefiting more consistently from larger contexts even under distribution shift. However, scaling training data under distribution shift introduces new challenges: in-distribution and out-of-distribution performance mostly improve together at smaller scales but can diverge at larger scales. We examine this through MLP capacity sweeps and comparisons of the validation distributions used for tuning and early stopping in MLPs and GBDTs. We also compare common practices of using validation data, contrasting its use for model selection in MLP pipelines with using it for in-context fitting in tabular foundation model pipelines. Under stronger shifts, MLPs selected using validation representative of the evaluation conditions generally maintain or improve performance as training data grows. In contrast, including such examples in context improves foundation-model performance, but does not prevent deterioration with increasing training size in our experiments.

</details>


### [479] [Two hidden layer suffice: the caterpillar net](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26795)
*Jakob Paul Zimmermann*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为 Caterpillar Net 的非递归构造，用于在两层隐藏层的 ReLU 神经网络中实现 N 个输入的最大值运算，隐藏层宽度分别为 O(N^2) 和 2^{O(N log N)}，该构造具有直接的几何解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 连续分段线性（CPWL）函数可表示为仿射函数最大值的有限符号和，因此最大值表示是研究 ReLU 网络表达能力的核心问题。先前关于最大值运算需要对数深度的猜想已被推翻，且 Brunck 等人（2026）证明了两层隐藏层足以表示一般 CPWL 函数，这启发了本文寻找一种显式的、非递归的两层最大值构造。

Method: 提出 Caterpillar Net 构造：一种非递归的网络结构，用两层隐藏层实现 N 个输入的最大值。第一层宽度为 O(N^2)，第二层宽度为 2^{O(N log N)}。该构造基于几何解释，直接构建而非通过递归或归纳方式。

Result: 成功给出了最大值运算的显式两层隐藏层构造，隐藏层宽度分别为 O(N^2) 和 2^{O(N log N)}，且具有直接的几何解释，验证了两层网络足以高效表示最大值运算。

Conclusion: Caterpillar Net 为最大值运算提供了一个具体的、非递归的两层 ReLU 网络实现，推进了对 ReLU 网络表达能力的理解，尤其是深度与宽度权衡及几何解释方面。

Abstract: Every continuous piecewise linear (CPWL) function is a finite signed sum of maxima of affine functions, making maximum representation a central problem in the study of the expressiveness of ReLU networks. A now-disproved conjecture predicted logarithmic depth for maxima. Inspired by the proof by Brunck et al. (2026) that two hidden layers suffice for general CPWL functions, we give the Caterpillar Net, a nonrecursive construction for the maximum of $N$ inputs with two hidden layers of widths $O(N^2)$ and $2^{O(N\log N)}$. The construction has a direct geometric interpretation.

</details>


### [480] [Learning to Refer: Inference-Time Collaboration in Decentralized Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26800)
*Yuheng Ma,Chendi Wang,Qiong Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: EdgeDRM 是一种去中心化联邦学习推理时协作框架，通过图约束的专家推荐路由，利用邻居间的密度势能差异实现查询路由，无需中心协调即可聚合分布式专长。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在去中心化联邦学习中，异构客户端可能发展出互补专长，但查询通常仅由到达的客户端评估，导致分布式专长未被充分利用。现有方法缺乏无需全局协调的推理时协作机制。

Method: 将推理时协作建模为预算受限的本地专家推荐，即图约束路由过程。EdgeDRM 为每个客户端学习基于密度的路由势能，利用邻居势能差异选择后续推荐，沿路由聚合本地任务模型预测。训练和推理均去中心化，仅使用邻居本地信息。

Result: 在基准和真实医疗数据实验中，EdgeDRM 在大多数设置下优于图匹配的去中心化基线，在稀疏连接下优势最明显。理论上建立了学习比较的估计保证，并刻画了本地改进和图结构如何决定先验加权密度增益。

Conclusion: EdgeDRM 通过密度势能驱动的去中心化路由，有效利用分布式专长，无需中心路由器或全局评分，在稀疏图结构下表现尤为突出，为去中心化联邦学习推理协作提供了可扩展且理论有保证的解决方案。

Abstract: In decentralized federated learning, heterogeneous clients may develop complementary expertise, yet each query is typically evaluated only by the client where it arrives. To exploit this distributed expertise without global coordination, we formulate inference-time collaboration as budgeted local expert referral, a graph-constrained routing process in which a query can move only between neighboring clients and only visited clients contribute to its final prediction. EdgeDRM implements this framework by learning a density-based routing potential for each client: differences between neighboring potentials provide the comparisons used to select successive referrals, while local task models generate predictions that are aggregated along the resulting route. Both training and inference are decentralized, using only neighbor-local information without a central router or graph-wide client scoring. We establish estimation guarantees for the learned comparisons and characterize how local improvement and graph structure govern prior-weighted density gains from referral. Experiments on benchmark and real-world medical data show that EdgeDRM outperforms graph-matched decentralized baselines in most settings, with the clearest benefits under sparse connectivity.

</details>


### [481] [Scaling Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning for Brain Encoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26802)
*Zhuofan Josh Ying,Guanglong Sun,Nolan Ho,Kieran Liu,Rui Yang,Andrew Chen,Nikolaus Kriegeskorte,Pony Ma,Hossein Adeli*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出BrainLoRA，利用参数高效微调（PEFT，具体为LoRA）将大规模多模态预训练主干网络（高达104B参数）适配于脑编码任务。通过利用主干网络的因果结构一次性预测多个时间点，大幅降低特征提取成本。在Algonauts 2025挑战赛上达到最优发表性能，并开发多LoRA内核实现200+模型集成训练，登上公开排行榜榜首。同时保持模型可解释性：模态归因恢复经典感觉拓扑，神经适应增强音频输入贡献及跨模态混合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 脑编码模型旨在预测神经对刺激的响应。主流方法冻结预训练主干仅训练读出层，而从头训练或全量微调大模型因神经数据昂贵稀缺而困难。需要一种能有效利用有限神经数据、以极少可训练参数适配超大规模预训练主干的方法，同时保持计算可行性与模型可解释性。

Method: 1. 采用低秩适配器（LoRA）+轻量读出层进行参数高效微调（PEFT），仅训练极少参数。2. 利用主干网络因果结构，一次前向传播预测多个时间点，替代滑动窗口，大幅降低特征提取开销。3. 开发多LoRA内核，在共享主干上联合加速训练多个LoRA，实现200+模型集成。4. 在九种多模态主干（含Qwen3-Omni等）上验证，规模达104B参数。

Result: • 在相同Qwen3-Omni主干上，BrainLoRA达到Algonauts 2025挑战赛最优发表性能。• 多LoRA集成（200+模型）在挑战赛后公开排行榜排名第一。• 适配后的多模态主干保持可解释性：模态归因恢复经典感觉拓扑（以往需单独单模态编码器构造），神经适应增加音频输入贡献及主干内跨模态混合。• 九种多模态主干上性能一致提升。

Conclusion: 参数高效微调（PEFT）是脑编码任务的高效强范式：能以极少可训练参数有效适配超大规模预训练多模态主干，在受限神经数据下显著提升编码性能，同时保持模型可解释性。多LoRA内核进一步规模化集成训练，推动脑编码模型向更大规模、更高性能发展。

Abstract: Brain encoding models aim to predict neural responses to stimuli. The most widely used approach fits readouts from frozen pretrained backbones. Using neural data to train large models from scratch or fully fine-tune them after task-pretraining has proven difficult because neural data is costly and limited. We show that parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) enables us to effectively adapt very large pretrained backbones for brain encoding with a small number of trainable parameters. To make it computationally practical, we exploit the backbone's causal structure to predict multiple timepoints in a single pass instead of using sliding windows, significantly reducing feature-extraction cost. This enables efficient fine-tuning of multimodal backbones with up to 104B parameters, the largest model adapted for brain encoding to our knowledge. Trained with a low-rank adapter (LoRA) and a lightweight readout, our approach consistently improves brain encoding performance across nine diverse multimodal backbones. On the same Qwen3-Omni backbone as the prior state-of-the-art (SoTA), our method BrainLoRA achieves the best published performance on the Algonauts 2025 Challenge. We also show the adapted multimodal backbones remain interpretable: modality attribution recovers the canonical sensory topography that prior work often obtains by construction from separate unimodal encoders, and neural adaptation increases the contribution of audio inputs and cross-modal mixing within the backbone. To scale out the number of adapted models, we develop a multi-LoRA kernel that accelerates joint training of multiple LoRAs on a shared backbone. This enables an ensemble of 200+ adapted models that ranks first on the public Algonauts post-challenge leaderboard at the time of writing. Together, our results highlight PEFT as an efficient and powerful paradigm for brain encoding.

</details>


### [482] [Kronecker Delta Rule for Long Context Linear Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26834)
*Anamaria-Roberta Hartl,Levente Zólyomi,Michael List,Günter Klambauer,Sebastian Böck,Sepp Hochreiter*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 KronLSTM，一种基于克罗内克尔三角法则的线性注意力架构，通过极简侵入式的记忆修订机制实现稳定的长上下文建模，无需额外归一化即可保持记忆矩阵范数有界，性能优于现有 DeltaNet 等线性注意力模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的线性注意力架构（如 DeltaNet）在长上下文建模中存在记忆干扰和不稳定问题，需要额外的归一化和稳定化机制。作者旨在设计一种解析上可处理、记忆动态稳定且干扰最小的关联记忆更新规则。

Method: 提出克罗内克尔三角法则作为关联矩阵记忆的新型更新规则，扩展 xLSTM 族，引入仅沿矩阵空间单一方向修改记忆的记忆修订机制。将记忆动态建模为收敛于稳态分布的马尔可夫链，证明记忆矩阵期望范数在整个序列中一致有界，从而避免额外归一化。

Result: 实验表明 KronLSTM 在长上下文基准上表现尤为强劲，具有竞争力且常超越现有线性注意力架构（包括 Gated DeltaNet 等），确立了克罗内克尔三角法则作为稳定关联记忆的有效且解析可处理的基础。

Conclusion: KronLSTM 通过克罗内克尔三角法则实现了稳定、低干扰的关联记忆更新，为循环线性注意力架构提供了理论上可保证的长上下文建模能力，代码与模型已开源。

Abstract: We propose KronLSTM, a linear attention architecture based on the Kronecker Delta Rule, a novel update rule for associative matrix memories. KronLSTM extends the xLSTM family with a memory-revision mechanism that corrects targeted associations while modifying the memory only along a single direction in matrix space. This minimally invasive memory revision reduces interference with previously stored information compared with delta-rule updates, making it particularly well suited for long-context language modeling. The resulting memory dynamics can be mathematically described as a Markov chain that converges to a steady-state distribution, while the expected norm of the memory matrix remains uniformly bounded throughout the entire input sequence. Hence, KronLSTM ensures stable memory dynamics without requiring additional normalization and stabilization mechanisms for the memory state. Experiments show that KronLSTM is competitive with, and often outperforms, existing linear attention architectures, including models of the (Gated) DeltaNet family, with particularly strong performance on long context benchmarks. These results establish the Kronecker Delta Rule as an effective and analytically tractable foundation for stable associative memory in recurrent linear attention architectures. Our code (https://github.com/NX-AI/KronLSTM) and models (https://huggingface.co/collections/NX-AI/kronlstm) are open-source.

</details>


### [483] [Text-to-Image Generative Modeling Without Language Pretraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26863)
*Keshigeyan Chandrasegaran,Yue Zhao,Armin W. Thomas,Ehsan Adeli,Jiajun Wu,Juan Carlos Niebles,Li Fei-Fei,Michael Poli*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Halcyon 系列模型从零开始在 1 亿图文对上预训练，无需大规模语言预训练，即可在更少算力下超越现有 SOTA 文生图模型，并同时具备图像字幕能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究大规模语言预训练是否为强文生图系统的必要条件，验证从零开始的多模态联合预训练是否能达到甚至超越依赖语言预训练的方法。

Method: 提出 Halcyon 系列早期融合多模态自回归模型，在 GPIC 数据集（1 亿图文对）上从头预训练；对比实验中移除文本仅预训练，并通过替换 caption dropout 为 I2T 监督引入图像字幕任务。

Result: Halcyon-0.52B 在 gFD 指标上以 63.3 超过 LlamaGen-XL/8 的 48.0，预训练算力减少 18.2 倍；Halcyon-1.6B 以 41.0 超过 JiT-T2I-XXL/8++ 的 35.3，算力减少 275 倍；文本仅预训练不提升文生图性能；加入 I2T 监督后保持竞争力的文生图质量并获得字幕能力。

Conclusion: 强文生图系统无需互联网规模语言预训练，从零开始的多模态联合预训练即可实现更高效、更优的性能，且可自然扩展至图文双向生成。

Abstract: Modern text-to-image (T2I) systems use internet-scale language pretraining for text-conditioned image generation. We ask whether language pretraining is necessary for strong T2I generation. We introduce Halcyon, a family of early-fusion multimodal autoregressive models pretrained entirely from scratch on GPIC, a dataset of 100M image-text pairs.
