Halcyon-0.52B outperforms LlamaGen-XL/8 (48.0 vs. 63.3 gFD) with 18.2$\times$ less pretraining compute. Further, Halcyon-1.6B outperforms JiT-T2I-XXL/8++ (35.3 vs. 41.0 gFD) with 275$\times$ less pretraining compute. Controlled experiments show that text-only pretraining does not improve T2I generation. Halcyon also learns image captioning by replacing caption dropout with I2T supervision, maintaining competitive T2I generation quality under the same pretraining budget. We show that strong T2I systems can be trained from scratch without internet-scale language pretraining. Code and models are available at https://cs.stanford.edu/~keshik/halcyon

</details>


<div id='cs.IR'></div>

# cs.IR [[Back]](#toc)

### [484] [When Does Evidence-Graph Structure Predict Answer Correctness? Label-Free Abstention for Structured Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24030)
*Anjan Goswami*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需训练的弃权方法，利用证据图中的边界切割来评估检索答案的可信度，在多跳问答基准上显著提升精确率-覆盖率曲线下面积，且无需标签或置信度模型训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 检索系统返回的高分答案不一定可信，现有方法依赖置信度模型训练或正确性标签，缺乏轻量级、可审计的事后弃权机制。

Method: 基于证据图的边界切割方法：计算选中候选与未选候选之间的加权切割作为弃权信号，利用图结构闭包特性，无需正确性标签或置信度模型训练。

Result: 在MemoryAgentBench FactConsolidation多跳任务上，AUC从0.736提升至0.785（+0.049，95% CI [+0.008, +0.092]），原始评估下提升0.108；零切割子集含71/400查询且观测精确率100%；有监督梯度提升选择器在检索栈匹配时达0.814，略高于边界切割的0.785。

Conclusion: 证据图的结构闭包可支持轻量级弃权，但有效性取决于图构建、边语义和关系；类型结构本身不足以保证有用的置信度；边界切割为利用现有证据图进行无额外模型推理的可审计弃权提供了实证指导。

Abstract: Retrieval systems return scored answers, but a high score does not show that an answer should be trusted. The proposed training-free abstention method applies the boundary cut to the selected evidence in an evidence graph. The signal is the weighted cut between selected and unselected candidates and requires no correctness labels or confidence-model training. On MemoryAgentBench (MAB) FactConsolidation multi-hop, with unresolved queries ranked last for every selector, it raises area under the precision-coverage curve from 0.736 for the best score baseline to 0.785 (+0.049, 95% CI [+0.008, +0.092]); under the native evaluation, where score baselines keep their unresolved values, the gap is +0.108. A zero-cut subset contains 71 of 400 queries at 100% observed precision. In this pipeline, the subset corresponds to structural closure; controlled analyses attribute much of the remaining separation to resolution status, with little benefit from continuous edge weights. Across external benchmarks, usefulness varies with graph construction, edge semantics, and relation; typed structure alone does not ensure useful confidence. A supervised gradient-boosted selector achieves 0.814 versus the boundary cut's 0.785 when the retrieval stack matches. These findings provide empirical guidance for using available evidence graphs for lightweight, auditable post-retrieval abstention without additional model inference.

</details>


### [485] [Location, Location, Generation: Where You Ask Matters for Generative Engine Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24081)
*Mahe Chen,Nick Koudas*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 该论文通过受控审计研究了生成式搜索引擎（ChatGPT和Gemini）如何根据用户位置改变引用的来源，发现两者处理位置信息的方式截然不同，导致商家可见性具有强位置依赖性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着生成式引擎优化（GEO）兴起，需要了解用户位置如何影响生成式搜索引擎的来源引用和商家推荐，现有审计通常仅从单一位置进行，无法捕捉位置敏感性。

Method: 设计受控实验：向ChatGPT提问300个问题，使用19个声明位置；向ChatGPT和Gemini从5个网络位置提问，每个重复两次以测量运行噪声，共获得31,200个回答。分析引用来源和推荐商家随位置通道（声明位置vs网络位置）的变化。

Result: ChatGPT遵循应用声明的位置（精确到城市），将其写入搜索查询，搜索后端即使查询未提及地点也会本地化结果，忽略网络位置。Gemini忽略声明位置，遵循网络位置的国家，即使对于非位置依赖问题也会更换大部分来源。推荐的商家随来源变化而变化。

Conclusion: 生成式搜索中的可见性具有强位置特异性，审计必须同时控制声明位置和网络位置两个通道，才能准确评估来源引用和商家推荐。

Abstract: Generative search engines answer local and commercial questions with a written answer and a few cited sources. A growing practice of generative engine optimization (GEO) monitors which sources and brands these answers show, typically from a single place. In this paper, we present a controlled audit of how the user's location changes the sources that generative engines cite. We ask 300 questions of ChatGPT with 19 declared locations, and of ChatGPT and Gemini from five network locations, each twice to measure run-to-run noise (31,200 answers). The engines take location from different channels. ChatGPT follows the location an application declares, down to the city: it writes the place into its own searches, and its search backend localizes results even when the queries name no place. It ignores the network. Gemini ignores the declared location and follows the country of the network, changing most of its sources even for questions that do not depend on place. The businesses the answers recommend change with the sources. Thus, visibility in generative search is specific to the user's location, and audits must control both channels.

</details>


### [486] [Candidate-dependent residual routing trades top-of-list accuracy for recall in sequential recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24200)
*Han Chen,Yingrui Li*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 候选依赖路由在序列推荐器中用候选物品的嵌入决定路由权重，实验显示 NDCG@10 基本不变，但召回率上升 1.81%、MRR 下降 1.09%，新增命中多集中在第 6-10 位，仅在用户近 50 步内有目标的查询上受益，更早的历史目标反而受损，整体表现为用头部排序精度换取长尾召回。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 验证候选依赖路由（candidate-dependent routing）是否能通过为每个候选物品单独加权用户历史行为，提升序列推荐的效果。

Method: 在自注意力基线模型上叠加一个轻量残差路由模块，对比两种路由权重来源：用户历史表征与候选物品嵌入；在 REES46 化妆品数据集上使用五组配对随机种子、完全一致的训练设置进行实验。

Result: 主指标 NDCG@10 平均相对变化仅 +0.003%，基本持平；次要指标显示召回率 +1.81%、MRR -1.09%，新增命中主要落在第 6-10 位；细分分析发现，仅当目标物品出现在用户最近 50 步交互中时模型受益，更早历史目标的查询表现下降。

Conclusion: 该形式的候选依赖路由以牺牲列表头部排序精度为代价，换取列表下部的召回提升，整体 NDCG@10 未见改善。

Abstract: Candidate-dependent routing lets a sequential recommender weight a user's past behaviors differently for each item it scores. We test whether this flexibility helps by adding a small residual routing module to a self-attentive baseline, in two versions that differ only in what sets the routing weights: the user's history representation or the candidate item's embedding. Across five paired seeds on the REES46 cosmetics-shop dataset, with matched training for all three models, candidate-dependent routing leaves the primary metric, normalized discounted cumulative gain at cutoff ten (NDCG@10), essentially unchanged (mean relative change +0.003%). Secondary and exploratory analyses show that this flat average hides two effects that cancel. The candidate-dependent model places more relevant items in its top ten (recall +1.81%) but ranks the first one lower (mean reciprocal rank -1.09%), and most of its new hits land at positions six to ten. Its gains come from queries with at least one target among the user's last 50 events, while queries whose targets all lie outside that window get worse. In this form, candidate-dependent routing trades accuracy at the top of the list for recall further down.

</details>


### [487] [Optimal Fusion Weights Form Intervals, Not Points: A Latency-Aware Study of Query-Adaptive WRRF](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24341)
*Iris Ma,Zahra Shekarchi,Stuart Mcilroy,Mahtab Farrokh,Fattane Zarrinkalam,Joel Stremmel*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文研究混合检索中动态融合权重预测策略，发现每查询最优融合权重通常为区间而非单点，提出分层决策框架指导方法选择。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RRF 广泛用于稀疏和密集检索器的混合检索，但其固定统一权重忽略查询差异；现有查询感知方法假设每查询最优权重为单点，但该假设的实证有效性未被验证。

Method: 在四个数据集和四种稀疏-密集检索器组合上，实证评估八种动态融合权重预测策略，对比静态融合和每查询 Oracle，共测试 128 种动态融合方法，并进行误发现率校正。

Result: 1) 每查询最优融合权重通常为区间，可能存在多个最优区间且形状多样；2) 128 种动态融合方法中有 74 种在 FDR 校正后显著优于标准 RRF；3) 动态融合方法在质量和延迟上存在差异。

Conclusion: 提出分层决策框架，根据从业者约束、数据集属性、标签可用性、硬件和延迟预算映射到合适的方法类别，并开源代码。

Abstract: Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) is widely used to combine sparse and dense retrievers in hybrid information retrieval, but a critical limitation is that it assigns a fixed, uniform weight to each retriever regardless of the query. Query-aware methods treat the per-query optimal weight as a single point, an assumption whose empirical validity has not been examined. We present an empirical study of eight dynamic fusion weight prediction strategies across four datasets and four sparse--dense retriever pairs. When we compare these approaches to static fusion and a per-query oracle that bounds achievable performance, several findings emerge. First, the per-query optimal fusion weight is typically an interval rather than a point. Queries can have multiple optimal intervals, and these can take on a variety of shapes. Second, 74 of 128 dynamic fusion methods tested were significantly better than standard RRF after false discovery rate correction. Third, dynamic fusion methods exhibit differing quality and latency characteristics that should be considered when choosing an appropriate fusion method. To address this last finding, we present a tiered decision framework that maps practitioner constraints, dataset properties, label availability, hardware, and latency budget to an appropriate method class. We release the code for our experiments at https://github.com/thomsonreuters/query-based-rrf.

</details>


### [488] [DuoLM: Fast and Effective Personalized Recommendation with Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24481)
*Jiang Wu,Yutong Song,Hongbo Wang,Guanghe Cao,Jeff Liang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 论文提出DuoLM框架，通过紧凑推荐模型与高效服务运行时相结合，实现快速且有效的个性化推荐，单张H100可达26,400候选评分/秒，吞吐量比教师模型高60倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有语言模型虽能利用丰富物品内容、用户历史和反馈做个性化推荐，但全文本输入评估大量候选物品会带来巨大在线计算开销，限制服务吞吐量。

Method: DuoLM包含编码器LLM离线学习紧凑物品表示供复用，个性化排序LLM结合用户历史和反馈进行推荐；两模型端到端用推荐监督和教师蒸馏训练。运行时通过虚拟Token ID嵌入访问、共享历史计算、CUDA Graph重放加速推理。

Result: 基准测试显示推荐质量与专家教师模型相当；单张H100实现约26,400候选评分/秒，吞吐量为vLLM+自动前缀缓存服务教师模型的约60倍。

Conclusion: DuoLM通过模型架构设计与系统级优化协同，在保持推荐质量的同时大幅提升服务吞吐量，为大规模个性化推荐部署提供实用方案。

Abstract: Language models can make personalized recommendations from rich item content, user history, and feedback. However, evaluating many candidates with full-text inputs incurs substantial online computation and limits serving throughput. We introduce DuoLM, a framework for fast and effective personalized recommendation that integrates a compact recommendation model with an efficient serving runtime. An encoder LLM learns compact item representations for offline reuse, while a personalized ranker LLM combines them with user history and feedback for recommendation. We train both models end to end with recommendation supervision and teacher distillation. The runtime further accelerates inference through virtual token IDs for embedding access, shared history computation, and CUDA Graph replay. Benchmark results show that our framework achieves recommendation quality comparable to that of the expert teacher model. On a single H100, it delivers approximately 26,400 candidate scores per second, about $60\times$ the throughput of the teacher served with vLLM and automatic prefix caching.

</details>


### [489] [RAGit: Turning Document Preprocessing into an Experimental Variable for RAG](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24659)
*Omar El Bachyr,Saad Ezzini,Tegawendé F. Bissyandé,Jacques Klein*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: RAGit是一个开源实验工作台，用于系统化、可复现地评估RAG流水线中文档预处理选择对下游检索的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文档预处理选择（解析、分块、索引）对RAG检索影响大，但通常靠启发式选择，难以在一致条件下对比，缺乏系统评估工具。

Method: RAGit将解析、分块、索引、检索、评估建模为可配置的实验阶段，保持下游设置固定，支持多解析器、分块策略、稠密/晚交互检索，保留从检索块到源页面的溯源，将异构检索单元映射为统一页面级排序进行评估，提供可复用中间产物和多配置基准测试。

Result: 通过固定检索设置下的受控实验，对比不同预处理配置，展示了如何将预处理作为显式实验变量进行系统评估，验证了工具的有效性。

Conclusion: RAGit为RAG预处理选择提供了标准化、可复现的实验平台，促进了预处理策略的科学对比与优化，代码和文档已开源。 }

Abstract: Document preprocessing choices can substantially affect retrieval in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, yet they are often selected heuristically and are difficult to compare under consistent conditions. We present RAGit, an open-source experimentation workbench for the systematic and reproducible evaluation of document preprocessing choices through downstream retrieval. RAGit represents parsing, chunking, indexing, retrieval, and evaluation as configurable experimental stages, enabling controlled comparisons while the remaining downstream settings are kept fixed. It preserves provenance from retrieved chunks to source pages and maps heterogeneous retrieval units to a common page-level ranking for evaluation. The current implementation supports multiple parsers and chunking strategies, dense and late-interaction retrieval, reusable intermediate artifacts, and multi-configuration benchmarking. We demonstrate RAGit through controlled experiments comparing alternative preprocessing configurations under a fixed retrieval setup, illustrating how preprocessing can be treated as an explicit experimental variable. RAGit and its documentation are publicly available on GitHub (https://github.com/OmarElbachyr/ragit). A demonstration video is available at https://youtu.be/tsst-Bhfz4I.

</details>


### [490] [MemRevise: A Self-Revising Memory for Conversational Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24672)
*Mohammed Ali,Abdelrahman Abdallah,Adam Jatowt*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文针对对话式搜索中用户会修正误解、修改请求、回到早期主题的问题，现有基准无法隔离此类轮次，现有方法也无法标记被放弃的内容。作者提出 CONVREVISE 基准（4,429 个测试问题，六个层级的回溯与修订）和 MEMREVISE 方法：基于可修订记忆图、从教师记忆蒸馏的 3B 写入器、记忆引导的检索。写入器单次读取每轮并添加节点，记录主题、事实及操作（添加、放弃、重新激活），主题状态由操作决定，被放弃的主题保留事实且可恢复。冻结检索器下，MEMREVISE 平均 MRR@10 达 0.701，显著优于最强竞争者 ConvSearch-R1-FT 的 0.589 和无记忆写入器的 0.617，记忆机制贡献 0.084 提升。在 TopiOCQA 和 OR-QuAC 上显著领先，在 CORAL 与提示式 32B 重写器持平，且在所有层级从未显著落后最强竞争者。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在对话式搜索中，用户常纠正误解、修改请求、返回早期主题，导致部分历史不再反映当前意图。现有基准未隔离这类“回溯与修订”轮次，现有方法要么重读历史要么记录每一轮，均无法显式标记被放弃的内容，限制了对动态意图的建模能力。

Method: 提出 CONVREVISE 基准，基于 TopiOCQA、CORAL、OR-QuAC 构建 4,429 个测试问题，覆盖六个层级的回溯与修订。提出 MEMREVISE 方法，包含三大组件：(1) 可修订记忆图，节点记录主题、事实及操作（添加、放弃、重新激活），主题状态由操作推导，被放弃主题保留事实可恢复；(2) 从教师记忆蒸馏的 3B 写入器，单次读取每轮对话并写入图节点；(3) 记忆引导的检索，冻结检索器，利用记忆图状态指导检索。

Result: 冻结检索器下，MEMREVISE 平均 MRR@10 为 0.701，优于最强竞争者 ConvSearch-R1-FT 的 0.589 和无记忆写入器的 0.617，记忆机制带来 0.084 绝对提升。在 TopiOCQA 和 OR-QuAC 上显著优于所有基线，在 CORAL 上与提示式 32B 重写器统计学无显著差距，且在所有六个层级从未显著落后最强竞争者。

Conclusion: MEMREVISE 通过可修订记忆图显式建模主题的添加、放弃与重新激活操作，有效捕捉对话式搜索中的动态意图变化，在多个基准和层级上均达到或超越最强基线，证明了记忆图机制对处理回溯与修订的关键作用。

Abstract: In conversational search, users correct misun-derstandings, revise their requests and return to earlier topics, so part of the history no longer reflects what they want. Existing benchmarks do not isolate such turns. Current search methods either re-read the history or keep a record of every turn, and none of them marks earlier content as dropped. We introduce CONVREVISE, a benchmark of 4,429 test questions in six tiers of returns and revisions over TopiOCQA, CORAL and OR-QuAC. We also propose MEMREVISE, which combines a revisable memory graph, a 3B writer distilled from teacher memories, and a search guided by the memory. The writer reads each turn once and adds a node that records its topic, its facts and the operations it performs, such as adding, abandoning or reactivating a topic. Topic status follows from these operations, so a dropped topic keeps its facts and can be restored. With a frozen retriever, MEMREVISE reaches a mean MRR@10 of 0.701, against 0.589 for the best competitor, ConvSearch-R1-FT, and 0.617 for a writer distilled the same way without the memory, so the memory and the steps built on it add 0.084. MEMREVISE is significantly better on Topi- OCQA and OR-QuAC, statistically tied with prompted 32B rewriters on CORAL, and never significantly behind the strongest competitor of any tier.

</details>


### [491] [VisR-RAG-Fin: Benchmarking Multimodal RAG over Visually Rich Financial Documents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24822)
*Omar El Bachyr,Laura Maria Bernardy,Saad Ezzini,Jacques Klein,Tegawendé F. Bissyandé,Charles Mont'e,Anas Zilali,Ulrick Ble,Anne Goujon*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文针对金融等视觉丰富企业文档的多模态RAG系统，构建了开源基准VisR-RAG-Fin，并系统分析了文本、多模态及混合检索生成配置的端到端性能，为实践者提供可操作的设计与评估指导。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自动化系统处理财务报告等企业文档时，因文档兼具密集文本、表格、图表及复杂布局，主要面向人类阅读设计，导致RAG系统在检索相关页面及利用视觉结构信息生成答案时面临显著挑战；尽管多模态检索与视觉语言模型近年进展，但检索与生成组件的设计选择对端到端RAG性能的影响仍缺乏系统理解。

Method: 提出通用管线构建开源基准VisR-RAG-Fin，保留原始布局与视觉内容；基于该基准，在页面级问答任务上，对文本仅、多模态及混合三种检索生成配置进行系统实证分析，涵盖检索行为与生成行为的对比评估。

Result: 通过VisR-RAG-Fin基准，量化了不同模态配置在视觉丰富金融文档上的检索召回、生成准确性等关键指标差异，揭示了多模态融合对复杂布局理解的提升作用，以及混合配置在平衡效率与效果方面的优势，形成了多模态RAG管线设计的经验性结论。

Conclusion: 该工作为复杂企业文档集合上的多模态RAG系统提供了严谨评估基础与可落地的实践洞见，指导从业者在检索与生成组件的模态选择、融合策略及管线架构上做出更优决策。

Abstract: Enterprise documents such as financial reports are increasingly processed by automated systems, yet they are primarily designed for human reading and exhibit complex visual structure, combining dense text with tables, charts, diagrams, and rich layouts. These characteristics pose significant challenges for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems, which must retrieve relevant pages and leverage visual and structural information during answer generation. Despite recent advances in multimodal retrieval and vision-language models, there remains a limited understanding of how design choices across retrieval and generation components affect end-to-end RAG performance on visually rich documents. In this paper, we present a comprehensive empirical study of multimodal RAG for page-level Question Answering (QA) over financial documents. We introduce VisR-RAG-Fin (Visually Rich RAG for Finance), an open-source benchmark constructed through a general pipeline for visually rich documents that preserves original layout and visual content. Using this benchmark, we systematically analyze retrieval and generation behavior under text-only, multimodal, and hybrid configurations, providing a foundation for rigorous evaluation of RAG systems on complex enterprise document collections. Overall, this work provides actionable insights for practitioners designing and evaluating multimodal RAG pipelines over complex, visually rich enterprise documents.

</details>


### [492] [Structure-Aligned History Learning with Subspace-Structured Semantic IDs for Generative Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25093)
*Kaiwen Wei,Kejun He,Jie Zhang,Xiaomian Kang,Yuming Yang,Aijia Zhou,Xie Zhou,Yining Wang,Nayu Liu,Li Jin,Zhenyang Li,Jiang Zhong,He Bai,Jingxuan Wei,Junnan Zhu*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: SAHL 通过语义残差均衡量化（SRBQ）构建平衡的 token-子空间-item 层级，并利用量化结构指导历史重构，结合预测熵优先级和课程优化，显著提升生成式推荐的 NDCG@10。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成式推荐方法在两个阶段均存在局限：传统量化器导致码本分配不平衡，缺乏连贯的中间语义单元；推荐模型以 next-item prediction 为主，仅将历史交互作为条件上下文，难以从分散的远距离交互中恢复持久偏好。

Method: 提出 Structure-Aligned History Learning (SAHL)：1) Semantic Residual Balanced Quantization (SRBQ) 构建平衡的 token-子空间-item 层级结构；2) 在量化定义的同一粒度上重构历史；3) 预测熵优先处理不确定转移；4) 课程优化逐步向推理对齐的 next-item prediction 过渡。

Result: 在四个 Amazon Review 类别上，SAHL 相对 RPG 提升 NDCG@10 18.6%-30.0%，相对强基线 MHL 提升 2.7%-6.0%。消融实验验证了均衡码本使用、遵循量化分组重构的收益及对用户历史的依赖。

Conclusion: SAHL 将量化结构与历史重构对齐，解决了码本不平衡和长程偏好建模不足的问题，为生成式推荐提供了更有效的语义 ID 学习范式。

Abstract: Generative recommendation constructs semantic IDs for catalog items and predicts the next ID from user interaction histories. However, existing methods face limitations in both stages. First, conventional quantizers may produce imbalanced code assignments and lack coherent intermediate semantic units between individual tokens and complete items, limiting history reconstruction. Second, recommendation models remain dominated by next-item prediction, treating historical interactions mainly as conditioning context and providing limited supervision for recovering persistent preferences across the historical path, particularly when relevant preference signals are distributed over distant interactions. To address these limitations, Structure-Aligned History Learning (SAHL) reconnects the two stages by using the structure created during quantization directly for history reconstruction. Its Semantic Residual Balanced Quantization (SRBQ) forms a balanced token-subspace-item hierarchy, and SAHL reconstructs history at these same granularities. Predictive entropy prioritizes uncertain transitions, while curriculum optimization progressively shifts training to inference-aligned next-item prediction. On four Amazon Review categories, SAHL improves NDCG@10 by 18.6%-30.0% over RPG and 2.7%-6.0% over strong method MHL. Controlled analyses verify balanced code use, the benefit of following quantizer-defined groups during reconstruction, and dependence on user history. The relevant code is available at https://github.com/CQU-MM-Intelligent-Lab/SAHL.

</details>


### [493] [When Semantics Fall Short: Persona-Guided Cross-Domain Sequential Recommendation with Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25221)
*Jundong Chen,Honglei Zhang,Shuai An,Enneng Yang,Han Yu*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出PerCDR框架，针对跨域序列推荐中LLM语义桥接的两大局限——语义域隔离与语义-行为不一致，转向基于Persona引导的行为建模，利用LLM推断的Persona全局指导跨域可迁移行为模式，结合局部语义关系增强域内建模，最后进行域偏好自适应优化推荐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于LLM的跨域序列推荐方法依赖全局语义桥接，但面临两个核心问题：1) 语义域隔离——物品语义具有域特异性，阻碍可迁移建模；2) 语义-行为不一致——局部语义关系与行为转移一致，但全局跨域一致性常失效。

Method: 提出PerCDR框架：1) 利用LLM推断用户Persona，全局指导跨域可迁移行为模式学习；2) 利用局部语义关系增强域内行为建模；3) 引入域偏好自适应机制进一步优化推荐结果。

Result: 大量实验验证了PerCDR的优越性，证明了该方法在解决语义域隔离和语义-行为不一致问题上的有效性。

Conclusion: 从全局语义桥接转向Persona引导的行为建模是跨域序列推荐的有效范式，PerCDR通过LLM推断的Persona实现跨域行为模式的可迁移建模，显著提升推荐性能。

Abstract: Cross-domain sequential recommendation (CDSR) alleviates data sparsity by transferring user behaviors across domains. Recent advances increasingly leverage large language models (LLMs) to bridge domains through global item semantics. However, this paradigm is inherently limited by two issues: I. semantic domain isolation, where item semantics remain domain-specific and hinder transferable modeling, and II. semantic-behavior inconsistency, where local semantic relations are more consistent with behavioral transitions, whereas such consistency often breaks down globally across domains. To this end, we propose PerCDR, an LLM-enhanced CDSR framework that shifts the focus from global semantic bridging to persona-guided behavioral modeling. Specifically, PerCDR leverages LLM-inferred personas to globally guide transferable cross-domain behavioral patterns, while exploiting local semantic relations to enhance intra-domain behavioral modeling, followed by domain preference adaptation for recommendation refinement. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superiority of PerCDR and validate its effectiveness.

</details>


### [494] [MEMORA: A Memory-Enhanced Multimodal Committee Reranking Agent for Reasoning-Intensive Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25282)
*Mohamed Mahmoud,Mostafa Farouk Senussi,Mahmoud Abdalla,Mahmoud SalahEldin Kasem,Abdelrahman Abdallah,Hyun Soo Kang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: MEMORA 是一个记忆增强的多模态编排重排序智能体，专为推理密集型检索设计，通过协作因子委员会重排序、情景记忆模块和推理感知稠密检索器三大创新，在 MM-BRIGHT 基准上实现了最先进的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有检索系统在处理需要深度语义推理且以多模态形式到来的查询时面临根本挑战：它们孤立地处理每个查询，依赖单体重排序器，且缺乏为跨模态推理训练的检索器。

Method: 三大核心贡献：(1) 协作因子委员会重排序——将查询分解为意图因子，提取因子特定证据构建结构化矩阵，通过记忆条件元裁决模型综合判断；(2) 情景记忆模块——跨查询追踪因子结果并在推理时动态调整优先级；(3) 推理感知稠密检索器——在 20k+ 推理密集型样本上通过思维链增强进行微调。

Result: 在覆盖 29 个领域的 MM-BRIGHT 基准上，MEMORA 实现了 nDCG@10 41.5（文本到文本）和 38.9（多模态查询到文本），分别比最强的纯文本智能体基线高出 8.3 分，比最强的多模态智能体基线高出 7.9 分。

Conclusion: MEMORA 通过协作重排序、情景记忆和推理感知检索器的协同作用，有效解决了推理密集型多模态检索的核心难题，在 MM-BRIGHT 基准上建立了新的最先进水平。代码和数据已开源。

Abstract: Reasoning-intensive retrieval is fundamentally challenged when queries demand deep semantic inference and arrive in multimodal form. Existing systems treat each query in isolation, rely on monolithic rerankers, and lack retrievers trained for cross-modal reasoning. We introduce MEMORA, a Memory-Enhanced Multimodal Orchestrated Reranking Agent built around three contributions: (1) Collaborative Factor-Committee Reranking, which decomposes queries into intent factors, extracts factor-specific evidence into a structured matrix, and synthesizes judgments via a memory-conditioned meta-verdict model; (2) an Episodic Memory Module that tracks factor outcomes across queries and dynamically adjusts priorities at inference time; and (3) a Reasoning-Aware Dense Retriever fine-tuned with chain-of-thought augmentation on 20k+ reasoning-intensive pairs. Evaluated on MM-BRIGHT across 29 domains, MEMORA achieves nDCG@10 of 41.5 (text-to-text) and 38.9 (multimodal query-to-text), outperforming the strongest agentic text-only baseline by +8.3 points and the strongest agentic multimodal baseline by +7.9 points. Code and data are available at https://github.com/HarnessLab/MEMORA.

</details>


### [495] [Selling in the Wild: Benchmark and Randomized Field Evidence for a Sales Agent Trained on Commercial Conversations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25461)
*Benjamin Tannenbaum*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文评估了在460万去标识商业对话上微调的销售代理Javo，通过四项研究（基准测试、大规模随机对照试验、模型隔离实验、人机对比）证明其在收入、转化率上显著优于前沿通用模型，且与人类销售相当（非劣效），成本仅为人工的1.8%，同时满足安全护栏要求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 验证专门针对销售场景微调的大语言模型代理是否能在真实商业环境中超越通用前沿模型并达到人类销售水平，同时大幅降低成本并保证安全合规。

Method: 采用四阶段评估：研究1在SalesLLM和SmartSalesBench两个公开销售基准上对比10个前沿/开放权重模型；研究2在14个行业的100个真实网站上进行大规模RCT（1480万访客，2026年5-9月），三臂随机分配（无代理、Javo、前沿模型代理），界面工具护栏完全一致；研究3通过对比两个代理臂隔离模型效应；研究4在20个人工客服站点上将Javo与人类销售直接对比。

Result: 相对无代理，Javo使人均收入提升+10.0%（95% CI +5.1至+14.9）；在有互动访客中，转化率比前沿模型代理高+21.6%（95% CI +16.9至+26.3）；对比人类销售，有互动转化率11.26% vs 11.20%（非劣效，边界-7%，单侧p=0.004；无显著优势），单次对话成本仅为人工的1.8%；退货率、无依据产品宣称和投诉率均符合预设安全护栏。

Conclusion: 领域微调的销售代理Javo在真实商业部署中显著优于通用前沿模型，达成与人类销售非劣效的转化表现，并以极低成本满足安全要求，证明了专用销售LLM的商业可行性。

Abstract: We test whether Javo, a sales agent fine-tuned on 4.6 million consented, de-identified commercial conversations, sells better than a frontier general-purpose model and better than human sales associates. The evaluation has four parts. Study 1 scores the agent on two public sales benchmarks, SalesLLM and SmartSalesBench, against 10 frontier and open-weight models. Study 2 is a randomized controlled trial on 100 live websites in 14 industries (e-commerce, travel and hospitality, and high-consideration services), run from 1 May to 30 September 2026, in which 14.8 million visitors were randomized to no agent, Javo, or a frontier-model agent with an identical interface, catalog tools and guardrails. Study 3 isolates the effect of the model by comparing those two agent arms. Study 4 compares Javo with each site's own human associates on 20 sites with staffed live chat. Relative to no agent, Javo changed revenue per visitor by +10.0% (95% CI +5.1 to +14.9). Among engaged visitors, it changed conversion by +21.6% relative to the frontier-model agent (95% CI +16.9 to +26.3). Against human associates, its engaged conversion was 11.26% versus 11.20% (non-inferior, margin -7%, one-sided p = 0.004; no significant superiority), at 1.8% of the cost per conversation. Return rates, unsupported product claims and complaint rates met the prespecified safety guardrails.

</details>


### [496] [Knowledge Manifold Optimization for Scientific Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25662)
*Shigeru Obayashi,Yoshiaki Kawagoe,Kazuhiko Komatsu,Tomonaga Okabe*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 论文提出知识流形优化（KMO），将科学发现形式化为在文献衍生的连续知识空间中的多目标搜索，通过四个互补目标识别帕累托最优的“受支持知识空白”，并将其转化为可审计的假设包，实验表明该方法能发现不同的发现模式，且优于仅基于空白度的基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学文献的快速扩张和专业化使得难以识别已知内容以及新的可支持知识可能出现的位置，现有方法缺乏在显式知识空间中进行结构化多目标搜索的框架。

Method: 引入知识流形优化（KMO），作为知识流形框架的面向发现的扩展。将科学发现视为在连续、文献衍生的知识空间中的多目标搜索。候选位置由四个互补目标评估：持久知识机制边界强度、带通白空间新颖性、语义梯度幅度和证据支持。不将这些标准折叠为单一加权分数，而是识别帕累托最优的受支持知识空白（语料库相对的未占据区域，且周围文献提供足够支持）。在99篇空气动力学和空气动力学设计论文语料库上演示，使用21x21网格进行精确帕累托分析，并将代表性帕累托位置转化为可审计证据包，再由受约束的大语言模型口头化为候选研究假设。

Result: 在21x21网格上，精确帕累托分析产生19个非支配点，排除白空间得分为零的点后得到16个实用前沿点。这些解表现出不同的发现模式：方法学桥接、气动-结构拓扑/FSI集成、功能性气动装置集成、后尾迹/车辆流控集成。距离最大化基线倾向选择外推区域，且支持度和可靠性显著较低，表明仅凭空白度不足够。代表性帕累托位置成功转化为假设包。

Conclusion: 科学发现可以被表述为在显式知识空间中的结构化多目标搜索，同时保持新颖性的语料库相对性，并将数值发现与下游语言生成分离。

Abstract: The rapid expansion and specialization of scientific literature make it increasingly difficult to identify not only what is known, but where new and still supportable knowledge may emerge. We introduce Knowledge Manifold Optimization (KMO), a discovery-oriented extension of the Knowledge Manifold framework that treats scientific discovery as a multiobjective search over a continuous, literature-derived knowledge space. Candidate locations are evaluated using four complementary objectives: persistent knowledge-regime boundary strength, band-pass white-space novelty, semanticgradient magnitude, and evidential support. Rather than collapsing these criteria into a single weighted score, KMO identifies Pareto-optimal Supported Knowledge Gaps, defined as corpus-relative unoccupied regions that remain sufficiently supported by surrounding literature. The method is demonstrated on a 99-paper corpus in aerodynamics and aerodynamic design. On a 21 x 21 grid, exact Pareto analysis produced 19 non-dominated points, of which 16 formed the practical front after excluding points with zero white-space score. These solutions exhibited distinct discovery modes, including methodology bridges, aero-structural topology/FSI integration, functional aerodynamic-device integration, and rear-wake/vehicle flow-control integration. A distance-maximization baseline preferentially selected extrapolative regions with substantially lower support and reliability, demonstrating why emptiness alone is insufficient. Representative Pareto locations were converted into auditable evidence packages and then verbalized by a constrained large language model into candidate research hypotheses. The results show that scientific discovery can be formulated as structured multi-objective search in an explicit knowledge space, while keeping novelty corpus-relative and separating numerical discovery from downstream language generation.

</details>


### [497] [Cross-Pollination Retrieval: Finding Transferable Ideas Across Fields in Scientific Literature](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25678)
*Seokwon Jung,Yerang Kim,Yejin Kim,Alexander Rubinstein,Arnas Uselis,Sangwoo Park,Seong Joon Oh,Sangdoo Yun*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出跨领域灵感检索任务，构建了大规模CPR-Dataset数据集（含1300个查询和10573个训练对），现有检索器表现不佳（Recall@10仅0.26），LLM重排可达0.81，对比学习微调后可提升至0.70，且泛化能力强，在AnaloBench和BRIGHT基准上显著优于现有检索数据集训练的模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学进步常源于跨领域思想迁移（cross-pollination），但现有检索基准局限于狭窄领域范围，跨领域论文检索仍未充分探索，缺乏大规模、多领域的评测和训练资源。

Method: 通过挖掘跨主题引用构建CPR-Dataset，包含26个领域的1300查询评测集（CPR-eval）和10573训练对（CPR-train）；评估11种现有检索器与LLM重排器；在CPR-train上进行对比学习微调；在AnaloBench（类比推理）和BRIGHT（推理密集检索）上验证泛化性能。

Result: 最佳现有检索器Recall@10仅0.26，LLM重排达0.81；CPR-train微调后Recall@10提升至0.70；增益泛化至未见领域、类比与推理任务：AnaloBench nDCG@10提升33%（现有数据集训练反而下降），BRIGHT nDCG@10提升70%（是现有数据集增益的2倍以上）。

Conclusion: CPR-Dataset有效解决跨领域灵感检索的数据稀缺问题，对比学习微调显著提升检索器跨域迁移与推理能力，为促进跨学科科学发现提供了重要资源与基准。

Abstract: Many scientific advances come from cross-pollination, carrying an idea from one field over to a problem in another. Yet retrieving papers across fields remains underexplored, with existing benchmarks confined to a narrow range of fields. We study cross-pollination retrieval, the problem of identifying transferable ideas across research fields, and introduce CPR-Dataset, a large-scale dataset constructed by mining cross-topic citations. Its evaluation split CPR-eval has 1,300 queries in 26 fields, and its training split CPR-train has 10,573 pairs. On CPR-eval, the best of eleven existing retrievers reaches a Recall@10 of only 0.26, whereas an LLM reranker reaches 0.81. Standard contrastive fine-tuning on CPR-train raises Recall@10 to as high as 0.70. The gain carries over to domains held out from training and to analogy and reasoning-intensive retrieval. On AnaloBench, it raises nDCG@10 by up to 33% over the untrained retriever, whereas training on three existing retrieval datasets lowers it. On BRIGHT, it raises nDCG@10 by up to 70%, more than twice the gain from those datasets. CPR-Dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/CPR-Dataset, and the code at https://github.com/SeokwonJung-Jay/Cross-Pollination-Retrieval.

</details>


### [498] [MAPS: A Multi-Agent Personalized Script-Driven Video Advertising System Enhanced by Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25748)
*Zhongyu Wang,Chen Zuo,Qingxuan Sun,Jiayang Qiao,Qiuhao Qian,Songyan Cui,Guocheng Chen*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种多智能体个性化脚本驱动的视频广告系统(MAPS),通过四个协作智能体形成闭环流水线,利用强化学习训练脚本生成智能体,实现细粒度个性化视频广告生成,在快手广告系统在线实验中显著提升CTR、CVR和ARPU。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于检索的个性化视频广告系统受限于预制作的候选创意,个性化粒度粗糙,导致不同用户群体表现差异大,需要更细粒度的生成式个性化方案。

Method: 设计四个协作智能体(用户画像建模、脚本生成、视频合成、反馈驱动迭代优化)形成闭环流水线;为脚本生成智能体开发多维度奖励函数的强化学习框架,使其生成的脚本同时符合用户内容偏好和目标产品信息。

Result: 离线实验表明该方法在生成和整合个性化创意方面表现优异;在快手广告系统在线A/B实验中,相对于生成式基线,CTR提升2.87%,CVR提升2.74%,ARPU提升9.85%。

Conclusion: MAPS通过多智能体协作和强化学习驱动的脚本生成,有效解决了传统检索式视频广告个性化粒度受限的问题,实现了细粒度个性化视频广告生成,显著提升广告业务指标。

Abstract: With the rapid growth of online video consumption, video advertising has become a dominant component of digital advertising. Most personalized video advertising systems follow a retrieval-based paradigm, which matches ad content with user preferences in a feature space and recommends the most similar candidates. However, since the candidate creatives are pre-produced, this paradigm limits the granularity of personalization and leads to performance disparities across diverse user groups. To address this limitation, we propose a multi-agent personalized script-driven video advertising system (MAPS). We design four collaborative agents that form a closed-loop pipeline of user profile modeling, script generation, video synthesis, and feedback-driven iterative refinement. To train the Scripter Agent, we develop a reinforcement learning framework equipped with a multi-dimensional reward function, which steers the agent toward producing scripts that simultaneously align with user content preferences and target product information. Extensive offline experiments on representative datasets demonstrate that our approach achieves encouraging performance in generating and integrating personalized creatives. Online A/B experiments in a specific scenario in the Kuaishou advertising system show that MAPS improves CTR by 2.87%, CVR by 2.74%, and ARPU by 9.85% over the generative baseline.

</details>


### [499] [Learning Complementary Agent Groups via Task Hypergraphs for Next-POI Recommendation with Missing Modalities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25801)
*Jinze Wang,Yuze Liu,Liang Yuan,Gaoyuan Du,Xiaohang Xu,Yong Xiang,Jiong Jin*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出CATH框架，利用任务超图动态选择互补智能体组进行POI推荐，解决文本/图像缺失问题，实验显示NDCG@20相对提升8.4-9.1%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有POI推荐依赖文本和图像内容，但这些内容常缺失；大语言模型智能体虽用于偏好建模和证据获取，但难以为每个请求联合选择最优智能体组以分析可用证据。

Method: CATH将具有不同处理角色的智能体作为任务超图节点；超边连接选定的智能体组并记录分析目标和目标POI。策略网络基于请求、任务及已选智能体条件化选择成员。执行阶段，成员共享候选关联结果指导后续操作；完成任务更新候选状态和智能体记忆。共享排序头将候选状态转化为对固定基础排序的修正。训练采用监督排序训练执行器，随后策略优化并考虑计算成本。

Result: 在Gowalla-CA、Foursquare-NYC、Foursquare-TKY三个数据集自然缺失设定下，CATH相对最强基线HyperAgent4POI在NDCG@20上提升8.4-9.1%。额外分析对比了组选择与执行设计、额外掩码下的排序表现，并刻画了质量-成本权衡。

Conclusion: CATH通过任务超图动态选择互补智能体组，有效整合LLM智能体处理缺失内容，显著提升POI推荐性能，同时兼顾计算成本，为基于智能体的推荐系统提供了新范式。

Abstract: Next point-of-interest (POI) recommendation uses visit histories and POI content, but text and images are often missing. Large language model agents have been applied to recommender systems for preference modeling and evidence acquisition. The challenge is to select agents that can jointly analyze the available evidence for each request. We propose \textsc{CATH} (\emph{Complementary Agents via Task Hypergraphs}), which learns to select agent groups for tasks such as comparing candidates or analyzing a POI with missing content. Agents with distinct processing roles are the task hypergraph nodes; each hyperedge connects the selected group and records its analysis goal and target POIs. The policy selects members conditioned on the request, task, and agents already selected. During execution, members share candidate-linked results that guide their subsequent operations. Completed tasks update candidate states and agent memories within the request. A shared ranking head converts candidate states into corrections to a fixed base ranking. Supervised ranking trains the executor, followed by policy optimization that accounts for computation cost. Experiments under natural missingness on Gowalla-CA, Foursquare-NYC, and Foursquare-TKY show 8.4--9.1\% relative NDCG@20 gains over HyperAgent4POI, the strongest prior baseline evaluated. Additional analyses compare group-selection and execution designs, test ranking under additional masking, and characterize quality--cost tradeoffs.

</details>


### [500] [OneChord: Distill What You Rank, Recommend in One Pass](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25805)
*Zesheng Li,Chengchang Pan,Honggang Qi*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: OneChord 提出了一种统一的语义ID推荐框架，通过单一学习的目录归一化融合实现直接训练、精炼蒸馏与推理一体化，在六个Amazon数据集上全面超越基线，实现最高召回率与NDCG，并加速推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语义ID推荐部署时需融合代码概率与物品相似度，最终排序依赖归一化与相对权重，现有方法缺乏直接优化服务排序分布的原则，导致推理预算紧张下难以准确发现商品。

Method: OneChord 采用共享并行解码器联合输出语义ID证据与物品匹配分数；训练时冻结去噪器提供合法部分SID，学生模型评估这些状态构建精炼融合目标；在共享难候选上匹配直接与精炼预测，将精炼迁移至单次推荐；理论表征候选条件下的融合权重，给出保持精炼预测器全目录Top-K选择的充分条件。

Result: 在六个Amazon数据集上，OneChord 在每个数据集上均达到最高 Recall@5 与 NDCG@5，平均相对提升 6.30% 与 7.12%；全测试生成速度比最快基线提升 1.04–1.18 倍。

Conclusion: OneChord 将服务排序分布作为推荐学习与蒸馏的共同优化对象，实现了训练、蒸馏与推理的一体化，显著提升了语义ID推荐的准确性与效率。

Abstract: Accurate product discovery on the Web requires recommendation models that rank catalog candidates within tight inference budgets. In semantic-ID recommendation, deployment can fuse code probabilities with item similarities, making the final ranking depend on their normalization and relative weights. This motivates a direct training principle: \emph{distill what you rank}. We present OneChord, which uses one learned, catalog-normalized fusion for next-item supervision, refinement distillation, and inference. A shared parallel decoder produces joint SID evidence and item-matching scores. During training, a frozen denoiser supplies legal partial SIDs; the student evaluates these states to construct refined fused targets. Matching direct and refined predictions on shared hard candidates transfers refinement into one-pass recommendation. We characterize the fusion weights induced by candidate conditioning and establish sufficient conditions for preserving the refined predictor's full-catalog Top-$K$ selection. Across six Amazon datasets, OneChord achieves the highest Recall@5 and NDCG@5 among the compared methods on every dataset, with average relative gains of 6.30\% and 7.12\% over the strongest baseline. It also achieves a 1.04--1.18$\times$ full-test generation speedup over the fastest baseline. OneChord makes the served ranking distribution the common object of recommendation learning and distillation.

</details>


### [501] [Multimodal Decoupling for Diversified Recommendation through Semantic and Structural Shaping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26024)
*Changran He,Jiaming Wei,Jianghong Ma,Tianjun Wei,Haijun Zhang,Xiaofeng Zhang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出MOSS框架，通过多模态解耦与语义结构双重塑造，解决推荐系统中准确性与多样性的权衡难题，实验证明其在真实数据集上显著优于基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有推荐系统在优化准确性时导致结果过度集中，限制了推荐多样性。多模态信号虽丰富但常被视为ID嵌入的辅助，语义利用不充分；同时训练过程中准确性提升往往以牺牲多样性为代价，这种权衡根源于表示的结构性质与优化动态。

Method: MOSS包含四个核心模块：(1) 基于MLLM的解耦特征提取，将多模态内容解耦为信息量丰富的表示；(2) 类别感知嵌入选择，提取紧凑的类别感知语义特征；(3) 交替双图传播，融合协同与多模态传播缓解表示坍塌；(4) 基于熵的多样性正则化，通过促进类别均衡曝光缓解优化偏置。

Result: 在多个真实数据集上的大量实验表明，MOSS在准确性-多样性权衡上持续优于强基线方法。

Conclusion: MOSS通过语义解耦与结构重塑的统一框架，有效缓解了多模态推荐中语义利用不足与优化偏置问题，为平衡推荐准确性与多样性提供了新范式。

Abstract: Recommender systems often suffer from over-concentrated results when optimized for accuracy, limiting recommendation diversity. While diversity has become an important objective, existing methods still face fundamental limitations from both semantic and structural perspectives. On the one hand, multimodal recommender systems provide rich semantic signals, yet are often treated as auxiliary to ID embeddings, leading to ineffective semantic utilization for diversity. On the other hand, the accuracy--diversity trade-off persists during training, where accuracy gains often come at the cost of diversity. We show that this phenomenon is fundamentally governed by both the structural properties of learned representations and the dynamics of optimization. To address these challenges, we propose MOSS, a unified framework for multimodal decoupling through semantic and structural shaping. Specifically, we first introduce an MLLM-based Decoupled Feature Extraction module to disentangle multimodal content into informative representations. To enhance semantic utilization, we design a Category-aware Embedding Selection module that extracts compact, category-aware semantic features. To address structural limitations, we propose two complementary modules: Alternating Dual-Graph Propagation, which alleviates representation collapse by integrating collaborative and multimodal propagation, and Entropy-based Diversity Regularization, which mitigates optimization bias by promoting balanced category exposure. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets demonstrate that MOSS consistently achieves a superior accuracy--diversity trade-off over strong baselines.

</details>


### [502] [Don't Rewrite the SID Map: Topology Preservation for Generative Retrieval in Dynamic E-Commerce Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26105)
*Jianbo Zhu,Xing Fang,Xiaopeng Chu,Mingmin Jin,Jing Wang,Bokang Wang,Jiaqi Ye,Xiang Zhang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文系统研究生成式检索在动态电商环境中SID映射更新对检索质量的影响，通过67天大规模日志实验揭示三大核心发现：语义漂移被大beam掩盖、重映射比例与检索质量单调相关、拓扑保持策略极其有效，并提出部署原则：插入新项冻结旧项、可热启动则热启动、绝不改变已学习SID。线上A/B测试验证UCTCVR提升0.29%、GMV提升1.16%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式检索为每个物品分配离散语义标识符（SID），通过自回归生成SID序列进行检索。在电商等动态环境中，新物品持续到来，需要定期更新SID到物品的映射和模型以保持检索时效性。每次更新可能使检索器已学习的搜索路径失效，但映射变更与检索质量的定量关系未被系统表征，亟需深入研究。

Method: 在淘宝/天猫大规模电商搜索日志上进行67天受控实验，系统变更SID重映射比例（0%至72.75%），对比不同beam size（1至1000）下的HitRate变化；评估完全重映射与保持策略在热启动训练下的表现；验证固定旧物品SID、插入新物品SID并热启动的拓扑保持策略；最终在TmallAPP进行三周线上A/B测试。

Result: 三大核心发现：(1) SID语义漂移导致严重检索退化，大beam掩盖真实严重程度：beam=1时HitRate下降41.78%-62.05%，beam=1000时仅下降8.33%-10.85%。(2) 重映射比例与检索质量严格单调相关：重映射比例从0%增至72.75%，HitRate单调下降，beam=1时最大跌42.66%；完全重映射在热启动下仍显著劣于保持策略，表明短预算持续训练无法修复拓扑破坏。(3) 拓扑保持原则使最简单的热启动策略高效：固定旧项SID、插入新项SID、热启动，旧项HitRate提升10%，新项HitRate提升109%，跨两个不重叠更新周期验证。线上A/B测试：UCTCVR +0.29%，GMV +1.16%。

Conclusion: 生成式检索动态更新的核心原则：插入新物品SID、冻结旧物品SID；条件允许时热启动、否则冻结模型；绝不修改模型已学习的SID。该原则经大规模离线实验与线上A/B测试双重验证，有效解决动态环境下SID语义漂移与拓扑破坏问题，显著提升新旧物品检索性能与业务指标。

Abstract: Generative retrieval assigns each item a discrete semantic identifier (SID) and retrieves items by autoregressively generating SID sequences. In dynamic environments such as e-commerce, new items arrive continuously, requiring periodic updates to the SID-to-Item mapping and model to maintain retrieval timeliness. Each update, however, can invalidate search paths already learned by the retriever, and the quantitative relationship between mapping change and retrieval quality has not been systematically characterized. We study this problem with extensive controlled experiments over 67 days of large-scale e-commerce search logs and obtain three core findings. (1) SID semantic drift causes severe retrieval degradation that may be masked by large beam sizes: mapping updates reduce HitRate by 41.78-62.05% at beam size 1 but only 8.33-10.85% at beam size 1000, as redundant candidate generation conceals the true severity of drift. (2) The fraction of changed SIDs is strictly monotonically related to retrieval quality: as the remapped fraction increases from 0% to 72.75%, HitRate decreases monotonically, dropping up to 42.66% at beam size 1. Full remapping remains substantially worse than the preservation policy under warm-start training, indicating that short-budget continued training alone cannot repair topology disruption. (3) The SID topology-preserving principle makes even the simplest warm-start strategy highly effective: fixing old-item SIDs, inserting new-items, and warm-starting from the previous model improves old-item HitRate by 10% and new-item HitRate by 109%, validated across two non-overlapping update cycles. These findings distill into a concise deployment principle: insert new-items, freeze old-items; warm-start when possible, otherwise freeze; never change SIDs the model has already learned. A three-week online A/B test on TmallAPP shows UCTCVR +0.29% and GMV +1.16%.

</details>


### [503] [FLMNet: Self-Ensemble Distillation from Masks to Seeds for Single-Tower CTR Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26143)
*Yifan Wang,Yifei Du*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 该论文研究点击率（CTR）预测中的自我蒸馏现象，证明了当Dropout模式数量趋于无穷时，目标函数精确分解为logit平均预测的标签损失加上Dropout副本间分歧的惩罚项。基于此理论设计了FLMNet，无需采样即可训练，且多种子网络蒸馏能回收部分集成增益。在五个基准上对比十七个基线，单网络推理即取得前两名准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有CTR模型（如FinalNet、QNN）发现通过不同Dropout模式的自我蒸馏能提升精度，但其理论机制不明，且随机采样带来计算开销。需要从理论上解释自我蒸馏为何有效，并设计无需采样的确定性训练方法。

Method: 1. 理论分析：证明Dropout模式数→∞时，目标函数 = 标签损失(logit平均) + Dropout副本分歧惩罚。2. 当Dropout不影响特征门控时，惩罚项可闭式近似。3. 基此设计FLMNet，显式最小化该目标，无需随机采样。4. 多种子网络蒸馏：将多个独立训练网络的知识蒸馏至单一网络，回收集成增益。

Result: 在五个公开CTR基准上对比十七个基线方法，FLMNet及其蒸馏变体在单网络推理下均获得前两名准确率。惩罚项增益与蒸馏增益在可测量情况下基本可加性叠加。

Conclusion: 自我蒸馏的本质是最小化集成预测的标签损失同时正则化模型不确定性。FLMNet通过闭式惩罚项实现了无采样的高效训练，多种子蒸馏进一步提升性能，为CTR预测提供了理论指导的实用框架。

Abstract: Click-through rate (CTR) prediction underpins recommender systems and online advertising, where high-dimensional categorical features interact in combinatorially many ways. Several recent CTR models, such as FinalNet and QNN, report higher accuracy when a network also learns from its own averaged predictions, for example by running the same network under different dropout patterns and training each run toward the average. Why this self-distillation helps, and whether its random sampling is needed, remains unclear. This work shows that as the number of dropout patterns grows without bound, the objective reduces exactly to the label loss of the logit-averaged prediction plus a penalty on how much the dropout copies of the network disagree. When dropout does not affect how a network gates its features, this penalty can be approximated in closed form, and FLMNet is designed on this principle and trains without sampling. Networks trained from different seeds disagree in the same form, and distilling several of them into one network recovers part of their ensemble gain. On five benchmarks against seventeen baselines, the resulting models take the top two places in accuracy with a single network at inference, and the gains of the penalty and of distillation, where measurable, largely add up.

</details>


### [504] [Babbar26 main x genre](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26220)
*Bournonville Aur{é}lien,Clotilde Levy,Thomas Largillier,Guillaume Pitel,Fran{\c c}ois Rioult,Fabrice Maurel*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 该论文介绍了Babbar26，一个包含1111个网页、来自1006个域名、涵盖五种语言的多语言数据集，同时标注了体裁（五类分类法）和主要内容/样板文本（基于DOM的main/noise区域），并报告了双重标注一致性及与经典基准的对比。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有网页体裁分类和主内容提取数据集多为单语、规模较小或标注粒度不足，缺乏跨语言、基于DOM结构的联合标注资源，无法满足现代Web页面复杂性（DOM元素更多、可读文本更长）的研究需求。

Method: 构建多语言网页语料库（英/法/德/西/意），制定紧凑五类体裁分类法及基于DOM锚定的主内容/样板文本标注指南，采用双重标注流程，计算体裁任务准确率（97.1%）和内容级Cohen's kappa（0.766），并与KI-04基准对比页面复杂度指标。

Result: 数据集规模为1111页/1006域，双重标注一致性高；中位数页面DOM元素数量是KI-04的2.3倍，可读文本量是其1.9倍，反映现代网页结构更复杂、内容更丰富。

Conclusion: Babbar26为跨语言网页体裁分类与主内容提取提供了高质量、大规模、结构感知的联合标注基准，填补了现有资源在多语言性、标注粒度和现代Web代表性上的空白。

Abstract: We introduce Babbar26, a multilingual dataset of 1111 web pages from 1006 domains in five languages (English, French, German, Spanish, Italian), jointly annotated for genre, following a compact five-class taxonomy, and for main content and boilerplate, as main/noise regions anchored to the DOM. We describe the annotation guidelines and report double-annotation agreement on both tasks (97.1% on genre; content-level Cohen's k = 0.766 for main content). Compared with the classic KI-04 genre benchmark, a median page has 2.3x more DOM elements and 1.9x more readable text.

</details>


### [505] [Preference Is Not Position: Evaluating Reranking on NevIR in Fixed Hybrid Candidate Pools](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26260)
*Yuning Bian,Lele Xu,Yifan Yuan,Xinyu Yin,Chengyan Zhan*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 该论文研究了在检索任务中，针对仅在决定性条件（如否定词）上不同的近似相同段落，排序模型可能正确排序但将首选段落排在靠后位置的问题。通过结合稠密、稀疏和BM25检索的固定候选池，评估配对训练排序器、点式重排序及大语言模型（Qwen3-14B-AWQ）与交叉编码器（BGE）的表现。实验表明，配对排序器虽提升严格偏好准确率但降低MRR；有界点式重排序改善双指标；Qwen3-14B-AWQ配合融合打破平局达到77.45%严格偏好、0.7509 MRR。研究支持联合评估配对偏好、段落位置及计算成本，并区分模型判断与综合排序流程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有排序模型在处理仅在关键条件（如否定）上不同的近似相同段落时，虽能正确判断偏好，但往往将首选段落排在检索列表靠后位置，导致实际检索效果不佳。需要一种联合评估配对偏好准确率与首选段落排名位置（MRR）的方法，并探索如何在计算成本可控下同时优化这两个指标。

Method: 使用官方NevIR数据集中被稠密检索、学习稀疏检索和BM25检索固定候选池共同覆盖的段落对。在2,736个测试查询方向上，对比配对训练排序器、固定融合、背景采样与修正监督的变体、有界点式重排序（融合top 20）、Qwen3-14B-AWQ大语言模型配合融合打破平局、BGE交叉编码器。指标包括严格逐查询偏好准确率、首选段落倒数排名均值（MRR）、NevIR风格配对准确率。

Result: 配对排序器将严格偏好从52.30%提升至56.62%，但MRR从0.5764降至0.3055。背景采样变体达到MRR 0.5859和偏好54.53%。有界点式重排序改善双指标。Qwen3-14B-AWQ达77.45%严格偏好、58.99%配对准确率、MRR 0.7509。BGE交叉编码器达69.77%偏好、MRR 0.7404。事后分析显示，Qwen评分相等触发融合打破平局的分支占27%方向，包含大多数剩余偏好失败案例。

Conclusion: 研究证实需联合评估配对偏好、指定段落位置及计算成本，并区分模型判断与综合排序流程。大语言模型配合融合策略能显著提升两个指标，但评分相等时的平局处理仍是主要失效来源。有界点式重排序为平衡效果与效率提供了实用方案。

Abstract: Near-identical passages can differ in a decisive condition, such as negation. A ranker may order such a pair correctly while placing the preferred passage far down the retrieved list. We examine this distinction using official NevIR pairs jointly covered by fixed candidate pools from dense, learned sparse, and BM25 retrieval. On 2,736 Test query directions, a pairwise-trained ranker improves strict per-query preference over fixed fusion (56.62% versus 52.30%) while reducing preferred-passage mean reciprocal rank (MRR) from 0.5764 to 0.3055. An exploratory fixed-model replay of a variant with background sampling and revised supervision yields MRR of 0.5859 and strict preference of 54.53%. Bounded pointwise reranking of the fusion top 20 improves both outcomes. Qwen3-14B-AWQ with fusion tie-breaking reaches 77.45% strict preference, 58.99% NevIR-style paired accuracy across 1,363 complete pairs, and preferred-passage MRR of 0.7509. A BGE cross-encoder reaches 69.77% strict preference and MRR of 0.7404. A post-hoc analysis finds that the branch where equal Qwen grades for the two designated passages trigger fusion tie-breaking accounts for 27% of evaluated directions and contains most remaining strict-preference failures. These findings support joint evaluation of pairwise preference, designated-passage position, and computational cost, while distinguishing model judgments from the combined ranking procedure.

</details>


### [506] [AGR: Agentic Generative Retrieval with Tool-Augmented Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26831)
*Ming Yang,Yaqi Yin,Zhibo Wang,Xiaoze Jiang,Jingwei Zhuo,Chao Zhang,Quanzhi Zhu,Weiguo Zheng,Liang Zeng,Yunfeng Zhao,Jiaqiang Liu,Kefeng Wang,Yupeng Huang,Kaiqiao Zhan,Xuanping Li*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 论文提出 Agentic Generative Retrieval (AGR)，一种工具增强的生成式检索范式，能在语义 ID (SID) 生成过程中动态决定是否调用工具、获取哪个特征、以及在何处融合特征观测，从而自适应利用异构特征生态，提升大规模搜索与推荐系统的检索质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成式检索 (GR) 方法采用静态特征注入，要么编码所有可用信号，要么按预设方案放置，导致服务成本高、引入无关或冲突证据，且无法自适应判断何时需要特征、选择哪个特征、以及特征应在 SID 层级的哪个位置生效。

Method: AGR 将 SID 生成与按需特征获取交织：基于请求和已解码的 SID 前缀，模型决定是否调用工具、获取哪个特征、以及观测应影响后续解码的哪个步骤，引导生成走向特征一致的 SID 分支。监督信号来自基于特征适用性和 SID 层级信息增益构建的工具增强轨迹，训练采用 SID 预训练后接工具增强微调的两阶段流程。

Result: 在工业数据集和三个公开基准上的离线实验，以及在线 A/B 测试中，AGR 均持续优于基线，验证了其有效性。

Conclusion: AGR 通过工具增强的自适应特征获取机制，解决了静态特征注入的局限，实现了异构特征在生成式检索中的高效利用，为大规模搜索推荐系统提供了可落地的新范式。

Abstract: Large-scale search and recommendation systems derive much of their retrieval quality from rich, heterogeneous features, yet existing generative retrieval (GR) methods struggle to exploit such feature ecosystems efficiently. Static feature injection either encodes all available signals or places them according to predetermined schemes, increasing serving cost and introducing irrelevant or conflicting evidence. More fundamentally, existing methods cannot adaptively determine when a feature is needed, which feature to select, or where it should influence hierarchical Semantic ID (SID) generation. We propose Agentic Generative Retrieval (AGR), a tool-augmented paradigm that interleaves SID generation with on-demand feature acquisition. Conditioned on the request and decoded SID prefix, AGR decides whether to invoke a tool, which feature to acquire, and where its observation should influence subsequent decoding, thereby steering generation toward feature-consistent SID branches. To supervise this behavior, we construct tool-augmented trajectories based on feature applicability and information gain along the SID hierarchy, and train the model through SID pretraining followed by tool-augmented fine-tuning. Experiments on an industrial dataset and three public benchmarks, together with an online A/B test, consistently demonstrate the effectiveness of AGR.

</details>

### [507] [GardenBench: A lightweight, daily evaluation of LLM capabilities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23866)
*Benedict Cummins-Mburu,Mariana Garcia Mejia,Oscar Heath,Sabrina Kreyzerman,Ellie Murray,Arusan Surendiran,Rohan Alexander*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: GardenBench 是一个包含 11 个测试套件的轻量级基准，通过系统性轻量查询评估 LLM 在日常任务上的能力，持续跟踪模型性能、成本和延迟的日常波动，支持跨提供商和版本对比，并提供实时公开仪表板。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准多忽略模型部署后的日常性能漂移、版本迭代导致的进步或退化，以及不同提供商模型在实际消费级任务上的横向对比需求。需要一个面向消费者、低成本、轻量化且可持续运行的基准来填补这一监测空白。

Method: 构建 11 个覆盖通用日常任务的测试套件，采用轻量级提示词系统性查询各版本 LLM，自动记录准确率、推理成本、响应时间等指标，按天聚合并跨提供商/版本对比，最终通过实时仪表板公开所有结果。

Result: 成功捕捉到模型发布后的性能波动（包括性能提升与退化），给出不同提供商及版本在 11 个任务上的详细准确率、成本、延迟对比数据，验证了基准的轻量化（单次评测成本极低）和高频运行可行性。

Conclusion: GardenBench 以创新、轻量、低成本的设计补全了 LLM 持续评测的短板，提供了一个面向消费者和研究者的实用工具，推动了模型在真实日常场景下的透明化监控与横向比较。

Abstract: We introduce GardenBench, a benchmark with 11 test suites that evaluate the capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) across a range of tasks. By systematically prompting LLMs with various lightweight queries, we document day-to-day changes in model performance, including run costs and times, that other benchmarks miss. This allows us to compare the accuracy and features of responses across model providers and versions. We account for daily variations in model accuracy, capturing both model progress and degradation, for instance, when a model is changed post-deployment or when a new model is released. We base our evaluation on general-use tasks and make our results publicly accessible via a live dashboard, diversifying existing approaches to LLM testing. Our main contribution is an innovative, lightweight, and inexpensive benchmark, designed to be consumer-facing and for everyday tasks.

</details>


### [508] [Doing Less with More: A First-Principles Exploration of the Suitability of Agentic Computing over Alternative Architectural Choices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23921)
*Ritvik Garimella,Biplav Srivastava,Amit Sheth*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文通过受控数学任务（1000个算术表达式）系统对比了7种架构方法在准确率和延迟上的表现，发现确定性方法（原生函数调用、REST、SOAP、MCP）实现100%准确率且延迟可忽略；直接LLM评估最高92.9%准确率但延迟为基线22,000倍；结合MCP工具的Agent最佳达99.9%准确率但延迟高达基线1,000,000倍。结论指出LLM不适合精确算术评估，提出架构决策框架（ADF）建议根据任务类型选择架构而非盲目采用LLM。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管Agentic AI在自动化业务活动中兴起，但缺乏关于何时应选择Agent而非成熟替代方案（本地计算、REST、SOAP、MCP）的实证研究，特别是在开发速度、性能和运营成本等维度的权衡上。

Method: 设计受控数学基准测试，包含1000个需保持运算符优先级语义的算术表达式，对比7种方法：原生函数调用（Python库）、REST微服务、SOAP微服务、MCP微服务、Groq云API直接LLM响应、5个本地部署Ollama模型直接响应、5个本地LLM调用MCP工具的Agent系统。

Result: 确定性方法均达100%准确率且延迟可忽略；直接LLM评估最高92.9%准确率，延迟为原生函数调用22,000倍以上；结合MCP工具的最佳Agent达99.9%准确率，但延迟接近基线1,000,000倍。

Conclusion: LLM方法不适合精确算术评估任务。研究激发了基于准确率和吞吐需求的架构决策框架（ADF），建议根据任务类型（推理类 vs 语言类）探索多种架构选择，而非采用一刀切的LLM方案。

Abstract: There is growing interest in automating business activities with Agentic Artificial Intelligence (AI) due to latter's seeming ease of use. Never has it been easier, or costlier, to do less with more. However, little is known about when agents are preferable to established alternatives such as local computation, Representational State Transfer (REST), the Simple Object Access Protocol (SOAP), and the Model Context Protocol (MCP), particularly when development speed, performance, and operational cost are considered. We investigate this question using a controlled mathematical task that compares seven methods on a benchmark of 1,000 arithmetic expressions where semantics of operator precedence has to be preserved. We ran this setup across a native Function Calling baseline (Python library), REST, SOAP and MCP microservice architectures, direct responses from large language models (LLMs) using a Groq cloud API and five locally deployed Ollama models, and agentic systems in which five local LLMs invoke MCP tools. The deterministic methods achieve 100% accuracy with negligible latency. Direct LLM evaluation achieves at most 92.9% accuracy at over 22,000x the latency of a native function call. With MCP tools, the best agent reaches 99.9% accuracy, but incurs nearly 1,000,000x the baseline latency. These results demonstrate that LLMs approaches are poorly suited for exact arithmetic evaluation and motivate an informed architectural decision framework (ADF) for choosing an architecture based on accuracy and throughput requirements. We recognize that an actual interaction with an agent may span both reasoning and linguistic tasks. Hence our recommendation is to explore multiple architectural choices (based on task type) rather than one-size-fits-all solution (LLMs).
  Code is available at - https://github.com/Ritvik-G/adf/

</details>


### [509] [A Controlled LLM Workflow for Evidence-Grounded Diagnosis of Risk Score Differences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23962)
*Hanqing Dou,Zijia Cao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种受控的大语言模型工作流，用于解释风险评分差异。该工作流结合参考检索、对比SHAP证据、基于参考的LLM推理和确定性验证，实验证明其能生成更一致、有证据支撑且可追踪的诊断结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM在解释风险评分差异时缺乏结构化指导，导致输出不一致、缺乏证据支持且难以追踪。需要一种受控工作流来提升解释的可靠性和可解释性。

Method: 提出受控LLM工作流，包含四个核心组件：1) 参考检索 - 检索相似历史交易；2) 对比SHAP证据 - 使用SHAP值对比分析特征贡献差异；3) 基于参考的LLM推理 - 结合检索到的参考和SHAP证据进行推理；4) 确定性验证 - 对生成的解释进行规则校验。

Result: 在测试数据集上实验表明，该工作流产生的诊断比无结构化指导的同类LLM更一致、更有证据支撑、更可追踪。

Conclusion: 结合参考检索、对比SHAP证据和确定性验证的受控LLM工作流能有效提升风险评分差异解释的质量，为金融风控等领域提供可靠的可解释AI方案。

Abstract: We propose a controlled Large Language Model (LLM) workflow for explaining risk score differences using similar historical transactions. The workflow combines reference retrieval and contrastive SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) evidence with reference-based LLM reasoning and deterministic validation. Experiments on a test dataset show that the workflow produces more consistent, evidence-grounded and traceable diagnoses than the same LLM without structured workflow guidance.

</details>


### [510] [What Social Media Teaches Us About Accumulative AI Risks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24006)
*Dawei Li,Bohan Jiang,Huan Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出「轨迹忽视论点」，指出AI安全讨论过度关注灾难性风险，而忽视了日常广泛使用中累积的隐性危害，呼吁评估累积使用模式并采取相应保障措施。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前AI安全讨论主要关注生存性威胁和灾难性事件（如核冲突、生物疫情），但类比社交媒体研究表明，重复使用、反馈循环和个体易感性可能导致难以察觉的累积性危害（如视角狭窄、判断力减弱、被剥削影响），这些不伴随单一明显有害事件却长期影响个体和社会。

Method: 通过类比社交媒体研究（互惠媒体效应、社会强化、个体易感性），分析对话式AI系统中的生成、语义推理、持久记忆如何收紧反馈循环；以谄媚行为、操纵、隐私丧失为案例研究，展示风险如何交互累积；提出需评估累积使用模式、个体/社会结果、因果推断及适度防护。

Result: 识别出AI系统中可能导致累积性危害的机制（如谄媚、操纵、隐私丧失的交互），论证了从单一事件转向累积轨迹评估的必要性，提出了具体研究方向和政策建议。

Conclusion: 应建立针对累积性AI危害的评估框架，包括长期使用模式监测、因果推断方法、保留有用协助与用户知情选择的比例性保障措施，避免「轨迹忽视」导致系统性风险被低估。

Abstract: Prominent AI safety discussions emphasize existential threats and catastrophic events, such as AI-enabled nuclear conflict or engineered biological outbreaks. This position paper argues that there is another type of AI risk that arises and accumulates from the widespread use of AI. Drawing on lessons from social media, we argue that safety assessments must also address accumulative harms that develop through repeated use, recurring decisions, and feedback across interconnected deployments. Repeated reassurance, selective exposure, recurring decision biases, and growing personal profiles may gradually narrow perspectives, weaken independent judgment, or enable exploitative influence without a single clearly harmful event. We advance the Trajectory Neglect Thesis: a focus on vivid catastrophic events and identifiable incidents risks overlooking less visible harms that accumulate through the widespread daily use of AI. Social media research motivates this position by showing how reciprocal media effects, social reinforcement, and individual susceptibility shape outcomes beyond individual encounters. We examine how related mechanisms may operate in AI systems, using conversational AI as a concrete setting where generation, semantic inference, and persistent memory may tighten feedback loops. Sycophancy, manipulation, and privacy loss provide a case study of how these risks may interact and accumulate. This comparison identifies mechanisms to investigate rather than assuming that repeated AI use is harmful. We therefore call for evaluation of cumulative patterns of use and deployment, individual and societal outcomes, careful causal inference, and proportionate safeguards that preserve useful assistance and informed user choice.

</details>


### [511] [Beyond Explicit Intent: Discovering and Shaping Artistic Intent through Human-AI Co-Creation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24010)
*Renye Yan,Jialun Zhong,Jikang Cheng,Yi Gao,Yanzeng Li,Ling Liang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种人机共创范式，通过扩展模型探索让艺术家发现潜在偏好，并将策展判断融入强化学习，形成“探索-识别-塑造-再探索”循环，实现艺术意图的渐进发现与外化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成式AI交互假设创作者能预先明确意图并通过文本提示准确传达，但艺术意图往往模糊、潜在或仅在看到具体视觉可能性后才能识别，需要超越显式意图表达的交互范式。

Method: 扩展模型探索生成多样视觉可能性，让艺术家通过观察、比较、选择识别未言说偏好；将策展判断融入强化学习，根据对生成轨迹的偏好分配不同学习强度，使模型逐渐适应个体审美；形成持续的“探索-识别-塑造-再探索”循环。

Result: 通过三项用户研究，验证了潜在偏好发现、个性化偏好对齐以及模糊难表达创作意图外化的有效性。

Conclusion: 该范式实现了艺术意图的渐进发现、外化与塑造，为生成式AI辅助艺术创作提供了新的交互模式。

Abstract: Generative AI is becoming an important medium for artistic creation, yet existing interactions often assume that creators can specify intentions in advance and accurately communicate them through text prompts. Artistic intentions, however, may be vague, latent, or recognizable only after seeing concrete visual possibilities. We propose a human-AI co-creation paradigm beyond explicit intent expression. By expanding model exploration, we expose artists to diverse visual possibilities, allowing them to identify previously unarticulated preferences through observation, comparison, and selection. We then integrate artists' curatorial judgments into reinforcement learning, assigning different learning strengths based on preferences over generation trajectories, so recognized directions are more strongly reinforced and the model gradually adapts to individual aesthetics. This creates a continuous "explore-identify-shape-re-explore" loop in which artistic intent is progressively discovered, externalized, and shaped. Through three user studies, we examine latent-preference discovery, personalized preference alignment, and the externalization of vague, difficult-to-express creative intentions.

</details>


### [512] [Unified Multiparadigm Fusion Intelligence for Rare Disease Diagnosis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24024)
*Jian Yang,Peiling Liu,Songda Li,Yu Cao,Yuqing Feng,Lan Yu,Jiarong Pan,Jing Ye,Xinwen Huang,Chaochun Zou,Xudong Lu,Huilong Duan,Haomin Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: FusionRare 是一个统一的多范式融合框架，整合了知识驱动的符号推理、深度学习模式识别、基于病例的患者检索和基于 LLM 的启发式推理，通过统计元聚合和知识增强的智能体反思实现整合。在 2,528 个严格隔离的临床病例上评估，FusionRare 在罕见病优先排序上达到最先进水平，表型诊断宏平均 Recall@1 为 51%，表型-基因型联合分析为 79%。随机交叉临床医生-AI 验证显示，FusionRare 在 45% 的决策中提升了真实诊断排名，62% 提高了医生信心，诊断时间减少 21%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 罕见病影响全球约 3 亿人，患者面临漫长的诊断历程，受限于临床资源稀缺和医学知识碎片化。AI 已逐步推进罕见病诊断，从符号方法、深度学习到基于大语言模型 (LLM) 的系统，但每种范式都有结构性局限：符号方法受限于知识完整性，神经模型牺牲可解释性，基于 LLM 的系统易受数据泄露等评估偏差影响。

Method: 提出 FusionRare 框架，融合四大正交 AI 范式：知识驱动的符号推理、深度学习模式识别、基于病例的患者检索、基于 LLM 的启发式推理；通过统计元聚合和知识增强的智能体反思实现统一。在 2,528 个严格隔离的临床病例上评估，对比先进智能体系统 DeepRare、前沿 LLM（如 GPT-5.5）及专用工具 PhenoBrain 和 LIRICAL，采用严格的防泄露协议。另进行随机交叉临床医生-AI 验证。

Result: 宏平均 Recall@1：表型仅诊断 51%，表型-基因型联合分析 79%，显著优于所有基线。临床医生研究：45% 的决策中真实诊断排名提升，62% 提高医生信心，诊断时间缩短 21%。

Conclusion: 调和正交 AI 范式能显著增强诊断能力，弥合计算基准与可操作临床可靠性之间的鸿沟。该工作为在复杂、高风险、服务不足的医学领域部署可信诊断 AI 提供了可复制框架。

Abstract: Rare diseases (RDs) affect an estimated 300 million people globally, leaving patients to navigate a protracted diagnostic odyssey constrained by clinical scarcity and fragmented medical knowledge. Artificial intelligence (AI) has progressively advanced RD diagnostics, from symbolic methods and deep learning to large language model (LLM)-based systems. However, each paradigm carries structural limitations: symbolic methods are bounded by knowledge completeness, neural models sacrifice interpretability, and LLM-based systems are vulnerable to evaluation biases like data leakage. In this study, we introduce FusionRare, a unified multiparadigm fusion framework integrating knowledge-driven symbolic reasoning, deep-learning pattern recognition, case-based patient retrieval, and LLM-based heuristic inference via statistical meta-aggregation and knowledge-enhanced agentic reflection. Evaluated on 2,528 strictly isolated clinical cases, FusionRare achieves state-of-the-art RD prioritization, attaining a macro-averaged Recall @1 of 51% for phenotype-only diagnosis and 79% for phenotype-genotype joint analysis. These results represent decisive advantages over the advanced agentic system DeepRare, frontier LLMs including GPT 5.5, and specialized tools like PhenoBrain and LIRICAL under stringent anti-leakage protocols. A randomized, crossover clinician-AI validation demonstrated that FusionRare elevates the true diagnostic rank in 45% of decisions, improves physician confidence in 62%, and reduces time to diagnosis by 21%. These findings indicate that reconciling these orthogonal AI paradigms significantly enhances diagnostic capabilities, bridging the gap between computational benchmarks and actionable clinical reliability. More broadly, this work provides a replicable framework for deploying trustworthy diagnostic AI across complex, high-stakes, and underserved medical domains.

</details>


### [513] [LogicVal:A Logic-Formalized Benchmark for Constraint Satisfaction in Text-to-Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24051)
*Savitha Sam Abraham,Marjan Alirezaie,Hossein Rahnama*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出将文本到图像（T2I）评估形式化为约束满足问题，引入逻辑框架 LogicVal 结合神经视觉检测与逻辑推理，评估四种最先进 T2I 模型在 9 类约束上的表现，揭示了单对象与复杂多对象关系约束的巨大性能差距，以及组合泛化和不可满足约束识别的困难，LogicVal 在 CLEVR 上与人类判断高度一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 T2I 基准多关注特定能力（属性绑定、数字、空间推理、常识推理），缺乏统一的形式化评估框架；将评估视为约束满足问题，能系统刻画模型在逻辑约束（如量词、计数、蕴涵）下的综合能力，揭示其局限。

Method: 构建逻辑框架形式化定义基准域（对象、属性、关系）及生成图像必须满足的约束；设计 9 类约束从单对象属性到多对象逻辑关系（∀, ∃, count, →）；评估四种 SOTA T2I 模型；提出 LogicVal，结合神经视觉检测器提取图像场景图，再用逻辑推理器验证约束满足度；在 CLEVR 数据集上与人类判断对比验证。

Result: 最佳模型在单对象属性约束上达 98% 准确率，但在复杂多对象条件约束仅 53%；组合泛化测试中，单约束提示 84% 下降至多约束同时满足的 20%；不可满足约束识别仅 23% 准确率。LogicVal 在 CLEVR 上 ROC-AUC 0.88-0.98，与人类判断强对齐。

Conclusion: 基于逻辑的约束满足评估框架能系统表征 T2I 模型能力边界，揭示其在复杂逻辑推理、组合泛化和不可满足约束检测上的显著短板；LogicVal 提供了可扩展、与人类一致的自动化评估工具，推动 T2I 评估向形式化、逻辑化方向发展。

Abstract: Text-to-Image (T2I) generative models have made significant progress in producing high-fidelity images from natural-language prompts. Alongside this progress, numerous benchmarks have been developed to evaluate capabilities such as attribute binding, numeracy, spatial reasoning, and commonsense reasoning. In this work, we propose a new perspective on T2I evaluation by casting it as a constraint-satisfaction problem. We introduce a logical framework that formally specifies the benchmark domain, including objects, attributes, and relations, alongside the constraints that generated images must satisfy. We evaluated four state-of-the-art T2I models across 9 classes of constraints ranging from a single-object-attribute to multi-object relationships constraints involving logical operators ($\forall, \exists, count, \rightarrow$). Our results reveal a substantial gap between single-object and complex conditional multi-object relationship constraint classes, with the best-performing model achieving 98% accuracy on the former and just 53% on the latter. We assess compositional generalisation, finding that the best-performing model`s accuracy drops from 84% on single-constraint prompts to 20% when satisfying multiple constraints simultaneously. Identifying unsatisfiable constraints is also challenging, with the best model correctly recognizing only 23% of such prompts. Building on this framework, we introduce \textbf{LogicVal}, an evaluation methodology that combines neural visual detection with logical reasoning to assess constraint satisfaction in generated images. On CLEVR, LogicVal achieves ROC-AUC scores ranging from 0.88 to 0.98, indicating strong alignment with human judgments. These findings underscore the value of logic-based evaluation for characterizing T2I model capabilities and limitations.

</details>


### [514] [World of SWECraft: Agent Collaboration at Scale via Simulated Software Worlds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24061)
*Shannon Zejiang Shen,Yapei Chang,Qiyao Liang,Benjamin Newman,Jenny Liang,Rulin Shao,Ziqiao Ma,Junjie Oscar Yin,Yung-Sung Chuang,Weijia Shi,Yejin Choi,Luke Zettlemoyer,Pang Wei Koh,Mohit Iyyer,Tongshuang Wu,David Sontag*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 Software World 框架，用于模拟多智能体在真实软件生态系统中的协作，研究推理时计算扩展下的智能体协作效果。实验显示最佳模型可使下游效率提升 31%，但部分前沿模型会过早停止探索改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着 AI 智能体团队承担更大项目和长期开放问题，智能体协作成为推理时计算扩展的新维度。需要理解什么使这种协作有效且可扩展，因此开发了一个可在真实软件生态中模拟多智能体协作的框架。

Method: 开发 Software World 框架，包含创建真实、相互依赖的 Python 包环境（软件世界）的管道。智能体在世界中维护包，目标是提高软件效率，可自由发现任务并与他人协作。通过测量隐藏依赖包的加速比来集体评估工作。通过改变通信、所有权和资源分配来研究协作的不同要素。在三个不同世界中运行模拟，总计超过 10,000 小时的智能体工作，涉及八个模型。

Result: 整体性能提升随推理时计算扩展而扩展，最佳模型将下游效率提升高达 31%。大多数智能体能通过协作找到有意义的任务，但部分前沿模型会过早停止寻找改进，进展甚微。

Conclusion: Software World 为大规模研究智能体协作提供了可复现的仿真平台。实验证实协作能有效扩展推理时计算，但也揭示了前沿模型在探索策略上的局限性。作者已发布框架和轨迹数据以支持后续研究。

Abstract: As teams of AI agents take on larger projects and long-standing open problems, agent collaboration offers another dimension for scaling inference-time compute. To understand what makes such collaboration effective and scalable, we develop Software World, a framework for simulating multi-agent coworking in realistic software ecosystems. It comes with a pipeline to create environments of real, interdependent Python packages of different topics, sizes, and dependency structures, which we call software worlds. In a simulation, agents maintain packages in the world with a high-level goal of improving software efficiency, and they are free to discover tasks to work on and collaborate with others. We evaluate agents' work in a world collectively by measuring speedup in hidden dependent packages. The framework allows us to study different elements of collaboration by varying communication, ownership, and resource allocation. We run simulations in three different worlds, totaling more than 10,000 hours of agent work across eight models. Overall, performance improvement scales with inference-time compute, with the best model improving downstream efficiency by up to 31%. We show that most agents can find meaningful tasks via collaboration, but some frontier models can prematurely stop looking for improvements and make little progress. We release the simulation framework and traces to support future studies of agent collaboration at https://szj.io/sw.

</details>


### [515] [Persistent Memory and Iterative Improvement in an LLM Agent for Chinese-Character Drawing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24090)
*Peilin Wu,Yi-Zhuang You*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文研究持久记忆是否有助于LLM智能体解决新问题，以及记忆设计如何影响这种收益。通过程序化汉字绘制任务（668项），对比5种智能体条件发现：自由形式笔记使首次尝试成功率提升4.6个百分点，代码库设计（结合自由笔记与可复用代码）提升2.8个百分点。两种设计整体差异不显著，但代码库在后期更难项目上显示优势。当代码库智能体获得特权结构监督时，改进幅度显著更大。结果表明记忆设计影响累积经验发挥作用的位置，即便平均收益有限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究持久记忆（来自先前尝试的累积经验）是否能帮助LLM智能体解决新问题，以及不同记忆设计如何影响这种潜在收益。

Method: 采用程序化汉字绘制任务，跨5种智能体条件在相同的668个项目上进行实验。对比自由形式笔记记忆与代码库记忆（结合自由笔记与可复用代码）两种设计。另进行事后对比，测试代码库智能体在获得特权的、针对目标的结构监督时的表现。

Result: 自由形式笔记使首次尝试成功率提升4.6个百分点；代码库设计提升2.8个百分点。两种设计整体差异不显著，但代码库在后期更难项目上显示出暗示性优势。当代码库智能体接收特权结构监督时，改进幅度大幅增加。

Conclusion: 记忆设计可能影响累积经验发挥作用的具体位置/阶段，即使其平均收益较为温和。智能体能够利用高信息量的结构指导，但特权的逐项信息无法确立仅从经验中能学到什么。

Abstract: Does persistent memory accumulated from previous attempts help an LLM agent solve new problems, and does memory design affect that benefit? We study programmatic Chinese-character drawing across five agent conditions attempting the same 668 items. Accumulated memory produces modest aggregate gains despite substantial growth in the memory stores: free-form notes improve first-attempt success by 4.6 percentage points, while a design combining free-form memory with reusable code improves it by 2.8 points. The two designs do not differ significantly overall, but the code bank shows a suggestive advantage on later, harder items. A separate post-hoc comparison finds a much larger improvement when the code-bank agent receives privileged, target-specific structural supervision. The agent can therefore exploit highly informative structural guidance, although the privileged per-item information does not establish what could have been learned from experience alone. These results suggest that memory design may affect where accumulated experience becomes useful, even when its average benefit is modest.

</details>


### [516] [Cache2LoRA: Understanding and Improving Context Internalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24107)
*Yi Fang,Gaurav Srivastava,Zhenyu Bi,Sirui Ding,Xuan Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 Cache2LoRA 方法，通过查询从冻结文档缓存聚合证据生成 LoRA 更新，在 17 个任务上达到 0.663 macro F1，逼近全上下文学习（0.671），且解码吞吐量提升 5.9 倍；在相同内存下，生成的 LoRA 比 learned-KV 更稳健地保持答案准确性，且与保留的文档 KV 结合更有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 Context-to-LoRA 方法将文档编码为低秩参数更新，避免在解码时保留源文本，但其事实保持可靠性及对不同指令的适应性尚不明确。需要系统诊断事实辨别、目标保持和响应适应，并解决竞争源干扰、事实恢复不保证遵循指令等问题。

Method: 提出 Cache2LoRA：利用可复用的冻结文档缓存，按查询聚合证据生成 LoRA 更新；可训练编码仅作用于查询和记忆标记后缀；采用多风格监督同时教授证据保存和答案表达。

Result: 在 17 个任务上，Cache2LoRA 超越现有 Context-to-LoRA 方法，macro F1 0.663 接近全上下文 ICL 的 0.671；32K 文档、256 token 输出、batch 16 下解码吞吐量为全上下文 ICL 的 5.9 倍；同等内存下，生成 LoRA 在长且多样的干扰文本中比 learned-KV 更可靠地保持准确性，与保留的文档 KV 结合产生更高的混合 F1 和 EM。

Conclusion: Cache2LoRA 通过查询驱动的证据聚合和多风格监督，显著提升了 Context-to-LoRA 的事实保持与指令遵循能力，在准确性和效率上均接近或超越全上下文学习，且与 KV 缓存混合使用效果更优，为长文档问答提供了高效可靠的参数化记忆方案。

Abstract: Context-to-LoRA methods encode documents as low-rank parameter updates, allowing language models to answer without retaining the source text in their decoding context. How reliably do these updates preserve facts and support their use under different instructions? Controlled diagnosis of existing context-to-LoRA methods separates fact discrimination, target retention, and response adaptation. Competing sources influence answers, while target-only construction and memory-state optimization improve recovery at fixed update size. Recovering facts also does not ensure that answers follow response instructions. We introduce Cache2LoRA, which uses each query to aggregate evidence from a reusable frozen document cache before generating LoRA updates. Trainable encoding operates only on the query and memory-token suffix, and multi-style supervision teaches both evidence preservation and answer expression. Across 17 tasks, Cache2LoRA improves on existing context-to-LoRA methods and achieves macro F1 of 0.663, approaching full-context in-context learning at 0.671. For 32K documents and 256-token outputs at batch size 16, its decoding throughput is 5.9$\times$ that of full-context ICL. At matched memory size, generated LoRA preserves answer accuracy more reliably than the learned-KV variant under long, diverse intervening text and combines more effectively with retained document KV, yielding higher hybrid F1 and EM.

</details>


### [517] [Joint, Decoupled, or Agent: When Each Multimodal Alignment Paradigm Wins](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24108)
*Yi Fang,Gaurav Srivastava,Sirui Ding,Xuan Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文系统对比了三种多模态学习范式（JOINT、DECOUPLED、AGENT）在16个数据集、5个域、多标注预算下的表现，发现无单一范式全面优势；进而提出基于表征几何、监督诊断和文本-标签匹配的两级级联选择器，在留一组出评估中以71.4%的胜率和0.028的平均相对遗憾显著优于仅用元数据的路由。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态融合有联合预训练、解耦预训练和基于LLM的代理等多种范式，但何时采用哪种范式缺乏系统性指导。作者旨在量化三种范式在不同任务格式、监督预算和单模态表征质量下的优劣，并开发无需训练候选模型即可预测最佳范式的诊断工具。

Method: 1. 实例化三种范式：JOINT（冻结联合预训练编码器+融合头）、DECOUPLED（冻结独立预训练编码器+融合头）、AGENT（冻结LLM+任务指令、少样本示例、文本输入、单模态读出）。2. 在16个成对数据集、5个域、多标注预算（共144组合）上评测。3. 引入表征几何、监督表征诊断、文本-标签匹配三类诊断指标。4. 构建两级级联选择器：先判AGENT还是融合，再判JOINT还是DECOUPLED。5. 采用留一组出交叉验证评估选择器性能。

Result: 三大范式胜率接近（DECOUPLED 54、JOINT 44、AGENT 46）。ScienceQA/MELD/MetMeme随监督增加从AGENT转向融合。QA任务JOINT优势显著（4/5数据集全预算领先）；分类任务单模态5-NN准确率越高越倾向DECOUPLED（Spearman ρ=-0.67）。级联选择器胜率71.4% vs 54.2%，平均相对遗憾0.028 vs 0.057；三类诊断指标联用优于任意单一指标。

Conclusion: 范式偏好与监督预算、任务格式、单模态5-NN准确率显著相关。目标任务诊断指标（表征几何、监督诊断、文本-标签匹配）结合元数据，可在不训练候选模型的情况下可靠预测最佳范式，为多模态系统设计提供实用的选择指南。

Abstract: Jointly pretrained multimodal encoders are a common way to combine modalities, while alternatives integrate their information during downstream training or inference. When does each approach win? We compare three paradigms, instantiated with public checkpoints, across 16 paired datasets in five domains and multiple training-label budgets. JOINT trains a fusion head on frozen, jointly pretrained encoders. DECOUPLED trains a fusion head on frozen, independently pretrained encoders. AGENT gives a frozen LLM task instructions, labelled examples, available sample text, and supervised unimodal readouts. No paradigm dominates the complete 144 dataset-budget combinations: DECOUPLED wins 54, JOINT 44, and AGENT 46 by mean utility. ScienceQA, MELD, and MetMeme shift from AGENT to fusion as supervision increases. Between the fusion paradigms, JOINT leads on four of five QA datasets across all evaluated budgets, while higher unimodal 5-NN accuracy is associated with a relative shift toward DECOUPLED across eight classification datasets (Spearman $ρ=-0.67$). We test whether representation and task diagnostics predict these preferences on held-out datasets before fitting their candidate systems. A two-step cascade combines these diagnostics with task and budget metadata to select AGENT or fusion, then JOINT or DECOUPLED. Under leave-one-group-out evaluation, it selects the winner in 71.4% of cells versus 54.2% for metadata-only routing, with mean relative regret 0.028 versus 0.057. Using geometry, supervised representation diagnostics, and text-label matching together yields higher accuracy and lower regret than using any one of these sources with metadata. These results connect paradigm preferences to supervision budget, task format, and unimodal 5-NN accuracy. Target-task diagnostics thus support selecting among the three paradigms before candidate fitting.

</details>


### [518] [A Conditional No-Hair Theorem for Transformers: How Language Models Forget Their Prompt](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24133)
*Shuyang Xiang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文研究自回归Transformer在生成t个token后对提示词的保留程度，发现隐藏状态差异按幂律t^{-α}衰减，训练模型遗忘快（α≈0.55–0.7），未训练模型慢（α≈0.2–0.5）。证明了提示词影响的上界为O(P(log t)^{L-1}/t)，揭示了“条件无发定理”：提示词对下一个token的影响随t增长而消失，任何存活的提示词属性必须由生成文本本身承载。线性中继模型验证界限不可改进，稀释机制是遗忘的必要且充分条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解Transformer在长上下文中如何保留或遗忘提示词信息，量化提示词对后续生成的持久影响，揭示注意力稀释与中继传递的几何机制。

Method: 对比两个不同提示词后接相同续文的隐藏状态距离，测量幂律衰减指数α；理论推导有限深度pre-LN softmax Transformer在有界注意力logits和pre-norm激活远离零条件下的上界；构建可精确求解的线性中继模型验证界限紧致性；实验对比训练/未训练模型及logit bias干预。

Result: 隐藏状态差距按t^{-α}衰减，α=1对应均匀注意力稀释基准；训练模型α≈0.55–0.7（遗忘快），未训练模型α≈0.2–0.5（遗忘慢）。证明上界O(P(log t)^{L-1}/t)，线性中继模型复现未训练网络局部指数上升至1的现象。Logit bias抵消稀释可阻止或逆转衰减，证实稀释是遗忘的必要充分条件。

Conclusion: 提出“条件无发定理”：给定已生成文本，提示词对下一token的影响随上下文增长而消失，提示词的任何持久属性（如语言风格）必须编码在生成文本本身中。注意力稀释是遗忘的核心机制，中继传递仅能带来对数因子，无法改变幂律衰减本质。

Abstract: We ask how much an autoregressive transformer retains of its prompt after generating $t$ tokens.
